Role Title: Dimensional Metrology Quality Engineer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Dimensional Metrology Quality Engineers to contribute to a customer's project focused on advanced inspection and measurement solutions. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity involves evaluating and producing first-article inspection deliverables using 3D scanning and advanced metrology software, ensuring accuracy in scan-to-CAD comparisons, datum setups, and profile and position callouts. Your insight will help determine whether deviations arise from true part discrepancies or fixturing and alignment artefacts, supporting critical sign-off decisions on FAI reports.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and validate first-article inspection (FAI) reports derived from 3D scan data.
  2. Conduct detailed scan-to-CAD comparisons, analyzing measurement deviations and their sources.
  3. Set up, interpret, and document datum structures, profiles, and position callouts as per industry standards.
  4. Utilize CMM measurement techniques and perform uncertainty analysis for dimensional integrity.
  5. Differentiate between actual part deviations and artefacts caused by fixturing or alignment issues.
  6. Deliver clear, comprehensive written and verbal feedback to support decision-making on FAI sign-off.
  7. Contribute nuanced, high-quality metrology input to inform and enhance AI system development.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Expertise in Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) and FAI processes within manufacturing or quality environments.
  2. Proficiency with 3D scanning devices and inspection software (e.g., PolyWorks, GOM Inspect, or similar).
  3. Strong background in CMM measurement techniques and uncertainty analysis.
  4. Proven ability to interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, and technical specifications.
  5. Experience producing or approving FAI reports backed by practical metrology knowledge.
  6. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a keen attention to explanatory detail.
  7. Analytical mindset for discerning true quality issues versus artefacts introduced by measurement setup.

We are looking for an experienced AI/LLM Engineer (Model Fine-Tuning & Conversational AI) to join a fast-growing international technology company developing AI-powered conversational products. You will work directly with model training pipelines, datasets, evaluation frameworks and GPU infrastructure to improve conversational quality, personality consistency, contextual memory and multilingual capabilities.

The position covers the full model improvement lifecycle, from identifying weaknesses and preparing training data to running experiments, measuring results and deploying improved models into production. You will collaborate closely with AI engineering, product, web development and DevOps teams to deliver measurable improvements in conversational performance and user experience. The ideal candidate has practical experience personally fine-tuning and deploying open-weight LLMs, strong Python and PyTorch skills, and a solid understanding of post-training techniques such as supervised fine-tuning, LoRA and QLoRA. jobs.title: Buyer
jobs.excerpt: Leidos currently has an exciting opportunity for a Buyer to join our Shared Services Procurement organization.
jobs.description:
Leidos currently has an exciting opportunity for a Buyer to join our Shared Services Procurement organization. In this role, you’ll be part of a collaborative team that plays an important role in helping Leidos programs deliver solutions for some of our customers’ most critical missions.


As a Buyer, you’ll manage a diverse portfolio of procurement activities supporting programs and internal customers across the company. You’ll work directly with suppliers and cross-functional teams to source materials, equipment, and services; evaluate supplier proposals; negotiate pricing and terms; and place and administer purchase orders.


This is an excellent opportunity for a procurement professional who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, negotiating with suppliers, and taking ownership of their work. You’ll have the opportunity to expand your knowledge of government contracting and procurement while gaining exposure to a wide variety of programs, suppliers, technologies, and purchasing requirements.


Ready to take the next step in your procurement career? Join Leidos and build your expertise through challenging assignments, collaboration, and opportunities to learn and grow while supporting missions that matter.


2. Primary Responsibilities


As a Buyer, you will:


  • Manage assigned procurement requirements from receipt through purchase order award, administration, and closeout, as applicable.
  • Partner with program teams and internal customers to understand purchasing requirements, priorities, and delivery needs.
  • Develop and issue Requests for Quote (RFQs) and other supplier solicitations.
  • Identify and engage qualified suppliers and pursue competitive sourcing opportunities whenever practicable.
  • Evaluate supplier quotations and proposals for price, delivery, terms and conditions, and other business considerations.
  • Conduct price analysis and document fair and reasonable price determinations in accordance with established procedures.
  • Negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, terms and conditions, and other commercial considerations with suppliers.
  • Prepare, issue, and administer purchase orders and modifications within delegated authority.
  • Monitor supplier performance and delivery commitments and proactively address issues that could affect program schedules.
  • Develop productive relationships with suppliers while serving as a trusted procurement partner to internal customers.
  • Communicate procurement status, risks, and recommended solutions to program teams and other stakeholders.
  • Identify procurement and supplier risks and collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop practical solutions.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready procurement files and documentation.
  • Ensure purchasing activities comply with Leidos policies and procedures, contractual requirements, and applicable government procurement regulations.
  • Manage multiple purchasing actions and priorities in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment.
  • Apply sound business judgment and procurement experience to independently resolve moderately complex purchasing issues.
  • Collaborate with fellow procurement professionals and cross-functional partners to accomplish team and program objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve procurement processes, supplier performance, cost, and customer experience.

3. Basic Qualifications


To be successful in this role, you will have:


  • Bachelor's degree with 2–4 years of prior relevant experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, contracts, or a related field; or a Master's degree with less than 2 years of prior relevant experience.
  • Practical knowledge of purchasing, procurement, supply chain, or supplier management principles and practices.
  • Experience soliciting, evaluating, and/or negotiating supplier quotations or proposals.
  • Ability to analyze supplier pricing and other relevant information to support sound purchasing decisions.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and competing priorities while meeting established deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently on moderately complex assignments and exercise sound business judgment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to effectively work with suppliers, program personnel, management, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to analyze procurement issues, identify potential risks, and develop practical solutions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Ability and willingness to learn and effectively use procurement, purchasing, and enterprise resource planning systems.
  • Ability to meet any U.S. Person requirements applicable to the position or programs supported.

4. Preferred Qualifications


It would be great if you also have:


  • Experience purchasing direct materials, equipment, components or indirect goods and services.
  • Procurement or supply chain experience within the government contracting, aerospace, defense, technology, or other regulated industry.
  • Knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS).
  • Experience working within a CPSR-compliant procurement environment.
  • Experience conducting price analysis and documenting fair and reasonable pricing.
  • Experience managing competitive and sole/single-source procurement actions.
  • Experience negotiating supplier pricing, delivery schedules, and commercial terms and conditions.
  • Familiarity with government contractor procurement documentation and audit requirements.
  • Experience supporting multiple programs, projects, or internal customers simultaneously.
  • Experience managing supplier performance and resolving delivery, quality, pricing, or contractual issues.
  • Experience with enterprise procurement or ERP systems.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and analytical skills, including experience analyzing procurement, supplier, or spend data.
  • A customer-focused approach and demonstrated ability to build effective relationships with internal stakeholders and suppliers.
  • An interest in continuous improvement and identifying ways to make procurement processes more efficient and effective.

Why Leidos?


At Leidos, procurement is more than placing purchase orders. Our Buyers help programs solve problems, manage supplier relationships, negotiate business solutions, and support the successful execution of important customer missions. You’ll work alongside experienced procurement professionals while building skills that can support continued growth within Procurement, Supply Chain, Subcontracts, and other areas of the organization.


Bring your curiosity, business judgment, and drive to grow—we’ll provide the opportunity to put them to work.


If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

jobs.excerpt: This position will operate on a remote, freelance basis.
jobs.description:
This position will operate on a remote, freelance basis. Applicants must be located in the US or Canada.

Is your desk covered in Raspberry Pis, half-finished ESP32 builds and test prints? Do you run a 3D printer, tinker with single-board computers and keep a home lab going, and actually enjoy explaining what worked, what didn’t and why? Can you take a weekend project and turn it into a story readers can’t stop reading?

Valnet's Tech brands (XDA and How-to Geek) are looking for a Features Writer who lives at the crossroads of maker tech and computing. You’ll write first-person, hands-on features based on real projects you build, break, fix and improve.

We’re looking for a sharp, practical voice to cover these verticals:

  • Raspberry Pi & SBCs: Pi 5, Pi Zero, Pico and other single-board computers. Projects, setups, edge AI, value comparisons (SBC vs. mini PC) and community builds worth showing off.
  • Microcontrollers & DIY Electronics: Arduino, ESP32, GPIO projects, sensors and practical gadgets for the home and desk.
  • 3D Printing: Filaments (PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU and others), slicer settings, printer upgrades and monitoring, model management, and useful prints that solve real problems around the house, office and home lab.
  • Home Lab & Self-Hosting: NAS builds, TrueNAS, Proxmox, Docker, Jellyfin/Plex, and running local services on low-power hardware.
  • Mini PCs & Alternative OSes: Small-form-factor builds, Linux distros, and the odd niche OS that’s fun to explore.

Job Responsibilities

  • Contribute reliably and consistently under tight deadlines. Work includes hands-on features, project write-ups, tutorials, listicles and opinion pieces, plus timely news on Raspberry Pi and 3D printing launches.
  • Pitch original story ideas drawn from your own builds, experiments and failures.
  • Take original photos of your projects, prints and setups, and find and format images according to our guidelines.
  • Enter your work into our in-house CMS.
  • Stay current with maker, SBC, 3D printing and self-hosting news, including product releases, price changes, software updates and standout community projects.
  • Coordinate with the editorial team on assignments and feedback.

Application Requirements

  • CV
  • Cover Letter (tell us why you want to write for us, and what’s on your workbench right now!)
  • 2–3 tech articles you’ve written that best show your writing. Hands-on or project-based pieces are strongly preferred.

Applicants must have a self-starter attitude and meet the following requirements:

  • Relevant experience writing and editing in English.
  • Ownership of, and regular hands-on experience with, at least one 3D printer and one or more Raspberry Pis or other SBCs.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, the command line, and setting up and troubleshooting self-hosted services (Docker experience is a plus).
  • Comfort with slicers (e.g., Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer, Cura) and with diagnosing print-quality problems.
  • The ability to explain technical projects clearly and with personality, for beginners and experienced tinkerers alike.

Nice to Have

  • CAD experience (Fusion, OpenSCAD, Onshape, Tinkercad or similar) for designing your own prints.
  • Experience with Arduino, ESP32 or Pico projects, including basic wiring or soldering.
  • A home lab or NAS setup you actively maintain.
  • A background in IT, sysadmin or networking.

The hiring team will get back to you as soon as possible if we think you’d be a solid addition to the team. We only consider applications that include relevant writing samples.

About PrePass

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

About the Role

We’re seeking a BI Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team, reporting to the Manager of Business Intelligence. In this role, you’ll translate data into actionable insights that support business decision-making across the company. You’ll collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand their goals and objectives and deliver meaningful insights. This position is primarily remote, with occasional visits to our downtown Phoenix office, located directly across the street from Footprint Center.

Reporting & Analysis

  • Gather, analyze, and interpret data to provide insights and recommendations to stakeholders.

  • Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in tolling, bypass, device, and customer data.
  • Respond to ad hoc report and data requests submitted through the BI service desk across multiple business areas.

BI Solutions & Data Quality

  • Create and enhance Power BI reports, dashboards, and visualizations, including semantic model and DAX measure changes.

  • Validate report outputs against warehouse and source data before release to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and accessibility.

AI-Assisted Analytics

  • Use AI-assisted workflows to translate business questions into reporting artifacts (semantic model changes, DAX, and documentation), validating outputs for accuracy and policy compliance.

  • Begin applying simple agentic tools to single, well-defined tasks under guidance.
  • Review AI outputs for accuracy before use, ask informed questions, and seek out new AI use cases relevant to your work.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Process Improvement

  • Collaborate across the BI team to reach shared goals, and mentor teammates one-on-one as opportunities arise.

  • Ability to manage multiple requests from different stakeholders and explain findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor's degree (BSc/BA) in a relevant field.

Preferred

  • Experience using Git for version control of BI assets.
  • Familiarity with tolling, transportation, or fleet data.
  • Exposure to Python, Alteryx, or Power Automate.
  • Exceptional collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate dynamic environments and embrace change.

Benefits

How We Will Take Care of You

  • Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.
  • Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.
  • 401(k) plan with employer match.

  • Tuition Reimbursement Program.
  • Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts.

  • Company-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees.
  • Community Give-Back initiatives.
  • Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

Join Us

At PrePass, our mission drives us.

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

jobs.description:
As a Growth Manager, you're responsible for owning the growth motion for one of our brands end to end. You will set the strategy, ship the work, measure the outcomes, and decide what to build next. This is a hands-on operator role, not a manager-of-managers role. You will not be briefing agencies or waiting for tickets. You will be doing the work, with AI as your leverage.

The brand you join is an established product with a real audience and channels already in place, so this is not a launch. Email and lifecycle marketing sits at the center of the work, with conversion rate optimization alongside it, and content, social, and automation around both.

💡 Interested in applying?

🔍 Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.

Attention to detail is one of our core values! This is your chance to stand out :)

To love this role, here’s the type of person you are:

  • Hands-on operator. You enjoy doing the work yourself rather than briefing it out.
  • AI-first workflow is your bar. A campaign that used to take a small team a week should ship in a day or two through your AI workflow, without the output looking generic.
  • Velocity matters to you. Success in the first 60 to 90 days is measured by acceleration of output, how many things you ship, how quickly you learn from them, and what you do with the learnings.
  • Self-directed. You bring ideas to leadership based on data. You do not wait for someone to tell you what to test next.
  • Curious about new tools as they ship. You try them, keep the ones that improve the work, and drop the ones that do not, rather than waiting for something to become standard before adopting it.

Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Email and lifecycle marketing as the central engine: newsletters, lifecycle automations, segmentation, A/B testing across subject lines, copy, CTAs, send times, and offers. For several of our brands, email is the highest-leverage channel and the place where the biggest wins live.
  • Conversion rate optimization across landing pages, sign-up flows, pricing pages, and checkout. Hypothesis, test, read, decide.
  • Content and copy production: blog posts, landing pages, email copy, lead magnets, social content. Shipped at velocity with AI leverage.
  • Social presence on the channels that matter for your brand. Platform-native treatment, hooks, formats, and pacing tuned to where the content lives.
  • Marketing automation workflows in n8n, Make, Zapier, or equivalent. Connecting your tools into systems that run without you.
  • Weekly analytics review across GA4, email platform reporting, and channel dashboards. Identifying what is working, iterating on what is not, bringing data-backed ideas to leadership.
  • Working closely with the brand General Manager, product team, support, SEO, and the central Awesome Motive growth team.

Requirements

  • Operator background. 5+ years of growth marketing as the only or founding marketer at a B2B SaaS, or as the operator inside a small growth team where you owned full execution.
  • Real AI-augmented work. Specific workflows, specific tools used daily, specific outputs that AI made possible. Not "I use ChatGPT for research" but real systems.
  • Email and lifecycle depth. You have owned an email program at a SaaS company. You know the metrics that matter and have shipped programs that moved them.
  • CRO chops. You have run real experiments on real pages with real data. You can talk through your wins and your losses.
  • Full-stack execution. Copy plus landing page plus email plus campaign plus analysis. You can carry a piece of work from idea to live without waiting on anyone.
  • Hungry over knowledgeable. You learn new tools quickly, drop old ones without ego, and treat your skill stack as something you upgrade continuously.
  • Sharp communication. You work async with US-based teams daily. Your writing is clear, your updates are concise, and you communicate without needing a meeting.
  • Time zone. Minimum 9 AM to 1 PM EST overlap. Some brands have tighter overlap requirements.
  • If your strongest work happened inside a small growth team rather than truly solo, and you owned a meaningful slice end to end, tell us how the work happened and we will figure it out together. The bar is real execution ownership, not titles.

Bonus points if you also have:

  • Public proof of your AI-augmented work. A newsletter, YouTube channel, X presence, Substack, podcast, or personal site where you have written about or demonstrated your workflow.
  • Zero-to-one experience. You have built an audience, a brand, a community, or a product from nothing and grown it to meaningful scale.
  • WordPress ecosystem familiarity. You can stand up a site, install plugins, and ask the right questions. Several of our brands serve WordPress site owners, so this helps.
  • Specific revenue or growth wins. Numbers you can point to: ARR contribution, conversion lift, list growth, audience growth, revenue per send improvements.
  • A point of view on where marketing is going as AI continues to reshape the function, and proof you are actively investing in that direction.

Benefits

Working for a fast-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here’s what we offer.

  • Competitive Salary.
  • Term Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment for all full-time team members during their employment.
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance benefits for full-time U.S. employees.
  • Health Insurance benefits for all employees in Argentina, Brazil, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Jamaica, Kenya, Mexico, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Spain, and Ukraine.
  • Work from your home. We’re spread out all over the world – United States, Canada, Ukraine, India, Pakistan, Singapore, and more.
  • Flexible PTO after 90 days of employment. We encourage employees to take the time they need for a vacation, stay healthy, and spend time with friends and family.
  • Holidays (based on your location)
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • We happily provide or reimburse software you’ll need as well as books or courses that promote continued learning.
  • We cover all costs of company travel (including our annual all-company retreat and mini-team meetups).
  • Additional Perks include AM Welcome Box for new team members, Yearly Anniversary Gifts, and Technology Stipend each work anniversary.
  • We give you the opportunity to solve challenging and meaningful problems that make a difference.
  • Ability to work with some of the best people in the business through frequent, if not daily, interactions.
  • And in case you were wondering: no politics, no b.s., and no jerks.

LocationThis is a remote position - our team is spread around the globe! Our home base is in Florida, USA, so company operating hours are 9am - 5pm ET (UTC -5). While full coverage is not a requirement, you must be available during a portion of the day.

Job Description

Senior Product Manager

North Hospitality - Remote



Join the hospitality experts. Imagine delivering sophisticated hospitality technology, simplified payment processing, and award-winning support to some of the top restaurants in the U.S.



North is seeking a highly detail-oriented and technically proficient Senior Product Manager to drive the execution of our product roadmap and oversee the delivery of innovative, high-impact solutions in the payments and fintech space. You will serve as the technical backbone of the product team, collaborating closely with multiple Agile engineering teams to translate strategic vision into actionable, detailed requirements and deliverables. Daily decisions include prioritization, value, timelines, risk management, and functionality for the Developer Experience Team’s product. The Product Manager is able to understand not only the business needs and value, but has an understanding of the technical and system aspects impacted by the projects and business needs.


As the Senior Product Manager, you will dig deep into technical details, coordinate complex cross-functional initiatives, and ensure that our products meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and customer value. You will be responsible for managing and optimizing workflows using Jira and other product management tools, and will play a key role in aligning internal and external stakeholders. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on technical complexity, is relentless about details, can drive order out from multiple competing priorities, and is passionate about building products for developers in FinTech.



What you'll do:

  • Technical Product Ownership: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned product areas, from ideation through delivery and ongoing optimization, with a strong emphasis on technical requirements and system integrations.
  • Deep Technical Engagement: Work closely with Agile engineering teams (internal and external) to break down complex business needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Agile Leadership: Act as Product Owner for one or more products, providing clear vision, direction, and detailed requirements. Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, and prioritization using Jira.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Gather and synthesize input from internal teams (engineering, product, leadership, sales, and support) and external partners/customers. Ensure alignment and transparency around product decisions, progress, and trade-offs.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Develop and own processes and tools to collect, analyze, and present data that informs prioritization, risk management, and release planning.
  • Release & Roadmap Management: Own and maintain a detailed product roadmap and backlog. Ensure visibility and communication of progress, risks, and changes to all stakeholders.
  • Quality & Compliance: Ensure all deliverables meet North’s Definition of Ready and Definition of Done. Proactively manage escalations and communicate impact of expedited or unplanned work.
  • Continuous Improvement: Collaborate with other Product Managers and leadership to refine and improve product management best practices across North.



What we need from you:


  • Bachelor’s (BA or BS) or equivalent experience.
  • Four years previous experience as a Product Manager, Product Engineer, Product Analyst, or similar technical product roles.
  • Proven experience working with Agile software development teams.
  • Strong proficiency with Jira and modern product management software.
  • Product Owner Certification (CSPO, etc.) preferred.
  • Payments or fintech industry experience highly preferred.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and technical depth; able to dive into system architecture, APIs, and data flows.
  • Advanced knowledge of Agile methodologies and best practices; experience as a Product Owner on Scrum teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to break down complex business and technical problems into actionable requirements and deliverables.
  • Skilled in backlog management, roadmap planning, and cross-team coordination.
  • Strong analytical skills; able to leverage data to drive prioritization and decision-making.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering high-value products.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Innovative thinker who embraces change and continuous improvement.


Travel Requirements: Up to 20%

License and Certification Requirements: CSPO or similar Agile certification preferred



What we offer:


We offer a comprehensive benefits package that enables our teams to live a life well lived, both personally and professionally. Some of our perks include:

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) + Match
  • Education Assistance
  • Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave
  • Mental Health Support & Well-Being Program
  • Company-funded Lifestyle Spending Account


Salary Range: $115,000 to $135,000

Pay within this range varies by work location and on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process.



Who we are:

We are restaurateurs building products for restaurateurs. At North Hospitality, our team has years of experience working in, and for, some of the most renowned hotels and restaurants in the country. Now, we’re committed to bringing that passion to restaurateurs everywhere in the form of a single, seamless platform for all operations.

  • Maintain system documentation, configuration inventories, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

Do you love figuring out how things could work better—and then making it happen? Are you someone who can look at a complicated process, connect the dots between teams and technology, and turn it into something simpler, smarter, and more scalable?

We combine education, coaching, technology, and managed services to help estate planning lawyers grow thriving businesses while creating better experiences for the families they serve.

And we're growing.

We're investing in our Operations team to build the systems, processes, and infrastructure needed to support that growth. That's where you come in: We're looking for a Senior Product Operations Specialist who brings together technical expertise, strategic thinking, and a love of solving complex business problems.

This isn't a traditional project coordination or product administration role. You will serve as an internal operational consultant and business systems architect, have a meaningful voice in product development, lead cross-functional initiatives, and design and govern the operational systems that deliver our products.

If you love both the thinking and the doing, this might be your kind of role.

  • Memberships: Digital education, coaching, community, and resources that help lawyers build successful estate planning practices.

  • Advanced Growth (Managed) Services (AGS): B2B services, technology, and specialized support that help law firm owners get big law support without the big law lifestyle.

About PrePass

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

About the Role

PrePass is seeking a Sr. Product Manager, Public Sector to lead an enterprise-wide strategy connecting government needs, transportation policy, funding, research, pilots and procurement opportunities with PrePass capabilities.

This role connects Public Sector and Product, owns the consolidated public-sector roadmap and prioritization process, represents public-sector customers across Product, and positions PrePass to engage before programs and requirements are fully defined.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Public-Sector Product Strategy

  • Integrate opportunities across Safety, Innovation, Site Systems, 360SmartView, Compliance and Bypass into a unified public-sector roadmap.
  • Translate agency needs, policy changes and funding priorities into product implications, opportunity hypotheses and recommendations.
  • Evaluate opportunities based on customer value, strategic fit, roadmap alignment, funding potential, product readiness and organizational capacity.
  • Develop leadership decision materials that clarify value, tradeoffs, dependencies and the recommended path, then drive agreed product outcomes.

Deliver Public-Sector Product Outcomes

  • Translate contract commitments, RFP responses, grant deliverables and regulatory mandates into clear requirements for value-stream Product Managers.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Product Operations to prioritize commitments and deliver them on schedule.
  • Provide product expertise for RFP responses, state onboarding and renewals.
  • Define and report outcomes, including agency adoption, data quality, safety impact and contribution to renewals and new states.

Co-Lead Grants, Pilots and Upstream Development

  • Monitor and evaluate federal and state grants, research opportunities, demonstrations and pilot funding cycles.
  • Participate in coalitions with agencies, state DOTs, enforcement organizations, University Transportation Centers, research institutions, carriers and technology partners.
  • Identify collaborations and PoC requirements early so opportunities address public-sector needs and align with PrePass investments and capabilities.

Policy, Regulatory and Market Intelligence

  • Partner internally to assess legislation, rulemakings, standards and government initiatives affecting commercial vehicle safety and compliance, and communicate roadmap implications early.
  • Coordinate product input into RFIs, RFPs, public comments, research initiatives, standards discussions and related government opportunities.

Represent PrePass as a Public-Sector Thought Leader

  • Represent PrePass in relevant forums, including FMCSA, FHWA, CVSA, state DOTs, University Transportation Centers, IRP and IFTA committees, ITS America initiatives and autonomous vehicle task forces.
  • Build trusted relationships with leaders who influence transportation policy, funding, research, procurement and implementation.

What Success Looks Like

  • PrePass maintains a clear, current and actionable public-sector strategy and consolidated roadmap.
  • Public-sector opportunities are identified and shaped before grant, pilot and procurement requirements are finalized.
  • Product teams receive timely insight that improves planning and aligns funded pursuits with PrePass capabilities and investments, including voice of the customer.
  • Public-sector stakeholders increasingly engage PrePass as a trusted strategic, technical and commercialization partner.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in transportation product management, public-sector program development, transportation technology, innovation or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated success translating public-sector transportation needs into technology, product, pilot or program strategies.
  • Expertise in federal and state transportation funding, including identifying opportunities, shaping concepts, coordinating partners, developing scopes and leading proposals.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams to translate public-sector needs into actionable product strategies and measurable outcomes.
  • Established relationships across the public-sector transportation ecosystem, such as federal agencies, state DOTs, enforcement organizations, CVSA, University Transportation Centers, task forces, advisory councils or industry associations.
  • Ability to travel regularly up to 30% for agency meetings, conferences, task forces, partner development and industry engagements.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Public Policy, Transportation, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience, is a plus.

Benefits

How We Will Take Care of You

  • Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.
  • Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.
  • 401(k) plan with employer match.
  • Company-funded “lifestyle account” upon date of hire for you to apply toward your physical and mental well-being (i.e., ski passes, retreats, gym memberships).
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program.
  • Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts.
  • Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you).
  • Company-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees.
  • Community Give-Back initiatives.
  • Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

Join Us

At PrePass, our mission drives us.

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.

“The entire customer journey. One platform”

Every CM.com colleague, connects to our 4 shared values:

Drive and Lead

You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.

Grow and Learn

The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. You like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.

We work together and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. You value the social side of work, you show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being.

CM.com is building its go-to-market engine in the US, and we are looking for a marketer to help design it and run it. As Marketing Manager, you will work side by side with our US Partner Sales Managers and our AI Technical Solutions Consultant to turn our platform into pipeline through two motions: channel partnerships and brand-direct campaigns built around industry solutions.

This is a builder role for an early-career marketer ready to take on real scope. You will have a seat at the table, a US sales team that wants to collaborate with you, and the mandate to use AI to do the work of a much larger team. You will move between strategy and execution, across every pillar of marketing, and see your work show up in pipeline. This is a fully remote role for candidates based in the Eastern Time Zone.

  • Help architect the US go-to-market plan: Shape our strategy across the channel partner and brand-direct motions, with clear priorities, targets and a regular rhythm of measuring what works and adjusting.

  • Co-market with our channel partners: Work with the Partner Sales Managers to build partner-ready programs: joint value propositions, co-branded campaigns, onboarding and enablement kits, partner webinars and events, and co-marketing funds.

  • Own industry solutions marketing: Turn our platform into vertical stories for the industries we prioritize with Sales: messaging, use cases, case studies, landing pages and campaigns that speak to a specific buyer.

  • Be the US voice in global marketing: Adapt global brand and content for the US market and bring back insight on customers, partners, competitors and market trends.

  • First 90 days: You know our portfolio, partners and buyers. You have shipped a first partner co-marketing campaign and a priority industry one-pager, set a baseline for funnel metrics, and proposed the US go-to-market plan.

  • By 6 months: A repeatable partner co-marketing playbook and at least one industry solution campaign are live and generating measurable pipeline, with AI workflows noticeably speeding up how the team produces and reports.

  • Ownership and initiative. You have experience working independently in a hybrid or remote setting, prioritize well and follow through.

Our diverse perspectives fuel innovation and drive us forward. We welcome everyone, regardless of age, background, or beliefs.

Before you apply

We move fast and expect you to bring your own thinking. Priorities shift, AI is actively changing how we work and we embrace that reality. If that sounds like a great environment to you, we'd love to hear from you.

Note: For this position, we can only consider candidates who already hold a permanent work and residence permit for the US.

Corporate Travel Consultant (Parexel Team)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday, with a preference of working from 11:30 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday - Friday.

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 9 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts

  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability

  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

The Business Development Representative (BDR) Lead is responsible for overseeing the BDR team, driving lead generation efforts, and ensuring the successful qualification of leads. Sobre a GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH

Conheça nossa visão nas palavras doRonaldo, fundador e líder da empresa:

[Clique para acessar o vídeo]

A GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH é uma plataforma detecnologia e serviços especializados para o mercado de crédito. Unimos tecnologia de ponta à inteligência regulatória e operacional para estruturar produtos de financiamento e operações de securitização. Somos resolvedores de problemas complexos e nosso combustível diário é descomplicar o mercado de crédito: transformamos regras complexas em soluções fluidas que simplesmente funcionam.

Aqui, você vai entender na prática a engrenagem que move o mercado de capitais e de financiamento, desde formalização de CCBs e arranjos com correspondentes bancários até a estrutura de securitização e FIDCs.

Através de nossas unidades de negócio desenvolvemos soluções que operam de forma integrada e escalável. Por meio de APIs robustas, plataformas proprietárias e estrutura operacional especializada, conectamos originadores de crédito, investidores e esteiras completas de originação com precisão. Cada parceiro tem desafios e dinâmicas próprias, e nossa missão é arquitetar e sustentar a infraestrutura tecnológica exata para cada um deles.

Como pensamos (Nosso DNA)

Valorizamos quem tem BRIO!

Somos uma empresa formada por NERDs apaixonados por resolver problemas complexos com tecnologia inteligente. Atuamos com uma mentalidade de jogo infinito: não focamos em ganhar uma partida isolada, mas em permanecer no jogo, buscando desafios cada vez maiores e manter um aprendizado contínuo para ser cada dia melhor.

Na GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH, mérito e entrega real andam juntos. Quem gera impacto e fortalece o time será sempre recompensado. Nossas lideranças e time sênior são formadas majoritariamente por profissionais que começaram como estagiários ou em cargos júnior. Aqui, novas vagas importantes são prioritariamente preenchidas com pessoas da casa.

Nossos processos seletivos buscam futuros parceiros e sócios para a empresa. Para ir rápido, melhor ir sozinho. Se queremos construir algo grande, precisamos nos juntar a mais gente boa que pense como a gente. Dedicamos muito tempo nos processos seletivos para achar essas pessoas e entregamos desafios constantes para promover crescimento. Temos hoje comosócios da empresa, muitas pessoas que começaram em posições de base e mostraram que têm vontade de ser mais.

Fundadores [nossa base]

Uma empresa é a extensão dos valores e sonhos de seus sócios fundadores. A GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH foi fundada por quatro sócios, que têm como primeira formação a tecnologia, e são apaixonados por servir os outros usando seu conhecimento e por resolver problemas complexos.

Isso é GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH

  • Liderança e mentoria:aqui não temos "chefes", mas líderes que caminham lado a lado, incentivam e ensinam.
  • Voz ativa:a melhor ideia prevalece, não o maior cargo. Oferecemos espaço para testar, errar e aprender.
  • Autonomia e responsabilidade:valorizamos o trabalho remoto e a autonomia. Você tem liberdade para trabalhar de onde preferir e vestir o que for mais confortável; em troca, esperamos responsabilidade total com as entregas.
  • Evolução contínua:priorizamos nosso time para ocupar novas vagas e posições mais desafiadoras. Temos muitas pessoas que iniciaram como estagiários e hoje evoluíram para o nível sênior, alguns, inclusive, passaram a ser sócios da empresa.
  • Excelência técnica:nossa principal estratégia comercial é possuir a melhor tecnologia e um produto de alta performance. O resultado é a satisfação dos nossos clientes, que nos avaliam constantemente com notas acima de 9.

Isso NÃO é GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH

  • Não somos uma instituição financeira tradicional de "terno e colete puffer".
  • Não valorizamos hierarquias rígidas ou burocracias excessivas para tomada de decisão.
  • Não somos os donos da verdade; somosinquietos, curiosos e abertos a mudanças.

Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos pessoas capazes de se adaptar a cenários dinâmicos e com sede de conhecimento. Valorizamos a inquietude: a busca constante por evoluir processos e construir resultados melhores a cada dia.

Se você é apaixonado por solucionar problemas com excelência, busca desafios que te tirem da zona de conforto e nunca está satisfeito com o mediano, seu lugar é aqui.

Venha construir o futuro da infraestrutura de crédito com a gente!



Sobre a vaga

Você vai sustentar os três sistemas que rodam a nossa operação todos os dias: GTPayroll, GTFgts e a Central de Operações. É o posto de quem entra no código que não escreveu, descobre por que uma operação de crédito parou e corrige na origem. Quando uma integração com órgão público degrada, é você quem vê primeiro. Se você é do tipo que não sossega enquanto não encontra a causa raiz, e gosta de ser a pessoa que destrava o cliente, essa vaga é para você.


O desafio

Você vai nos ajudar a:

  • Resolver o que o primeiro nível não conclui, investigando logs, banco e histórico da operação até reconstituir o que aconteceu de verdade.
  • Corrigir na origem, com teste automatizado cobrindo o caso que gerou o chamado, em vez de repetir o contorno conhecido.
  • Enxergar antes do cliente, monitorando a saúde das APIs e das integrações externas e tratando fila travada, mensagem em dead letter e job que falhou.
  • Devolver resposta em linguagem humana para Atendimento e Operação, para que eles consigam falar com o cliente sem intermediário.
  • Transformar diagnóstico em conhecimento, documentando o recorrente até o primeiro nível passar a resolver sozinho.
  • Reduzir o próprio sobreaviso, tratando todo acionamento que se repete como defeito a corrigir e não como rotina a aceitar.

Quem buscamos

  • Capacidade de entrar em um código Java com Spring que você não escreveu, localizar a causa do defeito e corrigi-la sem quebrar o resto.
  • Investigação em produção: leitura de log, rastreamento de requisição e reconstituição de histórico a partir de dados.
  • SQL para consultas de investigação, incluindo join entre tabelas de operação e de evento.
  • Entendimento prático de HTTP, autenticação e webhook, com faro para distinguir falha própria de falha do terceiro.
  • Noção de fila e job agendado suficiente para diagnosticar mensagem travada e reprocessar com critério.
  • Disponibilidade para escala de sobreaviso e atuação fora do horário comercial em incidente crítico e em janela de manutenção.
  • Inglês suficiente para ler documentação técnica e mensagem de erro.
  • Experiência: mínimo de 2 anos em desenvolvimento ou sustentação de software em produção.
  • Qualidade: Clean Code e testes automatizados aplicados à correção, para que o bug corrigido não volte.
  • IA e produtividade: desenvolvimento assistido por IA aplicado à investigação e à correção, com assistentes de código e LLMs para análise de log e uso de skills, commands, workflows, agent teams e harness de agentes para automatizar diagnóstico recorrente, dentro das diretrizes de segurança de dados.

Vai ser um diferencial:

  • Experiência prévia em sustentação, suporte N2 ou SRE.
  • Python para script de diagnóstico e automação de rotina.
  • AWS: SQS, Lambda, CloudWatch e RDS.
  • Ferramenta de observabilidade usada para investigar e para criar alerta, não só instalada.
  • Atuação com SLA e ferramenta de ticket.
  • Vivência em crédito, consignado, FGTS ou meios de pagamento.

jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

As part of the GE Aerospace Digital Technology organization supporting the Defense & Systems (D&S) business, the Principal Technical Product Manager, Data & Platform owns the D&S Palantir Foundry environment and leads delivery across the technical teams that build on it and feed it. This person will own platform health, configuration, access and security markings, and ontology development for the D&S Foundry instance and the shared demonstration environment. This person will also be the program owner for 8+ platform functions (data products, platform support, predictive models, emerging technology, user-facing applications, and fleet data), managing the dependencies between them without owning the teams directly. The role also governs Foundry resources, cost, and Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) capacity, and owns the platform's access model, including enrollment of external customers. This is a senior individual-contributor role. It turns the D&S data strategy set by the Chief Technology Office (CTO) into a reliable, governed platform that the Defense and Systems Customer Experience (DSCX) products and our AI roadmap run on.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

Palantir Foundry Platform Ownership

  • Own platform health. Keep the D&S Foundry instance available, performant, and correctly configured, and own the platform roadmap that keeps it that way.
  • Run the demonstration environment. Keep the shared Foundry demo environment current, stable, and ready for customer-facing and leadership demonstrations on short notice.
  • Build the ontology. Drive ontology development in step with front-end work in Workshop and Contour, so the data model and the applications on top of it evolve together.
  • Manage the Palantir roadmap. Serve as the primary vendor contact for licensing, product roadmap, support escalations, and new capability adoption.

Palantir Foundry Resource, Cost, and AIP Management

  • Govern platform resources. Oversee compute allocations, ontology volumes, and storage across every Foundry usage account, and partner with the platform teams to keep resources optimized and fully visible.
  • Own cost attribution. Monitor, analyze, and manage platform consumption and cost down to the usage account, project, and ontology level, with proactive reporting and usage controls (FinOps).
  • Manage AIP capacity. Partner with Palantir to manage AIP utilization, usage thresholds, platform limits, and spend, balancing advanced AI capability against cost containment and operational stability.
  • Security, Access Governance, and B2B Enrollment
  • Own the access model. Own the Foundry security posture: design and maintain role-based access controls (RBAC), fine-grained security roles and markings, and scalable access provisioning, so every dataset and application is visible only to the people cleared to see it.
  • Control intangible exports. Define and maintain the strategy for intangible exports (export-controlled technical data shared electronically through the platform) in partnership with Export Compliance.
  • Run customer B2B enrollment. Oversee business-to-business (B2B) onboarding, identity federation, and enrollment workflows so external customers get secure, compliant multi-tenant access.

Cross-Team Platform Delivery and Dependency Management

  • Run the platform as one program. Coordinate delivery across Data Foundry, Platform Support, Insight Engines, Future Tech Labs, Digital Service Delivery, and Fleet Data Hub Support, plus the Data Flow Engine and Cloud & Solutions Design teams in the CTO organization.
  • Own the dependencies. Map, track, and resolve cross-team dependencies, and maintain a single integrated view of the platform roadmap and release plan.
  • Sequence releases. Partner with Platform Support on patch and release management for the D&S Foundry instance so changes land without disrupting users.
  • Bring models into production. Work with Insight Engines to integrate predictive models, machine learning (ML), and simulations into the platform and the applications that use them.
  • Move emerging technology to the platform. Partner with Future Tech Labs to take promising technologies from evaluation and prototype to deployed capability.

Data Products and Platform Strategy

  • Translate strategy into execution. Partner with CTO Architecture & Data to turn the D&S data strategy and technical standards into the DSCX platform roadmap.
  • Centralize critical data products. Work with Data Foundry to model, secure, and publish the data products and semantic layer that DSCX applications depend on.
  • Set the data quality bar. Define data quality, lineage, and governance tagging standards for the platform, and measure against them.
  • Build the foundation for AI. Make sure the data behind TrueChoice Defense (TCD) fleet management and supply optimization, and every AI capability on the DSCX roadmap, is defined, governed, and ready to use.
  • Platform Reliability and Compliance
  • Own the escalation path. Partner with Platform Support on Level 1 through Level 3 (L1-L3) incident resolution and own escalations that cross teams.
  • Keep the platform audit-ready. Drive Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) readiness and vulnerability remediation for the D&S Foundry instance, along with data governance and audit readiness.
  • Partner on infrastructure. Work with CTO Architecture & Data, which owns the Amazon Web Services (AWS) tech stack, the Data Flow Engine, and architecture review, so platform needs are reflected in infrastructure and data delivery decisions.

Leadership and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead without authority. Align 8+ technical teams behind one platform plan through clear priorities, transparent tradeoffs, and credible follow-through.
  • Set the platform standard. Provide principal-level leadership and mentorship across the D&S Digital Technology team for data platform management.
  • Improve continuously. Use FLIGHT DECK, the GE Aerospace lean operating model, to cut toil and shorten delivery cycles. You will need to be AI experienced and know how to use AI agents to help the platform teams deliver more.

Environment

  • The D&S Foundry instance runs on AWS infrastructure owned by CTO Architecture & Data, with data arriving through the Data Flow Engine from U.S. and international sources. The platform handles export-controlled and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) data, so access controls, security markings, and governance tagging are core to the work. The shared demo environment supports customer-facing and leadership demonstrations alongside the production instance, and external customers access the platform through B2B enrollment.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college with a minimum of 10 years of professional experience, OR Associate's degree with a minimum of 13 years of professional experience, OR High School Diploma with a minimum of 15 years of professional experience.
  • Minimum of 7 years of professional experience in data platform management, technical product or program management, or a related Distinct Area of Work (DAW).

Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience.


Eligibility Requirement:

  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.

Desired Characteristics:

Technical Expertise

  • Hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry (ontology, pipelines, Workshop, Contour, security markings) or a comparable enterprise data platform (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake).
  • Working fluency in data modeling, semantic layers, and data governance.
  • Experience managing consumption-based platform cost and capacity (FinOps), ideally Palantir Foundry and AIP.
  • Experience designing RBAC and identity federation (e.g. SAML, OpenID Connect, Microsoft Entra B2B) in a multi-tenant environment.
  • Experience with DevSecOps practices, cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), and secure platform operations in a regulated environment.
  • Experience delivering in an Agile environment (Scrum and Kanban) alongside engineering and architecture teams.

Business Acumen

  • Breaks complex platform roadmaps into sequenced, dependency-aware delivery plans.
  • Manages a strategic software vendor across licensing, roadmap, and support.
  • Connects data quality and platform reliability to the business decisions they support (e.g. fleet readiness, supply optimization).

Leadership

  • Aligns teams they do not manage around a shared plan.
  • Explains the reasoning behind platform tradeoffs.
  • Recognizes when a process needs to change and shapes it with the CTO and platform teams.

Personal Attributes

  • Finds important patterns in seemingly unrelated technical and operational information.
  • Sustains momentum across teams through setbacks.
  • Innovates and integrates new processes that add measurable value to GE Aerospace.

Key Success Metrics:

  • Platform reliability: Foundry availability, incident resolution time against service level agreements (SLAs), and demo environment readiness.
  • Data quality: critical data product coverage, data quality scores, and governance tagging completeness.
  • Delivery velocity: cross-team dependencies delivered on time and release cadence.
  • Compliance: CMMC and vulnerability findings closed on schedule, and audit readiness.
  • Cost and capacity: platform consumption attributed by usage account, project, and ontology; spend and AIP usage within approved thresholds.
  • Access governance: access provisioning time, access reviews completed on schedule, and customer B2B enrollments completed without security findings.

Location and Travel:

Location: Cincinnati, OH (Evendale), strongly preferred. Additional eligible U.S. locations include Atlanta, GA; Livonia, MI; and Niskayuna, NY.

Travel: up to 10% for vendor engagement, cross-team planning, and leadership demonstrations.


Note:

The base pay range for this position is $152,000 to $222,000 annually. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 13th, 2026.

Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Overview

Learning is where that mission gets personal. Our vision is Connected Learning: training, practice, and coaching that are always-on and tailored to each rep, grounded in what's actually happening in their deals. Because learning shares context with a rep's accounts, meetings, approved content, and skills, we can deliver what they need next, in the moment they need it, and show whether it moved the number.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead key parts of two of our strategic themes: Adaptive Training, which removes the manual work for enablement teams and gives every rep only what they still need, and Continuous Learning, which brings learning into the flow of work so it sticks. You'll partner closely with others PMs on the team.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll decide where the most valuable, durable opportunities are, place the bets, and own the results: adoption, expansion, retention, and revenue. This is a role for a PM who wants to run a business, not maintain a feature list.

What you'll be doing:

  • Run your areas like a business. Set the strategy and roadmap, choose the bets that create the most durable value, help shape how they're packaged and priced, and own the adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes that follow.

Our physician-led organization is passionate about supporting exceptional care and enriching the lives of patients across the United States. We envision the opportunity to create a scaled, cutting-edge, technology-enabled healthcare services platform that leverages a value-based delivery model.

Position Summary:

The FP&A Analyst is an experienced contributor to the finance team, playing a key role in the company's budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting processes. This role independently builds and maintains financial models, monitors performance against budget, and delivers polished reporting and analysis that inform leadership decision-making. This is a strong opportunity for an experienced finance professional to deepen their FP&A expertise and take on greater ownership within a growing, physician-led healthcare organization.

Responsibilities may include:

Budgeting and Forecasting:

  • -Lead the preparation of components of the annual budget and periodic financial forecasts, working directly with department and business unit leaders.
  • -Consolidate and validate inputs from cross-functional departments, ensuring accuracy and alignment with corporate goals.
  • -Track actual performance against budget and forecast, identify variances, and develop clear explanations and recommendations for leadership.

Financial Reporting and Analysis:

  • -Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
  • -Independently conduct financial analysis to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement, and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • -Build and maintain supporting schedules, dashboards, and executive-ready summaries for leadership review.
  • -Prepare revenue recognition reports as part of the close process, ensuring accurate accruals, cutoffs, and reconciliations across all practices.

Business Partnering:

  • -Serve as a day-to-day finance partner to assigned business units, providing financial insights and guidance to support decision-making.
  • -Proactively respond to data requests from business units and anticipate follow-on questions from leadership.
  • -Lead scenario analysis and ad hoc financial calculations to support business decisions and investment discussions.

Process Improvement:

  • -Identify and lead opportunities to streamline financial models, reports, and recurring processes.
  • -Maintain data integrity and consistency across financial systems and reporting tools, and recommend improvements where gaps are identified.
  • -Document and continuously improve FP&A processes and procedures, and help train junior team members on best practices.

Ad-hoc Analysis:

  • -Lead ad-hoc financial analysis and reporting as requested by the FP&A team or senior management.
  • -Provide analytical support for special projects, business initiatives, and cross-functional strategic efforts as needed.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

Experience:

  • -3–5 years of experience in FP&A, financial analysis, accounting, or a related role; healthcare or multi-site company experience is a plus.
  • -Solid understanding of financial modeling, forecasting, and budgeting techniques, with demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • -Strong proficiency with Excel; experience with financial planning tools or ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) is a plus.

Competencies:

  • -Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize large, complex data sets into clear, actionable insights.
  • -Confident written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present financial information to non-financial stakeholders.
  • -Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy and the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • -Strong business acumen and the ability to build effective working relationships across cross-functional teams.
  • -Experience with business intelligence (BI) tools and data visualization software (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is a plus.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands and fingers to handle or feel, as well as talk and hear. The employee is regularly required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is required to stand and walk. The employee may lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
