Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer (Azure)

Type: Remote Contract
Location: United States (US work authorization required)
Openings: 2 positions, including 1 Platform Lead
Start Date: Around December 1, 2026
Duration: Multi-month engagement, with potential extension

About Virtasant

Virtasant is a global technology services company with a network of over 4,000 technology professionals across 130+ countries. We specialize in cloud architecture, infrastructure, migration, and optimization, helping enterprises scale efficiently while maintaining cost control.

Our clients range from Fortune 500 companies to fast-growing startups, relying on us to build high-performance infrastructure, optimize cloud environments, and enable continuous delivery at scale.

About the role

We are building a senior engineering team for a large enterprise program in healthcare operations and workforce decisioning. The platform helps operations leaders understand what is happening across their workforce, make informed decisions, take action within the enterprise systems they already use, and measure the results.

We are looking for two Senior DevOps / Platform Engineers, including one Platform Lead, to design, build, secure, and operate the production infrastructure supporting this platform.

The environment will run within the client's own Azure tenant, handle regulated workforce and operational data, and support isolated production deployments for individual customers.

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring deep Azure expertise, infrastructure as code, cloud security, and production platform ownership. You will establish the initial build environment, develop the production infrastructure, and implement the automation, security controls, observability, and disaster recovery capabilities needed to operate a reliable enterprise platform.

For the Platform Lead position, you will also own key architectural decisions, establish engineering standards, and work directly with the client's architects and security teams.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain production Azure infrastructure, including subscriptions, landing zones, private networking, managed identities, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Monitor.

  • Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform or Bicep, creating reusable modules and automated provisioning processes.

  • Establish the initial build and development environments, followed by secure, production-ready infrastructure within the client's Azure tenant.

  • Design and implement isolated customer deployments, ensuring strict separation of subscriptions, networking, encryption keys, and data stores.

  • Build repeatable infrastructure deployment processes that allow new customer environments to be provisioned consistently and efficiently.

  • Implement secure identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID, workload identities, least-privilege RBAC, just-in-time access, and break-glass procedures.

  • Design and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines using client-controlled repositories and runners, including automated testing, security scanning, approval workflows, and controlled production releases.

  • Implement cloud security controls and support enterprise security assessments, penetration testing, compliance reviews, and vulnerability remediation.

  • Build observability capabilities across customer deployments, including centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, alerting, and integration with enterprise SIEM platforms.

  • Design and implement resilient infrastructure, backup strategies, zone redundancy, and disaster recovery solutions, including secondary-region failover capabilities.

  • Define recovery objectives, conduct disaster recovery and performance testing, and document results and remediation actions.

  • Collaborate with application engineers, security teams, enterprise architects, and client stakeholders to ensure infrastructure meets operational, security, and performance requirements.

  • Develop operational runbooks, infrastructure documentation, and incident response procedures.

  • Participate in production on-call rotations, incident troubleshooting, and post-deployment hypercare.

  • Take ownership of infrastructure throughout its lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

  • For the Platform Lead position, guide technical architecture, establish platform engineering standards, coordinate engineering activities, and represent the team in client architecture and security discussions.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Experience

  • Senior Azure platform engineering experience. You have designed, built, and operated production Azure environments end to end, including subscriptions, landing zones, private networking, managed identities, Key Vault, and Azure Monitor. You have personally implemented infrastructure rather than only maintaining environments designed by others.

  • Infrastructure as code. Strong hands-on experience with Terraform or Bicep, including reusable infrastructure modules, automated provisioning, configuration management, and infrastructure lifecycle ownership.

  • Security and regulated environments. You have built production platforms handling PHI or similarly sensitive data and successfully supported HIPAA, SOC 2, or comparable enterprise security reviews. You have participated in penetration testing, addressed security findings, and produced technical evidence for compliance assessments.

  • Identity and secrets management. Strong experience with Microsoft Entra ID, workload identities, least-privilege RBAC, just-in-time and break-glass access, credential rotation, and secure secrets management. You understand how to eliminate long-lived credentials from pipelines and repositories.

  • Multi-tenant infrastructure architecture. You have designed and operated customer-isolated environments with separate networking, encryption keys, and data stores. You can automate repeatable customer deployments while maintaining strict security boundaries.

  • Secure CI/CD engineering. Experience building production deployment pipelines within enterprise-controlled environments, including secure runners, environment promotion, approval workflows, container and dependency scanning, and coordinated releases across multiple deployments.

  • Disaster recovery and resilience. Hands-on experience implementing backup strategies, zone-redundant infrastructure, secondary-region recovery environments, and documented RTO/RPO objectives. You have personally executed and validated production disaster recovery or failover tests.

  • Observability and production operations. Strong experience implementing logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, security event monitoring, and performance testing. You can troubleshoot production issues, identify bottlenecks, and participate in on-call support.

  • Technical ownership and stakeholder communication. You can independently own complex infrastructure initiatives, explain architectural decisions to enterprise architects and security reviewers, and document operational procedures and technical trade-offs.

  • Strong English communication. You are fluent in written and spoken English and comfortable collaborating directly with US-based engineers, enterprise architects, security teams, and client stakeholders.

  • US location and work authorization. You must be based in the United States and authorized to work in the US. Occasional domestic travel may be required.

  • Available around December 1, 2026.

Additional requirement for the Platform Lead: Previous experience leading a small platform engineering team, establishing technical standards, owning architectural decisions, and representing infrastructure designs in enterprise client discussions.

Nice-to-haves

  • Healthcare technology experience, particularly provider, payer, workforce management, or other regulated healthcare platforms.

  • Snowflake administration, including customer-specific environments, private connectivity, customer-managed encryption keys, replication, and failover.

  • Experience operating graph databases such as Neo4j in production, including clustering, encryption, backup, and patching.

  • Experience deploying and supporting Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI, including regional data controls and infrastructure for AI applications.

  • Experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, or equivalent security monitoring and governance tools.

  • Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Azure Container Apps for production containerized workloads.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, scripting, and CI/CD engineering.

  • Experience supporting enterprise platforms with strict security, availability, and customer isolation requirements.

Our recruitment process

  • Recruiter interview (30 min)

  • Technical interview (30 min)

  • Client interview (45 min)

We strive to move efficiently from step to step to make the recruitment process as fast as possible.

jobs.description:
Same time zone as Europe. If you've worked agency or BPO desks on commission, you already know how this works, now paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Pretoria and across South Africa.

Read all of this before you apply. It's long on purpose. If this isn't you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. Everything grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • Direct contact with us whenever you have a question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

IT Support Technician
MSP (Microsoft 365, Active Directory, N-able N-sight RMM)

Remote | Philippines | Part-Time (20 hrs/week) | Php 30,000 – 40,000/month | 5:00 AM – 9:00 AM PHT, Mon–Fri (8:00 AM – 12:00 PM NSW, Australian business hours) | Long-Term Remote Role

If you’re a high-performing IT support technician who stays calm on a live support call, works to the clock on SLAs, and writes things down so others can follow them, and you want to work with a growing Australian managed service provider that values strategic impact over simple task completion — keep reading.

This isn’t a role for a “close the ticket and move on” technician who needs every step spelled out.

This is a focused, outcome-driven position where you’ll be the first responder for an MSP’s clients during the morning support window, resolving issues within agreed service levels and building the documentation that lets the business scale.

Why This Is a Dream Job

You’ll be working directly with the founders of a young, fast-growing Australian MSP who:

  • Champions Innovation: Runs a modern MSP stack (N-able N-sight RMM, TeamViewer, Microsoft 365, cloud services) and wants your ideas on scripts, checklists and RMM automations that cut repeat issues.
  • Values Your Growth: Supports relevant certifications and continued learning (e.g. Microsoft 365 or cloud), allocates training time on tools you haven’t used yet, and gives you a dedicated Success Manager (CSM) for performance coaching.
  • Respects Your Expertise: Wants a technician who owns the support window and brings a resolution plan, not someone waiting to be told each step.
  • Builds Stability: Is looking for a long-term team extension, with the option to move from part-time to full-time after the first three months based on workload and performance.
  • Includes Benefits: Health insurance (HMO) is included from day one.

You’ll get career transformation, direct visibility with the business owners, and the chance to shape how a growing MSP runs its support, without being stuck as an anonymous seat on a large helpdesk.

What You’ll Be Owning

This is a core first-line support role covering live phone support, email requests, user administration and routine infrastructure maintenance for clients that are mostly accounting firms and nonprofits. You aren’t just resetting passwords; you’re triaging every request against clear SLAs, keeping clients informed, escalating smartly, and turning rough notes into proper SOPs.

You’ll take the lead on:

  • Live Phone & Email Support: Handling urgent calls (helping the customer live where possible) and email requests through a structured triage flow: review within 10 minutes, resolution plan or escalation within 15 minutes, implement, inform the customer, log a timesheet.
  • SLA-Driven Resolution: Meeting acknowledgment and resolution targets across Critical (15 min / 1–1.5 hrs), Non-Critical (30 min / 2–4 hrs) and Non-Urgent (1 hr / 4–6 hrs) requests.
  • User Lifecycle Management: Onboarding and offboarding users in Active Directory and Microsoft 365.
  • Desktop, Network & Printer Troubleshooting: Resolving everyday end-user issues remotely via N-sight RMM and TeamViewer.
  • Daily Maintenance: Running server, email and Microsoft 365 maintenance checks, and raising and tracking tickets with cloud providers for affected clients.
  • Documentation & SOPs: Turning existing rough documentation into written SOPs for the most frequent request types, so a second technician could be onboarded from them.
  • Continuous Improvement: Spotting recurring issues and proposing a script, checklist or RMM automation that measurably reduces repeat problems or resolution time.

Requirements

This Role Is a Great Fit If You:

  • Are a Mid-Level Support Pro: You have solid IT support experience, ideally within an MSP or supporting multiple client environments.
  • Thrive on Live Support: You’ve handled live phone support and email ticket queues against defined SLAs, and stay composed with frustrated users.
  • Know the Microsoft Stack: You have hands-on experience with Active Directory user management, Microsoft 365 administration, and Windows server and email system maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot Methodically: You resolve desktop, network and printer issues and can clearly explain the solution. Expect real-world scenario questions in the interview.
  • Can Script and Speak Cloud: You have working knowledge of scripting (e.g. PowerShell) and foundational cloud knowledge.
  • Have Used an RMM: You’ve worked with an RMM platform (N-able N-sight preferred, comparable tools accepted) and remote-access tools such as TeamViewer.
  • Respect Access Boundaries: You work strictly within the access you’re given and handle sensitive client data with care.
  • Are High-Accountability: You don’t need to be chased for updates. You’re reliable, log your work consistently, and own your mistakes as much as your wins.
  • Communicate with Clarity: You explain technical issues plainly to non-technical staff by phone and in writing, and you document procedures by habit.
  • Can Commit to the Schedule: You’re self-directed and available for an early-morning shift aligned to Australian business hours.

Genuine differentiators (not requirements): Experience supporting accounting firms or nonprofits.

What Success Looks Like

After 60–90 Days:

  • SLAs Are Met: You’re consistently acknowledging and resolving client requests within service levels across every priority, backed by timesheet and ticket records.
  • Triage Is Second Nature: Every phone and email request follows the triage flow, and no request is left without a clear next step.
  • The Support Window Is Yours: You independently own first-line support, user on/offboarding and routine server, email and Microsoft 365 maintenance, with the founders involved only for escalations and site visits.
  • Documentation Is Built: Written SOPs cover the most frequent request types and form a library a second technician could learn from.
  • Trust Is Earned: You flag recurring issues and SLA risks before they become client problems, and you’ve proposed at least one concrete improvement to how support runs.

Final Word

If you’ve ever thought:

“I’m a solid, reliable technician who’s great with clients and good at fixing things. I just want a team that gives me real ownership, clear SLAs, and room to grow into a bigger role.” This is that role.

Let’s build long-term success — together.

  • Travailler sur des niches parmi les plus concurrentielles du web.

  • Des méthodes de travail modernes, assistées par l’IA.

    • Targeted Digital Advertising: Running performance-based ads to supplement organic partner traffic.

3. Content-Led Conversion

  • Case Study & Testimonial Engine: Systematically capture success stories from SMBs using the LXP to create "Social Proof" assets that lower the friction for new users to sign up.

jobs.title: Selbstständiger Vertriebsmitarbeiter / Handelsvertreter (m/w/d) für individuelle
jobs.excerpt: Du kannst Menschen begeistern, hast ein Gespür für gute Beratung und möchtest mit dem Verkauf hochwertiger Häuser richtig durchstarten?
jobs.description:
Du kannst Menschen begeistern, hast ein Gespür für gute Beratung und möchtest mit dem Verkauf hochwertiger Häuser richtig durchstarten?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Die Poll Massivhaus GmbH steht für individuell geplante Massivhäuser, hochwertige Bauqualität und persönliche Betreuung von der ersten Idee bis zur Schlüsselübergabe. Als inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen sind wir regional verwurzelt und verbinden die Erfahrung eines etablierten Bauunternehmens mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und persönlichem Engagement.

Für den weiteren Ausbau unseres Vertriebs suchen wir einen selbstständigen Vertriebsmitarbeiter / Handelsvertreter (m/w/d), der unsere individuellen Massivhäuser mit Leidenschaft und Überzeugung verkauft.

Aufgaben

Aus Wohnträumen echte Bauprojekte machen

Du begleitest unsere Interessenten auf dem Weg zum eigenen Zuhause – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

Dabei bist du nicht einfach Verkäufer, sondern persönlicher Ansprechpartner und Berater unserer Bauherren.

Das erwartet dich:

  • Du gewinnst neue Kunden und baust deinen eigenen Kundenstamm kontinuierlich aus
  • Du berätst Interessenten individuell zu unseren Massivhäusern und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen die passende Lösung
  • Du führst persönliche Beratungsgespräche, Hausbesichtigungen und Verkaufstermine durch
  • Du begleitest deine Kunden vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Beauftragung
  • Du erstellst Angebote, verfolgst diese konsequent nach und führst Verhandlungen
  • Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse und entwickelst daraus konkrete Baukonzepte
  • Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und pflegst dein Netzwerk
  • Du repräsentierst Poll Massivhaus bei Messen, Veranstaltungen und regionalen Vertriebsterminen
  • Du beobachtest den regionalen Markt und erschließt neue Vertriebs- und Kundenpotenziale

Qualifikation

Wir suchen keinen klassischen „Messeverkäufer“, sondern einen Vertriebler mit Persönlichkeit, Eigenantrieb und Abschlussstärke.

Du passt zu uns, wenn du:

  • bereits Erfahrung im Vertrieb gesammelt hast – idealerweise in der Bau-, Immobilien- oder Finanzbranche
  • Spaß daran hast, Menschen persönlich zu beraten und für ein Produkt zu begeistern
  • sicher, sympathisch und verbindlich auftrittst
  • ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und ihre individuellen Wünsche hast
  • Verhandlungen souverän führst und den Abschluss nicht scheust
  • selbstständig, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich arbeitest
  • unternehmerisch denkst und deinen Erfolg selbst in die Hand nehmen möchtest
  • über ein gutes regionales Netzwerk verfügst oder bereit bist, dir eines aufzubauen
  • mobil bist und einen Führerschein der Klasse B besitzt

Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung ist von Vorteil, aber für uns nicht entscheidend. Viel wichtiger sind deine Vertriebserfahrung, deine Persönlichkeit und dein Wille, erfolgreich zu sein.

Benefits

Dein Erfolg ist unser gemeinsamer Erfolg.

Bei Poll Massivhaus erwartet dich kein anonymer Konzern, sondern ein inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen mit kurzen Wegen, persönlichem Austausch und einem starken Team im Rücken.

  • Attraktives und leistungsorientiertes Provisionsmodell
  • Hohe Verdienstmöglichkeiten bei erfolgreichen Abschlüssen
  • Freie und flexible Zeiteinteilung als selbstständiger Handelsvertreter
  • Ein hochwertiges und beratungsintensives Produkt, hinter dem du stehen kannst
  • Individuelle Massivhäuser statt Häuser „von der Stange“
  • Qualifizierte Unterstützung durch unser erfahrenes Backoffice
  • Unterstützung bei Planung, Kalkulation und Angebotserstellung
  • Moderne Vertriebs- und Arbeitsmittel
  • Professionelle Unterlagen und hochwertige Präsentationsmaterialien
  • Persönliche Einarbeitung und fachliche Unterstützung
  • Zugang zu einem starken regionalen Netzwerk und spannenden Bauprojekten
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Austausch mit unserem Team
  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit mit einem familiengeführten Unternehmen mit Zukunft

Deine Chance bei Poll Massivhaus

Du möchtest nicht einfach irgendein Produkt verkaufen, sondern Menschen bei einer der wichtigsten Entscheidungen ihres Lebens begleiten?

Du möchtest eigenständig arbeiten, deine Kunden selbst betreuen und dabei von attraktiven Verdienstmöglichkeiten profitieren?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Werde Teil der Poll Gruppe und baue gemeinsam mit uns die Häuser, die Menschen wirklich wollen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.description:
About Ampd Energy

Ampd Energy is transforming how cities build - cleaner, smarter, and more sustainably. We are trailblazers in making the construction industry emission-free. Our products are advanced, compact, and connected battery energy storage system (BESS) designed to replace the dirty, noisy, and hazardous diesel generators that power construction sites around the world. By combining connected hardware with advanced software and AI, we reduce emissions, noise, and operational complexity.
We envision an emission-free future across all industries. Our mission is to develop robust, versatile, and easy-to-use products that deliver clean energy - empowering businesses and people to achieve more. We're seeking individuals who bring entrepreneurial drive, adaptability, and enthusiasm, and who thrive in an environment of continuous learning and evolution.

Ampd Energy is seeking a Senior Business Development Manager for the Benelux region to grow our commercial business across this region.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with direct responsibility for developing new customers, expanding existing accounts, building strategic channel and rental partnerships, and delivering profitable growth across the territory.

You will own the full commercial cycle—from market development and pipeline creation through customer engagement, proposals, commercial negotiation and close—and will be accountable for commercial targets for the Benelux region.

The role requires a high degree of autonomy and the ability to build trusted relationships at all levels, from project and site teams through senior and executive leadership.

You will work closely with Ampd's global Commercial, Application Engineering, Service, Operations and Marketing teams to develop the market and ensure successful execution for our customers.

Ampd Energy is a values-driven company, and we are looking for candidates aligned with our core values: Selfless, Never Satisfied, Resourceful and Bold.

What you'll do:

  • Own the commercial development and growth of Ampd's business across the Benelux region.

  • Deliver agreed revenue, direct-profit and commercial performance targets.

  • Develop and execute territory and strategic account plans aligned with Ampd's broader commercial strategy.

  • Build, maintain and convert a strong pipeline of qualified sales opportunities.

  • Identify and win new customers across construction, equipment rental and other priority market segments.

  • Develop and grow strategic relationships with existing customers, increasing penetration and share of wallet.

  • Identify and develop relevant rental partners, distributors and other routes to market.

  • Build relationships with key customer decision-makers and develop Ampd's presence across customer organizations.

  • Lead customer proposals, commercial negotiations and deal development within Ampd's pricing and approval framework.

  • Maintain accurate pipeline, opportunity and forecast information within HubSpot.

  • Provide clear and reliable forecasts, including opportunity timing, probability, risks and commercial outlook.

  • Work closely with Application Engineering to develop appropriate technical solutions and use cases for customers.

  • Coordinate with Service and Operations to support successful customer delivery and long-term account development.

  • Provide market and customer feedback to Product, Engineering and Marketing to support future product and market development.

  • Represent Ampd at relevant customer meetings, industry events and conferences.

  • Work collaboratively with the Business Development Specialist to develop pipeline and accelerate market penetration across Benelux.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • 8–10+ years of successful B2B business development or sales experience, ideally within construction, equipment rental, power, energy or industrial technology.

  • Proven track record of developing a territory and consistently delivering against commercial targets.

  • Experience developing both direct customers and indirect/channel relationships.

  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills with the ability to engage customers from site level through executive leadership.

  • Comfortable presenting innovative technology products to both small and large audiences.

  • Ability to quickly understand technical concepts and translate them into clear customer value propositions.

  • Strong CRM, pipeline management and forecasting discipline.

  • Ability to operate independently within a fast-growing international organization.

  • Fluent English required; Dutch and/or French strongly preferred.

  • Ability to travel regularly throughout the Benelux region and internationally as required.

Ampd Energy offers competitive benefits, strong opportunities for professional growth, and a collaborative, multinational work environment.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer
jobs.excerpt: As a senior engineer, you'll work across a diverse software portfolio—improving UIs, adding optimization workflows, fixing C++ bugs, and building MCP servers for LLM integration—rather than being tied to one product.
jobs.description:
As a senior engineer, you'll work across a diverse software portfolio—improving UIs, adding optimization workflows, fixing C++ bugs, and building MCP servers for LLM integration—rather than being tied to one product.

You will work across our software portfolio rather than on a single product. On any given week that might mean improving the UI of a simulation control tool, adding a new optimisation workflow, fixing a bug in a C++ codebase, or building an MCP server that exposes one of our tools to an LLM agent.

UI quality and AI-friendliness are both priorities here, and they reinforce each other. A well-designed tool with clear inputs, predictable behaviour, and informative feedback is easier for a scientist to use and easier for an LLM to drive reliably. You will think about both audiences. Part of your work will be making our existing tools usable by AI agents, designing tool interfaces that behave well when an LLM is at the controls, and building agent pipelines that integrate with our simulation workflows.

We also have new projects to start from scratch. As you build familiarity with the domain and demonstrate ownership, there is genuine opportunity to lead one of those projects end-to-end.

No prior background in simulation or optimisation is expected. The domain is learnable and we will support that process. What matters is that you are genuinely curious, pick things up quickly, and enjoy building tools that serious technical users depend on.

C++ Programming Language; BS in Computer Science or applicable experience; must be fluent in English.

Minimum 5-8 years experience in this type of role and preferably in the semi-conductor industry.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location, and the range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role-related considerations.

Depending on the position offered, equity, bonuses, commission, or other forms of compensation may also be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits.

WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Silvaco, we do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at 408.567.1000.

About Silvaco, Inc.

For over four decades, Silvaco, based in Silicon Valley, California and with global locations around the world has solved semiconductor design challenges by offering affordable and competitive TCAD (Technology Computer Aided Design) software, EDA (Electronic Design Automation) software, proven design IP (intellectual property), and world class support to engineers and researchers across the globe. Silvaco solutions span from atoms to systems: starting with simulation of material behavior impacting semiconductor devices, to design and analysis of transistor circuits, and lastly providing IP blocks for systems-on-chip (SoC) designs. Our solutions are deployed in production flows across broad industry segments such as leading display companies, automotive OEM suppliers, and top Memory, 5G, and IoT (internet of things) providers.

You hold decision authority for global process standards, procedural changes and system-level corrective actions within your assigned subprocess. You will lead an empowered user community, establish clear decision rights, ensure regulatory compliance, audit readiness, and will make measurable business impact.

Providing end-to-end Process Leadership

  • You will lead cross-functional projects teams to achieve milestones and objectives
  • You will ensure processes are aligned with regulatory requirements (such as US FDA 21 CFR, EU MDR) international standards (such as ISO 13485), customer expectations and internal quality standards.
  • You will lead periodic reviews and updates of procedures and training materials.
  • You act as the business owner for digital workflows and system capabilities supporting your assigned subprocess(es) partnering with IT to prioritize enhancements and ensure data integrity.

Engaging users and Stakeholders

  • You will facilitate cross-functional collaboration to resolve systemic issues and enhance product quality.
  • You will be a key opinion leader to set goals and objectives that align to the business

Deliver timely solutions and audit excellence

  • You will support Integer sites during audits including customer and regulatory audits as necessary.

How you will be measured:

  • Are an active supporter of the Integer Environmental, Health, Safety & Security programs
  • Reduce process variability
  • Reduce site-to-site deviations
  • Improve audit outcomes related to assigned subprocesses
  • Deliver quantifiable cost-of-quality and efficiency improvements linked to targeted process changes
  • Improve data continuity
  • Nurture an engaged community tied to your sub-process
  • Meet your defined Goals and Objectives specifying key projects and expected milestones to achieve

    • You will need to be able to query systems, conduct data analysis and communicate results in a timely manner that facilitates business decision making
    • You have expertise in process mapping, analytics and continuous-improvement
    • You are a proven change leader having achieved stakeholder alignment in matrixed and cross-functional environments
    • You possess excellent communication, ability to influence and negotiation capabilities
    • Your business acumen is excellent and includes an understanding of how the quality process impacts financials and operations
    • You have the ability to manage complex projects including the coordination of global rollouts with multiple workstreams
    • You are familiar with governance, compliance and industry specific regulations
    • You are proficient in leveraging technology solutions to achieve the best solutions.

You will also help grow the business by identifying expansion opportunities, building relationships with prospective studios, and supporting discovery, demos, and commercial conversations.

Business development and regional growth

Why join us

You will help shape how we serve game studios in APAC, with direct influence on customer outcomes, regional growth, and product feedback. This is an opportunity to build lasting relationships across the games industry while working closely with a global team.

Summary:

Kampgrounds of America, Inc. (“KOA”) seeks an experienced Corporate Counsel to join its Legal Department. In this role, you will serve as a trusted legal advisor to company leadership reporting to the General Counsel, providing comprehensive legal guidance on business transactions, corporate and regulatory compliance, litigation, risk management, franchise support, and organizational matters. This position offers the opportunity to work with a dynamic outdoor hospitality company with over 500 locations in the U.S and Canada, while managing diverse legal responsibilities in a fast-paced environment. This position is located either at our Home Office in Billings, Montana or remote and may involve occasional travel to other company locations, events and legal seminars. This role may require attention to urgent legal matters outside standard business hours. The successful candidate should be comfortable working independently while maintaining strong communication with internal stakeholders.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Contract Management: Review, draft, negotiate, and manage a wide range of commercial contracts, including franchise agreements, vendor agreements, service contracts, and operational agreements. Litigation Support: Manage litigation matters, coordinate with outside counsel, assist with discovery, and develop litigation strategies to protect company interests. Compliance & Risk Mitigation: Ensure company compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws; identify legal risks; and implement mitigation strategies across all business operations. Intellectual Property: Assist with the maintenance and expansion of the company’s trademark, copyright, and patent portfolios, including enforcement if necessary. Insurance Management: Oversee company insurance programs, claims management, policy reviews, and coordinate with insurance carriers, managers, and panel counsel. Employment & Human Resources: Provide legal counsel on employment and HR matters, including litigation, employee relations, investigations, wage and hour issues, ADA/FMLA matters, policies and compliance. Advise and assist with employment related policies and training programs aligned with company culture and values. Corporate Governance & Licensing: Support Executive Team on corporate governance (in both the U.S. and Canada) and compliance for KOA and its subsidiaries, including liquor licensing. Franchise Operations: Advise and support franchise related legal matters and ensure franchise agreement compliance. Legal Research & Analysis: Conduct legal research and provide written and oral legal opinions to business units.

Non-Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

This job description is not intended to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice. Key Competencies

Strategic Legal Thinking Negotiation & Problem-Solving Risk Assessment & Management Attention to Detail & Accuracy Business Acumen Team Collaboration Adaptability & Organization Integrity & Ethical Judgment

Required Education and Experience:

Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school Active bar license (State of Montana bar license preferred) Minimum 5 years of legal experience (law firm or in-house) Location in Billings, Montana or Remote Demonstrated expertise in contract review and negotiation Strong background in litigation management or litigation support Proven experience with insurance management, including coverage analysis and claims handling Substantive employment law experience General knowledge of corporate law matters and business operations Excellent research, writing, and analytical skills Exceptional communication skills with ability to translate legal concepts for business audiences Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment High ethical standards and a commitment to maintaining confidentiality

Preferred Education and Experience:

Franchising experience and familiarity with franchise regulations (FTC Franchise Rule, state franchise laws) Liquor Licensing and compliance experience and abilities to support campground alcohol sales across multiple jurisdictions Familiarity with Montana business law and regulations

Project management experience Experience working as in-house counsel is preferred Experience managing litigation and working with outside counsel is preferred Interest in outdoor hospitality and recreation (e.g., camping, RV’ing, glamping)

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

Work is performed in an office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboard, including lifting and carrying a laptop and other small items up to 20 pounds. Prolonged exposure to computer screens and artificial lighting. Use of repetitive motion, standing, bending, sitting, lifting, and walking short distances. Frequent in person interaction with KOA employees in various settings, where noise level is typically low to moderate, including office spaces. Will experience occasional interruptions and shifting priorities.

This is a highly visible, outward-facing role that requires strong relationship skills, disciplined execution, and the ability to operate confidently on the front line of the trade. The role is based remotely with domestic and occasional international travel. It suits someone who is highly self directed, prioritises effectively, and operates with flexibility across time zones, while maintaining strong connection to the broader organisation.


We’re on the lookout for a bold and brilliant human to chart big things down under. You'll need drop anchor at home in either Sydney or Brisbane to cover one of our most vibrant territories where we bring a knack for shaking up the norm, and a Virgin spirit that turns “why?” into “why not?”

Client Relationship Manager

Location: Home Based

Department: Customer Experience / Activate Collision Solutions

Contract type: Permanent / Full-time

We’re looking for a Client Relationship Manager to join our Customer Experience team!

The Client Relationship Manager is responsible for managing and growing key motor insurance and broker client relationships. Working closely with other areas of the business they will ensure the delivery of exceptional service across all departments in alignment with our operational and strategic goals.

Working closely with department heads, the Business Development Director and the Managing Director they will lead current client engagement including performance reviews, service innovation and continuous improvement delivery.

In addition, they will spot commercially viable opportunities for growth and the introduction of additional company and group services.

Activate Group is a growing UK business with 1,000+ team members nationwide. This is an exciting opportunity to build a long-term career with a company that values its people and offers genuine development and progression opportunities.

Key responsibilities

Client retention and development:

  • Own and manage strategic relationships with multiple stakeholders inside current client base.
  • Understand each client's business model, claims processes, cost drivers, and strategic priorities, tailoring our service offerings to align with their operational and commercial goals.
  • Lead service and performance reporting reviews, supported by Network Operations. Create presentations and reports for the purpose of the same.
  • Attending industry events with clients to promote Activate Collision Solutions and its proposition, galvanising relationships with key client stakeholders.
  • Represent Activate Collision Solutions with credibility and authority in client-facing forums, senior reviews, external events, strategic planning sessions and as required.
  • Build strong, trusting relationships across internal and external stakeholder groups, involving the right people early and communicating openly and respectfully to strengthen long-term partnerships.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex client issues, ensuring swift, high-quality resolution and sustained client satisfaction.

Commercial Performance:

  • Take responsibility for the retention, profitability, and growth of the client portfolio, delivering against revenue, margin, and volume targets.
  • Identify and pursue opportunities for account growth, service enhancement, wider group cross-sell, and innovation.
  • With the Managing Director and other senior stakeholders, Lead contract renewals, commercial negotiations, and tender responses, protecting and improving commercial terms where possible.
  • Monitor market trends, regulatory changes, and competitor activity to inform account strategy and keep Activate Collision Solutions ahead of the industry.
  • Use insight and data to inform decisions and direction, tracking performance against KPIs and translating analysis into clear commercial action.

Service Delivery and Operational Excellence:

  • Lead regular service reviews and performance reporting, working with internal stakeholders to ensure SLAs and client expectations are consistently met or exceeded across the business.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless, high-quality delivery.
  • Assist in driving continuous improvement in service quality, efficiency, and customer outcomes, challenging outdated ways of working and championing better ones.
  • Support the development of bespoke solutions, aligned to our core activities for insurer and broker clients.
  • Anticipate delivery risks early and remove barriers before they escalate, keeping progress on track and clients informed.

This role is expected to lead in line with the Activate Group Leadership Competency Framework:

  • Win Together — build strong, trusting relationships with clients and internal teams; involve the right people early, communicate clearly and respectfully, remove barriers between teams, and create an inclusive culture of collaboration and shared success.
  • Strive for Better — champion innovation and challenge outdated thinking; use insight and data to inform direction, welcome constructive challenge, establish ambitious standards, and continuously improve service and ways of working.
  • Make It Happen — take full accountability for decisions and outcomes; make timely, well-judged decisions even with limited information, set clear direction, remove barriers before they escalate, and deliver high-quality results at pace.

Skills and experience

  • Proven experience in customer account management with motor insurer and broker clients.
  • Strong understanding of motor claims, repair networks, and the accident management lifecycle.
  • Demonstrable track record of retaining and growing major accounts, delivering revenue and margin targets.
  • Proven success in contract renewals and negotiations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build trust at multiple levels.
  • Commercial awareness and analytical ability to turn data into action.
  • Experience presenting to external stakeholders and managing complex, high-value strategic partnerships.
  • Confident leading service reviews and presenting performance reporting, with strong data literacy (e.g. Excel, Power BI, CRM reporting tools).
  • Proficiency in CRM systems, reporting tools and Microsoft office packages (PowerPoint, Word etc).
  • Awareness of relevant regulatory and compliance requirements within the insurance and claims environment.
  • A self-starter, focused on successfully achieving goals, with a can-do attitude.
  • Flexible to travel to locations across the UK as required.

Benefits

We believe in rewarding our people for the great work they do. When you join Activate Group, you can expect:

• 33 days holiday, including bank holidays

• Personal health cash plan – claim back the cost of everyday healthcare such as dental and optical check-ups

• Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental pay

• Life assurance at three times your basic salary

• Free breakfasts and fresh fruit

• A birthday surprise for everyone

What you can expect from us

At Activate Group, we want everyone to have the tools and support they need to do their best work. We’re an innovative business that continuously reviews and improves our systems, processes and ways of working, making sure they support our teams to do their jobs effectively.

Every role at Activate Group is aligned to our wider business vision and purpose – making someone’s bad day better. You’ll understand how your role contributes to the bigger picture and how your work helps deliver excellent outcomes for customer and partners.

We believe work should be enjoyable. We make time to celebrate success, recognise achievements and bring people together at team events and company-wide celebrations. We’ll also support your ongoing development through regular feedback and career planning.

Whether you’re based in one of our contact centres in Halifax, Peterborough or Huddersfield, working at an Activate Accident Repair (AAR) site, or working from home, you’ll be part of a supportive culture where people are encouraged to succeed.

A bit about us

Activate Group is a fast-growing business approaching 1,000 team members nationwide.

We work with some of the UK’s largest fleets and insurance companies, supporting drivers that have been involved in road incidents through our contact centres in Halifax, Peterborough and Huddersfield.

We manage every step of the repair journey - repairing vehicles at our own Activate Accident Repair (AAR) body shops, as well as through a UK-wide network of trusted independent repair partners.

We also work with the UK’s largest vehicle manufacturers, supporting their approved repair programmes, and deliver innovative technology solutions to fleets, vehicle repair centres and dealerships.

Our purpose & values

jobs.description:
Directeur(trice) de comptes (Télétravail – Montréal)

À propos de nous

Chez GG TEQ, nous aidons les organisations à moderniser leur environnement technologique grâce à des solutions novatrices en matériel, logiciels, services infonuagiques et infrastructure TI.
Nous sommes une entreprise technologique en forte croissance où l'esprit entrepreneurial, l'autonomie, la responsabilisation et la performance sont au cœur de notre culture. Si vous souhaitez accompagner les entreprises dans leurs défis technologiques, bâtir des relations durables et contribuer directement à la croissance de GG TEQ, nous aimerions vous rencontrer.

Notre engagement

Chez GG TEQ, nous respectons votre temps.

Chaque candidature est examinée personnellement par notre spécialiste en acquisition de talents, et tous les candidats qualifiés recevront une réponse dans les 48 heures suivant leur candidature.

Aperçu du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Directeur(trice) de comptes dynamique, orienté(e) vers le conseil et les résultats, qui aime développer des relations, créer de nouvelles occasions d'affaires et conclure des ventes.

Vous serez responsable de l'ensemble du cycle de vente, de la prospection jusqu'à la conclusion des ententes, tout en accompagnant vos clients dans leurs projets grâce à un vaste portefeuille de solutions en infrastructure TI, services infonuagiques, logiciels et matériel.

Ce poste offre un potentiel de rémunération exceptionnel, une grande autonomie ainsi que de réelles possibilités d'avancement.

Ce qui définit le succès

  • Développer et maintenir un solide portefeuille d'occasions d'affaires.
  • Mener avec assurance des échanges de qualité avec les clients.
  • Atteindre et dépasser régulièrement les objectifs de vente.
  • Devenir un conseiller de confiance en développant des relations durables avec vos clients.

Responsabilités principales

  • Gérer l'ensemble du cycle de vente, de la prospection jusqu'à la conclusion des ventes.
  • Développer de nouvelles occasions d'affaires grâce à la prospection et au réseautage.
  • Positionner des solutions en matériel informatique, logiciels, services infonuagiques et infrastructure TI.
  • Comprendre les enjeux d'affaires des clients et recommander des solutions adaptées à leurs besoins.
  • Maintenir un portefeuille d'occasions d'affaires à jour et produire des prévisions de ventes fiables.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes avant-vente, les spécialistes techniques et la direction afin d'assurer le succès des projets.
  • Utiliser l'outil de gestion de la relation client (CRM) afin d'assurer le suivi des activités, des occasions d'affaires et des résultats.
  • Atteindre ou dépasser les objectifs de vente établis.

Qualifications

Exigences

  • De 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en vente B2B couvrant l'ensemble du cycle de vente.
  • Expérience en vente de solutions technologiques, TI, infonuagiques, SaaS ou de matériel informatique.
  • Historique démontré d'atteinte ou de dépassement des objectifs de vente.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, en présentation et en négociation.
  • À l'aise avec la prospection active et le développement de nouvelles occasions d'affaires.
  • Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement entrepreneurial en forte croissance.
  • Expérience auprès d'un revendeur à valeur ajoutée (VAR) en TI.

Atouts

  • Expérience auprès de décideurs en technologies de l'information.
  • Expérience chez un manufacturier ou un fournisseur de technologies.
  • Connaissance des modèles de revenus récurrents (MRR/ARR).
  • Expérience en vente consultative axée sur la création de valeur.
  • Connaissances en infrastructure TI, cybersécurité, réseautique ou services infonuagiques.

Rémunération et avantages

  • Salaire de base concurrentiel accompagné d'un régime de commissions non plafonné.
  • Vacances payées.
  • Journée personnelles rénumérées.
  • Ordinateur portable et équipement de travail fournis par l'entreprise.
  • Programme complet d'avantages sociaux.
  • Possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel et de formation continue.
  • Excellentes possibilités d'avancement professionnel.
  • Environnement de travail à 99 % en télétravail.

GG TEQ souscrit au principe de l'égalité en emploi. Nous valorisons la diversité et nous nous engageons à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif où chaque personne est traitée avec respect, équité et professionnalisme.

---

Account Executive (Remote – Montreal)

About Us

At GG TEQ, we're building the next generation of hybrid solutions by offering hardware, software, and IT solutions designed to help organizations modernize infrastructure and move faster with confidence.

We’re a high-growth, entrepreneurial team that values ownership, performance, and integrity. If you want to sell meaningful solutions (not just products) and directly impact company growth, you’ll fit right in.

Our Hiring Commitment

At GG TEQ, we respect your time. Every application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition Manager and you can expect to hear back from us within 48 hours of applying.

Role Overview

We are looking for a driven, consultative, and quota-crushing Account Executive to help us scale. You’ll own the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing and be instrumental in driving solution sales across our product stack. This role is comprised of unlimited earning potential.

This is a true full-cycle role where you’ll hunt, close, and grow accounts while selling a broad, high-demand portfolio of IT solutions.
In this role you will have the opportunity to have uncapped earning potential, a clear path to growth and leadership and be given high autonomy to provide high impact.

What Success Looks Like In This Role

  • You have built a healthy, self-generated pipeline.
  • You confidently lead customer conversations.
  • You consistently close deals and drive revenue growth.
  • You become a trusted advisor to your customers. We are in the business of building and growing relationships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle: outbound prospecting, qualifying leads, product demos, proposals, and closing deals.
  • Develop product knowledge across hardware, software, and cloud services to position solutions effectively.
  • Build strong, consultative relationships with prospects and customers to uncover business needs and deliver tailored solutions.
  • Maintain a sales pipeline and accurately forecast monthly and quarterly revenue.
  • Collaborate with pre-sales engineers and leadership to align deals with customer requirements and implementation timelines.
  • Use CRM tools to track activity, report results, and continuously refine sales approach.
  • Provide feedback to product, marketing, and operations teams to improve go-to-market execution.
  • Achieve set targets.

Qualifications

Must-Have:

  • 2–5 years of full-cycle B2B sales experience (preferably in technology, IT solutions, or cloud/SaaS/hardware).
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding quotas.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a growing team in a startup environment.
  • Comfortable with outbound prospecting and high activity levels.
  • Experience working for an IT VAR.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience selling into IT decision-makers.
  • Previous manufacturer experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with recurring revenue models (MRR/ARR).
  • Background in value-based selling.
  • Technical acumen or knowledge of infrastructure, cybersecurity, or networking.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + uncapped commission.
  • Paid vacation.
  • Paid personal days.
  • Company-provided laptop and work equipment.
  • Comprehensive benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional development and continuous training.
  • Excellent career advancement opportunities.
  • 99% remote work environment.

GG TEQ is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

Salary: $50,000 - $80,000 Base + Uncapped Commission

jobs.title: Principal Portfolio Project Manager
jobs.excerpt: The Opportunity:Avantor is seeking a highly experienced Principal Portfolio Project Manager to lead a portfolio of complex, global programs and capital investments within its Life Sciences business.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

Avantor is seeking a highly experienced Principal Portfolio Project Manager to lead a portfolio of complex, global programs and capital investments within its Life Sciences business. This role is responsible for both portfolio management and project execution, ensuring strategic initiatives are appropriately prioritized, funded, governed, and delivered to achieve business objectives.

The position oversees multiple large-scale CAPEX and business transformation initiatives simultaneously, including projects related to manufacturing, engineering, operations, EHS, PSM, IT, real estate, supply chain, and commercial functions. The successful candidate will operate within a matrixed global organization, coordinating cross-functional teams, external vendors, municipalities, and suppliers to deliver projects that meet or exceed approved business case objectives.

In addition to leading individual programs and projects, this role will manage a portfolio of strategic investments, balancing priorities, resources, risks, and capital allocation to maximize business value. Projects may range up to $100M, requiring strong executive communication, strategic leadership, disciplined governance, and a proven track record of delivering measurable business outcomes.

How you will thrive and create an impact


Portfolio Management & Strategic Prioritization

o Manage a portfolio of strategic initiatives and capital investments across Engineering, Operations, EHS, PSM, Real Estate, IT, Supply Chain, and Commercial functions.

o Evaluate, prioritize, and balance project investments based on strategic alignment, business value, risk, resource availability, and organizational capacity.

o Partner with business leaders to develop and maintain multi-year portfolio roadmaps supporting Avantor's strategic objectives.

o Facilitate portfolio governance reviews, investment decisions, funding approvals, and executive prioritization discussions.

o Identify portfolio-level risks, dependencies, constraints, and opportunities to optimize value delivery.

o Develop executive portfolio dashboards and reporting to provide visibility into capital deployment, resource utilization, project performance, and business outcomes.

o Ensure portfolio investments align with approved business cases, operational priorities, and enterprise strategy.


Global Program Leadership

o Lead and manage multiple concurrent global programs and CAPEX projects across manufacturing and operational domains.

o Drive end-to-end project execution from concept through commissioning, qualification, startup, and operational handover.

o Ensure programs align with Avantor's strategic objectives, operational priorities, and Life Sciences growth initiatives.

o Lead global cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority to achieve program objectives.


CAPEX & Manufacturing Project Execution

o Manage projects involving process equipment, assembly systems, manufacturing technologies, automation, and facility infrastructure across global locations.

o Lead facility expansions, process improvements, equipment installations, operational efficiency projects, and capital investment programs.

o Support projects focused on EHS, PSM, IT, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Real Estate initiatives.

o Ensure technical solutions meet quality, compliance, safety, operational, and business requirements.

o Manage projects and programs that may exceed $50M in capital investment.


Stage-Gate Governance

o Drive projects through a structured stage-gate process, ensuring appropriate documentation, stakeholder engagement, approvals, and governance at each phase.

o Prepare and present business cases, project charters, gate reviews, and investment recommendations to senior leadership.

o Support enterprise portfolio governance processes to ensure projects are appropriately prioritized, funded, and aligned with corporate objectives.

o Lead executive reviews and provide recommendations regarding project continuation, acceleration, modification, or termination.

Financial & Schedule Management

o Maintain rigorous control of project budgets, forecasts, schedules, risks, and financial performance.

o Manage portfolio-level capital planning, forecasting, cash flow projections, and benefit realization tracking.

o Ensure projects achieve approved business case objectives and KPI targets.

o Develop and manage integrated schedules, proactively identifying and mitigating risks affecting cost and timing.

o Optimize allocation of capital and resources across competing initiatives.


Business Case Development & Benefits Realization

o Develop, validate, and maintain project business cases and investment justifications.

o Establish measurable KPIs and benefit realization targets for each initiative.

o Track actual business performance against approved commitments following implementation.

o Ensure projects deliver expected productivity, capacity, quality, compliance, cost reduction, and revenue objectives.


Stakeholder & Vendor Management

o Collaborate with stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Commercial, EHS, and IT organizations.

o Manage relationships with external contractors, equipment suppliers, engineering firms, consultants, regulatory agencies, and municipalities.

o Support procurement activities, vendor selection processes, contract negotiations, and supplier performance management.


Leadership & Team Management

o Provide direct and indirect leadership to project teams across multiple regions and business functions.

o Influence stakeholders and leaders within a highly matrixed organization.

o Foster collaboration, accountability, transparency, and execution excellence.

o Mentor and coach project managers and team members on project management best practices.


Executive Communication & Influence

o Communicate project, program, and portfolio performance clearly and effectively to executive leadership.

o Deliver concise, data-driven reporting on portfolio health, capital deployment, project status, risks, and business outcomes.

o Build strong relationships with senior leaders and external partners.

o Present complex technical and business issues in a manner that supports informed decision-making and organizational alignment.


Change Management & Organizational Readiness

o Drive stakeholder engagement, communication planning, organizational readiness, and adoption activities.

o Ensure business operations are prepared to successfully transition into new processes, systems, and facility capabilities.

o Support sustainable implementation and realization of expected business benefits.


Independent Judgment & Advanced Problem Solving

o Operate with a high degree of autonomy and accountability.

o Independently plan and execute work while addressing complex issues, risks, and deviations.

o Analyze ambiguous situations involving operational, financial, technical, and organizational considerations.

o Apply strategic thinking and sound judgment to develop scalable solutions.

o Make significant recommendations regarding investment priorities, resource allocation, and execution strategies.

Expertise, Thought Leadership & Development

o Serve as a subject matter expert in portfolio management, capital program execution, project governance, and PMO best practices.

o Contribute to continuous improvement of project management methodologies, stage-gate processes, governance frameworks, and portfolio management practices.

o Provide coaching, mentoring, and informal training across the PMO organization.


What we're looking for


o Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Operations, Manufacturing, Business, or related discipline.

o Minimum of 12 years of progressive project, program, and portfolio management experience, including leadership of global CAPEX projects and strategic business initiatives.

o Demonstrated success managing large-scale capital projects and cross-functional business programs.

o PMP certification from the Project Management Institute (PMI), or willingness to obtain within a defined timeframe.

Preferred

o Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration (MBA), Project Management, or related discipline.

o Experience in Life Sciences, pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, specialty chemicals, or similarly regulated industries.

Portfolio Management

o Proven experience managing portfolios of strategic initiatives and capital investments.

o Strong understanding of portfolio governance, prioritization methodologies, capital planning, and resource optimization.

o Ability to balance competing priorities and recommend investments that maximize organizational value.

o Experience providing executive portfolio reporting and facilitating investment decisions.

Strategic & Conceptual Thinking

o Strong understanding of business strategy, operations, financial planning, and organizational goals.

o Ability to translate complex business challenges into executable solutions.

o Capable of evaluating long-term implications of investment decisions.


Project & Program Mastery

o Extensive knowledge of project management principles and lifecycle methodologies.

o Proven ability to manage scope, schedule, budget, resources, and risk across global programs.

o Strong record of delivering large-scale, multi-site CAPEX initiatives.


Leadership & Influence

o Ability to lead multiple projects and programs simultaneously.

o Skilled at influencing leaders and teams without direct authority.

o Trusted advisor to senior stakeholders.


Communication & Executive Presence

o Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.

o Strong presentation and facilitation capabilities.

o Ability to communicate effectively with executives, business leaders, and technical teams.


Collaboration & External Engagement

o Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.

o Experience working with contractors, vendors, engineering firms, regulators, and municipalities.

o Ability to develop productive partnerships across diverse stakeholder groups.

Dare to go further in your career. Join our global team of 14,000+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life-changing science.

The work we do changes people's lives for the better. It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle.
