jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Senior - Data & Analytics
jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community The Senior Data Engineer Designs, builds, and maintains data processing architectures and solutions enabling the efficient conversion of structured and unstructured data to insights at enterprise scale.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Data Engineer Designs, builds, and maintains data processing architectures and solutions enabling the efficient conversion of structured and unstructured data to insights at enterprise scale. The Senior Data Engineer work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

Overview

Humana is seeking a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to support our mission of improving the health and well-being of our consumers. This role will focus on building scalable, secure, data & analytics solutions that power analytics, clinical insights, and business decision-making across the enterprise. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, this individual will work directly alongside business and analytics stakeholders, translating real-world problems into working solutions quickly and driving adoption across the enterprise. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with cloud-based data platforms, Databricks, PostgreSQL, and healthcare data, with a passion for delivering high-quality, trusted data solutions in a regulated environment.

Key Responsibilities

Data & ML Engineering

  • Develop scalable and cost-efficient Data & ML solutions using Databricks (Spark) and cloud-native services
  • Build and optimize ETL/ELT workflows for ingesting structured and unstructured healthcare data (claims, clinical, provider, and consumer data)
  • Develop and maintain data models in enterprise data warehouses
  • Support Lakehouse architecture leveraging Databricks, Delta Lake, and cloud storage

Advanced Data Processing

  • Build real-time and batch pipelines for analytics and operational use cases
  • Develop data transformations using PySpark and SQL within Databricks
  • Integrate data from APIs, third-party vendors, and internal systems

AI & Advanced Analytics (Databricks Genie)

  • Leverage Databricks Genie (AI/BI capabilities) to enable natural language querying and democratize data access for business stakeholders
  • Design and optimize semantic layers and governed datasets that power Genie-driven insights with trusted, high-quality data
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business questions into AI-assisted analytics workflows using Databricks
  • Ensure AI outputs are accurate, explainable, and compliant with healthcare data governance and HIPAA requirements

Technical Leadership

  • Lead design and architecture discussions for enterprise scale solutions
  • Establish and enforce best practices in data & ML engineering, testing, and CI/CD

Collaboration & Customer-Facing Delivery

  • Serve as the embedded, customer-facing engineer for assigned business or analytical teams, working directly with end users, to understand existing capabilities & workflows, pain points, and success criteria
  • Lead requirements discovery end-to-end: run working sessions and discovery workshops, translate ambiguous, evolving business problems into concrete technical specifications and delivery plans
  • Rapidly prototype, configure, and demo solutions to stakeholders to validate direction early and de-risk larger investments
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to business and clinical stakeholders, balancing engineering rigor with pragmatic, fast-turnaround delivery to accelerate time-to-value and drive adoption of new tools and datasets
  • Drive post-launch adoption by training end users, gathering hands-on usage feedback, and iterating quickly on delivered solutions in response to that feedback
  • Blend engineering, product discovery, and solution delivery skills, partnering with product, UX, and business SMEs to identify and ship solutions rapidly

Healthcare Data & Compliance

  • Work with healthcare datasets, including producer/agent, broker, commission, and distribution data, ensuring proper ingestion, normalization, and optimization for analytics and reporting
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, HITECH, and enterprise data governance policies
  • Implement data security, encryption, masking, and access controls
  • Maintain data lineage, auditability, and regulatory reporting readiness


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in building cloud-native Data & ML engineering solutions
  • 5+ years of programming experience in Python (PySpark) and SQL
  • 3+ years of experience in deploying data & feature pipelines, model training, and inferencing within the Databricks stack
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with:
    • Databricks
    • PostgreSQL
    • Distributed data processing frameworks (Apache Spark)
    • Databricks ML stack including MLflow, Databricks Notebook, Runtime ML, etc.
    • Demonstrated ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical business and clinical stakeholders, and to rapidly translate ambiguous, in-the-field requirements into a working solution

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare or insurance industry (payer experience strongly preferred)
  • Familiarity with healthcare standards (e.g., FHIR, HL7)
  • Prior experience in a customer-facing, consulting, solutions engineering, or forward-deployed engineering role, engaging directly with end users to gather requirements, run demos, and deliver solutions on tight timelines
  • Experience with:
  • Delta Lake / Lakehouse architecture
  • Orchestration tools (Airflow, Azure Data Factory)
  • Streaming (Kafka, Event Hubs)
  • Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions)
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$117,600 - $161,700 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

jobs.excerpt: Director of Events & Field MarketingReports to: Chief Marketing Officer Location: Remote (New England Area Preferred) Travel: Approximately 25–35%, concentrated around peak event periods About the RoleWe’re hiring a Director of Events & Field Marketing to own how CallMiner shows up in person and in-region across North America and EMEA.
jobs.description:
Director of Events & Field Marketing

Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer

Location: Remote (New England Area Preferred)

Travel: Approximately 25–35%, concentrated around peak event periods

About the Role

We’re hiring a Director of Events & Field Marketing to own how CallMiner shows up in person and in-region across North America and EMEA. Reporting to the CMO and leading a small events team, you’ll run our annual customer conferences, a global trade show program, and an ABM-aligned field program of executive dinners, roundtables, and partner events, all measured against clear pipeline and revenue targets. This is a player-coach role: you’ll set strategy and roll up your sleeves on execution.

Strategic thinking, creativity, and cross-functional collaboration are central to this role. You’ll bring marketing, sales, and customer success partners together for every event to create world-class experiences that represent our brand and stand apart from the pack. 

Your program will span:

  • Hosted conferences, including our annual customer conferences in North America and EMEA
  • Trade shows and industry conferences
  • Regional field marketing events and programs, such as executive dinners, roundtables, lunch-and-learns, sponsorships, and ABM-aligned activations
  • Webinars
  • Channel and customer co-marketing events

What You’ll Do

Strategy, Pipeline & Budget

  • Develop the annual events and webinar strategy for North America and EMEA, built around incremental pipeline targets and pipeline acceleration and influence targets set each year in Q1.
  • Own the global events and field marketing budget across multiple currencies, including vendor selection and negotiation.
  • Partner with our local EMEA marketing team on localized execution, retaining ownership of EMEA events and field strategy and budget.
  • Stay current on events and field marketing best practices and shifts in the market and adjust strategy and tactics to stay effective.

Flagship Events & Trade Shows

  • Lead the strategy, development, and execution of our annual customer conferences, including LISTEN in North America and EMEA.
  • Lead the cross-functional effort behind each flagship event, working with marketing, sales, customer success, and product stakeholders on content and every element of a great event experience.
  • Own our trade show and industry conference program from selection through post-event follow-up.
  • Manage all event logistics and operations, and ensure booth design, event content, and promotion reflect our brand standards and differentiate us.

Regional Field Marketing & ABM

  • Partner with sales leadership to develop semi-annual regional field marketing programs in North America and EMEA, tied to incremental pipeline and pipeline acceleration targets.
  • Integrate events, field programs, and swag and gifting into broader account-based marketing (ABM) campaign sequences.
  • Develop an integrated attendance plan for each event and lead its execution.
  • Partner with demand generation, BDR, and sales teams on pre-event promotion and post-event follow-up.

Customer & Partner Programs

  • Work with customer success and channel teams to plan customer and channel enablement and co-marketing events.
  • Provide logistical support to customer success for Customer Advisory Board (CAB) meetings.

Measurement & Reporting

  • Lead ongoing analysis of event and field marketing performance, including promotion effectiveness and ROI at both the campaign and aggregate level.
  • Report results and recommendations to the CMO and revenue leadership.

Team Leadership

About the Role

BreachLock is a penetration testing and security testing company. You will be the main point of contact for the client and the bridge to our technical team, and you will also manage a renewal and deal pipeline sourced from sales and from past SOWs.

Customer Success Lifecycle

You will manage each client account through the BreachLock customer success lifecycle:

  • Onboarding: kickoff, scoping, access and platform setup, and confirming the first test timeline with the client.
  • Engagement: keeping the client informed through testing, report publication, findings walkthroughs, remediation support and retests.
  • Upsell and Renewal: starting renewal and expansion conversations early, preparing quotes and SOW inputs, and working toward closure before subscription dates.
  • Nurture: staying in regular contact between engagements to keep clients active and ready for the next cycle.

Responsibilities: Onboarded Clients

  • Take ownership of assigned onboardings and client accounts from handover through the full lifecycle.
  • Run kickoff and onboarding calls, collect scoping information, confirm timelines, and set expectations on the platform and testing process.
  • Act as project manager for each engagement: track milestones, dates and open items, and keep internal teams and the client aligned.
  • Coordinate with the technical team to schedule pen tests and retests, and confirm test windows with the client.
  • Follow up with clients regularly on testing progress, findings, report delivery and retest status.
  • Coordinate report publication with the technical team once testing is complete, and walk clients through findings and remediation steps.
  • Escalate risks, blockers and SLA concerns early and track them to resolution.

Responsibilities: Renewal and Deal Pipeline

  • Manage your own renewal and deal pipeline, including deals and SOWs handed over from sales and renewals from past engagements, not only the accounts you onboarded.
  • Balance onboarding and engagement work with pipeline activity, prioritising by renewal date and deal value.
  • Reach out to clients and prospects regularly to move deals forward. Do not wait for clients to come to you.
  • Prepare quotes, SOW inputs and commercial follow-ups, and drive deals to close.
  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities such as additional tests, retests and new modules.
  • Keep deal stages, notes, next steps and forecasts accurate in HubSpot.

Requirements

Requirements (Must Have)

  • 3+ years in customer success, account management, or project/delivery coordination, ideally in SaaS or security services.
  • Proven experience managing multiple client accounts and a renewal or deal pipeline at the same time.
  • Strong, clear business English, both written and verbal. You will write client emails, prepare proposals and run calls daily.
  • Consistent, proactive client outreach with a clear follow-up cadence.
  • Strong organisation and time management, with the ability to work independently across time zones.

Good to Have (Preferred)

  • Basic working knowledge of HubSpot (contacts, deals, pipelines, tasks and notes).
  • Sales experience, especially in renewals, upsell or account expansion.
  • Basic understanding of cybersecurity concepts such as penetration testing, vulnerability management, web and API security, and security reports.
  • Cloud knowledge from working with cloud hosting or infrastructure providers, which helps when discussing client environments and scoping.
  • Experience with project management tools or methods (timelines, status reporting, RACI).

Working Hours and Location

Location: India. Shift: 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST, which is 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Standard Time.

Hours follow US Eastern time, so the shift moves by one hour during US daylight saving time.

What We Look For

A proactive, organised communicator who runs client accounts end to end, reaches out to clients on a regular cadence without waiting to be prompted, works a renewal pipeline with discipline, and communicates clearly in professional English, both written and spoken.

jobs.title: Expert RAG Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for an Expert RAG Engineer to design, build, and own the retrieval-augmented generation systems behind our AI products.
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Expert RAG Engineer to design, build, and own the retrieval-augmented generation systems behind our AI products. Your core work will be architecting production-grade RAG pipelines end to end: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, evaluation, and serving on top of open-source LLMs (Ollama, llama.cpp) in cloud, on-prem, and air-gapped environments.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You’ll define RAG architecture standards, make the key technical decisions on retrieval quality, latency, and cost, and provide technical guidance to AI Developers on the team. You’ll work closely with engineering, product, and client stakeholders to turn complex knowledge sources into reliable, measurable, and secure AI features.

Key Responsibilities

RAG Architecture & Engineering (core focus)

  • Design and own end-to-end RAG architectures, from document ingestion to grounded, cited responses.
  • Build advanced retrieval strategies: hybrid search (dense + BM25/sparse), reranking (cross-encoders), query rewriting/expansion, metadata filtering, and multi-step or agentic retrieval.
  • Define chunking and indexing strategies for diverse sources, including structured and semi-structured data (XML/XSD, Office formats, PDFs, scanned documents).
  • Select, benchmark, and fine-tune embedding models; manage vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, Azure AI Search, or similar) at scale.
  • Build evaluation frameworks for retrieval and generation quality (recall@k, MRR, nDCG, faithfulness, answer relevance) and run them continuously as part of CI/CD.
  • Reduce hallucinations through grounding, citation, guardrails, and confidence handling.
  • Implement permission-aware and multi-tenant retrieval so users only access data they’re authorized to see.
  • Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations that expose RAG systems and internal data sources to LLMs and agents.
  • Optimize LLM serving with Ollama and llama.cpp: quantization (GGUF), GPU/CUDA tuning, batching, caching, and offline/air-gapped deployments.

Technical Leadership

  • Set RAG architecture standards, reference implementations, and best practices for the AI department.
  • Review designs and code, and provide technical guidance to AI Developers.
  • Translate client and product requirements into retrieval strategies with clear quality, latency, and cost targets.
  • Evaluate emerging techniques (GraphRAG, long-context vs. retrieval trade-offs, agentic RAG) and recommend what’s worth adopting.

DevOps & Infrastructure (supporting)

  • Deploy and scale RAG services on Microsoft Azure and AWS using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services (Azure DevOps preferred; GitHub Actions / GitLab CI also used).
  • Build observability for RAG systems: tracing, retrieval diagnostics, latency, cost, and quality dashboards.
  • Support event-driven ingestion and re-indexing pipelines using Apache Kafka.
  • Troubleshoot across the stack - dig into root causes rather than patching symptoms.

Requirements

  • Experience & Core RAG Expertise: 6+ years in backend, ML, or infrastructure with 2+ years building production RAG systems, including end-to-end architecture, hybrid retrieval, reranking, chunking, indexing, and evaluation frameworks.
  • Python & Vector Databases: Expert-level Python programming combined with deep knowledge of embeddings, vector databases, and metrics-driven evaluation.
  • LLM Optimization & Serving: Hands-on experience serving and optimizing open-source LLMs (Ollama, llama.cpp) with quantization, alongside GPU/CUDA troubleshooting and performance tuning.
  • DevOps, Infrastructure & MCP: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred), and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Leadership & Collaboration: Strong communication, technical leadership, and ownership to define architectural standards and collaborate effectively in a distributed, remote environment.

This is a remote position.

As Platform Engineer - IaC & CI/CD, you will build and maintain the infrastructure automation and software-delivery foundation supporting the reView Decision Intelligence platform.

data² has standardized on AWS as its cloud platform. This role owns the engineering capabilities that allow reView environments to be provisioned, configured, built, tested, deployed, promoted, and recovered consistently through automation — in AWS, and in the on-premises, disconnected, and air-gapped environments our regulated and federal customers require.

Your primary areas of ownership are Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, container and Kubernetes deployment automation, artifact and release management, offline and air-gapped delivery packaging, observability integration, secrets and configuration patterns, and developer delivery workflows.

Where this role sits.You own the patterns, standards, and reusable modules for infrastructure and delivery. The Junior CI/CD Engineer implements and operates within them. QA Automation owns the tests and evaluation harnesses that your gates execute. Operations provides AWS account-level administration and foundational cloud governance; this role establishes and maintains the automated infrastructure and delivery patterns used to operate reView within those environments.

This role supports both the Global Product and Federal delivery tracks, creating a reusable platform-engineering foundation across data² software delivery.

This position requires work within U.S.-controlled development and federal software-delivery environments.

Responsibilities

1. Infrastructure as Code & Environment Automation

Own the IaC foundation used to provision and maintain reView environments.

  • Design, build, and maintain reusable Terraform and/or AWS CDK modules and infrastructure patterns.
  • Automate provisioning of development, test, staging, production, and applicable federal environments.
  • Manage application-level AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes/EKS resources, load balancing, routing, autoscaling, storage, and supporting services through code.
  • Establish version-controlled, repeatable infrastructure configurations that minimize configuration drift.
  • Maintain environment configuration, secrets integration, and infrastructure lifecycle automation.
  • Define and maintain the infrastructure pattern for federal delivery, including the account, partition, and boundary model applicable to the environment (for example AWS GovCloud or a controlled commercial enclave).
  • Support infrastructure validation, recovery, and controlled change management.

Tools / Skills:AWS, Terraform and/or AWS CDK, Kubernetes/EKS, Docker, Git.

2. CI/CD & Release Engineering

Build and maintain the automated delivery pipelines used to move reView from source code through release.

  • Design and maintain build, test, deployment, promotion, and release pipelines.
  • Integrate QA automation, security validation, and quality gates into CI/CD workflows.
  • Automate container builds, artifact creation, versioning, signing, storage, and promotion.
  • Establish repeatable deployment and rollback strategies.
  • Support controlled promotion across development, test, staging, production, and federal release environments.
  • Own the offline delivery path: reproducible, version-pinned installation bundles and mirrored dependency and registry content for on-premises and air-gapped customer environments where pipeline egress is unavailable.
  • Maintain pipeline reliability, performance, traceability, and release evidence.

Tools / Skills:CI/CD pipelines, Git, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, AWS, artifact repositories, offline packaging and registry mirroring.

3. Platform Runtime & Developer Enablement

Create reliable platform patterns that allow Engineering to develop and deploy reView efficiently.

  • Establish reusable deployment templates, environment patterns, and developer workflows.
  • Maintain container and Kubernetes deployment standards for reView services.
  • Standardize runtime configuration, secrets integration, service connectivity, ingress, and application networking patterns.
  • Enable consistent local, integration, and cloud deployment workflows.
  • Improve developer self-service and reduce manual environment and deployment activities.
  • Partner with Engineering to resolve platform and deployment issues.

Tools / Skills:AWS, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, Git, configuration and secrets management.

4. DevSecOps & Software Supply Chain

Embed security and software-assurance controls throughout infrastructure and delivery automation.

  • Integrate SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container scanning, and applicable policy-as-code controls into CI/CD.
  • Implement secure secrets and credential-management patterns.
  • Support least-privilege IAM patterns within application and delivery environments.

jobs.excerpt: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

  1. Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations
  2. Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service
  3. FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia- Pacific.

Requirements

We are looking for an Accountant that is excited about the below Mission and Outcome.

Mission: As an Accountant, you will play a key role in providing high-quality accounting services to our clients. This position is ideal for someone with 5 years of experience, preferably within practice, looking to deepen their expertise and take on new responsibilities in a fast-paced, cloud-based environment. You’ll collaborate with a team of experienced accountants, managing a portfolio of clients and ensuring financial accuracy.

Your 5+ years of Accounting experience working with a portfolio of Singapore clients will help you succeed in this role.

Position Duties

  • You will lead and manage a high volume of portfolio of accounting clients and be the key point of contact for all your clients.
  • You will hence be accountable for the quality of service deliveries, timeliness, accurate billings, managing client relationships, maintaining good rapport with clients, and having the ability to achieve client satisfaction and retention.
  • You must be able to plan your work effectively and efficiently, and provide effective leadership, supervision and guidance to staff to ensure deliverables are in accordance with the scope of services and timelines. This includes but not limited to corporate secretarial, accounting, tax, payroll, GST, immigration, mailroom, and nominee director services.
  • From the start of your engagement, you must be able to demonstrate expertise in primary accounting frameworks and in relation to financial reporting matters as regulated by ACRA. You must also have sufficient knowledge on the regulatory requirements of various company set-ups in Singapore, mainly that of private limited companies.
  • You are required to gain a comprehensive understanding of client operations, processes, and business objectives and utilise that knowledge on engagement.
  • For assigned clients, you must have the ability to review and/or prepare management accounts and schedules, corporate tax computation, payroll reports, GST reports and other statutory filings, and ensure its accuracy and completeness before delivering to clients.
  • The knowledge that you have will enable you to provide basic consultancy advice to clients on various accounting, tax, payroll and corporate secretarial matters.
  • One of your key responsibilities is to prepare Unaudited/Group Unaudited Financial Statements and XBRL for clients with zero error.
  • You must adhere to the highest degree of professional standards and strict client confidentiality.

Requirements

  • Recognised degree/diploma in Accountancy
  • Preferably professionally certified with ACCA, CPA, or CA qualification
  • Preferably 5-7 years of relevant working experience for candidates who are not / yet to be certified. 2-3 years of relevant working experience for professionally certified candidates.
  • Good understanding of SFRS and Singapore regulatory compliance
  • Hands-on experience with Google workspace and Microsoft applications
  • Experience with cloud accounting software, Xero will be a definite plus, preferably at least a year of experience in Xero
  • Resourceful and experience with various productivity software applicable to facilitate daily works
  • Self-motivated, positive attitude, proactive and detail-oriented
  • Love meeting people and have great interpersonal and communication skills
  • Able to adapt to VUCA way of thinking and contribute to process improvement efforts
  • Able to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
  • Immediate availability is preferred

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

One Way Video Interview / TA Screening

Selected candidates will be invited to complete a short, one-way video interview. Depending on the results, candidates may then progress to a ~30-minute screening call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to explore their experience and discuss the role in more detail.

Technical Round:
A ~ 90-minute technical deep dive with the hiring team covering your most recent roles and hands-on experience.

Final Round:

A ~45 minute session with our Country Manager where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

Reference Verification

Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

+++++

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You will be required to work from the office at least 2–3 days per week if you are based in Singapore or Australia. For all other hiring locations, the role will be fully remote, with work from home five days a week. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate.

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Additionally, you’ll be able to access our flexi benefits scheme for home office equipment or health and fitness expenditure. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

jobs.title: Event Producer, APAC
jobs.excerpt: RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands.
jobs.description:
RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands. From global live events to bespoke branded content, we exist to create meaningful connections between fans and the worlds they love. Our team brings deep expertise across partnership sales and marketing, talent management, event production, media, community building, and IP development.

For more than 20 years, the Evolution Championship Series (Evo) has produced the largest and longest-running fighting game tournament conventions in the world. Our events are gathering points where players, fans, publishers, developers, creators, and brands come together to celebrate fighting games and the communities that make them thrive.

Beyond our flagship live events, Evo continues to expand how we create, celebrate, and grow fighting game fandom around the world.

Role Overview

As the APAC Event Producer, your primary remit will be to plan, build, and deliver assigned Evo events and activations across APAC, from production planning and vendor sourcing through on-site execution. You will be at the center, driving cross-functional alignment across Product, Marketing, Event Operations, Broadcast Production, and Business Development from initial concept through to on-site delivery.

This role sits within the Evo Product & Community organization and manages day to day coordination across internal teams, local production partners, venues, and vendors. You will ensure that master project milestones, event product features, show programming and on-site experiential builds land on schedule, within budget, and to the highest standard of execution.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on event production experience, strong vendor management skills, budget discipline, with a collaborative approach to solving operational problems, and an understanding of the competitive video games landscape.

Reporting Structure

You will report to Evo’s General Manager.

Key Responsibilities
APAC Event Planning & Delivery
  • Develop production plans and detailed schedules for assigned APAC events, translating approved concepts into venue requirements, layout and staffing plans, vendor briefs, and build, rehearsal, and event-day milestones.
  • Work with local venues and production partners to adapt event delivery to each market’s language needs, venue procedures, and operating conditions.
  • Manage day to day dependencies across internal teams for assigned events, resolve operational issues, and escalate resource conflicts or decisions that materially affect scope, budget, or timing.
  • Assess proposed changes to events, document their downstream impact on schedules, vendor scopes, and costs. Gain alignment and approval(s) for material changes prior to implementation.
  • Proactively identify delivery bottlenecks and operational risks well ahead of event windows, implementing practical solutions and contingency plans to maintain delivery excellence.
  • Use and maintain event planning templates and documentation while recommending improvements needed to execute in APAC.
Show & Business Partnerships Delivery Support
  • Work with Business Development and Product to develop clear, cross-functional execution plans for agreed partner commitments, including game publisher showcases, strategic partner activations, and regional operating partnerships.
  • Coordinate across Broadcast, Creative, and Event Ops to ensure partner deliverables (stage share-of-voice, show floor footprints, digital broadcast assets, and promotional integrations) land seamlessly without compromising tournament flow.
  • Partner with internal account managers to monitor and confirm the accurate on-site and on-stream delivery of all contracted partner inventory and experiential commitments.
Financial Management & Tracking
  • Prepare production estimates and manage approved budgets for assigned events, tracking vendor commitments, actual costs, forecasts, and variances in coordination with Finance and relevant department leads.
  • Work with Finance to reconcile final event production expenditures and partner fulfillment reports against initial baseline budgets.
Vendor Sourcing & Management
  • Source and evaluate venues, production partners, and event vendors in Japan and assigned markets. Prepare briefs, compare proposals, and recommend suppliers based on capability, quality, availability, and cost.
  • Define vendor scopes, deliverables, and schedules, and manage day-to-day vendor relationships. Negotiate pricing and delivery terms within approved parameters, coordinate contract review and approvals with internal teams, and resolve supplier issues throughout planning and on-site delivery.
  • Track vendor milestones, verify delivery against agreed scopes, and coordinate invoice approval and cost reconciliation with the relevant internal owners.
On-Site Delivery & Post-Event Reporting
  • Lead on-site production for assigned events, coordinating vendors and event crews through load-in, setup, rehearsals, live delivery, and breakdown.
  • Maintain clear operational swimlanes with Event Operations on venue logistics and tournament floor flow, and with Broadcast Production on control room and stream execution.
  • Lead cross-functional post-mortems, documenting vendor performance and delivery lessons, and recommend improvements for future events.
Qualifications
  • 5+ years in live event production or operations, including independently delivering events or substantial production workstreams and working with venues and vendors in Japan.
  • Professional fluency in Japanese for vendor management and on-site delivery, and business-level English for international coordination and reporting.
  • Experience managing multiple production workstreams, schedules, budgets, and vendors, including proposals, scopes of work, contracts, purchase orders, and cost reconciliation.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment and the ability to coordinate internal teams and external partners under pressure.
  • Working knowledge of live event and venue operations, including coordination with broadcast, creative, and tournament teams.
  • Ability to work in Japan
  • Willingness to travel across APAC and work on site during event preparation, delivery, and breakdown, including occasional evenings and weekends.
Bonus Points
  • Experience delivering events in additional APAC markets.
  • An established network of venues and production suppliers in Japan.
  • Interest or experience in gaming, esports, entertainment, or creator culture, with familiarity with fighting games and their communities.
  • Familiarity with fighting games and their communities.
Our Philosophy
  • We believe strongly in work/life balance - you’ve got to feel your best to do your best. We invest in people, not just output, and aim to create an environment where creativity, empathy, and experimentation thrive.
Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
  • 401k plan available for employee contributions
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Generous PTO and company-observed holidays
  • Remote-first culture

About the Role

A fast-growing, U.S.-based premium lifestyle food brand is seeking a Guest Experience Representative to deliver high-touch, concierge-level support across digital channels.

The brand operates as a premium “ghost kitchen” concept, meaning there are no dine-in locations. Instead, all orders are placed online and fulfilled through delivery. This model allows the brand to focus entirely on food quality and guest experience behind the scenes, while the Guest Experience team ensures every interaction feels as thoughtful and high-touch as a luxury, in-person dining experience.

In this role, you will act as the voice of the brand, engaging directly with guests across email, SMS, and occasional phone interactions. The focus is on delivering thoughtful, real-time support that feels human, personal, and aligned with a premium hospitality experience.

The team operates in a fast-paced, delivery-first environment, similar to a high-end restaurant without dine-in service. Guests expect not just resolution, but care, attention, and a seamless experience, especially when things go wrong.

Success in this role requires the ability to:

  • Communicate naturally and authentically (not scripted)
  • Think on your feet and respond in real time
  • Balance empathy with confidence when handling challenging guests
  • Take full ownership of guest issues from start to resolution

This is a high-accountability role with long shifts and a strong emphasis on consistency, professionalism, and team collaboration.

Work Schedule

The company currently operates 16 store locations across the United States, serving guests 7 days a week. To support daily operations, the Guest Experience team provides coverage during business hours across multiple U.S. time zones, ensuring every guest receives prompt, personalized service regardless of location.

    • Ensure every interaction reflects a premium, concierge-level experience
  • Guest issue resolution & recovery
    • Handle guest concerns with empathy, clarity, and sound judgment
    • Turn negative experiences into positive outcomes through thoughtful responses
    • Balance guest care with company guidelines and decision-making
  • Ownership & follow-through
    • Take full ownership of guest issues from start to resolution
    • Ensure timely, accurate, and thoughtful responses across all channels
    • Maintain strong attention to detail in all interactions
  • Cross-functional coordination
    • Collaborate with kitchen operations and internal teams to resolve issues efficiently
    • Help ensure smooth execution across delivery, fulfillment, and guest communication
  • Service excellence & continuous improvement
    • Uphold high standards for hospitality and professionalism
    • Identify opportunities to improve guest experience and internal processes
    • Adapt to feedback and continuously refine communication and service approach

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in customer-facing roles (hospitality, guest services, client experience, or similar)
  • Strong experience in high-touch service environments (hotel, airline, restaurant, food delivery, concierge, luxury retail, or similar guest-focused industries)
  • Demonstrated ability to think on your feet and respond effectively in real-time situations
  • Ability to remain calm, confident, and solution-oriented under pressure
  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability in handling tasks and responsibilities

Preferred

jobs.description:
Soyez acteur de la solution avec Technip Energies et rejoignez-nous pour une carrière unique. Vous contribuerez à développer des solutions de pointe pour résoudre les problèmes énergétiques auxquels notre monde est confronté.

Technip Energies est une entreprise de technologies et d’ingénierie de premier plan. Leader dans le GNL, l’hydrogène, l’éthylène, la chimie durable et la gestion du CO2, nous contribuons au développement de marchés stratégiques tels que l'énergie, les dérivés énergétiques, la décarbonation et la circularité. Nos segments d’activité complémentaires, Technologies, Produits et Services (TPS) et Livraison de Projet, transforment les innovations en réalité industrielle à grande échelle.

Animés par des valeurs de collaboration et d’excellence dans l’exécution, plus de 17 000 collaborateurs dans 34 pays s'engagent pour allier prospérité et durabilité en faveur d’un monde conçu pour durer.

Missions proposées :

Les unités flottantes offshore (FPSO, FLNG, etc…) sont constituées de plusieurs modules pesant plusieurs milliers de tonnes et supportés par la coque.
Chacun de ces modules repose sur la coque au travers de « bearing nodes », nœuds structuraux qui permettent de transmettre les efforts du module vers la coque tout en accommodant les mouvements relatifs entre ces deux structures.

Ces « bearing nodes » sont des structures complexes, comportant un nombre important de pièces et de soudures engendrant des temps significatifs d’analyses, de fabrication et d’inspection.

L’objectif du stage est d’étudier la faisabilité d’un concept de « bearing node » simplifié et standardisé couvrant plusieurs plages de chargement et pouvant être décliné sur de futurs projets.

L’étude portera sur :

  • Analyse du design de référence
    • Revue des concepts existants sur différents projets
    • Identification des paramètres dimensionnants
    • Analyse des difficultés de fabrication et de modélisation
  • Développement d’un concept simplifié et standardisé
    • Simplification de la géométrie
    • Réduction du nombre de pièces et d’assemblages soudés
    • Simplification des procédés de soudage
    • Définition d’une gamme de variantes par plage de charges admissibles
  • Evaluation des bénéfices
    • Constructibilité et facilité de fabrication
    • Performance
    • Temps et complexité des calculs
    • Impact poids

L'étude devra mettre en évidence les avantages, les limitations et le domaine d'application du concept proposé, ainsi que son potentiel de standardisation pour les futurs projets.

Lors de ce stage, vous serez accompagné(e) par un(e) tuteur/tutrice pour répondre à vos différentes questions. Ce stage sera pour vous, l’occasion de monter en compétences, connaissances.

Profil recherché:

Nous serions heureux de vous rencontrer et d’échanger sur votre adéquation à ce poste. Pour réussir cette mission, vous devrez remplir les conditions suivantes :

  • En cours de Bac +5 dans une école d'ingénieurs
  • Vous suivez une formation en ingénierie des structures offshore ou navale
  • Vous avez des connaissances en RDM et calculs de charpentes métalliques
  • Vous avez des connaissances en Elément Finis
  • Vous avez un anglais opérationnel (oral & écrit)

Vous cherchez à réaliser votre stage dans un environnement international et dynamique, à prendre part à des projets d'envergure et à relever des défis techniques et organisationnels ?

Envoyez-nous votre candidature!

Votre carrière chez nous :

Travailler chez Technip Energies est une aventure passionnante, remplie de projets novateurs et de collaborations actives. Entouré(e) de personnes diverses aux nombreux talents, vous vous sentirez accueilli(e), respecté(e) et impliqué(e). Vous évoluerez dans un environnement sûr et bienveillant où vous pourrez proposer de nouvelles idées, réinventer l'avenir et conduire le changement. Au fur et à mesure de l'évolution de votre carrière, vous bénéficierez des possibilités d'apprentissage offertes par T.EN University, telles que le programme « Future Ready », et du soutien de votre manager, par exemple à l'occasion de l'entretien de mi-année, qui favorisent votre épanouissement et développement continus.

Prochaines étapes :

A réception de votre candidature, nos recruteurs évalueront vos compétences, votre expérience et votre aptitude à vous intégrer au sein de nos équipes en fonction des besoins du poste. Nous vous demandons un peu de patience pendant que l’équipe traite le volume de demandes dans les meilleurs délais ! Vous pourrez suivre son avancement via votre compte personnel à partir du profil que vous avez créé lors de votre candidature.

Retrouvez nos actualités en consultant le site et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, et YouTube.

Collaborate with internal and external experts, including legal, underwriting, vendors, and agents, to evaluate claims and determine validity and value. Lead cross-functional meetings and communicate complex information clearly to diverse audiences. Serve as a subject matter expert and contribute to departmental projects and initiatives; act as a technical resource for other adjusters. Identify and proactively pursue opportunities to transfer risk to the appropriate entities for the benefit of insureds and business partners. Identify and assign subrogation potential appropriately; set up files to support successful recovery efforts. Ensure all claims activities comply with regulatory and company standards. Execute jurisdictional compliance requirements and support others in understanding regulatory obligations. Use technology and data tools to identify trends, correct inconsistencies, and optimize outcomes. Negotiate high-value and contested claims using advanced strategies. Investigate and manage suspicious claims using advanced techniques and tools; refer to the Special Investigation Unit (SIU) as needed. Maintain awareness of fraud indicators and regulatory reporting obligations. Set reserves, authorize payments, and make financial decisions within authority and contribute to reserving accuracy and efficiency. Use advanced tools and analytics to identify trends, correct inconsistencies, and improve claims handling efficiency. Maintains comprehensive factual and organized claim records and prepares detailed reports summarizing findings and recommendations. Strong knowledge of local geography, regulations, and public safety agencies, as well as the ability to build rapport with insureds and navigate the insurance and legal climate. Workfront Lead Consultant

Delivery | Remote, Australia | Permanent Full-Time | APAC

Who We Are: Front Office Transformation Experts

Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution.

What We Do: Cutting Complexity Across the Front Office

We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.

The Role

You'll own the Workfront solution design and delivery approach on the client engagements you lead. That means running discovery, deciding how workflows, custom forms, access levels and reporting fit the way each client's teams really work, and directing the Functional Consultants who build it. Your week moves between client workshops, design reviews with your build team and the odd pursuit, where you run the Workfront platform demo around the prospect's own requests and approvals. You'll report to our Technology Lead for Workfront, who sets the standard across the capability, while the design on your engagements is yours to call. It's workstream leadership rather than line management, and you'll judge your success by whether clients are still using Workfront well months after go-live.

What you'll do

  • Lead discovery and design of each Workfront solution so it fits how the client operates, with design sign-off before the build starts

  • Set the build sequence with the Project Manager, so requirements land in the order the client needs them, not the order they were raised

  • Direct the Workfront build day to day, guiding Functional Consultants and reviewing configuration before anything reaches the client

  • Handle client escalations on Workfront, fixing what sits within the design and raising wider issues with the Technology Lead early

  • Run the platform demo on pursuits, built around the prospect's real work requests, approvals and reporting

  • Design client enablement so each client's own administrators can run Workfront confidently after go-live

  • Mentor and reuse by pairing with Functional Consultants and turning proven designs into templates, with AI speeding up configuration docs

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on Adobe Workfront depth, having configured live client instances end to end rather than only using the platform

  • Solution design ownership, having led discovery and turned how a client team works day to day into a design they signed off

  • Workstream leadership directing other consultants' build and reviewing configuration quality without needing line management to do it

  • Client-facing confidence running workshops, handling escalations and demoing to senior marketing and operations stakeholders

  • Enablement experience designing training and admin handover so clients can run the platform themselves

  • Consulting delivery background in a consultancy, agency or partner setting, working to a plan alongside Project Managers

  • Adobe Workfront certification is a strong plus, as is exposure to the wider Adobe Experience Cloud

Why this role, why now

We're shaping our proven Workfront designs and templates into a reusable practice now, and the lead consultants who join at this stage set the pattern the rest of the capability builds on. You'll see engagements from discovery through go-live and into adoption, with a seat in pursuits as well as delivery.

Additional information

Location: Remote (Australia). Open to candidates based anywhere in Australia. Applicants must have the right to work in Australia and be available during AEST/AEDT business hours.

Employment type: Permanent full-time.

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process.

IM8 is a next-generation health and longevity brand co-founded by David Beckham and Prenetics (NASDAQ: PRE), on a mission to make world-class nutritional science accessible to everyone. Launched in late 2024, IM8 grew Q1 2026 revenue nearly 6x year-over-year to $33.8M, and the company has raised full-year 2026 IM8 revenue guidance to $190M–$210M. Over 60% of revenue is generated outside the US. We ship to 43 countries, and our athlete partner roster includes David Beckham, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Aryna Sabalenka, Ollie Bearman, and Inter Miami CF.

We are built on science, not story — our flagship Daily Ultimate Essentials carries 90 active ingredients, we run randomized controlled trials on our products, and we hold a clinical-grade standard in a category notorious for shortcuts.

Our business is subscription at its core. Every basis point of NRR we add compounds — into LTV, into payback, into the ability to outspend everyone else on acquisition. Retention isn't a department at IM8. It is the model.

Why This Role Is Different

Most retention roles are about plugging holes in someone else's bucket. This one isn't.

IM8 has the rarest combination in DTC: a brand customers genuinely identify with, a product they actually feel working, a co-founder roster that drives organic demand, and a CEO who treats retention as the highest-leverage lever in the business. Our acquisition engine is firing. Our cohorts are strong. What we need now is an operator who can compound those cohorts into a generational consumer franchise.

For the right person, this is the most consequential retention seat in DTC supplements — and arguably one of the most consequential in consumer, full stop.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Head of Retention to own IM8's global subscriber P&L — LTV, NRR, churn, win-back, lifecycle, loyalty, and the entire post-purchase experience. This is a hands-on, senior role for someone who lives at the intersection of data, behavioural science, AI, and brand.

You will own every touchpoint between the first purchase and the lifetime relationship: subscription mechanics, email, SMS, push, in-app, replenishment, win-back, loyalty, referral, community, and the cross-sell pathways that turn a single-SKU buyer into a multi-product subscriber. You will work with AI tooling and agentic workflows that didn't exist 18 months ago — and you will build the next ones.

Your mandate: take our NRR from where it is to category-defining. Extend our LTR to the point that our paid acquisition team can outbid anyone, anywhere.

What You'll Do

Subscriber P&L Ownership

  • Own the metrics that matter: NRR, gross churn, voluntary vs. involuntary churn, reactivation rate, LTV, payback period, subscriber LTR.
  • Move NRR materially up and to the right — through better onboarding, better subscription mechanics, better lifecycle, better win-back, and better products in the basket.
  • Drive the monthly-to-quarterly-to-annual subscription migration. Build the offer architecture, the messaging, and the experience that earns the longer commitment.
  • Reduce involuntary churn through best-in-class dunning, payment retry logic, and card-update flows.
  • Build the cross-sell engine that turns Essentials subscribers into Longevity subscribers into Beckham Stack subscribers — and lifts ARPU without lifting CAC.

AI-Native Operating System

  • Run a retention function where AI is embedded in everything: predictive churn modelling, LTV forecasting, personalised content generation at scale, dynamic offer engines, journey orchestration, and sentiment analysis on every cancellation reason.
  • Deploy LLMs and generative tools (Claude, GPT, ElevenLabs, and whatever comes next) to produce hyper-personalised email, SMS, and on-site content — at a volume and quality no traditional CRM team can match.
  • Build agentic workflows that automate the operational layer: campaign QA, audience building, journey diagnostics, weekly retention reporting, anomaly detection on cohort behaviour.
  • Be the in-house authority on AI-native retention platforms — Klaviyo AI, Attentive AI, predictive churn engines — and extract performance most operators leave on the table.

Lifecycle & CRM Leadership

  • Own the email, SMS, push, and in-app programmes end-to-end: strategy, segmentation, content, calendar, deliverability, and performance.
  • Build a global lifecycle programme that adapts to 43 markets — language, regulatory, behavioural, and cultural — without losing brand coherence.
  • Run a constant test-and-learn programme on subject lines, send times, offers, journeys, and segmentation logic. Every campaign teaches us something we put into the next one.

Subscription Experience & Community

  • Own the subscriber experience end-to-end — onboarding, replenishment cadence, pause/skip/swap mechanics, account self-service, customer success, and offboarding.
  • Partner with product and ops on the unboxing, packaging, and in-pack inserts that turn every shipment into a retention asset.
  • Build the loyalty and referral programme that compounds — leveraging our athlete and Beckham partner ecosystem in ways no other supplement brand can match.
  • Design and run the subscriber-only content, events, and access that make IM8 membership feel like membership.

Data, Measurement & Analytics

  • Build the cohort analytics, attribution, and forecasting that lets the business plan LTV with confidence — and lets the acquisition team bid accordingly.
  • Deliver weekly retention reporting, cohort diagnostics, and executive-ready insight. Be the source of truth for everything subscription.
  • Partner with finance on LTR:CAC, payback, and cohort modelling that feeds the strategic plan and investor narrative.
  • Run regular incrementality testing — prove what's actually moving the needle versus what's just correlated.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Performance Marketing on cohort feedback loops, offer architecture, and LTV signals that improve acquisition decisions.
  • Partner with Product on roadmap — which SKUs to launch, in what order, with what bundling logic, to maximise subscriber LTV.
  • Manage agency, ESP, and platform relationships to a high bar.

What We're Looking For

Non-Negotiable

  • Scale credentials. You have personally owned a subscription book of meaningful scale — minimum $50M ARR or 250,000+ active subscribers — or you have a clear, specific reason why this benchmark doesn't apply to your trajectory (e.g. you took a category-defining brand from 0 to material scale, ran retention for a high-LTV / low-volume premium book, etc.). If you can't make that case in a sentence, this isn't your role.
  • AI-native. Not AI-curious. Not AI-aware. AI is already embedded in how you segment, personalise, predict, generate, and report. You can talk fluently about how you use LLMs, predictive models, and generative tools in your daily retention workflow — and you can show the output.
  • Demonstrable retention impact. A specific, defensible track record of moving NRR, gross churn, or LTV by meaningful points — and the story of how you did it. Vague claims won't survive the interview.
  • Hands-on platform depth. Deep, in-the-platform expertise across the modern retention stack: Klaviyo, Attentive (or equivalent), Recharge/Skio/Stay (or equivalent subscription engine), Shopify, and the data infrastructure that connects them.
  • Subscription DTC fluency. You understand subscription mechanics in your bones — dunning, pause vs. cancel logic, monthly vs. quarterly vs. annual offer architecture, replenishment cadence, win-back economics.
  • Creative leadership. You can manage a lifecycle creative team to a high-volume, high-quality output. You can brief a winning email, and you can spot a mediocre one in five seconds.
  • Commercial instincts. Comfortable with cohort analysis, LTV modelling, payback math, and unit economics. You can defend your numbers to a CFO.
  • Builder's mindset. Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decision-making, and shaping the playbook rather than inheriting one.
  • Communication. You can move fluidly between a creative review, a cohort deep-dive, and an exec readout — and be the smartest person in each conversation.
  • Location. Hong Kong preferred. Open to US or UK base for the right candidate, with regular travel to HK. Must be eligible to work in your home market.

Nice to Have

  • Background in health, wellness, supplements, beauty, or premium lifestyle DTC.
  • Experience scaling retention across multiple international markets.
  • Loyalty programme design and execution at scale.
  • Community, content, or membership-led retention experience.
  • A clear point of view on where retention is heading in the next 24 months — and why most brands are getting it wrong.

    You Must Be AI-Native

Active, fluent daily AI tool usage is mandatory, not optional. We expect you to be embedding AI into every workflow you touch on day one.

Beat Claude Challenge

Shortlisted candidates complete a role-specific assignment, scored against a baseline we generate using Claude — same data, blind review. To advance, your thinking needs to be better than what the best AI produces. Ties don't advance.

Want to stand out? Head to our GitHub repo and submit your Beat Claude challenge: Prenetics/beat-claude

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist (Applied AI) to join our team. In this role, you will lead end-to-end data science workstreams, perform feasibility assessments, and design modern AI-driven solutions—from core statistical modelling to production-grade LLM applications and agents.

Your Role

You will own data science workstreams end-to-end, serving as both a technical authority and a key driver for AI solution design. You will work directly with stakeholders to validate feasibility, design architectures, and deliver reliable, high-impact data and AI applications.

What is it all about?

  • Core Machine Learning & Time Series:Develop predictive models and feature engineering solutions, with a strong focus on time series, predictive analytics, and classical statistical inference.

  • Applied AI & LLM Workflows:Build, evaluate, and deploy working LLM applications, including custom agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over text and document data, API integration, and structured workflows.

  • Cloud & Tech Ecosystem:Build primarily in Python, leveraging Azure AI Foundry for AI/ML development and Microsoft Copilot Studio for lighter agent workflows. Extract and query data across AWS (S3, Redshift) and Azure environments.

  • Applied AI Skills:Hands-on experience building LLM applications via APIs/connectors, implementing RAG architectures, prompt engineering, and building data-driven AI agents.

  • Tech Stack & Cloud:High proficiency in Python. Experience with Azure (Azure AI Foundry, data stores), AWS (S3, Redshift for data retrieval), and familiarity with Microsoft Copilot Studio.

Join us and be part of a dynamic, fast-paced environment where your contributions truly matter.

PURPOSE OF POSITION:

As an Enrollment Advisor at MyComputerCareer (MyCC), you will change lives by helping prospective students take steps toward a career in information technology, with a strong focus on cybersecurity training and certification programs.

  • Exceed Performance & Conversion Quotas:Consistently meet and exceed individual enrollment targets, conversion velocity, and key performance indicators (KPIs) in a fast-paced environment.

  • Navigate the Enrollment Funnel:Seamlessly guide qualified candidates through critical enrollment milestones, including academic readiness assessments, funding/financial documentation, and compliance requirements.

  • Deliver Engaging In-Person and Camera-On Consultations:Host dynamic, professional video consultations that build immediate trust, uncover personal motivators, and persuasively present MyCC programs.

  • Performance & Goal Orientation:Motivated by winning, hitting ambitious targets, and outperforming benchmarks in a visible, performance-driven environment.

  • Resilience & Purpose-Driven Grit:Bounces back quickly from rejection, maintains high activity under pressure, and views objections as temporary obstacles to overcome.

  • Accountability & Self-Governance:Driven by an internal standard of excellence; takes full ownership of conversion metrics and enrollment results.

  • Data Literacy & Pipeline Optimization:Leverages sales metrics, funnel conversion rates, and CRM insights to self-govern daily activity, refine follow-up strategies, and maximize pipeline performance.

  • Work Ethic & Operational Discipline:Demonstrates exceptional punctuality, consistency, and time management essential for maintaining continuous pipeline momentum and executing scheduled consultations.

  • Persuasive Communication & Value Selling:Articulate and assertive; excels at building rapid trust, creating immediate urgency, and positioning education as the ultimate vehicle for life change and career transformation.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Education:High School Diploma or GED required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.

  • Proven Sales Success:2+ years of demonstrated success in target-driven sales environments, such as direct sales, agency recruiting/staffing, or outbound B2B/B2C sales.

  • High-Volume Activity Discipline:Proven track record of executing high-daily-activity routines, managing pipeline velocity, and maintaining sharp personal organization.

  • Tech & Pipeline Literacy:Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), video presentation tools, and sales performance dashboards; ability to analyze personal conversion metrics to optimize daily outreach and drive results.

  • Mission Alignment & Communication:Exceptional presentation and active-listening skills, with the emotional intelligence required to turn candidate career aspirations into enrolled starts.

PHYSICAL & COGNITIVE DEMANDS:The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:

  • Listen to potential students and communicate utilizing verbal and written feedback. Must be able to exchange accurate information.

  • Observe and detect concerns or areas for improvement within the workplace.

  • Frequently move about the office and customer/prospect locations in diverse environments.

  • Maintain a high level of consistent cognitive function to negotiate complex transactions with employees and students or vendors.

  • Stoop, kneel, or crouch when maneuvering the office environment.

  • Lift up to 25 lbs at times.

Why Join Us?

At MyComputerCareer, we offer a supportive environment where you can make a meaningful impact on the lives of our students. If you’re looking for a fulfilling career where you can help others succeed while growing professionally, apply today!

Comprehensive Benefits That Support You at Every Stage

We believe taking care of our people is just as important as taking care of our students. Eligible full-time employees enjoy a well-rounded benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and overall well-being.

Our benefits include:

• Multiple medical plan options, including HSA plans with employer contributions

• Dental and vision coverage

• 401(k) with company match
• Generous paid time off and holidays
• MyCC tuition benefits for eligible employees and family members

We’re committed to helping our employees stay healthy, feel secure, and maintain balance both at work and at home.
