Join us as we create a passwordless world and set new standards for digital identity assurance.

Your Title: Director, Strategic Sales – West

Your Location: Remote - Anywhere within the USA with travel expectations in your designated geography

YouReport to: Senior Vice President, Sales

Your Compensation: Competitive Base + Commission + Equity $325K–$350K OTE

1Kosmos is seeking a Strategic Sales Director – West to lead and accelerate commercial growth across a defined set of target verticals and the broader Western United States. This is a senior individual contributor and market development role for someone who can carry a complex, six- and seven-figure enterprise sales cycle from first conversation to signed contract, and who can operate credibly with CISO, CIO, and procurement stakeholders across industries where identity fraud and credential-based breaches carry direct financial and operational risk.

What you will own:

Territory and Market Development

  • Own a combination territory: 1-2 assigned target verticals (drawn from Manufacturing, Financial Services, Retail, BPO, Distribution & Supply Chain, and Travel & Entertainment) plus the Western United States geography for opportunities outside the company-wide target vertical set.
  • Build and execute a territory plan that prioritizes account targeting, whitespace mapping, and partner coverage across the assigned verticals and geography.
  • Generate pipeline through direct outreach, partner co-sell motions, industry events, and referral networks across CISO, CIO, VP of Identity, and IT leadership audiences.
  • Develop and maintain a qualified pipeline sufficient to support consistent quarterly and annual revenue targets.
  • Identify and pursue whitespace opportunities across the full 1Kosmos use case portfolio, including identity verification (onboarding, account recovery, step-up authentication) and passwordless authentication (enterprise and shared/frontline workstation).

Sales Execution and Deal Management

  • Own the full sales cycle from discovery through contract execution on net-new and expansion opportunities.
  • Lead executive-level engagement with CISO, CIO, VP of Identity, Security, and Procurement stakeholders.
  • Articulate 1Kosmos' differentiated value across identity verification and passwordless authentication, connecting both to the specific fraud, compliance, and operational risks relevant to each account's industry.
  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles including security reviews, legal, procurement, and compliance approvals common to enterprise purchasing environments.
  • Work with channel partners including Optiv, VARs, and GSIs on partner-assisted and partner-sourced deals.

Customer and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Act as the primary executive sponsor and relationship owner for strategic accounts throughout the sales cycle.
  • Translate identity security requirements into business outcomes, including reduced help desk volume, fraud loss prevention, and reduced risk of credential-based breaches.
  • Partner with Solutions Engineering on proof-of-concept design and execution, ensuring technical validation aligns with customer requirements.
  • Coordinate with Customer Success post-sale to support smooth onboarding and expansion planning.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the SVP of Americas Sales on territory planning, forecast accuracy, and executive account strategy.
  • Partner with Marketing on vertical-specific campaigns, event strategy, and collateral including case studies, use case briefs, and competitive positioning.
  • Provide structured feedback to Product on vertical-specific requirements, integration depth, and use case gaps.
  • Collaborate with the Partnerships team to activate and co-sell with systems integrators and technology alliance partners active in the assigned verticals and territory.

Reporting and Forecast Management

  • Maintain accurate pipeline, opportunity, and forecast data in CRM.
  • Provide regular updates to the SVP of Americas Sales on progress, risks, blockers, and competitive intelligence.
  • Track and report on key performance metrics including pipeline coverage, win rates, average contract value, and time to close.

What you bring:

  • 10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a demonstrated track record of closing six- and seven-figure SaaS or software deals.
  • Experience owning a combination territory (named verticals plus a broader geography) and prioritizing effectively across both.
  • Deep familiarity with enterprise purchasing environments including CISO, CIO, Procurement, and Legal stakeholders, and typical 6- to 18-month enterprise deal cycles.
  • Prior experience selling into one or more of the following verticals strongly preferred: Manufacturing, Financial Services, Retail, BPO, Distribution & Supply Chain, or Travel & Entertainment.
  • Comfort operating in a high-growth, fast-moving environment with evolving processes and significant individual ownership.
  • Excellent communication and executive presence; able to operate credibly at the C-suite level.
  • Based in or able to travel regularly across the South Central United States.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with identity, access management, digital identity, or cybersecurity platforms.
  • Prior sales experience at or against vendors such as Okta, Ping Identity, Microsoft, SailPoint, Saviynt, or CyberArk.
  • Existing relationships with CISO, CIO, or VP of Identity leaders within the assigned target verticals.
  • Background in channel or partner-assisted selling through resellers, systems integrators, or GSIs.

What Success Looks Like:

  • A qualified pipeline of opportunities across the assigned target verticals and South Central U.S. territory is built and maintained with strong coverage ratios.
  • Net-new enterprise logos are closed on a consistent quarterly cadence.
  • 1Kosmos is recognized as a credible, differentiated vendor for identity verification and passwordless authentication within the assigned verticals.
  • Relationships with key CISO, CIO, and VP of Identity stakeholders are established and active across the territory.
  • Vertical-specific use case narratives, case studies, and reference customers are developed in partnership with Marketing.

The 1Kosmos Opportunity

Identity fraud and credential-based attacks are accelerating across every industry, from synthetic identities and deepfakes used to defeat onboarding, to social engineering used to compromise help desks and account recovery flows. Manufacturing, financial services, retail, BPO, distribution and supply chain, and travel and entertainment organizations each face a version of this problem: high-volume identity events, distributed or frontline workforces, and growing regulatory and fraud-loss pressure.

1Kosmos is the only platform that combines certified identity verification with enterprise-grade passwordless authentication in a single architecture that sits on top of a customer's existing identity infrastructure. The platform integrates natively with Microsoft Entra Verified ID for verifiable credential issuance, Okta and Ping for enterprise SSO environments, ServiceNow for ITSM-integrated identity events, Workday for workforce onboarding, and identity governance platforms including SailPoint and Saviynt. Additional integrations span CyberArk, Broadcom, and multiple applicant tracking systems (ATS) for pre-hire identity verification.

Certifications relevant to enterprise buyers include:

  • NIST 800-63-3 certification at AAL2 and IAL2, with an IAL3 step-up option, supporting identity assurance requirements across onboarding, recovery, and step-up use cases
  • FedRAMP High authorization, relevant for customers serving or adjacent to federal and public sector programs
  • Department of Defense Impact Level 4 (IL4), establishing the platform's suitability for sensitive data environments
  • Kantara full Credential Service Provider (CSP) certification, one of a small number globally, supporting highest-assurance identity proofing workflows
  • iBeta Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) Level 2 for liveness and deepfake detection
  • SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliance

1Kosmos has also been recognized by industry analysts: named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Identity Verification with the highest product score for workforce use cases, and recognized as a leader in passwordless authentication for the enterprise by KuppingerCole.

Why 1Kosmos

1Kosmos is the trust platform for identity, operating at the intersection of identity verification, passwordless authentication, and verified credential reuse. Processing more than 2 billion authentications per year at five-nines availability, and named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Identity Verification with the highest score for workforce use cases, 1Kosmos is at an inflection point of scale and market category definition.

The combination of rising identity fraud, credential-based breach risk, and high-friction identity workflows across manufacturing, financial services, retail, BPO, distribution and supply chain, and travel and entertainment creates a compelling, high-urgency buying environment. This role joins a company with proven deployments, differentiated certifications, and the platform integrations required to win across these verticals and the broader Western U.S. market.

What we offer

  • Opportunity to build and lead a critical function at a high-growth Series B startup
  • Competitive salary and equity package
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Unlimited PTO Policy
  • Collaborative, fast-paced culture where your impact is immediate and visible

jobs.excerpt: FiXT is seeking an experienced, forward thinking A&R Manager who is passionate about discovering and developing artists, to join our team.
jobs.description:
FiXT is seeking an experienced, forward thinking A&R Manager who is passionate about discovering and developing artists, to join our team. We are mission-driven, artist-owned record label, setting out to empower artists to build sustainable careers in ways not previously possible to them, by putting a world class team around them, providing industry leading label services, and fostering lifelong fan relationships with a global audience.

This position's responsibilities include support for our current roster as well as scouting for new signings, managing production projects, budgets and deadlines, finding collaborators, delivering masters with supporting credits and documentation, researching emerging trends, and championing the label's music with internal and external teams. The position will report to FiXT's President / Co-Founder James Rhodes, as well as work closely with FiXT CEO/Founder Klayton (Celldweller). This role will also work frequently with FiXT's Distribution/Admin team and Marketing team to align release timing, metadata, and campaign planning around new and existing signings.

A Note on What We're Looking For

FiXT is an artist-owned, founder-led label. Klayton (Celldweller / Scandroid) built this company from his own catalog and career, and continues to lead it alongside President/Co-Founder James Rhodes. That matters for this role: we're not looking for an A&R Manager to sign volume or chase trends in isolation. We're looking for someone who takes the time to understand FiXT's history, Klayton's artistic vision, and the sound and culture Klayton & James have built for nearly 20 years, and who can operate inside that framework. At the same time, we're not looking to stand still. Part of this role is helping FiXT thoughtfully broaden into adjacent sonic territory beyond our current rock/metal/synthwave core, without losing what makes FiXT, FiXT. The right candidate sees the difference between “an interesting artist” and “the right artist for this label,” and can make that case to Klayton and James with real reasoning.

Job Duties

  • Act as a key point of contact between internal/external teams and our artists.
  • Scout for new artists to sign or collaborate with and research potential artists for culture, value and engagement fit.
  • Research and report on emerging trends around musical genre and production styles.
  • Coordinate Artist schedules and maintain project production timelines, budgets and documentation/credits.
  • Maintain active communication with artist roster with routine check-ins via Discord and Zoom calls.
  • Prepare weekly A&R meeting agendas, file-prep and presentation slides/notes for review with A&R team.
  • Be an active participant in key Team, Label and Operations meetings, as well as an advocate for artist roster within Merch and Sync meetings.
  • Leadership: Upholding FiXT's vision, mission and values, supporting FiXT's executive team to collectively lead artists/staff through company growth and evolution while creating/maintaining positive company culture.

Success in this role means 8+ new signings per year that meet our sound/values bar.

Job Requirements

  • 3+ years of relevant music industry experience.
  • Must display understanding/knowledge across rock/metal, industrial, synthwave and EDM genres, as well as adjacent/tangential genres such as cyberpunk, alternative metal, metalcore, hard rock and trap-metal.
  • Must have an ear for great songs and production quality.
  • Must be self-motivated, trustworthy & display integrity.
  • Must have a positive attitude and be service oriented.
  • Must be discretionary and mindful of private/confidential data.
  • Ability to prioritize work and work accurately under pressure of deadlines.
    • Comfortable working within Asana for project/task management, Discord for artist and team communication, and Chartmetric for trend and artist analytics research.

Desired Qualities

  • Tactful, confident and have strong people and communication skills.
  • Persistence and follow through to achieve goals.
  • Pro-active learner seeking continued self & professional development.

Location

FiXT's main label operations office is based in Burlington, Iowa (CST). Klayton is based in Detroit, Michigan (EST). We're looking for a US-based employee who is either willing to relocate to the Burlington, Iowa office, or based remotely with consideration given to candidates in a major Midwest market, including Chicago, Nashville, St. Louis, Minneapolis, Detroit, Indianapolis and similar cities.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume through this posting. In addition, we'd love to see a portfolio of previous signings you've championed, or a sample scouting report/artist pitch, so we can get a sense of your ear and your approach before we talk. Candidates who include this will be prioritized for review.

Job Type: Full-time / Salary

Benefits:

  • Sick/Vacation Time (80hrs/year baseline)
  • Holiday Pay (10 observed paid holidays each year)
  • Telemedicine Health Plan (no cost to employee)
  • Flex Spending Account (employer funded base, with option for employee contributions)
  • $25k Employer Paid Life Insurance Policy (no cost to employee)
  • Long Term Disability Policy (employer paid, no cost to employee)
  • Voluntary Dental Plan (employee funded with pre-tax pay-roll deduction)
  • Voluntary Vision Plan (employee funded with pre-tax pay-roll deduction)
  • IRA Retirement Plan with 3% matching contribution from employer

About FiXT:

FiXT is an internationally recognized, independent, artist-owned record label with a roster of 20+ innovative, genre-bending rock, metal, synthwave and EDM artists, including Celldweller, The Browning, ENMY, Daedric, Scandroid, Fight The Fade, The Anix, Enemies & Allies, Rabbit Junk, Fury Weekend, LeBrock, Young Medicine and more. The FiXT catalog of 4,000 tracks has garnered billions of online streams connecting with a core audience of gamers, sci-fi enthusiasts and comic book fans. Founded in 2006 by Klayton (Celldweller / Scandroid), FiXT serves a global fanbase of customers in over 150 countries. FiXT’s music has received over 1,000 Film/TV/Video Game placements, including titles such as: Avengers: Endgame, Blade Runner 2049, Kingsman: The Golden Circle, Westworld, Power Rangers, Lexus, Suicide Squad, Iron Man, Alien Covenant, Robocop, Jack Reacher, Deadpool, Lucy, Pacific Rim, PubG, Call of Duty, Assassin’s Creed, Dead Rising, UFC, NFL, MLB and more.

Integrity • Passion • Ambition • Excellence • Innovation • Empathy • Humility

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Embed security in the development lifecycle: threat-model new product features, review designs before code ships, and build guardrails like secure libraries and CI checks that make the safe path the easy path.
  • Decide what good looks like and prove it. Build the metrics and scorecards that show leadership how much risk we removed, and tie security spend to the risks and compliance obligations that matter most.
  • Secure our adoption of AI: architectures, threat models, and runtime protections for AI systems in production. Then point the same technology back at our own work, automating vulnerability management, threat detection, and security operations.
  • Be the engineer others bring their hard problems to. Explain the why behind a security practice, not just the requirement, and help engineers across the department level up through design reviews and pair sessions.
  • Own the security tooling stack, including the build-versus-buy calls, so our controls earn their cost, scale with the company, and satisfy our requirements.
  • Take a regular turn in the security engineering team's on-call rotation.

What You Will Need to Succeed

  • 10+ years of security experience spanning security operations, product security, infrastructure security, and application security.
  • You have set architectural direction: roadmaps, standards, and secure reference patterns that more than one business unit actually followed.
  • You have partnered with product and engineering leaders to build security into the development lifecycle, through threat modeling, design review, and secure defaults, instead of bolting it on afterward.
  • Deep technical breadth across cloud (AWS) and traditional enterprise security. This is a hands-on role: you build proof-of-concepts to prove a design, and you dig into broken systems yourself when it matters.
  • You have run security metrics programs, and the numbers drove prioritization and impact.
  • You have designed systems against best practices and regulatory requirements and you know how to pass an audit by design rather than by scrambling before it.
  • You have secured AI systems hands-on, from threat modeling to runtime defense, and you have used AI to automate real security work.
  • You talk to non-security stakeholders in plain language, build consensus, and influence engineering leadership without being the department of no. You would rather automate a recurring problem than file a ticket about it.
  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. CISSP is a plus.
  • Bonus points for offensive security experience: penetration testing, red teaming, or exploit development. You know how attacks work because you have run them. Extra if that includes attacking AI systems.

jobs.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team in Canada.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experience of tomorrow. We are looking for a talented Senior DevOps Engineer to support our engineering work, with a strong focus on the underlying infrastructure that we need to get from source code to production, plus keep it happy once it's there. We need someone who understands software development and enjoys working with developers on all the things necessary to improving, deploying, monitoring, and operating production services.

Responsibilities:

  • Build complex, highly available, and cost-optimized cloud infrastructure solutions on Azure and in Kubernetes (AKS)
  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade AKS clusters, including private cluster networking, node pool sizing and autoscaling, workload identity, ingress, certificate management, and cluster upgrade lifecycle
  • Own infrastructure as code end to end in Terraform: author and refactor reusable modules, manage per-environment workspaces and state, and drive changes through pull request, plan review, and apply
  • Design and implement advanced CI/CD pipelines ensuring quality, security, and efficiency, including container image build/publish and progressive promotion from lower environments to production
  • Establish comprehensive monitoring and observability strategies across cluster, application, and Azure platform services
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks, leading troubleshooting efforts for complex issues across compute, networking, identity, and data layers
  • Implement high-level security practices, integrating vulnerability scanning and threat modeling, and manage secrets through a centralized secrets store with identity-based (rather than credential-based) access
  • Maintain and exercise multi-region high availability and disaster recovery, including failover and failback procedures for Kubernetes workloads and managed databases
  • Work with application engineering to cultivate operational standards

Requirements:

We know that sometimes, you can't tick every box. We would still love to hear from you if you think you're a good fit!

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in a DevOps engineering role with significant Azure experience
  • Proven track record of designing and implementing large-scale Azure solutions
  • Hands-on experience running AKS in production, not just in development or proof-of-concept environments — including private clusters, cluster upgrades, autoscaling, and incident response on live workloads
  • Advanced, production-level Terraform experience: module design, state and workspace management, and multi-environment/multi-subscription deployments
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems and architect robust solutions
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Certified Kubernetes Administrator)

Desirable:

  • Cloud: Deep knowledge of Azure services, architectures, and design patterns, including Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities and workload identity federation, Key Vault, and subscription/landing zone structure
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Advanced skills in Terraform, or other IaC tools
  • CI/CD: Strong experience with pipeline-as-code (Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or equivalent), service connections and federated pipeline authentication, and GitOps-style continuous delivery to Kubernetes (Argo CD, Flux, or similar)
  • Programming and Scripting: Strong scripting skills (PowerShell, Bash, Python) and proficiency with one or more programming languages (e.g., Go, C#/.NET, Node.js)
  • Containerization and Microservices: Extensive experience with Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), Helm, container registries, and microservices architectures
  • Complex Configuration Management: Expertise in configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet, etc.)
  • Robust Networking: In-depth knowledge of networking concepts, Azure virtual network and subnet design, private endpoints and private DNS zones, hybrid connectivity (site-to-site VPN, network virtual appliances/firewalls), and network security
  • Data and Messaging Services: Familiarity with Azure managed data services such as SQL Managed Instance (including failover groups), Cosmos DB, Redis/managed cache, Storage, and Functions
  • Observability: Experience with Azure Monitor/Log Analytics and KQL, plus at least one third-party observability platform (Datadog, Grafana, or similar)
  • Resilience: Experience designing and testing multi-region redundancy, RTO/RPO-driven DR runbooks, and failover automation
  • Security Focus: Strong understanding of cloud security principles, penetration testing, and compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
  • Multi-cloud: ScriptCycle's footprint spans both Azure and Google Cloud, with an active workload migration track. Exposure to GCP and GKE (including Autopilot) and to cross-cloud networking and identity is a strong plus, though Azure is the primary focus of this role; experience supporting a GCP migration

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Care: Healthcare, Basic Life Insurance, Short and Long-term disability insurance according to the Company’s Benefit Plans

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress. Now expanding across Canada, we’re looking for talented professionals to strengthen our North American footprint. Join us to innovate at scale and deliver world-class solutions to global clients.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

Software Engineer in Test

US REMOTE (AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, MA, MD, NC, NJ, NH, NV, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX)

About VivoSense

VivoSense is a science and technology company specializing in digital health technologies (DHTs), including wearable sensors, mobile applications, and connected monitoring tools. We partner with pharmaceutical sponsors, healthcare providers, and academic groups to develop and deliver real-world digital clinical measures backed by rigorous scientific and analytic expertise.

Job Description

We are looking for a Software Engineer in Test who combines strong software testing and automation skills with experience working within a regulated software quality environment.

This role will help ensure that VivoSense software products are reliable, traceable, and appropriately verified and validated for their intended use. You will work closely with Software Engineering, Product Management, DevOps, and Quality to define test strategies, develop automated and manual tests, maintain validation evidence, investigate defects, and support software releases through established quality gates.

The ideal candidate understands that testing in a regulated environment goes beyond identifying software defects. It requires disciplined documentation, requirements traceability, risk-based testing, repeatability, controlled processes, and objective evidence demonstrating that software meets its intended requirements.

As part of a small and collaborative organization, you will also have significant ownership in improving our testing processes, automation frameworks, and overall software quality practices.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and maintain software test strategies, test plans, test cases, test procedures, and validation documentation for new features and software releases.
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites covering application workflows, APIs, integrations, regression testing, and other critical system functionality.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and build-triggered quality processes.
  • Perform risk-based testing, focusing verification effort on functionality that presents the greatest product, data integrity, security, or clinical risk.
  • Review product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical designs to ensure they are clear, testable, and appropriately covered by verification activities.
  • Maintain traceability between requirements, risks, test cases, test execution, defects, and release evidence where required by the software lifecycle.
  • Execute formal and exploratory testing and accurately document test results and objective evidence.
  • Identify, document, investigate, and reproduce software defects and collaborate with developers to determine root cause and verify corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, Science, Product Management, DevOps, and Quality to ensure releases successfully complete defined quality and validation gates.
  • Own software verification activities and ensure verification is appropriately planned, executed, documented, traceable, and completed in accordance with applicable quality procedures.
  • Support software validation activities for controlled releases and significant software changes, including validation planning, execution, documentation, and required evidence.

jobs.title: Director of Talent Acquisition
jobs.excerpt: Ready to Build the Team Behind a Brand Families Love?
jobs.description:
Ready to Build the Team Behind a Brand Families Love?

At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.

We are seeking a Director of Talent Acquisition to own how Hadley Designs finds, vets, and closes the growth operators and future leaders who will carry our next phase of growth. If you treat recruiting like a growth problem, love being the face of a brand to candidates, and want the autonomy to run the whole engine, this role is for you.

About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.

Our mission is to design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. Our vision is to build the most trusted children's brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow.

Role Overview

As our Director of Talent Acquisition, you will own how Hadley Designs sources, vets, and closes top talent for every open role, from Amazon and ecommerce operators to senior leaders. You will design and run the recruiting engine that consistently delivers a strong top of funnel, put every candidate through a process that shows who they really are, and bring our leadership only the people worth their time.

This is a leadership-tier role with end-to-end ownership of recruiting, from the pipeline to the right people joining our team. There is no recruiting coordinator. You build the engine and let AI and the tools you set up carry the admin, so your time goes to meeting candidates, sourcing them, and finding new ways to reach great talent. You will run first-round interviews, including for director-level roles, manage our outside recruiting partners to our standards, and be the face of Hadley Designs for every candidate, so you need to be great on camera and great with people.

Key Responsibilities

  • Recruiting pipeline management. Source candidates outbound and inbound across LinkedIn, Workable, job boards, online communities, referrals, and your own network, and filter applicants for red flags, competency match, and alignment with each role profile.
  • Test project and interview operations. Run our Culture Index step, case studies, and first-round interviews, review submissions, and manage the candidate experience end to end, including for the people we do not hire.
  • Sourcing channel optimization. Manage and optimize sourcing channels based on performance, and build "always hiring" shortlists for recurring high-leverage roles.
  • Outside recruiting partners. Manage our agency partners so every candidate they send follows the same process, and hold them to our terms.
  • New talent channels. Find creative new ways to reach great people, especially in the online communities where they already spend time.
  • Employer brand and reviews. Monitor and manage Glassdoor and Indeed reviews, organize team review drives, ask for feedback, flag issues, and protect our rating.
  • Hiring metrics and funnel reporting. Deliver weekly hiring pipeline reports broken down by channel and role, and track funnel performance against KPIs.
  • Reference checks. Run reference checks, by phone for leadership roles.

How Success Is Measured

  • Average time to fill open roles under 45 days
  • 250 or more qualified applicants per active role per week
  • Weekly hiring pipeline report by sourcing channel, 100% complete and on time
  • 15 or more completed candidate case studies available for review per role per week
  • A Glassdoor company rating of 4.5 or higher across the year, with Indeed tracked beside it
  • An interview and recruiting experience candidates rate highly, including the people we do not hire

Requirements

Who You Are

You are a recruiting-strong, systems-oriented leader. You have personally closed difficult hires, not just managed a team that did. You move fast in a sourcing pipeline, you can run a structured interview that lands the right read on a candidate in 30 minutes, and you are as comfortable pitching a role on camera as you are defending the company on Glassdoor. You look at people the way a growth marketer looks at growth, and you want the autonomy to run the whole engine.

You Have

  • 3 to 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in remote or ecommerce organizations; agency recruiting experience is a big plus
  • A proven track record of hiring across marketing, operations, Amazon, ecommerce, product, and leadership roles
  • Confidence and presence on camera, and comfort representing a brand to candidates
  • Experience running structured interviews, test projects, and case studies
  • Outbound sourcing experience, and expert-level LinkedIn and Workable skills
  • Real creativity in tapping online communities to find talent in unusual places
  • AI capability, a CRM and documented SOPs. You use AI every day to get more done with less, which is a must-have here and a capability rather than any one tool, and you have a clear view of how all three make recruiting faster and better now and going forward
  • Strong writing ability, from clear job posts to compelling outreach and direct candidate communication
  • The ability to handle 5 to 10 active roles at a time with no drop-off in process
  • Experience building and running reporting for hiring metrics
  • Experience managing outside recruiting agencies

Benefits

Why You'll Love Working Here

Your work will directly impact how families experience learning through the Hadley Designs brand. You will join a passionate, mission-driven team that values trust, creativity, and collaboration, with the freedom of a remote role and flexible working hours.

  • Remote-first work environment
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Access to learning resources and professional development
  • Free access to Hadley Designs products
  • Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO
  • Stability from more than a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

Our Hiring Process

Every candidate completes a Culture Index assessment and a case study before interviews. For this role, reference checks are done by phone.

Apply Today

If you are ready to build the team behind a brand that is shaping the future of learning, apply now to join Hadley Designs as our Director of Talent Acquisition.

P.S. If you don't hear from us within four weeks of your application, please consider that as our decision to move forward with other candidates, but we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs.

Position Type: Full-Time | Remote

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Bookkeeper to manage day-to-day financial records and support the company's accounting operations. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience maintaining accurate financial records, processing accounts payable and receivable, reconciling accounts, and preparing basic financial reports.

This role requires someone who is methodical, proactive, and comfortable working independently while ensuring all financial information is accurate, organized, and up to date.

What You’ll Own

  • Transaction Recording & Categorization: Record, categorize, and maintain daily financial transactions across company accounts, ensuring accurate and up-to-date bookkeeping records.
  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Manage incoming and outgoing payments, process invoices, follow up on outstanding balances, and maintain accurate accounts payable and receivable records.
  • Bank & Account Reconciliation: Reconcile bank statements, credit card accounts, and other financial records regularly, identifying and resolving discrepancies.
  • Financial Reporting: Prepare basic financial reports, including profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow summaries to support financial planning and decision-making.
  • Financial Documentation: Maintain organized records of transactions, receipts, invoices, and supporting documentation in an accurate and audit-ready format.
  • Month-End & Year-End Close: Assist with closing activities by reviewing transactions, preparing necessary entries, and ensuring financial records are complete and accurate.
  • Internal Coordination: Respond to finance-related queries, communicate discrepancies, and coordinate with relevant team members to ensure smooth accounting operations.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or a closely related accounting role.
  • Hands-on experience with accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, or similar platforms.
  • Solid understanding of double-entry bookkeeping and basic accounting principles.
  • Practical experience managing accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations.
  • Ability to prepare basic financial statements and reports.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial records.
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to manage daily responsibilities independently and meet deadlines.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting month-end and year-end closing processes.
  • Familiarity with financial documentation and audit preparation.
  • Experience working remotely with finance teams.
  • Ability to identify discrepancies and recommend improvements to bookkeeping processes.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Methodical & Consistent: You follow established processes, maintain accurate records, and ensure routine tasks are completed reliably.
  • Proactively Organized: You keep financial documentation structured and flag discrepancies before they become larger issues.
  • Independent & Accountable: You can manage your daily workload with minimal supervision and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Clear Communicator: You keep relevant stakeholders informed, ask questions when something is unclear, and communicate financial issues promptly.
  • Detail-Oriented: You understand the importance of accuracy and consistency when handling financial information.

What Success Looks Like

  • Daily financial transactions are recorded and categorized accurately.
  • Bank, credit card, and other account reconciliations are completed regularly.
  • Accounts payable and receivable records remain organized and up to date.
  • Financial reports are prepared accurately and delivered on time.
  • All receipts, invoices, and supporting documents are properly maintained.
  • Month-end and year-end bookkeeping activities are completed smoothly.

Typical Day

Your day will focus on keeping the company's financial records accurate and up to date. You'll begin by reviewing and recording new transactions, followed by reconciliation work and invoice processing or follow-ups. You'll also prepare financial summaries as needed, respond to internal questions about account details, and ensure all supporting documentation is properly organized.

The role is largely independent and task-driven, with periodic check-ins and coordination with your manager or finance team.

Interview Process

  • Initial recruiter screening.
  • Final interview with the hiring team.
  • Offer Letter & Onboarding

jobs.excerpt: Same time zone as Europe.  If you've worked agency or BPO desks on commission, you already know how this works, now paid per placement in euros.
jobs.description:
Same time zone as Europe. If you've worked agency or BPO desks on commission, you already know how this works, now paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Durban and across South Africa.

Take a few minutes to read everything first. It's long on purpose: if this isn't you, no problem, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing comes up front. Everything below grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • A direct line to us for any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

Agentic systems. Developing long-horizon agents that plan, use tools, and collaborate. We also build the core infrastructure to ensure reliability and governance at scale, spanning context/memory, observability, traffic control, and continuous verification.

Travel: 35% or less

Revenue Responsibility: $100M+ Design Win Portfolio across Nvidia and other EMEA optical customers


THE OPPORTUNITY


Semtech is a global leader in high-performance analog ICs for high-speed optical and copper interconnect. As AI workloads drive exponential bandwidth growth toward 1.6T infrastructure, interconnect is becoming the major limiting factor in data center scaling, creating an unprecedented market opportunity at the intersection of technical innovation and commercial impact.

This Principal Field Applications Engineer – High-Speed Interconnect represents a pivotal strategic hire, a technical strategist and commercial catalyst positioned to drive $100M+ in design-win revenue and establish market dominance across hyperscaler data centers.

The dual mandate is clear: secure immediate design wins with Semtech's current portfolio of high-speed analog ICs for optical and copper connectivity in AI networks, while simultaneously leading long-term customer co-development initiatives that will define our competitive position in next-generation 1.6T and 3.2T connectivity.


The role also extends technical scope to support key regional accounts in PON and Mobile Transport. These engagements draw on the same underlying product families and technical skill set, high-speed analog/mixed-signal ICs, signal integrity, and optical/electrical characterisation, making this a natural extension of the core mandate.


Success requires becoming a trusted technical advisor whom Tier 1 hyperscaler customers welcome into their most confidential labs, not as a vendor, but as an extension of their design teams. You'll leverage consultative discovery to uncover the situational factors, business consequences, and decision criteria that drive customer choices.

Your technical credibility will open doors; your strategic approach will close deals. Your voice will directly influence Semtech's product roadmaps, serving as strategic advisor to VPs in sales and product lines, co-creating breakthroughs that establish Semtech as the indispensable partner for the future of data center connectivity.

This role is for someone who thrives where breakthrough technology meets strategic business impact, someone ready to shape the future of an industry being transformed by AI.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Customer Co-Development & Innovation

  • Drive design wins for Semtech's portfolio of high-speed drivers, TIAs, copper redrivers, and other products, working closely with engineering teams from key data center customers.
  • Accelerate customer design-in cycles, proactively removing technical barriers to secure immediate revenue opportunities
  • Lead co-development initiatives for next-generation technologies (1.6T, 3.2T+) with customer engineering teams, defining the future of data center connectivity
  • Create joint innovation programs and proof-of-concept projects with Tier 1 hyperscaler providers that establish Semtech as their strategic technology partner
  • Align Semtech product roadmap with customer technology evolution plans, ensuring our solutions arrive precisely when markets mature

PON & Mobile Transport Account Support

  • Provide technical and pre/post-sales support to key European PON and Mobile Transport accounts
  • Apply signal integrity, high-speed analog, and characterisation expertise across product lines
  • Support design-in activities, technical evaluations, and troubleshooting for these accounts as required
  • Balance and prioritise time across data center and PON/Mobile Transport engagements in line with regional business needs

Technical Excellence & Customer Support

  • Lead technical evaluations and drive technical differentiation in competitive situations
  • Provide comprehensive pre-sales and post-sales customer support for strategic design-ins
  • Troubleshoot and debug complex technical issues with a relentless commitment to solving problems
  • Guide customers on hardware design, PCB layout, signal integrity optimization, firmware integration, and system validation
  • Support customer qualification processes with equipment manufacturers, network operators, and cloud service providers
  • Create application notes, white papers, and design guides establishing thought leadership

Cross-Functional Strategic Influence

  • Influence product management and R&D priorities based on customer insights and market intelligence
  • Serve as strategic technical advisor to VPs in sales and product lines, bridging the gap between customer needs and product strategy
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure customer co-development projects receive appropriate resources and priority
  • Drive internal alignment across product management, engineering, marketing, sales, and operations

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related technical field (Master's or Ph.D. preferred)
  • 5+ years of proven AE/FAE experience, demonstrating expert-level technical capability and strategic customer engagement, gained in data center, PON, or wireless/mobile transport environments

Technical Mastery

  • Expertise in signal integrity (high-speed principles, modulation schemes, channel modeling, equalization) for 800G, 1.6T, 3.2T data center, PON, or mobile transport applications
  • Knowledge of optical transceiver architecture, design, validation, and manufacturing
  • Familiarity with LPO, LRO, NPO, and CPO architectures (data center focus); familiarity with PON ONU/OLT or mobile transport optical architectures equally valued
  • Experience in high-speed PCB design including layout, impedance control, and signal integrity validation
  • Proficiency with high-speed test equipment (network analyzers, BER testers, oscilloscopes)
  • Understanding of IEEE 802.3 and OIF standards, or ITU-T PON standards depending on background

Market & Co-Development Expertise

  • Understanding of optical communications, networking, hyperscaler data center architectures, network topologies, and infrastructure evolution across data center, PON, or mobile transport markets
  • Demonstrated success leading customer co-development projects with significant revenue impact
  • Established relationships with Tier 1 customer engineering teams and ecosystem partners

Leadership & Communication Excellence

  • Exceptional communication across technical and business audiences
  • Proven ability to influence without formal authority and work autonomously in complex situations
  • Strong initiative and ownership mentality

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience with high-speed laser/modulator drivers, TIAs, redrivers, and/or DSPs
  • Active participation in industry standards bodies (IEEE 802.3, OIF, ITU-T) driving next-generation specifications
  • Prior experience at optical customers, optical networking, hyperscalers, optical module vendors, PON equipment vendors, mobile network infrastructure providers, or data center equipment manufacturers
  • Existing relationships with European PON or Mobile Transport accounts considered a strong plus

jobs.description:
Reports to: Head of Global Support

Location: Remote, USA

About Proscia

Proscia is revolutionizing pathology, the last major frontier in healthcare to embrace digital. As a leader in pathology AI software, we are empowering pathologists and scientists to transition from traditional microscope-based workflows to digital, AI-driven approaches, unlocking new possibilities in precision medicine.

The digital pathology market is experiencing explosive growth as advances in AI enable unprecedented insights into diseases like cancer. Pathology is central to medicine, and the shift to AI-powered solutions is not just modernizing workflows—it’s transforming how diseases are diagnosed, treated, and understood. Predictions for the future of pathology show a tidal wave of adoption, with experts describing the field as “poised for the next major breakthrough” in healthcare innovation.

Backed by over $100 million in funding from leading healthcare and technology investors, Proscia is at the forefront of this revolution. Joining Proscia means being part of a company at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, where the possibilities are limitless. With the convergence of AI, precision medicine, and digital pathology, we’re not just changing pathology—we’re redefining what’s possible in medicine.

About the Role

Some customers don't file a ticket and wait. They pick up the phone and expect the person on the other end to already understand their environment and workflows. Those are your customers. Proscia’s most strategic accounts run mission-critical digital pathology at scale, and they turn to one person who owns the technical relationship end-to-end.

As a Strategic Support Engineer, you are the technical owner and trusted advisor for a portfolio of Proscia’s highest-profile customers. This isn't queue work. You know your accounts better than anyone, drive their hardest issues to resolution, and carry what you learn back to Engineering and Product so the platform evolves to meet what your customers need. You do it in an AI-first support organization, using modern tooling to move faster than the role previously allowed.

About You

You think in relationships, not tickets. You'd rather understand a customer's workflow deeply enough to anticipate the next problem than close the current one and move on. You reason from evidence and follow through relentlessly, investigating problems across software, infrastructure, and integrations until the customer has a real answer. You’re the calm voice on a major-incident call and the persuasive one in an internal prioritization debate.

You treat AI as a native part of how you work, reaching for these tools to investigate, reproduce, and communicate faster without losing the human judgment that separates a plausible answer from the right one. You know how to validate and constrain what these tools produce rather than trust them blindly. And you don't hoard what you learn; every diagnosis becomes something the team can stand on next time.

What You’ll Own

  • Own your customers. Serve as the go-to SME for your assigned strategic accounts. Own their issues, run their check-in and troubleshooting calls, maintain the documentation behind them, and monitor cases to keep them moving toward resolution. Back up the broader queue as needed.
  • Crack the hard problems, AI-first. Investigate complex, multi-faceted issues across application, infrastructure, and integrations, bringing AI and modern tooling to bear to reproduce defects and reach root cause faster. Then document thoroughly and lead validation testing for the fixes. Set the standard for how the team uses AI in real customer work.
  • Lead when it counts. During major incidents, you lead the response: steady, high-touch communication and escalation with clear, timely updates to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Shape the product and align the account team. Carry a strong, evidence-based point of view: partner with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to prioritize the fixes and features that matter most to your customers, and keep Solutions Architects, Implementation Engineers, and Sales aligned on their needs.
  • Set customers up to win. Own technical account health. Maintain a current technical success plan for each assigned account, including environment architecture, integrations, known risks, recurring issues, upgrade posture, and mitigation actions. Identify emerging risks early and drive cross-functional plans before they become customer-impacting incidents.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of technical support or related experience, with a focus on large, strategic accounts.
  • Expertise in digital pathology, healthcare, or related industries, including how software and hardware integrate, and a track record of troubleshooting complex issues.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted workflows: you've made AI a default part of how you investigate and communicate, and you know how to validate and constrain what it produces.
  • Hands-on proficiency across diagnostic, monitoring, and support tooling, Linux/Windows environments, networking protocols, and cloud (AWS, Azure, Kubernetes).
  • Strong root-cause, debugging, testing, and validation skills for complex software and infrastructure issues.
  • Proven experience mentoring or leading other technical professionals, and influencing internal teams (Engineering, Product, Technical Operations) to prioritize customer needs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with real experience managing customer relationships and incident communications.
  • The ability to manage multiple high-profile accounts at once, prioritizing by business impact and proactively anticipating customer needs.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience influencing product or engineering roadmaps from support and customer data.
  • A point of view on where AI is headed in technical support, and ideas you’re eager to put into practice.
  • Experience in regulated or other mission-critical environments, and a background that spans multiple domains.

Beyond Just Work

As a company in healthcare, we want our people to be happy and healthy, in and out of the office. In addition to competitive pay, we ensure everyone on our team is supported with savings, schedule, and insurance options that promote long-term health and personal growth.

Our office environment is designed for creativity and agility: with walls as notepads and couches for collaboration. We’re located in the heart of Philadelphia, with views of the city so you can spend your time focusing on what matters most.

At Proscia, we don’t just accept differences — we celebrate them, we support them, and we thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community. Proscia is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What’s the position?

You will solve complex client engineering problems and raise the engineering bar across teams while remaining close to the code.

Working across Product, Design, QA, Backend, Platform, Security, Compliance, and Operations, you will turn ambiguous needs into durable strategies and guide critical initiatives from discovery through production. Technical strategy and architecture

jobs.excerpt: Recruit for Europe from home, paid in euros per placement.
jobs.description:
Recruit for Europe from home, paid in euros per placement. Your own hours, your own methods. Open to recruiters based in Bogotá and across Colombia.

Please read the whole post before applying. It's long on purpose. If it isn't for you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. For proven partners, things grow with your results, agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • You can reach us directly with any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

In deze rol ondersteun je de beleidsafdeling bij het uitvoeren en verfijnen van statistische analyses op bodemdata. Je werkt onder meer aan de volgende onderwerpen:

Vlaams bodemkoolstofmonitoringsnetwerk

Het Vlaamse bodemkoolstofmonitoringsnetwerk werd in juli 2021 opgestart. Over een periode van 10 jaar worden bodems onder alle landgebruiken bemonsterd, waaronder bodems in waterrijke gebieden, (half-)natuurlijke graslanden en bodems die worden beheerd door overheden, lokale besturen en burgers.

Na drie werkjaren is veel data beschikbaar voor verdere statistische analyse. De resultaten moeten op termijn bruikbaar zijn voor LULUCF-rapporteringen en prognoses. Zo kunnen ze helpen onderbouwen of landbouwbodems of bodems in residentieel gebied koolstof opslaan of verliezen. Daarnaast brengen de analyses verbanden tussen verschillende bodemeigenschappen verder in kaart.

Digital Soil Mapping

Het monitoringnetwerk genereert puntdata over Vlaanderen. Om die data gebiedsdekkend te maken, combineer je puntdata met gebiedsdekkende predictoren via digital soil mapping en random forest. Een historische bodemdataset werd eerder op dezelfde manier verwerkt. Het is de bedoeling om die doorrekening te optimaliseren en af te stemmen op de verwerking van de monitoringdata.

Europese Soil Monitoring Law

De Europese Soil Monitoring Law is momenteel in onderhandeling. Als de wet wordt aangenomen, moet Vlaanderen verschillende aspecten van de monitoring van bodemdata statistisch uitklaren. Het gaat onder meer om het aantal monitoringplots, verbanden tussen verschillende methodes en de nauwkeurigheid, betrouwbaarheid en accuraatheid van de monitoring. Ook moeten monitoringseenheden worden uitgewerkt.

Indicatoren en rapportering

Je berekent indicatoren voor de opvolging van het Vlaamse bodembeleid en voor de voorbereiding van rapportering over de Europese Soil Monitoring Law. Je past bestaande methodieken toe, stuurt ze bij en werkt nieuwe methodieken uit in samenwerking met beleidsmedewerkers. Daarbij gebruik je statistische analyses, geostatistiek, datakwaliteitscontrole en machine learning. Je optimaliseert ook berekeningsmethoden.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Ervaring met het optimaliseren en tunen van databases en queries.
  • Ervaring met digital soil mapping.
  • Ervaring met het analyseren van datastromen.
  • Ervaring met R.
  • Ervaring met de publieke sector.
  • Ervaring met databanken, in het bijzonder SQL en Oracle.
  • Kennis van geostatistiek.
  • Ervaring met machine learning.
  • Ervaring met rapportering.
  • Ervaring met scripting in Shell, Perl en Python.
  • Vertrouwdheid met het domein bodem.

Job Title: Senior Data Scientist, Insurance Pricing
Location: United States
Workplace Type: Remote


Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we’d love for you to be a part of it as our Senior Data Scientist, Insurance Pricing.

As a senior member of our data science team, you will own the development and deployment of our homeowners insurance pricing and risk models, taking complex modeling problems from scoping through production deployment. While GLM-based pricing sits at the core of this role, you will also contribute to profitability and retention modeling, geospatial risk analysis, and the evaluation of emerging techniques like generative AI. You’ll partner closely with actuarial, product, and engineering teams to translate Porch’s unique property data into a durable competitive advantage in underwriting and pricing. This is an ideal role for an experienced practitioner who wants to deepen their technical expertise, support other data scientists, and drive measurable business value.


What You Will Do As A Senior Data Scientist, Insurance Pricing

  • Contribute to modeling standards and best practices for insurance pricing and risk modeling, helping the team apply them consistently
  • Support and mentor junior data scientists through code review, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance
  • Build, validate, and deploy GLM-based models (frequency, severity, and loss cost) for homeowners insurance pricing
  • Build machine learning models (GBMs, neural networks, etc.) that drive underwriting accuracy, competitive positioning, and profitability
  • Develop ensemble models predicting insured-level profitability, customer retention, and conversion, including customer lifetime value (LTV) models to prioritize marketing and underwriting strategies
  • Incorporate non-traditional data sources, including aerial imagery, satellite data, government records, and building permits, to quantify localized risk and inform pricing and underwriting decisions
  • Partner with product, actuarial, engineering, and business stakeholders to scope initiatives and integrate data science solutions into operational workflows
  • Work with the actuarial team to develop, file, implement, and monitor new predictive models that meet regulatory requirements
  • Follow rigorous deployment practices in high-traffic environments, including A/B testing, performance monitoring, and continuous refinement
  • Evaluate emerging techniques, including generative AI and LLMs, to identify new opportunities for competitive advantage

What You Will Bring As A Senior Data Scientist, Insurance Pricing

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, with significant depth in insurance pricing or risk modeling
  • Track record of technical ownership, delivering complex projects end-to-end and supporting or mentoring less-experienced data scientists
  • Demonstrated experience building, validating, and deploying GLM-based pricing models in production, ideally for homeowners or other property/casualty lines, as well as machine learning models for non-pricing use cases
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience implementing GLMs and gradient boosting models (scikit-learn, statsmodels, xgboost, lightgbm)
  • Experience with experimental design, including building, deploying, and A/B testing models in high-traffic environments, as well as causal analysis
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., BigQuery, GCP) and MLOps practices such as model training pipelines, versioning, and monitoring
  • Proficiency with Confluence and Jira for documentation and project tracking in an Agile/Scrum environment
  • Master’s or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field preferred
  • Nice to have: background in actuarial science or insurance mathematics, including experience collaborating with actuarial teams on regulatory model filing
  • Nice to have: experience with customer lifetime value, retention, or conversion modeling
  • Nice to have: experience with geospatial or spatial data analysis (aerial imagery, satellite data, or property-level geographic datasets)
  • Nice to have: exposure to generative AI and LLMs, including prompt engineering or fine-tuning for insurance or financial services use cases
  • Nice to have: exposure to experimentation frameworks and causal inference methods
  • Nice to have: experience with model governance, validation frameworks, and regulatory compliance in insurance
