Le côté brillant de l'hypothèque

nesto est le chef de file du financement hypothécaire résidentiel numérique au Canada. Nous offrons aux Canadiens les taux les plus bas dès le départ, en toute transparence et sans négociation.

À propos de nous

Pionnier du financement hypothécaire en ligne au Canada, nesto transforme la façon dont les Canadiens financent leur propriété. Notre mission est d'offrir une expérience de financement immobilier positive, valorisante et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin.

Les emprunteurs profitent de taux souvent plus avantageux que ceux offerts par les grandes banques, ainsi que d'une expérience hypothécaire exceptionnelle, simple et fluide, du début à la fin. Le tout est propulsé par une technologie d'intelligence artificielle de pointe.

Rapide, simple et entièrement numérique, nesto a été nommé Prêteur hypothécaire de l'année par la CLA pendant trois années consécutives. Voilà le côté brillant de l'hypothèque.

Groupe Nesto

Le Groupe Nesto est le principal fournisseur de technologies hypothécaires et de solutions de financement au Canada, avec plus de 80 milliards de dollars canadiens en prêts hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux sous administration. Fort de la confiance de plusieurs des principales institutions financières du pays, le Groupe Nesto combine plus de 50 ans d'expertise hypothécaire à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives pour transformer l'avenir du financement.

Grâce à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives, nesto est devenu l'un des prêteurs hypothécaires à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada, gagnant des parts de marché dans le financement résidentiel direct aux consommateurs (D2C), le réseau des courtiers hypothécaires et le financement commercial multirésidentiel. Reconnue au palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte pendant trois années consécutives, l'entreprise continue de faire progresser le secteur grâce à l'innovation, à la technologie et à des solutions axées sur les clients.

Grâce à sa famille de marques — CMLS, nesto et Nesto Cloud —, le Groupe Nesto a pour mission de bâtir l'écosystème hypothécaire canadien de demain et de devenir un véritable chef de file canadien en technologies de financement et en services financiers.

Pour en savoir plus :

La vie chez nesto

Chez nesto, nous avons à cœur de remettre en question le statu quo, d'offrir une meilleure expérience hypothécaire et d'aider les Canadiens à économiser sur leur hypothèque. Nous cultivons une culture de collaboration, de transparence et de créativité, où chaque membre de l'équipe est encouragé à prendre ses projets en main, à avoir un impact concret et à évoluer.

Si vous souhaitez relever des défis stimulants et trouver des solutions à des enjeux importants aux côtés de collègues ambitieux, passionnés et toujours prêts à s'entraider, vous vous sentirez chez vous chez nesto.

Votre rôle

  • Effectuer quotidiennement l'examen d'un échantillon de demandes hypothécaires (avant et après déboursement) pour assurer la conformité aux normes de souscription, aux politiques du Groupe nesto et aux exigences réglementaires.
  • Évaluer l'ensemble des éléments de données, documents financiers, renseignements clients, transmissions des courtiers et assureurs, et documents juridiques afin de noter tout écart par rapport aux politiques.
  • Repérer les tendances de comportement inhabituel, les transactions suspectes et la légitimité des documents via les « dossiers à surveiller » des assureurs et les références internes.
  • Effectuer des enquêtes préliminaires et prendre les mesures nécessaires sur les dossiers suspects afin de réduire le risque de perte et de fausse représentation.
  • Préparer des rapports d'assurance qualité détaillant les constatations et recommandations, et mener des analyses approfondies à la demande de la gestion des risques ou de l'AQ.
  • Soutenir les audits avec les partenaires, investisseurs et assureurs, de la préparation initiale jusqu'à la résolution des items problématiques.
  • Aider à la gestion, au contrôle périodique et à l'examen des listes approuvées (évaluateurs, notaires/avocats, courtiers, fournisseurs) et des listes de lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent (LBA).
  • Exécuter les examens d'assurance et de contrôle de la qualité de façon régulière, rapide, efficace et objective.
  • Fournir des conseils, opinions et recommandations au personnel de souscription et aux parties prenantes concernant les risques de crédit, la mitigation des pertes, les risques d'inondation/propriété et les opportunités de formation.

Qui nous recherchons

  • Expérience : Minimum de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en approbation/adjudication de prêts hypothécaires. Expérience dans le canal des courtiers hypothécaires, un atout.
  • Outils & Maîtrise technique : Maîtrise des applications Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, SharePoint), Google Workspace (GDrive, Sheets, Docs), des CRM et outils de flux de travail (Salesforce).
  • Connaissances du domaine : Solide compréhension des directives des assureurs, internes et externes, ainsi qu'une bonne connaissance des implications, méthodes de détection et de prévention de la fraude.
  • Compétences clés : Pensée analytique et compétences bien développées en négociation et résolution de problèmes pour repérer les tendances et anomalies dans les pratiques de souscription.
  • Autonomie & Prise de décision : Capacité à travailler de façon autonome avec une supervision limitée, à gérer et prioriser les demandes urgentes, et à formuler des recommandations impopulaires lorsque requis.
  • Langue & Communication : Bilinguisme fluide (français et anglais) requis pour soutenir les clients à l'échelle nationale, avec une excellente capacité à communiquer les constatations à la direction et aux souscripteurs.

Pourquoi vous aimeriez travailler ici

Nous croyons que les personnes de talent donnent le meilleur d'elles-mêmes lorsqu'elles sont soutenues sur les plans professionnel, personnel et financier. C'est pourquoi nous offrons un programme de rémunération globale complet, conçu pour vous aider à vous épanouir à chaque étape de votre carrière.

  • Rémunération concurrentielle — Salaire compétitif, primes de rendement (le cas échéant) et reconnaissance de vos contributions.
  • Santé et bien-être — Couverture complète pour les soins médicaux, dentaires et de la vue, comptes de gestion des dépenses santé et bien-être (le cas échéant), télémédecine, programme d'aide aux employés (PAE) et soutien en santé mentale pour vous et votre famille.
  • Du temps pour refaire le plein — Vacances généreuses (4 semaines), congés mobiles et jours fériés pour vous permettre de vous ressourcer.
  • Planification de l'avenir — Cotisation de contrepartie au REER pour soutenir votre bien-être financier à long terme.
  • Soutien aux familles — Prestations complémentaires bonifiées pour les congés de maternité et parentaux.
  • Apprentissage et perfectionnement — Aide financière aux études, mentorat, formations et occasions de faire progresser votre carrière au sein du Groupe Nesto.
  • Des outils pour réussir — Technologies modernes, équipes collaboratives et toutes les ressources nécessaires pour vous dépasser.

Diversité, équité et inclusion

Au sein du Groupe Nesto, nous croyons que la diversité des points de vue fait notre force. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un milieu de travail inclusif où chacun se sent respecté, soutenu et habilité à réussir.

Nous accueillons les candidatures de personnes de tous horizons, y compris les membres des Premiers Peuples (Premières Nations, Inuit et Métis), les personnes en situation de handicap, les membres des communautés racisées, les femmes et les personnes de la communauté 2ELGBTQIA+.

Si vous avez besoin de mesures d'adaptation à n'importe quelle étape du processus de recrutement, nous nous engageons à collaborer avec vous pour répondre à vos besoins.

The bright side of mortgages

nestois Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.

About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS,nesto, andNesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services.

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

About the Role

  • Review an adequate daily sampling of mortgage applications post-funding and pre-funding to ensure compliance with nesto Group policies, underwriting standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Assess file data elements, financial documents, client information, broker file transmissions, insurer transmissions, and miscellaneous legal documentation to identify policy deviations.
  • Identify patterns of unusual behavior, suspicious transactions, and documentation validity via "Heads up Files" from external insurers and internal referrals.

Who we are looking for

  • Language & Communication: Bilingual fluency (English and French) is required to support nationwide clients, with an ability to effectively communicate findings to management and underwriting teams.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.

Time to Recharge — Generous vacation (4 weeks), floater days, and statutory holidays to help you recharge.

Planning for the Future — RRSP matching to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

Family Support — Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.

Learning & Growth — Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.

Tools for Success — Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Help build the next generation of Agentforce. We’re an entrepreneurial incubation team within Salesforce, combining the pace and ownership of a startup with access to enterprise customers and Salesforce’s distribution. We’re looking for a technical product leader with deep AI expertise who wants to turn frontier capabilities into products customers can rely on.

You’ll shape product strategy for AI quality and evaluation, establish how we measure progress, and personally lead a customer quality workstream and a focused feature from early learning through delivery.

People-management responsibilities may develop as the product and team grow. You should enjoy inspecting traces and data, challenging evaluation results, prototyping with coding agents, and working directly with customers. Engineering partners own technical architecture and production implementation.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Set a coherent product strategy and roadmap for AI quality and evaluation, connecting customer needs, technical opportunities, and measurable business outcomes.

Role Overview
The Research Scientist 2 applies statistical, epidemiologic, and analytical methods to healthcare data to evaluate clinical program performance, understand drivers of outcomes, and support clinical and business decision-making.

This role will be part of the Quality & Cost Strategy Analytics team supporting the performance management and evaluation of clinical programs. The Research Scientist 2 will design and execute rigorous outcomes studies, conduct deep-dive analyses to diagnose program performance, and translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations for clinical, operational, and business partners.

The role requires strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to approach moderately complex analytical questions independently while seeking guidance on more complex or ambiguous methodological issues.

Humana’s Quality & Cost Strategy Analytics team is seeking a Research Scientist 2 (Remote) to support the evaluation and performance management of clinical programs.

At Humana, we are focused on transforming the healthcare experience by improving health outcomes, managing healthcare costs, and advancing operational excellence. The Quality & Cost Strategy Analytics team operates at the intersection of clinical strategy, analytics, and enterprise value, using rigorous research and advanced analytics to inform clinical priorities and improve outcomes for our members.

Our team partners across the organization to identify opportunities, evaluate and optimize clinical solutions, and generate actionable insights that support high-value care. We apply rigorous performance measurement and research methods to understand what is working, for whom, and why, and translate those insights into opportunities for continuous program improvement.


Responsibilities

As a Research Scientist 2, you will:

  • Design and execute outcomes studies to evaluate the clinical, utilization, and financial performance of clinical programs using observational and experimental methods.
  • Apply causal inference, epidemiologic, and statistical methods to estimate program impact and generate credible evidence for decision-making.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses using medical and pharmacy claims, enrollment, and operational data to identify key performance drivers, diagnose performance gaps, and uncover opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate clinical and business questions into clearly defined analytical questions and hypotheses, partnering with senior scientists as needed on more complex study designs and methodologies.
  • Partner with clinical, operational, financial, and business stakeholders to translate analytical insights into recommendations that inform clinical strategy, program design, contracting, and performance improvement.
  • Develop high-quality analytical reports, presentations, and executive-level readouts for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Translate complex methodologies and findings into clear, actionable business insights, communicating both implications and analytical limitations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Independently determine appropriate analytical approaches and make sound methodological decisions in complex or ambiguous situations.
  • Manage multiple analytical priorities while maintaining high standards for methodological rigor, accuracy, and reproducibility.

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Economics, Statistics, Health Services Research, Clinical Informatics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • 2+ years of experience applying statistical, epidemiologic, econometric, or related quantitative methods to large, complex datasets.
  • Strong foundation in causal inference and study design, including observational studies, comparative effectiveness research, and randomized controlled trials.
  • Experience manipulating and analyzing data using Python, PySpark, R, SAS, or comparable analytical tools.
  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate clinical and business questions into analytical approaches.
  • Ability to select and apply appropriate analytical methodologies to moderately complex research and business questions, with guidance on more complex methodological challenges.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex methodologies and findings into clear insights and recommendations for non-technical audiences.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong interest in healthcare and a passion for improving health outcomes and healthcare value.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in health insurance, managed care, healthcare analytics, or health services research.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare payer economics, including healthcare utilization, medical cost, and total cost of care.
  • Experience working with medical claims, pharmacy claims, laboratory data, eligibility/enrollment data, and clinical program operational data.
  • Familiarity with clinical concepts across chronic and specialty conditions, such as cardiology, chronic kidney disease, oncology, or other high-cost clinical conditions.
  • Experience evaluating clinical programs, care management interventions, or value-based healthcare initiatives.
  • Familiarity with advanced causal inference and causal machine learning techniques, such as double/debiased machine learning, doubly robust estimation, and meta-learners.
  • Proficiency in Python and PySpark, with experience working in Databricks and Microsoft Azure.

jobs.title: Director, Organizational Effectiveness & Culture Transformation
jobs.excerpt: Clinigen is seeking a bold, pragmatic and commercially minded Director of Organizational Effectiveness & Culture Transformation to help shape how our global organization works, leads and delivers.
jobs.description:
Clinigen is seeking a bold, pragmatic and commercially minded Director of Organizational Effectiveness & Culture Transformation to help shape how our global organization works, leads and delivers. Reporting to the Chief Human Resources Officer and partnering closely with the CEO, Executive Leadership Team and business leaders, this role will turn our culture and accountability ambitions into practical, visible ways of working.

This is not a traditional employee engagement or learning position. It is a hands-on transformation role for someone who can work credibly with senior executives, simplify complexity and build the organizational conditions that enable people to make decisions, own outcomes, collaborate across boundaries and sustain change.

What You Will Do

Shape culture and ways of working

  • Partner with senior leaders to define and embed a focused set of leadership behaviors and enterprise ways of working.
  • Build and deliver a practical culture and organizational effectiveness roadmap aligned with Clinigen’s strategy and the Clinigen Way.
  • Identify the processes, routines and signals that reinforce current behaviors, then redesign them to strengthen ownership, trust, pace and follow-through.
  • Connect culture priorities to measurable business outcomes rather than stand-alone initiatives.

Strengthen leadership effectiveness

  • Advise and facilitate the CEO, CHRO, Executive Leadership Team and Business Unit leaders on team effectiveness, decision-making and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Design and lead leadership sessions that move teams from discussion to clear decisions, accountable owners and committed action.
  • Help establish effective operating rhythms, meeting disciplines, decision rights and escalation practices.
  • Coach senior leaders to model the behaviors required to build confidence, constructive challenge and accountability.

Build enterprise change capability

  • Create a simple, repeatable approach to change management that can be applied across enterprise and business-unit initiatives.
  • Assess change impact, stakeholder needs, readiness and risk, then translate the findings into sponsor, communication, manager and adoption plans.
  • Create visibility across major changes to identify collisions, sequencing risks and opportunities to stop, simplify or combine activity.
  • Equip leaders and managers with practical tools and conversations that help employees understand and adopt change.
  • Measure adoption and behavior change, intervening when implementation activity is not producing sustained results.

Turn employee insight into action

  • Lead Clinigen’s employee-listening and organizational-health approach in partnership with HR Business Partners and Internal Communications.
  • Translate survey, pulse and qualitative insight into a small number of priorities with clear executive ownership.
  • Establish disciplined action planning, follow-through and visible feedback to employees.
  • Provide leaders with a clear, evidence-based view of progress, barriers and organizational health.

Create accountability that works

  • Clarify outcomes, ownership, decision authority, interdependencies and success measures for critical priorities.
  • Design lightweight tools that make commitments and progress visible without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Identify recurring breakdowns in handoffs, decisions and collaboration, then facilitate practical resolution.
  • Partner across HR to align performance, recognition, leadership development and talent practices with the desired culture.

What Success Looks Like

  • Leaders demonstrate consistent ownership and deliver agreed commitments.
  • Executive and cross-functional teams make clearer decisions with stronger follow-through.
  • Major change initiatives have effective sponsorship, sequenced plans and defined adoption outcomes.
  • Managers are more confident leading teams through change.
  • Employees see visible action in response to feedback.
  • Culture and organizational effectiveness priorities produce measurable improvements in execution, collaboration and trust.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Significant progressive experience in organizational effectiveness, organization development, enterprise transformation, change management, leadership effectiveness or a related discipline.
  • A demonstrated record of leading culture and ways-of-working transformation in a complex, global and matrixed organization.
  • Credibility and courage to advise, influence and respectfully challenge C-suite executives and senior business leaders.
  • Hands-on experience assessing readiness, enabling managers and measuring adoption across multiple, concurrent changes.
  • Exceptional facilitation skills and experience helping executive or cross-functional teams navigate ambiguity, tension and consequential decisions.
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect people, culture and organization choices to customers, growth, execution and value creation.
  • Experience in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, life sciences, regulated services or another complex regulated environment is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in a private equity-backed, acquisitive or high-change environment is preferred.
  • A bachelor’s degree in organizational psychology, business, human resources or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
  • Familiarity with methods such as Prosci ADKAR, Kotter or comparable applied change frameworks. Certification is helpful, but practical results matter most.

How You Lead

  • You combine executive presence with a practical, low-ego approach.
  • You see the system, but you are equally comfortable building the roadmap, facilitating the session and following through on execution.
  • You simplify rather than add process.
  • You are comfortable challenging established ways of working while maintaining trust and discretion.
  • You work effectively across regions, functions and cultures and can balance global consistency with local realities.
  • You measure success through sustained behavior and business outcomes, not the volume of activity delivered.

About Clinigen

Clinigen is a global pharmaceutical services organization focused on helping improve access to medicines. Our colleagues work across functions, regions and business units to support customers, healthcare professionals and patients. We are building a more connected, accountable and growth-oriented organization, and we are looking for leaders who want to help shape that future.

Equal Opportunity

Clinigen is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment decisions are based on role requirements, qualifications and business needs. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals throughout the recruitment process and employment, consistent with applicable law.

Benefits

While at Clinigen, you’ll enjoy:

The culture. Thanks to our diverse opportunities for engagement and involvement, every colleague’s Clinigen experience can be a bit different, and we’re proud of that. We work hard to ensure our company culture is inclusive to people from all backgrounds and social styles.

The benefits. We take pride in having a broad range of activities, systems, and programs that provide a competitive benefit offering and build a culture of celebrating success.

  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Employee discount
  • Health insurance
  • Health savings account
  • Life insurance
  • Paid holidays
  • Paid time off
  • Parental leave
  • Professional development assistance
  • Referral program
  • Vision insurance

This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview
The Senior Project Manager is responsible for managing the programming, planning and activation of complex projects under the general supervision of the Director. Ensures the completion of projects are in scope, on schedule, within budget, and meets all program objectives and appropriate government regulations. Acts as a liaison between the client/operational leaders and all other project participants including consultants, contractors, vendors, and all regulatory agencies. Responsible for foundational planning, scheduling, delegation, and oversight of the work pertaining to the project resources and assigned project managers and project coordinators.

The senior project manager utilizing high-level communication skills acting as the liaison between the project team, contractors, customers, key stakeholders and senior leadership. The senior project manager has ultimate responsibility for the overall project delivery.

The senior project manager will be the primary owner and communicator regarding the assigned projects. This position is responsible for managing key strategic organizational projects. This includes the establishing of the project governance, communication requirements, project monitoring & control, defining project objectives; identifying, assessing & managing risks and escalations, and aligning leadership support. Will be required to use the existing standard work/processes and tools as part of the assessment and implementation processes.

Stanford Health Care

  • Standards, Guidelines & Technical:

    experience.

  • Seven (7) years project leadership role(s), including three (3) years consulting experience with major firm, or two (2) years managing complex corporate-wide major programs/initiatives for large organizations. preferred

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to work independently and make sound decisions while meeting time sensitive deadlines.

  • Ability to exercise judgment and demonstrate effectiveness in decision making occasions.

  • Ability to present facts and recommendations effectively in oral and written form.

  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex documents.

  • Ability to write reports using original or innovative techniques or style.

  • Ability to identify issues, risks, and escalations, assemble data, validate conclusions and incorporate resolutions.

  • Strong knowledge of medical and non-medical equipment, organizational programs and procedures.

  • Expertise in MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Visio) and Microsoft SharePoint.

jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewAt Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we build technologies that help people be their best in the moments that matter. Our products support people working in complex, high-stakes environments — from public safety and emergency communications to enterprise security.

Understanding the people who use these technologies, the environments they work within and the challenges they face is fundamental to building products that are useful, trustworthy and effective.

The Futures Insights Team is Motorola Solutions’ research-led futures and strategic foresight pod, embedded within the broader UX Research organization. Our team is primarily split across the United States and United Kingdom. Our work sits between user experience research, strategic foresight, design, and business strategy. We partner across multiple functions while maintaining enough independence to challenge existing assumptions and investigate opportunities that do not yet fit neatly within today’s organizational boundaries.

We approach futuring/futures as a space that is explored and co-created rather than predicted. We seek direction in uncertainty, contradiction, edge cases and emerging behaviours – as well as in established customer needs. The aim is ultimately to create strategic option value for Motorola Solutions: making uncertain futures more intelligible and identifying high-leverage opportunities earlier.


Job Description

As a Senior Futures Design Strategist, you’ll help shape Horizon 3 (5–10+ year) product opportunities and make sure they lead somewhere. This role is for someone who can dream and be pragmatic. You’ll make futures tangible through artifacts, interfaces and narratives that let users and leaders step inside them. Then you’ll make them actionable by turning them into value propositions, opportunity briefs and investment choices the business can act on. As the team’s main design-focused individual contributor, you’ll own the bridge between our futures work and the teams who explore and build. That means making sure every promising concept has a credible next step and a clear owner. You might call yourself a design strategist, innovation strategist, speculative designer or innovation consultant. Whatever the title, we want to hear from you if you’ve made the future tangible, built the case around it, and helped senior leaders decide where to place their bets, and just as importantly, where not to.


Core Responsibilities

  • Speculative Prototyping & Design Fiction: Create tangible future-state artifacts (mock interfaces, speculative journey maps, world-building narratives) that let users and stakeholders step into, critique, and pressure-test 5–10+ year concepts before investment is committed.
  • Commercial Opportunity Framing: Translate abstract futures into viable business opportunities by defining value propositions, target users, business models, competitive positioning, and the key assumptions that must hold true, along with why it matters to Motorola Solutions now.
  • Activation & Handover: Scope Strategic Opportunity Briefs, run activation workshops, and transition validated concepts to downstream R&D, product, and incubation teams, so each promising concept leaves with a well-scoped next step and a clear owner.
  • Executive Influence & Delivery: Present visually compelling strategic options, trade-offs, and risks to C-suite and senior leaders, bringing a clear point of view on which futures to invest in, monitor, or set aside.
  • Foresight Research & Synthesis: Partner with researchers to ground concepts in human needs and in market and technology context. Contribute to AI-assisted signal scanning and facilitate foresight methods (STEEP, CLA, Delphi) to turn weak signals into design hypotheses.
  • Practice Multiplier: Mentor peers, raise the quality of our experiential design, and help show how futures work creates strategic option value across the company.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in design strategy, innovation strategy, speculative design, strategic foresight, or innovation consulting.
  • Portfolio Evidence: Tangible future artifacts and frameworks grounded in human-centered research, with evidence of how that work moved past the presentation into funded exploration, product roadmaps, pilots, or new ventures.
  • Speculative Craft: Deep expertise in speculative design, design fiction, and scenario building, with exceptional visual craft (Figma, FigJam, physical prototyping, video narrative).
  • Commercial Fluency: Working fluency in how businesses create and capture value, including business model design, market and competitive dynamics, and risk/return. You don’t need an MBA, but you should be able to hold your own in a business review.
  • Methodological Breadth: Practical command of foresight and research methods (scenario planning, backcasting, STEEP, causal layered analysis, Delphi).
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to guide R&D, product, and design teams through futures work without direct authority.
  • Travel & Time Zones: Willingness to travel for in-person research when needed and to collaborate across US and European time zones.

Preferred

  • Education: Advanced degree (Master’s or Ph.D.) or equivalent professional expertise in Design Futures, Strategic Foresight, HCI, Anthropology, Systems Design, or a related field.
  • Innovation Practice: Experience in a design-led consultancy, corporate innovation or new ventures group, or incubation setting.
  • AI-Assisted Foresight: Experience using or building AI tools for signal scanning, trend tracking, and synthesizing unstructured data.
  • Domain Adaptability: Track record researching complex socio-technical systems (e.g., mobility, health, organizational analysis); public safety, government, or enterprise security experience is a plus.

Target Base Salary Range: $135,000 USD - $150,000 USD

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.


Note: Candidate can reside anywhere in the US.



Basic Requirements

  • Bachelors degree with 5+ years in UX research or design strategy
  • AND 3+ years in design strategy, speculative design, innovation strategy, or strategic foresight within a product strategy team, consultancy, or incubation setting.


Travel Requirements

10-25%


Relocation Provided

None


Position Type

Experienced


Referral Payment Plan

Yes

Our U.S. Benefits include:

  • Incentive Bonus Plans

  • Medical, Dental, Vision benefits

  • 401K with Company Match

  • 10 Paid Holidays

  • Generous Paid Time Off Packages

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Paid Parental & Family Leave

  • and more!

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:

The Senior Cloud Platform & Infrastructure Engineer will support RoundPoint Mortgage Servicing LLC. We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Platform & Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, support, and continuously improve our hybrid infrastructure and cloud platforms. This role will be responsible for maintaining highly available, secure, and scalable environments that support both internal business operations and customer-facing digital services, including our growing Homeowner Portal platform.


The ideal candidate combines expertise in cloud infrastructure, networking, systems engineering, automation, and platform operations with a strong focus on reliability, security, and operational excellence. This individual will play a key role in cloud transformation initiatives, infrastructure modernization, disaster recovery planning, and DevOps adoption across the organization.


This position requires a hands-on engineer who is comfortable working across the full technology stack, from networking and virtualization to cloud services, application delivery, automation, and business continuity planning.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering Design, implement, support, and optimize hybrid infrastructure environments spanning on-premises and Microsoft Azure platforms.
    • Manage and maintain compute, networking, storage, identity, security, and virtualization services.
    • Assist with infrastructure modernization, migration, and cloud adoption initiatives.
    • Build and maintain highly available, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions.
    • Evaluate and implement emerging technologies and services to improve operational efficiency and platform capabilities.
    • Assist with infrastructure lifecycle activities including upgrades, patching, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
  • Application Platform & Homeowner Portal Support
    • Support and maintain the infrastructure and cloud services that power the organization's Homeowner Portal and other customer and non-customer-facing applications.
    • Partner with development teams to design and support scalable, resilient, and secure application hosting environments.
    • Partner to help support web applications, APIs, authentication services, databases, and supporting platform services.
    • Implement and maintain solutions utilizing Azure Front Door, Application Gateway, Web Application Firewall (WAF), Load Balancers, and related services.
    • Monitor and optimize application performance, availability, and user experience across production environments.
    • Participate in application deployments, release management activities, and production readiness reviews.
  • DevOps & Automation
    • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using modern automation and deployment methodologies.
    • Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational processes.
    • Create and maintain scripts, workflows, and deployment pipelines to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
    • Support CI/CD practices and collaborate with development teams on deployment automation and platform reliability.
    • Identify opportunities to improve operational maturity through automation and standardization.
  • Networking & Security
    • Assist with supporting enterprise networking environments, including routing, switching, VPN connectivity, firewalls, DNS, DHCP, and network security services.
    • Design and support secure hybrid-cloud networking architectures.
    • Assist with supporting identity and access management solutions including Entra ID (Azure AD), Conditional Access, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Zero Trust security principles.
    • Collaborate with security teams to ensure compliance with organizational policies, security standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Reliability, High Availability & Disaster Recovery
    • Design and maintain highly available and fault-tolerant infrastructure architectures.
    • Implement and support resiliency solutions including:
    • High Availability (HA)
    • Load balancing
    • Redundancy
    • Active/passive & Active/active failover
    • Assist to Develop, maintain, and test Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Planning (BCP) strategies.
    • Support Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) for critical business services.
    • Assist with disaster recovery testing, failover exercises, and recovery validation activities.
    • Support enterprise backup and recovery solutions.
  • Incident Management & Operational Support
    • Provide advanced technical support and resolution for infrastructure, cloud, networking, and platform-related incidents.
    • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to prevent recurring issues.
    • Participate in incident response and major outage management activities.
    • Ensure operational service levels, availability targets, and customer satisfaction objectives are consistently achieved.
    • Collaborate with vendors and third-party partners to resolve technical issues and drive service improvements.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 5+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise infrastructure environments, required.
  • 3+ years of experience supporting Microsoft Azure cloud environments, required.
  • Experience supporting hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure architectures, required.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts including routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, load balancing, and network security, required.
  • Experience supporting highly available and mission-critical production environments, required.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing web applications and digital platforms, required.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across multiple technology domains, required.
  • Experience with:
    • Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), Intune, Conditional Access, (MFA), Azure Virtual Networks, Azure Front Door, Azure Application Gateway, Web Application Firewall (WAF), Azure Load Balancer, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights
  • Experience with VMware vSphere, Virtual Networking, Enterprise Storage Platforms, Backup and Recovery Solutions
  • Strong PowerShell scripting experience.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code methodologies.
  • Experience with Git-based source control platforms.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar CI/CD platforms.
  • Experience building automated deployment and operational workflows.
  • Strong understanding of Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) principles.

Job Summary:

We are looking to hire a POSM Designer who genuinely enjoys designing, takes ownership of assignments, and thrives under pressure rather than avoiding challenging tasks.

Job Duties:

1. Creative Design & Concept Development

  • Develop creative, professional, and visually compelling concepts for POSM displays, exhibition booths, customized plaques, awards, signage, retail displays, promotional stands, and other branding or fabrication-related products.
  • Independently translate basic instructions, reference images, sketches, or written specifications into complete design concepts.
  • Demonstrate creativity, initiative, and enthusiasm for developing innovative concepts and solving design challenges.
  • Suggest practical design alternatives and improvements while maintaining alignment with approved concepts and project requirements.

2. 3D Visualization & Technical Design

  • Develop realistic, high-quality 3D models and photorealistic renderings using professional 3D design software.
  • Demonstrate excellent proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and at least one professional 3D design and rendering software.
  • Accurately represent real-world dimensions, proportions, scale, material thicknesses, textures, finishes, and colors in all designs.
  • Translate approximate size instructions such as A4, A3, slightly larger than A4, or specified display dimensions into accurate and realistic 3D models.
  • Ensure all designs are technically practical, structurally feasible, and suitable for manufacturing, fabrication, installation, or assembly.

3. Material Knowledge & Manufacturing Feasibility

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of commonly used materials, including MDF, melamine, acrylic, stainless steel, aluminum, PVC, foam board, and other sheet-based or fabrication materials.
  • Understand standard material thicknesses, fabrication limitations, and how different materials can be layered, combined, or assembled to achieve the required dimensions and overall depth.
  • Accurately calculate and represent combined material thicknesses. For example, two 18 mm melamine sheets combined together result in a total thickness of 36 mm, excluding additional layers or finishing materials.
  • Understand the difference between material thickness, overall product depth, structural components, and decorative layers.
  • Maintain realistic material representation in 3D renderings, ensuring that specified thicknesses and construction methods are accurately reflected.
  • Avoid exaggerated dimensions, unrealistic structures, or visually attractive concepts that cannot be practically manufactured.
  • Maintain access to a measuring tape or meter scale for physical reference and dimension verification whenever required.

4. Design Accuracy & Quality Assurance

  • Produce accurate, error-free designs with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Carefully verify dimensions, proportions, material specifications, thicknesses, alignment, spacing, and written design instructions before submission.
  • Ensure consistency across design concepts, revisions, and final approved versions.
  • Strictly follow approved concepts, specifications, materials, dimensions, and project guidelines.
  • Review designs thoroughly before submission to minimize errors, rework, and unnecessary production delays.

5. Design Revisions & Project Coordination

  • Incorporate internal feedback, client comments, and additional design instructions professionally and efficiently.
  • Carefully review written feedback and ensure all requested modifications are accurately implemented.
  • Develop alternative concepts, design options, or variations when required.
  • Manage multiple design assignments, revisions, and changing requirements simultaneously.
  • Submit completed designs, updated renderings, and revisions within agreed timelines.
  • Maintain organized design files, project assets, and relevant documentation.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in POSM design, 3D product visualization, exhibition design, retail displays, or a related field.
  • Excellent proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and working knowledge of at least one professional 3D design and rendering software.
  • Strong understanding of real-world dimensions, proportions, material thicknesses, scale, and manufacturing feasibility.
  • Practical knowledge of materials such as acrylic, MDF, melamine, stainless steel, wood, aluminum, and other fabrication materials.
  • Understanding of fabrication and manufacturing techniques, including CNC routing, laser cutting, UV printing, engraving, material layering, and product assembly.
  • Ability to independently develop creative concepts and realistic, manufacturable 3D designs from basic instructions or reference images.
  • Strong attention to detail, ensuring accurate dimensions, proportions, material specifications, and design instructions.
  • Ability to produce high-quality, realistic 3D renderings and presentation-ready visualizations.
  • Comfortable managing multiple assignments, tight deadlines, design revisions, and changing project requirements.
  • Strong ownership, accountability, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Professional attitude toward constructive feedback, revisions, and collaboration.
  • Willingness to provide occasional support for genuinely urgent projects outside regular working hours, with reasonable coordination.

Preferred Experience

Experience in the following areas will be highly preferred:

  • 3D product visualization and photorealistic rendering.
  • Customized corporate awards, trophies, plaques, and recognition products.
  • Exhibition booths, promotional displays, POSM, retail displays, and signage design.
  • Acrylic, stainless steel, wood, MDF, melamine, and other fabrication materials.
  • Practical manufacturing methods, including CNC routing, laser cutting, UV printing, engraving, and product assembly.
  • Developing attractive designs that are realistically manufacturable rather than purely conceptual.

Senior Director, User Readiness

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

College Board’s Operations division is a best-in-class digital assessment delivery and customer engagement function that supports millions of students and thousands of test centers, annually. The Operations team is also leading exciting work to advance user experience using innovative solutions, products, and technology to enhance the end-to-end delivery of digital assessments and all aspects of customer support. Within Operations, the Assessment Delivery Operations (ADO) team is responsible for the successful execution of digital assessments like the SAT and Advanced Placement (AP) examinations, working closely with partners across College Board, the education sector, and beyond to improve testing technologies, customer experience, and outcomes. ADO’s User Readiness team ensures every coordinator, staff member and student has what they need, and takes the critical actions required, to succeed on test day, through community engagement, digital communications, technical readiness, and risk-based support.

About the Opportunity

College Board’s assessment delivery operates as a user-centered ecosystem, one where logistical and digital preparedness aren’t two separate disciplines, but a single, unified standard. As the Senior Director of User Readiness, you will sit at the intersection of traditional assessment delivery and digital transformation, helping write the roadmap for how College Board prepares every district-level, school-level, and student-level user, across every program, to succeed on test day.

This is a role that shapes strategy, not just executes it. You will define the shared framework that determines what “ready” means ahead of test day, and you will own the strategy, team coherence, and outcomes that flow from it. You will lead a portfolio of digital and technical work, across community management, digital engagement, technical readiness, and risk monitoring and intervention, each of whom owns hands-on, external execution within their function. You will shape and evolve the model they operate inside, the milestones that keep it moving in sync, and the relationships with College Board program, product, and technology leaders that keep it current as the platforms and technology it depends on continue to evolve.

In this role, you will:

Lead and Manage the User Readiness Team (30%)

  • Coach Directors to own outcomes within their function, not just administer requirements, so the User Readiness roadmap’s thinking runs through every level of the team.

User Readiness Framework & Cross-Program Alignment (25%)

  • Interpret data and analysis across the portfolio to build business cases and drive changes to process, technology, and resourcing based on what the evidence shows
  • Own the shared definition of user readiness and the operating standards every College Board program uses to ensure support is consistent regardless of assessment or delivery model

  • Anticipate emerging business needs and requirements, and set direction for the resulting changes to process, case management, and technology requirements

Roadmap & Readiness Outcomes (25%)

  • Set the vision and priorities for Directors across community management, digital engagement, technical readiness, and risk monitoring and intervention, empowering each to own hands-on execution within a shared strategic direction
  • Own the master planning calendar and milestone cadence spanning every function, so the roadmap moves as one coordinated system rather than separate efforts

  • A proven track record designing and operationalizing a shared, cross-program operating model; replacing duplicative or program-specific structures with a scalable, unified one
  • Experience running digital email or marketing campaigns, or activation-focused programs, building and scaling outreach that turns awareness into action

  • Experience communicating product and technical requirements directly to technology teams, with credibility to act as a technology integrator and spokesperson to senior stakeholders
  • Comfort with ambiguity and building new capability from scratch, particularly for less mature functions still taking shape

Position: Marketing Manager

Salary: Php 70,000 to Php 90,000

Working Hours: Aligned with AU Business Hours

Work Type: Independent Contractor

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The company engineers and supplies premium, world-class surfacing solutions tailored for aquatic environments, playgrounds, sports facilities, and recreational spaces. Installed across high-profile water parks, resorts, splash pads, and civic infrastructure globally—with core footprints spanning Australia, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East—our systems blend durability, aesthetic appeal, and technical performance. We are committed to safety, design innovation, and sustained global growth.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

The company is seeking an autonomous, strategic, and hands-on Marketing Manager to take complete ownership of our end-to-end marketing function. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level commercial objectives and tactical delivery: defining priorities, structuring an actionable marketing roadmap, executing multi-channel campaigns, and directly driving qualified inbound inquiries.

Operating with autonomy, you will receive overarching strategic context, product insights, and sign-offs from executive leadership, while independently driving initiatives from concept to execution. This role requires balanced capability in strategic planning and roll-up-your-sleeves execution. Initial focus areas center on high-impact email marketing workflows, compelling written project case studies, and brand content, followed by website optimization, social presence, and targeted paid acquisition.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Strategic Marketing Planning: Define marketing priorities, establish clear objectives with the leadership team, and manage an active, practical marketing calendar.
  • End-to-End Execution: Drive initiatives autonomously from brief to completion, managing production timelines and proactively sourcing necessary inputs and approvals.
  • Email Marketing & List Management: Architect, draft, build, and deploy targeted email campaigns—including product releases, project showcases, and nurture sequences—while segmenting audience data across global markets.
  • Content Creation & Technical Storytelling: Produce high-caliber case studies, technical articles, and web copy that translate complex product specifications into compelling value propositions for architects, contractors, and facility managers.
  • Collateral & Asset Development: Coordinate cross-functionally to collect photography, technical specs, and customer testimonials to transform raw project data into polished marketing assets.
  • Digital & Channel Management: Maintain and optimize core digital touchpoints, including CMS updates and organic B2B social media channels.
  • Paid Campaigns: Identify high-yield opportunities, design target criteria, and manage digital ad spend aligned with commercial objectives and available bandwidth.
  • Analytics & Performance Reporting: Monitor pipeline generation, traffic, and campaign metrics; deliver actionable insights and iterative optimizations to executive stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Proven track record in B2B marketing, with demonstrable experience owning campaigns or an independent marketing function.
  • Direct hands-on capability across email marketing systems, modern CMS platforms, web analytics, and baseline graphic design tools.
  • Exceptional copywriting and long-form written English capabilities, specifically calibrated for Australian B2B commercial audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate broad business mandates into tactical delivery without requiring granular day-to-day supervision.
  • Strong organizational discipline, project management rigor, and the prioritization skills needed to handle competing operational demands.
  • High commercial acumen with the executive presence to present recommendations, challenge assumptions, and communicate with business owners.

PREFERRED:

  • Around 3–4 years of progressive B2B marketing experience with substantive operational ownership (demonstrated capability prioritized over tenure).
  • Prior background supporting or working directly within Australian business environments.
  • Industry exposure within commercial surfacing, building materials, architecture, construction, or commercial recreation/aquatics.

What you’ll bring:

  • Proactive Ownership: A self-starter mindset that anticipates operational needs, surfaces roadblocks early, and maintains steady forward momentum.
  • Strategic Execution: Equal comfort operating at 30,000 feet aligning goals with founders and at ground level writing copy and deploying campaigns.
  • Commercial Mindset: A results-oriented focus dedicated to generating qualified pipeline, empowering the sales function, and maximizing return on marketing efforts.
  • Clear Communication: Transparent, candid, and articulate stakeholder engagement that drives consensus and accelerates decision-making.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Logic Design Engineer to contribute to the development of next-generation FPGA and ASIC-based control platforms.

jobs.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Senior Security Engineer on Zoom's Enterprise Security team, you will own the AI Governance program end to end, defining the technical standards and risk posture that determine how Zoom adopts AI safely and at scale. On any given day, you will be assessing emerging AI use cases, building security frameworks for GenAI and agentic systems, and serving as the trusted technical voice on AI security for engineering and enterprise stakeholders across four critical domains. This is a hands-on, highly autonomous role that calls for real depth in both AI/ML systems and security engineering; candidates without working familiarity with how modern AI introduces security risk will not be set up for success here. You will work as part of a globally distributed, multi-domain security engineering team, collaborating closely with colleagues across time zones and contributing across adjacent security domains beyond AI.


About the Team

Zoom's Enterprise Security team is the engineering foundation behind how the company identifies, contains, and gets ahead of risk across its most critical systems. Working across AI, data, network, endpoint, and cloud security, the team builds the controls, standards, and architectures that let Zoom move quickly without creating unacceptable exposure. As Zoom deepens its investment in AI across Zoom Workplace and its broader platform, this team's work is increasingly central to how the company grows responsibly.


Responsibilities

  • Own the AI governance risk register and end-to-end assessment methodology across four domains (GenAI, Agentic AI, Shadow AI/Local AI, and AI Gateway/MCP); conduct and review risk evaluations using Likelihood x Impact scoring and drive remediation with owning engineering teams.
  • Identify and prioritize security gaps in GenAI deployments including prompt injection, data leakage, model misuse, and insecure output handling; define monitoring and guardrail requirements for agentic systems operating with significant autonomy and tool access.
  • Lead the Shadow AI governance strategy end to end, from quantifying risk exposure to recommending and operationalizing detection and enforcement controls across the enterprise.
  • Set the security bar for AI gateway and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations, including secure configuration, access control frameworks, and governance coverage.
  • Architect reference security patterns for AI adoption (AI gateways, MCP servers, agent frameworks, LLM integrations) and serve as design authority in AI-related architecture reviews; translate the AI Governance Risk Charter into a concrete roadmap of technical requirements and measurable outcomes.
  • Drive evaluations of AI security tooling (AI gateways, CASB/SWG, agentic monitoring, MCP governance solutions), including POC design, cost-benefit analysis, and leadership recommendations; author and maintain security standards and policy for AI adoption.
  • Lead security architecture reviews and risk assessments across adjacent domains including Network, Endpoint, Cloud, and Data Security; contribute to incident response, detection engineering, and purple team exercises as shared team functions.
  • Serve as the primary technical partner to AI/ML, engineering, and enterprise teams; lead cross-functional working groups, mentor engineers on risk analysis and documentation quality, and deliver clear reporting on AI risk posture and forecasted challenges to leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of security engineering or cybersecurity experience, including end-to-end ownership of a security domain or program, with a track record of driving risk assessment, prioritization, and remediation across cross-functional teams.
  • Solid working knowledge of modern AI/ML systems and the security risks they introduce (LLMs, generative AI, agentic systems); direct experience securing GenAI or LLM-based applications in an enterprise environment is a strong differentiator.
  • Understanding of AI gateways, Model Context Protocol (MCP), CASB/SWG, or DLP tooling, and a working understanding of shadow AI detection and governance strategies.
  • Working knowledge across core security domains (network, endpoint, cloud, and data security) sufficient to independently lead architecture reviews and risk assessments outside of AI.
  • Experience designing security reference architectures or serving as a design authority in complex, cross-functional technical environments; threat modeling experience applied to AI or novel technology stacks is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, communicate risk clearly in writing and verbally, and drive alignment across engineering, product, and enterprise teams without direct authority.
  • Comfort operating in a globally distributed team with regular overlap with US Pacific hours; ability to work with high autonomy and produce clear, actionable risk documentation for leadership audiences.

Ways of Working
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.


Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Companion was formed in January of 2020 with a commitment to providing unmatched care to pets and unsurpassed support to veterinary teams through the management and operation of our acquired veterinary hospitals. We are based in Los Angeles, with a focus on expansion throughout the Western United States. The Companion team is passionate about the animal health industry and deeply committed to building a network of best-in-class veterinary practices with talented people collaborating to solve industry-wide problems and deliver exceptional medical care. We are seeking individuals who share our energy, drive and ambition and who will meaningfully contribute to our growth and success.


About This Role

We are seeking a high-caliber Corporate Controller to lead the accounting organization for a rapidly scaling, multi-site veterinary hospital group. This is a critical leadership role in a Private Equity-backed environment focused on system optimization and disciplined financial management across our network.

The ideal candidate is a strategic leader who can elevate existing financial controls, streamline multi-site reporting, and continuously enhance the institutional-grade reporting required by PE sponsors. You will bridge the gap between site-level clinical operations and corporate financial strategy, optimizing processes and ensuring integrity of our $100M+ P&L, while maintaining a scalable foundation for future growth initiatives including M&A growth.

This is a remote position with preference for the candidate to reside on the West Coast.


What Success Looks Like

Institutional-Grade Reporting & Compliance

  • Financial Close: Lead and accelerate the monthly, quarterly, and year-end close processes across 31+ locations, ensuring timely and accurate consolidated financial statements in accordance with US GAAP.
  • PE Reporting: Own the delivery of the monthly sponsor-specific reporting packages, including EBITDA bridge analysis and add-back tracking.
  • Audit & Tax: Manage the relationship with external auditors and tax advisors; lead the year-end audit and ensure compliance with multi-state tax requirements.

M&A Integration & Scalability

  • Post-Acquisition Integration: Lead the financial onboarding of newly acquired veterinary practices, including Chart of Accounts mapping, payroll migration, and ERP integration.
  • Purchase Accounting: Partner with the CFO and external advisors on opening balance sheet entries, valuation of intangibles, and working capital true-ups.
  • Systems Optimization: Oversee and optimize the accounting tech stack (e.g., NetSuite, PIMS, AP/Tipalti) to support a high-volume, multi-unit environment.

Operational Control & Cash Management

  • Internal Controls: Design and enforce robust internal controls across all hospital locations to mitigate risk in cash handling, inventory management, and procurement.
  • Revenue Integrity: Oversee the revenue cycle, ensuring accurate reconciliation between Practice Management Systems (PMS) and the general ledger.
  • Operational Partnership: Partner with the Senior Director of Finance to provide the data foundation for 13-week cash forecasts and budget-vs-actual variance analysis.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience; prior experience in a PE-backed or multi-site healthcare environment is required.
  • CPA Required. Big 4 or large regional public accounting background preferred.
  • Expert command of US GAAP, multi-entity consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and purchase accounting.
  • Hands-on experience integrating multiple tuck-in acquisitions per year into a centralized accounting engine.
  • Proven ability to manage, mentor, and scale a direct/indirect team of 5-6 (Accounting Managers, Senior Staff, AP, Treasury)
  • Hands-on experience with modern ERPs (e.g., NetSuite) and veterinary PMS platforms preferred.

How We'll Support You

  • Competitive salary ($200,000-$220,000 base plus annual bonus) and comprehensive benefits package
  • Significant growth opportunities as our organization expands
  • Collaborative environment that values your expertise and input
  • Professional development opportunities to enhance your leadership and technical skills
  • Modern technology and tools to support efficient financial operations
  • Supportive leadership team committed to your success
  • Opportunity to make a lasting impact by building our accounting infrastructure
  • Work-life balance that respects your personal and professional commitments

EEO Statement

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
