jobs.title: Associate Director, Medicare Advantage Product Management
jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community As Associate Director of Medicare Advantage Product Management, you’ll lead a team of Senior Product Managers responsible for multiple regional Medicare Advantage product portfolios.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

As Associate Director of Medicare Advantage Product Management, you’ll lead a team of Senior Product Managers responsible for multiple regional Medicare Advantage product portfolios. You’ll set direction, establish standards, and create the clarity and accountability the team needs to translate enterprise, segment and market strategies into competitive, compliant and operationally executable products.

You’ll serve as a senior product voice in executive and regional forums, bringing together Product, Actuarial, Finance, Network, Compliance, Operations, Marketing and Market Leadership to make complex decisions and resolve competing priorities. When significant product, regulatory. or execution issues arise, you’ll help the organization navigate the tradeoffs, determine the path forward and drive resolution.

Just as importantly, you’ll build leadership capability within the team. This role is an opportunity to develop experienced product professionals into stronger business and product leaders, build a high-performing organization, and strengthen the talent pipeline for future leadership roles.

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of Senior Product Managers, establishing clear expectations, priorities and accountability for individual, team and portfolio outcomes.
  • Build leadership and product management capability through ongoing coaching, meaningful feedback, development planning, and stretch opportunities.
  • Develop a strong talent pipeline through succession planning, career development and proactive identification of future leaders.
  • Create an environment where Senior Product Managers operate with appropriate autonomy, sound judgment and clear ownership rather than relying on escalation for routine decisions.
  • Establish clear roles, decision rights, and ways of working that enable the team to operate simply, effectively, and consistently.
  • Build a culture of curiosity, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Set Portfolio Strategy and Direction

  • Own product direction and priorities across assigned regional Medicare Advantage portfolios, translating enterprise, segment and market strategies into actionable product priorities.
  • Establish portfolio standards and guardrails that drive consistency while allowing for appropriate market differentiation.
  • Bring together competitive, financial, regulatory, operational, and market insights to inform product decisions and recommendations.
  • Evaluate product opportunities, risks, and tradeoffs and provide clear recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and emerging market needs to identify opportunities to improve product competitiveness, member value and business performance.
  • Look beyond the immediate bid cycle to anticipate future portfolio needs and position teams for effective execution.

Lead Enterprise and Market Partnerships

  • Serve as a senior Product Management partner for regional, segment, and functional leaders.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration across Actuarial, Finance, Network, Compliance, Operations, Marketing and Market Leadership to align product strategy and execution.
  • Navigate competing priorities and facilitate decisions when financial, regulatory, operational, market and member considerations require tradeoffs.
  • Represent Product Management in executive and regional leadership forums, clearly communicating product strategy, recommendations, performance, risks and decisions.
  • Build trusted partnerships that allow issues to be surfaced early and resolved at the appropriate level.

Lead Medicare Advantage Bid Strategy and Execution

  • Lead product strategy and readiness across the annual CMS bid cycle for assigned portfolios.
  • Establish expectations, governance and decision-making disciplines that enable accurate, timely, and compliant product submissions.
  • Ensure key product decisions, dependencies, regulatory requirements, and risks are identified and addressed before submission.
  • Partner across Product, Actuarial, Compliance and other functions to translate strategy into executable benefit and product designs.
  • Provide leadership during critical bid milestones and help teams navigate ambiguity, changing conditions and compressed decision timelines.
  • Create greater consistency and repeatability across product and bid processes through lessons learned, standardization and continuous improvement.

Strengthening Quality, Compliance and Operational Excellence

  • Establish and maintain standards for quality, accuracy and consistency across bids, ANOCs, EOCs, SBs, Provider Directories and other applicable CMS filings and product materials.
  • Build metrics, controls and operating mechanisms that provide visibility into portfolio health, product readiness, quality and risk.
  • Use data and root-cause analysis to identify systemic issues and drive sustainable improvements rather than one-time fixes.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and modernize Product Management processes, reduce unnecessary manual activity, and enable the team to focus more capacity on strategic work.
  • Partner with Compliance and operational stakeholders to ensure product decisions can be translated accurately and effectively into the member and operational experience.

Lead Through Complexity, Risk and Change

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for significant product, regulatory, compliance, market and operational issues.
  • Assess complex issues quickly, separate symptoms from root causes, and establish a clear path to resolution.
  • Make or facilitate timely decisions with appropriate consideration of member, regulatory, financial and operational implications.
  • Clearly communicate decisions, rationale, risks and accountability to stakeholders and senior leaders.
  • Lead the team through periods of ambiguity, transformation, and intense regulatory activity while maintaining focus on both immediate execution and longer-term improvement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Build leaders, not just manage work. Develop Senior Product Managers who demonstrate greater ownership, judgment, business acumen, and leadership over time.
  • Think portfolio-first. Connect individual product decisions to broaden market, segment, financial, member and enterprise objectives.
  • Create clarity from complexity. Turn ambiguous business, regulatory, and market challenges into clear priorities, decisions and accountability.
  • Balance strategy and execution. Keep teams focused on longer-term product strategy while delivering accurately against critical CMS deadlines.
  • Make informed decisions. Use data, business judgment, and functional expertise to evaluate tradeoffs and recommend a clear path forward.
  • Influence across boundaries. Create alignment among leaders and functions with different priorities without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Raise the standard. Establish mechanisms, processes, and expectations that leave the organization stronger rather than simply completing the next deliverable.
  • Develop the organization. Build capability, succession depth, and future leaders while creating an environment where people can do their best work.
  • Lead with accountability. Own portfolio and team outcomes and address issues transparently and decisively.

How You’ll Lead

How you achieve results matters as much as what you deliver. You’ll model the Humana Way through transparent, principle-driven decisions; curiosity and continuous learning; clear accountability; and collaboration across organizational boundaries. You’ll create an environment where associates understand not only what needs to be accomplished, but why it matters and how we’ll succeed together.


Role Expectations

  • Operate with significant independence within established enterprise, segment and functional strategies and policies.
  • Lead through others, establishing direction and outcomes rather than personally owning every deliverable.
  • Exercise sound judgment in complex situations where the path forward may not be immediately clear.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of portfolio, organizational, and talent needs while remaining accountable for near-term execution.
  • Build productive relationships across functions and levels and influence decisions beyond the formal boundaries of the team.
  • Translate complex information into clear recommendations appropriate for senior and executive audiences.
  • Create sustainable improvements in how the organization operates, rather than relying on heroic execution.

Key Partnerships & Reporting Relationship

You’ll report to the Director, Insurance Product Management and lead a team of Senior Product Managers. You’ll work closely with segment, regional and functional leaders across Actuarial, Finance, Network, Compliance, Operations, Marketing and Market Leadership.


The work follows the annual Medicare Advantage and CMS regulatory cycle. Certain periods of the year require additional flexibility, including extended hours and occasional weekend work, to meet critical regulatory and business deadlines.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional credential/licensure or experience (7+ years of relevant healthcare, health plan, product management or related experience)
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience, including responsibility for coaching, performance management and talent development
  • Demonstrated experience leading execution for a complex product, business or operational portfolio
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams through complex business, regulatory and/or operational decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to influence, communicate with and present recommendations to senior leaders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing or overseeing metrics, operational controls, quality programs or governance mechanisms
  • Experience using data and competitive insights to inform portfolio strategy and product decisions

About the Opportunity

We are recruiting an experienced Solar PV Design & Proposal Specialist to join a growing UK-based renewable energy business specialising in solar PV installations, battery storage systems and electric vehicle charging solutions.

This is an exciting opportunity for a highly organised, technically skilled and proactive individual with extensive experience using OpenSolar to produce accurate, professional and commercially competitive solar PV proposals.

The business is experiencing significant growth and requires someone who can manage a high volume of customer enquiries, deliver quality proposals efficiently and contribute to the continued development of its design and customer operations.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Solar PV Design & Proposal Development

  • Design residential and commercial solar PV systems using OpenSolar.

  • Prepare detailed system layouts, equipment specifications, energy generation estimates and customer proposals.
  • Ensure designs are technically accurate, commercially viable and aligned with customer requirements.
  • Manage a high volume of incoming enquiries while maintaining quality and turnaround times.
  • Review site information, energy consumption data and customer requirements to develop suitable solar solutions.
  • Recommend appropriate solar PV, battery storage and related renewable energy solutions.

Customer & Stakeholder Communication

  • Communicate professionally with customers and internal stakeholders regarding designs, proposals and project requirements.
  • Clarify technical specifications and gather additional information where required.
  • Respond proactively to customer enquiries and proposal amendments.
  • Work closely with sales, installation and operations teams to ensure proposals are accurate and deliverable.
  • Provide clear explanations of proposed systems and their benefits.

Workflow & Operational Support

  • Manage multiple proposals simultaneously while meeting daily productivity targets.
  • Prioritise urgent enquiries and maintain an organised proposal pipeline.
  • Identify opportunities to improve design efficiency, proposal quality and turnaround times.
  • Take ownership of assigned projects and work independently in a remote environment.
  • Support wider customer service and operational activities as the role develops.

Essential Requirements

  • 4–5 years of hands-on experience using OpenSolar, with strong proficiency in solar PV system design and proposal generation.
  • Proven ability to produce approximately 7–8 complete, high-quality proposals per working day.
  • Strong understanding of solar PV system design, equipment selection, system sizing and energy generation calculations.
  • Previous experience preparing customer-facing solar proposals, quotations and technical documentation.
  • Experience managing high volumes of proposals within tight deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to technical accuracy.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Confidence communicating directly with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities and take initiative.
  • Comfortable working UK business hours from South Africa.
  • Reliable internet connectivity and a suitable remote working environment.

Please note: Practical OpenSolar experience is essential. Candidates with experience limited to PVsyst, AutoCAD or other design software, without substantial OpenSolar proposal experience, will not meet the core requirements.

Advantageous Experience

  • Previous experience working with UK solar PV installers or renewable energy companies.
  • Knowledge of UK solar PV regulations, installation standards and industry requirements.
  • Familiarity with MCS (Microgeneration Certification Scheme) standards.
  • Understanding of DNO (Distribution Network Operator) requirements and grid connection processes.
  • Experience designing battery storage and EV charging solutions.
  • Experience supporting solar sales teams and handling customer enquiries.
  • Exposure to renewable energy project coordination or operational support.

Key Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Consistently deliver approximately 8 accurate and professional proposals per 7.5-hour shift.
  • Maintain high standards of design quality and customer service.
  • Demonstrate strong productivity without compromising technical accuracy.
  • Manage competing priorities and meet agreed turnaround times.
  • Work proactively with minimal supervision.
  • Contribute to clearing an existing proposal backlog and improving ongoing workflow efficiency.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a motivated, solutions-oriented professional who combines strong technical OpenSolar expertise with excellent productivity and customer communication skills.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, taking ownership of their workload and delivering results consistently.

A positive attitude, initiative, adaptability and willingness to support broader business operations will be essential for long-term success.

Recruitment Process

Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete:

  1. An initial recruitment screening interview.
  2. A short, timed OpenSolar design and proposal assessment.
  3. A professional video introduction.
  4. A client interview, including a practical proposal exercise.

jobs.excerpt: If you source for foreign clients every day, Europe is the same game, in your afternoon hours, paid per placement in euros.
jobs.description:
If you source for foreign clients every day, Europe is the same game, in your afternoon hours, paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Lahore and across Pakistan.

Read all of this before you apply. It's long on purpose. If this isn't you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. Everything grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • Direct contact with us whenever you have a question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

Job Title: Senior Clinical Research Associate - Onco/CNS (Spain)

Job Location: Virtual Spain Madrid

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Senior Clinical Research Associate at Worldwide

As a Senior Clinical Research Associate, you’ll play a key role in protecting patient safety, maintaining high-quality clinical data, and ensuring investigative sites deliver studies in line with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), regulatory requirements, protocols, and SOPs.

You’ll take ownership of the full site monitoring lifecycle, from qualification and initiation through interim monitoring, site management, and close-out. You’ll work closely with sites and study teams to strengthen protocol adherence, resolve data queries, maintain essential documentation, and ensure safety information is appropriately reviewed and reported.

You’ll also have the opportunity to bring your experience beyond individual sites, acting as a Lead CRA on global studies, coordinating and mentoring CRAs, contributing to monitoring plans, reviewing visit reports, delivering training, and supporting study milestones.


Where You'll Work

This is a home-based Clinical Research Associate role supporting sites across Spain. Candidates must reside within the territory to effectively support site visits and study activities. You will collaborate with sites, sponsors, and global study teams while traveling to investigative sites approximately 8-10 days per month.


What You'll Do

  • Lead site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, management, and close-out activities, ensuring compliance with protocols, GCP, applicable regulations, and SOPs.
  • Protect patient safety and data integrity by reviewing informed consent and safety information, conducting source document verification, reviewing CRFs, and supporting timely query resolution.
  • Guide sites in protocol adherence, Investigator Site File maintenance, regulatory and ethics documentation, investigational product accountability, and ongoing study requirements.
  • Coordinate CRAs as a Lead CRA on global studies and provide mentoring, training, accompanied visits, and practical guidance to less experienced colleagues and site staff.
  • Partner with Project Management and study teams to evaluate deliverables, study milestones, site performance, and monitoring activities.
  • Develop monitoring plans, study-specific tools, templates, and training materials as requested to support consistent study delivery.
  • Review site visit reports and provide clear feedback and edits while ensuring relevant site documentation is maintained for filing in the Trial Master File.
  • Contribute your clinical monitoring expertise to study team and investigator meetings, bid defenses, and the design of protocols and CRFs.

What You'll Bring

  • Education and CRA experience: an MD or Pharmacy qualification (MSPH, PharmD, PhD, equivalent Pharmacy degree, or similar) with at least 3 years’ CRA experience; or a minimum four-year college curriculum in medical, biological, physical, health, pharmacy, or another related science with at least 5 years’ CRA experience; or a two-year college curriculum or equivalent education/training, preferably a nursing or equivalent life science degree, with at least 7 years’ CRA experience.
  • Extensive knowledge of clinical research principles and processes, with a thorough understanding of FDA and/or EU regulations and directives, ICH Guidelines, local regulatory requirements, and SOPs.
  • Strong therapeutic-area expertise, with a thorough understanding of two to three therapeutic areas sufficient to operate as a Lead CRA where appropriate.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, planning, organizational, time-management, initiative, and problem-solving skills, alongside the ability to lead and motivate an assigned team when applicable.
  • Technical proficiency with Microsoft Office, IxRS, and electronic data capture (EDC) systems.
  • Experience in full-service monitoring PREFERRED.
  • Valid current passport and driving licence, with willingness to travel as required.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English, together with fluency in the local languages of the countries under responsibility.

Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit , or connect with us onLinkedIn.

jobs.excerpt: This is an internal role at Weekday.  Not a role by a client.
jobs.description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.

  • Role type: Full time
  • Location: Remote
  • Working with: CEO and Cofounder

Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.

About the role

You’ll work closely with the founders on some of the most important problems at the company.

There isn’t a fixed lane for this role. What you work on will depend on what the company needs at the time. That could mean figuring out why a product isn’t growing, launching a new product or market, improving an internal process, working with customers, researching a new opportunity, or taking on a project that simply doesn’t have an obvious owner yet.

This is a hands-on role. We’re not looking for someone whose job ends at analysing a problem and making a recommendation. You should be comfortable getting into the details and doing the work yourself.

As the company grows, the problems you work on will change. We expect the role to change with them.

What you’ll work on

Depending on the week, you might:

  • Take a new idea from a rough hypothesis to something we can actually test
  • Dig into a part of the business that isn’t working well, understand why, and fix it
  • Work on growth for an existing product, including talking to customers, improving positioning, running experiments, or helping close important deals
  • Research a new market, product, partnership, or business opportunity and decide whether it is worth pursuing
  • Build a process or internal tool where none exists today
  • Work with product and engineering to turn customer or business problems into product changes
  • Take ownership of projects that cut across teams and would otherwise fall between the cracks
  • Help the founders make decisions by getting to the underlying facts quickly

Some projects will last a few days. Others may become something you own for months.

What we’re looking for

  • You’re good at figuring things out. You can take a vaguely defined problem, ask the right questions, and get to a useful answer without needing a detailed brief.
  • You’re comfortable doing the work yourself. If something requires talking to customers, going through data, writing copy, building a spreadsheet, or putting together a quick script, you’ll do it.
  • You have good business judgement. You can distinguish between something that is interesting and something that actually matters.
  • You’re comfortable with numbers and technology. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be able to work with data and use technology to make yourself more effective.
  • You communicate clearly. You can write well, explain what you’ve learned, and say when something isn’t working.
  • You take ownership. Once you take something on, the founders shouldn’t have to keep checking whether it is moving.
  • You care about details. A lot of this job involves noticing things other people miss and following through on them.
  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Priorities will change and you won’t always have a playbook to follow.

We care less about whether you’ve had a “Founder’s Office” title before. You could come from startups, consulting, product, growth, operations, investing, or something else entirely. What matters is whether you can learn quickly and get useful things done.

What you get

You’ll work directly with the founders and get exposure to most parts of the company.

You’ll see how decisions get made, work on problems before they have dedicated teams around them, and have a lot of room to take ownership. If something you start becomes important enough, there’s a good chance you’ll continue to own it.

This role is a good fit for someone who eventually wants to build a company, run a business or product line, or become a generalist operator at an early-stage company.

jobs.title: Education to UX Design Career Changer Apprenticeship
jobs.excerpt: About the Program:Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online.
jobs.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.

We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

  • Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
  • Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
  • Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

  • Build digital products and services 0-1
  • Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
  • Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
  • Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
  • Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
  • Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
  • Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
  • Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
  • Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
  • Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
  • Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
  • Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
  • Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
  • Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
  • Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

NetSuite Solutions Architect

The NetSuite Solutions Architect is responsible for leading and delivering NetSuite implementations and optimization projects. This role requires a deep understanding of NetSuite functionalities and best practices to provide expert advice and solutions to clients. The NetSuite Solutions Architectworks closely with clients to gather requirements, configure NetSuite solutions, and ensure successful deployment and adoption of the platform. This role also involves mentoring junior consultants and contributing to the overall growth and success of the consulting team.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Provide support to the NetSuite Solutions Architect in providing accurate estimate, tailor fit to the business requirements of potential clients
  • Provide support to the NetSuite Practice lead in crafting Scope of Work for potential and existing clients
  • Lead the end-to-end implementation, optimization and managed services for NetSuite projects, working closely with clients to understand their unique business processes and configuring NetSuite to align with their needs.
  • Provide expert guidance on NetSuite best practices, offering strategic insights to optimize system performance, scalability, and efficiency.
  • Cultivate strong client relationships by effectively communicating with stakeholders, understanding their business objectives, and ensuring NetSuite solutions meet and exceed expectations as well as handling client escalations, as needed
  • Conduct comprehensive training sessions for end-users, fostering user adoption and ensuring clients are equipped to maximize the benefits of NetSuite. Offer ongoing support to address queries and troubleshoot issues.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to design and implement custom solutions, integrations, and enhancements to extend NetSuite functionality
  • Develop comprehensive project plans outlining scope, goals, deliverables, resources, timelines, and budget requirements.
  • Lead and motivate project teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and a positive work environment. Provide guidance, support, and mentorship to team members as needed; Proactively interacts through in person and remote meetings as well as phone/email communications to key prospects up to and including C-level executives.
  • Keep abreast of NetSuite updates, industry trends, and emerging technologies to provide informed recommendations, ensuring our solutions remain at the forefront of innovation.
  • Other tasks and responsibilities not included in the above but may be necessary in performing the roles of a NetSuite Solutions Architect

Corporate Travel Consultant - New Jersey Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

At Batesville, you will be a part of a dynamic team committed to excellence and innovation. A recognized leader in the death care industry in North America, we are committed to our mission of helping families honor the lives of those they love®.


Batesville has been named one of the Most Trustworthy Companies in America by Newsweek for the third year in a row, reflecting our commitment to quality, integrity, and the trust families and funeral professionals place in us every day.

Your Role at Batesville:

We are looking for a high-performing phone sales professional who knows how to hunt, control a sales conversation, overcome objections, and close business. This is not an order-taking or customer-service role. The Inside Sales Representative owns revenue growth across an assigned portfolio of funeral home accounts and is expected to proactively create opportunities, win new business, expand existing relationships, and consistently ask for the sale.

The role operates in a high-activity, performance-driven environment with clear expectations around revenue, outbound activity, customer engagement, call quality, and CRM discipline. Representatives are expected to conduct effective discovery, articulate differentiated value, handle objections, and make a close attempt on outbound sales calls.

How You’ll be Rewarded:

  • Batesville is a family. You will be part of a family of highly committed associates who are passionate about our company, committed to our customers and excited about our future.
  • The expected base salary range for this role is $25.00 - $30.00 per hour. Actual compensation within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to qualifications, skills, experience, and location.
  • IMMEDIATE ELIGIBILITY – Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance, as well as prescription coverage, short-term disability, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and more.
  • Generous 401K Matching Program
  • Paid time off
  • Opportunities for development and advancement

What You'll Do

  • Proactively hunt for revenue opportunities across existing, lapsed, and non-buying accounts.
  • Execute a consistent, high-volume outbound calling strategy and build relationships with customer decision makers.
  • Follow a defined sales process while adapting the conversation to the individual customer and situation.
  • Use strong discovery and active listening to uncover explicit and latent customer needs.
  • Control the sales conversation, maintain momentum, and prevent opportunities from becoming passive follow-up.
  • Clearly articulate value and competitive differentiation without defaulting unnecessarily to price.
  • Confidently handle objections, negotiate appropriately, and ask directly for the business.
  • Upsell and cross-sell products when customer needs and opportunities support it.
  • Maintain accurate CRM activity, customer insights, call outcomes, commitments, and follow-up.
  • Own individual results and use performance metrics to identify gaps and improve selling effectiveness.
  • Actively participate in call coaching, training, feedback, and continuous development.
  • Adapt quickly to changing products, promotions, technology, sales strategies, customer needs, and performance expectations.
  • Other duties may be assigned.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven phone-sales closer with demonstrated success converting conversations into revenue.
  • Strong outbound hunter who is comfortable pursuing customers who are not actively looking to buy.
  • Competitive and motivated by measurable goals, individual performance, and winning business.
  • Comfortable operating in a KPI-driven, accountable sales environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to follow a repeatable sales process without sounding scripted.
  • Strong call control, discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Resilient through rejection and persistent without becoming overly aggressive with customers.
  • High internal ownership. Looks first at what can personally be changed when results fall short.
  • Highly coachable and able to turn feedback into observable behavioral improvement.
  • Adaptable, self-directed, organized, and disciplined in a remote working environment.
  • Strong phone presence with concise, confident, customer-focused communication.

#INDSGA


Join the Batesville family and apply today!


Who We Are:


A cornerstone in the death care industry, Batesville has distinguished itself from all others through our commitment to quality, service, and innovation. For more than 115 years, Batesville has been dedicated to serving the needs of licensed funeral professionals and helping families honor the lives of those they love.® With annual revenues of approximately $600 million, Batesville is a leader, providing a comprehensive portfolio of burial and cremation products, memorialization offerings, profit-enhancing merchandising systems and leading-edge technology solutions.


At Batesville, our associates are our strongest asset. We strive to attract, hire, and develop the best and brightest to ensure our place in the future. Batesville has a strong culture of achievement, which is underpinned by these five core values:


  • Individual worth and integrity
  • Excellence in execution
  • Spirit of continuous learning and improvement
  • Courage
  • Customer focus and partnership

What Sets Us Apart:


Making a difference: Helping families honor the lives of those they love® isn’t just our mission. It’s why we do what we do every day to make every Batesville product the best it can be.


Development is a priority: We promote learning and development from Day 1. From our Experience Batesville onboarding program to self-guided courses on Batesville University, there are numerous opportunities to advance your skills. We encourage associates to create Individual Development Plans (IDPs) to help drive career-focused discussions and advancement.


Putting customers first: We value the funeral professional’s role in serving families and are committed to doing our part to ensure their success.


We Have Fun! We work hard, but when it’s time to play, we get creative – and competitive. We provide numerous engagement activities to bring people together across the organization.


We Give Back: We support our communities by assisting in fundraising events and volunteer programs to help those in need. *These services are not available at all Batesville locations.

Senior Product Manager, Live

Location: Ireland/UK (Remote)

About Entity

Entity is building the destination for high calibre games on the web. A curated catalogue of bestselling full-scale game titles running natively in the browser: click a link and you’re playing in seconds on the device you already own.

There are no downloads, no installs and no new hardware. This new low-friction way of playing games is powered by the latest developments in web technologies such as WebAssembly and WebGPU, allowing us to render high-quality game experiences on your device. This is not a game streaming service; this is the power of the New Web.

For developers, we’re the official, licensed channel for proper games on the web. We offer self-serve tools to publish, operate and grow their games, with social play, identity and a unique end-to-end business analytics suite built into the platform.

We’ve signed top-tier publishers representing millions of unit sales on PC and console to date and are preparing for launch in 2027. We are growing the company in preparation for welcoming players to a new way of experiencing, and discovering, a new home for their gaming experience.

We’re early, funded and moving fast. Joining Entity at this stage is a rare opportunity to help shape our company and our mission. We are an AI-native business; embracing the latest technologies and tools is essential to being successful with us.

About the role

We're hiring a Product Manager to own how that product performs once it's in players' hands. That means how players find games, decide to buy, keep coming back, and what we learn from it every week.

Product at Entity is split into two roles that work as one team:

  • Product Manager, Live (this role) owns how the product performs once it's live: the store, pricing, the player funnel, live ops and product performance.
  • Product Manager, Platform owns what we build: core platform features, the player experience, developer tools and governance.

You'll own the commercial side of the product and the weekly rhythm of a live service. Some of what you need will have to be built. When it does, you'll define the requirements and the Platform PM will plan them into the platform roadmap.

This role sits close to the business. You'll work with the Head of Games on releases, with marketing on campaigns and community, and with leadership and the data team on the numbers that matter. You'll also work with engineers and designers day to day to get changes shipped and tested quickly.

We're a small team heading into launch. We need someone who moves fast, runs experiments and makes decisions from evidence. The right person knows how much process is enough, and no more. You'll also be close to how players discover and buy games today, and keen to build for where the industry is heading.

Key responsibilities

  • Store and discovery. Own the storefront experience: game pages, merchandising, discovery and checkout conversion. Decide what players see, where, and why.
  • Pricing and offers. Own:
    • price points, trials, bundles and discounts
    • founding-member and waitlist incentives
    • the promotions calendar. Work with finance and the Head of Games on how publisher terms affect this.
  • Player funnel. Own the path from waitlist to first session, trial, purchase and return visits. Design and run A/B tests, and turn the results into product changes.
  • Live ops. Own the live ops calendar: events, promotions and feature beats. Line it up with the Head of Games' release schedule and marketing's campaigns.
  • Product performance. Define the product KPIs, own the dashboards and run a weekly performance review. Turn what you learn into roadmap priorities.
  • Early access. Run the early access programme's feedback loop: collect player feedback, sort issues and feed them into the backlog.
  • Requirements for growth features. Define what the store and live product need. Work with the Platform PM to get it planned and built, and use the live ops and analytics tools as their main internal customer.
  • Publisher performance. Give publishers and the Games team performance data, store placement and promotional slots that help their games succeed on Entity.
  • Working with marketing and community. Work closely with marketing, community, and our agency and creator partners so that what players hear matches what they find in the product. You don't run community or influencer programmes yourself, but you are a key stakeholder in growth.
  • Communication. Keep the team and leadership clear on performance and priorities. Write a short monthly update for the board pack and support investor KPI reporting.

Requirements

  • 3+ years' product management on games or digital consumer products, including recent ownership of monetisation, growth or live ops.

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 14M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Our team is seeking a Growth Marketing, Senior Manager to lead our marketing tech stack integration, and marketing operations, optimize our growth funnel, and pioneer next-generation acquisition strategies.

Are you highly curious? Comfortable in a fast-paced environment? Thrive in a collaborative team-setting? Pay special attention to details? Appreciate and can tap-into the unique skills of others? Are you a strong-contributor in a remote work setting?

ABOUT CONTINUED

A leader in EdTech, Continued is a team of passionate individuals dedicated to empowering professionals and enhancing careers. We are fast-paced, nimble, and we laugh a lot. We are proud to be certified as a great workplace, ranked #35 in Fortune's 2025 Best Medium Workplaces, ranked #18 in Fortune's 2025 top 25 Small & Medium Workplaces for Women, and ranked #74 in Fortune’s 2024 Best Small & Medium Workplaces for Millennials by the independent analysts at Great Place to Work®. We are 100% virtual, scattered across the country, but we maintain a tight-knit culture driven by curiosity, a love of learning, and a desire to solve complex problems. Learn more about us at continued.com.

THE MISSION

To own and evolve our email marketing program while simultaneously leading and guiding our customer data platform across other digital marketing channels and direct mail. This is a high-impact role that sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, marketing operations, data infrastructure, and intelligent automation.

You will join a team that is actively investing in centralized audience segment and being AI-first. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage batch-and-blast campaigns — it is for a modern marketer who understands that the future of email, direct mail, and cross-channel orchestration lives inside a well-architected customer data platform.

This role reports directly to the Director of Growth Marketing. You will collaborate closely with the data team, growth marketing team members, product, brand, and data automation teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead the audience segment buildout within our licensed platform: collaborate with our data team to manage audience traits, event taxonomy, identity resolution rules, and apply integration architecture with ESP’s and downstream channels
  • Own the email marketing program end-to-end: campaign strategy, segmentation, automation flows, A/B testing cadence, and performance reporting
  • Establish and enforce data hygiene standards, CAN-SPAM and other compliance protocols, and unsubscribe/suppression management across sends and mailings
  • Collaborate with the data team to maintain a subscriber data governance framework: aid in defining what we collect, how we store it, and how it flows across the stack
  • Partner with the data team to align CDP data structures to the broader data roadmap and migration project
  • Drive a cohesive omni-channel strategy by aligning direct mail logistics with digital campaigns to ensure consistent audience targeting, personalization, and suppression.
  • Lead AI automation adoption across email and direct mail: deploy AI tools for, send-time optimization, predictive segmentation, A-b testing and performance analytics
  • Manage reporting dashboards that connect marketing channels for engagement to renewal rates, and revenue contribution
  • Evaluate and recommend additional MarTech tooling to support channel expansion and automation maturity
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert on email and related CDP capabilities
  • Managerial responsibilities of one or more team members

WHO YOU ARE

You are a data-literate, technically fluent prospect, winback and engagement marketer who is equally comfortable in a CDP workspace as you are building journeys in an ESP. You research and follow trends in marketing technology. You are passionate about data quality. You are energized by collaboration and cross-team success.

  • 6+ years in email marketing, growth marketing, or marketing automation
  • Hands-on experience with a CDP — Twilio Segment preferred
  • Direct experience with a marketing automation platform (specifically with Marketo, or HubSpot. Also Klayvio, Customer.io or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated ability to design and execute segmentation strategies using first-party behavioral and transactional data
  • Working knowledge of CAN-SPAM and other privacy regulations, email deliverability best practices, and list hygiene management
  • Experience working cross-functionally with data engineering, analytics, and product teams
  • Direct mail program experience or exposure to omnichannel orchestration
  • Experience in a subscription or auto-renew business model
  • Active, hands-on use of AI tools in a marketing workflow
  • Experience in a regulated or compliance-sensitive vertical (healthcare, education, financial services)
  • Solid familiarity with Marketo

YOUR MINDSET

  • You default to data before opinions — you build the audience, test the hypothesis, and read the results
  • You are a builder, not just a manager — you are comfortable rolling up your sleeves in the platform while also influencing strategy
  • You move with urgency and communicate proactively, especially when blockers arise
  • You are energized by ambiguity and see an evolving role as an opportunity, not a risk
  • You hold yourself and your work accountable and to a high standard, and you raise the bar for the people around you
  • You strive for and uplift internal and cross-team accomplishments

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be able to work from home during core US business hours
  • Must be located in the United States and be legally eligible to work for us without sponsorship.
  • Must have the ability to fulfill the job requirements with or without reasonable accommodations
  • Travel is required for an all-company meeting, and may be required once or twice per year for team or project meetings

WHY JOIN US?

  • Full-time W2 position, work core business hours in your time zone
  • Work from home with a company-provided MacBook and internet stipend
  • 21 days of flexible PTO + your birthday + holidays (with flexible substitution)
  • ½ day Summer Fridays Memorial Day to Labor Day
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision group health insurance, flexible spending accounts, and more
  • 401k match, professional development budget, robust wellness programs, pet insurance and many more perks and benefits

TO APPLY

To apply, please submit a cover letter with your application. In your cover letter, we’d love to hear about: 1) why you would make a great addition to our team; and 2) a project achievement you are particularly proud of and why AND/OR something you’ve learned recently, etc.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we collect and process your personal information as described in our Applicant Privacy Notice. Please review the Notice before applying.

jobs.description:
Intellect is a global leader in mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale. Today, we serve over 4 million people across 100+ countries and territories, making mental health support truly accessible across borders and cultures.

Our platform powers the mental wellbeing of workforces at Fortune 500 companies like Dell, Bytedance, Visa, Shell, McDonald’s, and hundreds more, enabling them to support their people with the highest standards of clinical quality, cultural relevance, and on-demand accessibility.

Driven by our mission to build the world’s most trusted mental health benefits platform, Intellect combines a best-in-class digital platform with a world-leading global provider network to deliver unmatched client outcomes and transformative care experiences.

We are backed by top global investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Insignia Ventures Partners, HOF Capital, K3 Ventures, JAFCO, Headline, East Ventures, IHH Healthcare, MS&AD Ventures, and more, alongside an extensive coalition of notable family offices, big tech executives, and leading angel investors.

The Role

We’re looking for a product and content marketer to sharpen how Intellect competes, communicate the value of our solutions and turn that understanding into content that helps buyers choose us and clients get more from our offering.

Product marketing is at the centre of this role. You’ll build buyer and competitive insight, own positioning and messaging, and lead marketing planning for priority solution launches. Your remit spans Intellect’s digital products, care services and enterprise solutions.

You’ll also personally create the content that brings our positioning to life - from sales materials and customer stories to white papers, thought leadership and client communications. Working with our Clinical team, you’ll draw on research, evidence and subject-matter expertise to build credible, differentiated narratives. You’ll help strengthen Intellect’s brand, organic visibility and customer engagement through a focused, coordinated marketing plan.

Working directly with B2B marketing, sales, client success, product and clinical teams, you’ll have meaningful ownership of both the thinking and the execution.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. We’re open to hiring at Specialist or Manager level, depending on your experience and demonstrated ability to independently own and deliver this work.

Your Responsibilities

Product Marketing & Go-to-Market

  • Build buyer and competitive insight through customer conversations, sales feedback and reviews of won and lost opportunities, identifying buying priorities, objections and reasons to choose Intellect.
  • Own positioning, differentiation and value propositions across Intellect’s solutions, tailoring messaging to priority buyer segments and markets.
  • Lead marketing planning for priority solution launches and updates, defining target audiences, messaging, supporting evidence and sales readiness, with B2B marketing owning acquisition campaign execution.
  • Bring customer and market insights into discussions with product, clinical and commercial teams to inform how solutions are developed, packaged and communicated.

Commercial Content & Sales Enablement

  • Personally research, write and edit compelling sales decks, solution materials, customer stories, case studies and campaign content.
  • Identify barriers to purchase with sales and develop messaging, objection-handling resources and competitive positioning materials that help address them.
  • Partner with the Clinical team to translate research findings, clinical expertise and customer outcomes into clear, credible evidence that helps buyers evaluate Intellect and supports renewal and expansion conversations.
  • Keep core materials current and easy to use, assessing their usefulness through adoption, sales feedback and buyer responses.

Website, SEO & AI Search Visibility

  • Own core website content and routine CMS updates, ensuring our solutions, differentiation and customer evidence are clearly presented.
  • Improve organic discovery through search-informed content and practical on-page SEO, prioritising relevant audiences and commercial intent.
  • Test approaches to improve visibility in AI-powered search and answer platforms, building on useful, authoritative content and sound SEO foundations.
  • Use search and content performance to prioritise improvements, working with B2B marketing on conversion and specialists on technical changes.

Brand Communications, Thought Leadership & PR

  • Maintain a consistent voice and narrative across Intellect’s public and client-facing communications.
  • Collaborate with the Clinical team on research-led content and white papers, bringing buyer-relevant questions into topic planning and turning findings and subject-matter expertise into accessible narratives, with clinical review for accuracy.
  • Develop thought leadership, articles and executive content that connect Intellect’s expertise and perspectives to the issues facing employers and their people.
  • Own a focused editorial calendar for organic social and ongoing brand communications, coordinating creative support through to publication.
  • Develop company announcements, press materials and story angles; coordinate leadership approvals, routine media enquiries and outreach with specialist PR support where needed.

Customer Marketing & Lifecycle Communications

  • Plan and execute repeatable client programmes, including onboarding communications, newsletters, solution education and engagement journeys.
  • Personally manage client audience segments, email distribution and straightforward CRM workflows, coordinating targeting and timing with client success.
  • Develop communications that demonstrate ongoing value and introduce relevant additional services, supporting engagement, renewal and expansion.
  • Equip client success with reusable templates and materials for account-specific deployment.

Planning & Effectiveness

  • Translate business priorities into a focused plan, protecting time for positioning, launches and commercial content alongside recurring communications.
  • Assess effectiveness through sales adoption, buyer feedback, relevant search visibility, customer engagement and contribution to commercial programmes.
  • Build reusable assets and workflows, using AI and other tools to improve execution while maintaining accuracy, originality and editorial quality.

Requirements

  • Strong in product-marketing judgement. You can demonstrate how you have shaped positioning, messaging or a go-to-market approach using buyer insight, and explain the decisions behind your work.
  • An excellent hands-on writer and editor. You can turn complex products and services into clear, persuasive content, with work samples that show both your thinking and your personal contribution.
  • Commercially minded. You understand how enterprise buyers evaluate solutions and can connect your work to buying decisions, sales effectiveness and customer value.
  • An independent owner. You can identify gaps, propose priorities, gather inputs and deliver work without needing every step prescribed. You make sensible trade-offs and know when to seek input.
  • Comfortable with website publishing and SEO. You can manage content through a CMS, apply on-page SEO fundamentals and use data to improve performance. You’re curious and practical about emerging AI search opportunities.
  • Able to execute customer marketing. You can use CRM and email tools to segment audiences, run communications and build straightforward lifecycle workflows.
  • Confident working with experts and evidence. You can draw useful insights from specialists and research, communicate findings accurately and distinguish supported claims from overstatement. You do not need a clinical background, but should be comfortable learning complex subject matter.
  • Organised and collaborative. You work effectively with commercial teams, product and clinical experts, leadership and creative partners, managing competing priorities with sound judgement.
  • Motivated by the mission. You’re excited to make mental healthcare easier to understand and access, and connect strong product marketing and storytelling with meaningful business growth.
  • Open to candidates in Malaysia (hybrid), Singapore (hybrid), Philippines (remote) and Indonesia (remote)

We value demonstrated ownership and work quality over a particular title or rigid years-of-experience requirement. Experience with enterprise audiences, multiple markets, healthcare, employee benefits, HR technology or complex services would be an advantage. Experience in research-led content, PR, executive communications or AI search optimisation (GEO/AEO) is also welcome.

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

  • Global company – work in a diverse environment with people from nearly 20 countries
  • Generous leave policy – time off to rest and recharge
  • Christmas week off – company-wide break during Christmas, separate from annual leave
  • Birthday leave – enjoy a day off on your birthday
  • Quarterly mental health days – one day off every quarter to focus on your wellbeing
  • Flexible work arrangements – work in a way that suits your lifestyle and goals
  • Work-life balance – a culture that values personal time and long-term wellness
  • Medical coverage – comprehensive insurance for peace of mind

Most of your time is still hands-on client work: sourcing hotels, planning trips, responding to messages, and managing relationships from the first message through the moment a traveler gets home. But during your shift you are also responsible for the team hitting its standards. Response times, inbox coverage, message quality, escalations. When something starts to slip, you are the one who notices first and steps in.

If you have operated at a high service bar before, write with warmth and precision, stay calm under pressure, and take genuine pride in making people feel cared for, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • Work on a service that travelers rave about and help scale it to thousands of customers
  • Be a key voice in how the team delivers and how newer concierges develop

What You'll Work On

Client Portfolio Management

  • Own a portfolio of high-touch clients including some of the most complex and highest-value relationships
  • Learn each traveler's preferences, remember the details, and build the kind of rapport that turns one-time trips into long-term relationships
  • Respond quickly and thoughtfully with initial responses landing within 10 to 20 minutes during your shift
  • Anticipate needs before clients ask and proactively handle details they would have had to request themselves

Trip Research and Design

  • Research and recommend hotels, restaurants, and attractions using AI tools, editorial judgment, and strong research instincts
  • Build itineraries that match each client's pace, taste, and travel style
  • Verify every detail including location, timing, availability, and logistics before confirming anything
  • Stay current on destinations, new openings, airline programs, and loyalty rewards

Shift Leadership and Team Standards

  • Run the shared inbox during your shift and ensure messages are picked up on time, handoffs happen cleanly, and nothing slips through
  • Monitor response times, message quality, and customer satisfaction during your hours on
  • Flag when something is trending the wrong way, jump in, and escalate when needed
  • Step in on tricky situations including missed flights, hotel issues, and frustrated travelers as the experienced second voice

Mentorship and Process Contribution

  • Help onboard and support newer concierges, answer their questions in the moment, and model what great service looks like in practice
  • Contribute to playbooks and documentation as you spot recurring patterns or common service recovery situations
  • Share what works so the whole team gets better over time

Problem-Solving and Communication

  • Handle problems with composure: stay calm, present options clearly, and make the client feel taken care of in the hard moments
  • Write with warmth, clarity, and the right tone for every situation whether confirming a booking or delivering bad news
  • Know when to be concise, when to add a personal touch, and when a phone call is better than a message

What You Bring

  • 2+ years in a high-touch customer experience, hospitality, or client service role
  • Genuine hospitality mindset: you take pride in making people feel cared for and hold yourself to a high standard
  • Exceptional written English with the ability to communicate clearly and warmly across every type of message
  • Composure under pressure: when things go wrong you are the steady presence clients and teammates want on the line
  • Sharp judgment in ambiguous situations: you scope the real question, build a plan, and find smart fallbacks when needed
  • Detail-oriented and organized across confirmation numbers, time zones, dietary notes, and transfer windows
  • Reliable and consistent: when you are on shift, things run
  • Helpful and peer-supportive: you enjoy helping teammates get better and do not see it as a distraction

Nice to Have

  • Personal passion for travel and your own experience exploring the world
  • Working knowledge of popular destinations, hotel brands, airlines, and loyalty programs
  • Prior experience in hospitality, travel, or another high-touch service environment
  • Experience working in an early-stage startup or fast-moving team

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume highlighting any customer service or travel-related experience
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing how you have maintained high service standards under pressure, and sharing an example of a time you stepped in to help a teammate or resolve a difficult client situation
  3. A short writing sample such as a WhatsApp message or email showing your tone when handling a problem for a traveler

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you write with warmth, lead from the front during your shift, and want to help build a travel service that people genuinely love, this role gives you the client relationships, the team responsibility, and the platform to do your best work.

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team

  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.description:
Szukamy osób, które chciałyby zaangażować się w dodatkowy, płatny projekt realizowany dla KOSTAL Solar Electric.

To propozycja dla osób, które dobrze czują się w rozmowach telefonicznych, lubią kontakt z ludźmi, są systematyczne i chcą realizować dodatkowe zadania wyłącznie poza standardowymi godzinami pracy.

Na czym polega projekt?

Celem projektu nie jest bezpośrednia sprzedaż produktów przez telefon. Zadanie polega na pierwszym kontakcie z firmami i instalatorami z przygotowanej bazy, krótkim przedstawieniu KOSTAL Solar Electric oraz sprawdzeniu, czy dana firma jest zainteresowana dalszą rozmową.

Zakres zadań

  • kontakt telefoniczny z firmami i instalatorami z przygotowanej listy,
  • krótkie przedstawienie produktów i usług KOSTAL Solar Electric,
  • zebranie informacji zwrotnej z rynku,
  • rejestrowanie rezultatów rozmów,
  • przekazywanie zainteresowanych kontaktów do partnera handlowego,
  • w wybranych przypadkach: wykonanie dalszego kontaktu / follow-upu.

Szukamy osób, które:

  • swobodnie, profesjonalnie i uprzejmie rozmawiają przez telefon,
  • potrafią jasno oraz rzeczowo przekazywać informacje,
  • są dobrze zorganizowane i systematyczne,
  • potrafią rzetelnie notować wyniki rozmów,
  • nie zniechęcają się, gdy rozmówca nie jest zainteresowany,
  • znają język angielski w stopniu komunikatywnym.

Doświadczenie w sprzedaży ani szczegółowa znajomość branży PV nie są wymagane. Podstawowa wiedza z zakresu elektrotechniki lub fotowoltaiki będzie mile widzianym atutem.

  • Zaangażowanie: ok. 3–8 godzin tygodniowo
  • Forma współpracy: dodatkowa umowa zlecenia

Jesteśmy Grupą KOSTAL, globalną, niezależną firmą rodzinną z siedzibą w Niemczech, która opracowuje i produkuje zaawansowane technologicznie produkty elektroniczne i mechatroniczne. W 47 lokalizacjach w 21 krajach ponad 19 000 pracowników pracuje elastycznie, kompetentnie i blisko klienta.

KOSTAL Solar Electric od 2006 roku rozwija rozwiązania dla fotowoltaiki - zarówno dla domów, jak i obiektów komercyjnych. Obejmuje m.in. falowniki solarne, hybrydowe i bateryjne, systemy magazynowania energii, liczniki energii, stacje ładowania samochodów elektrycznych (wallboxy) oraz narzędzia do monitorowania i zarządzania energią.

Inzwischen sind wir über 90 Kolleginnen und Kollegen, verteilt auf zwei Standorte (Nijverdal und Zwolle). Ein großer Teil der Bauwelt in den Niederlanden, Belgien, Deutschland und Dänemark arbeitet bereits auf unserer Plattform und nutzt unsere Software täglich.   • Leidenschaft für Sales und den starken Willen, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst perfektes Deutsch – das ist ein Muss.

  • Neugierig, ehrgeizig und ein Teamplayer mit Hands-on-Mentalität.

  • Gute Selbstorganisation, Fokus und Verlässlichkeit.

  • Spaß daran, neue Ideen für Online Sales einzubringen.

  • Einen modernen Arbeitsplatz mit allen Tools, um deinen Job wie ein Profi zu machen.

  • Laptop.

  • Eine offene und transparente Unternehmenskultur, in der du wirklich gehört wirst.

  • Die Möglichkeit, über Compassion ein Patenkind in der Dominikanischen Republik zu unterstützen.

  • Ein Umfeld, in dem Kreativität und Out-of-the-box-Denken geschätzt werden – und in dem deine Ideen sofort Wirkung haben.

Support the business by ensuring Nursing Direct debts are collected as per agreed terms. Collaborate with the operations team and client support team to complete all weekly and monthly tasks. Partner with the Client Support Team Leader to reduce debtors and enhance cash collection for Nursing Direct.

Work closely with the NDHL operations team to ensure smooth invoice payments for onboarded clients.

Generate weekly outstanding invoice reports from Sage.

Meet weekly and monthly cash collection targets.

Perform daily cash allocation from RBS bank statements.

Conduct weekly bank reconciliations for the Nursing Direct ledger.

Assist the Client Support Team Leader in ensuring timely completion of weekly and monthly tasks.

Verify new packages or clients onboarded weekly to prevent delays in invoice payments due to missing data.

Resolve disputed or queried invoices in the Nursing Direct ledger within 45 days.

Maintain the client support inbox for the Nursing Direct ledger.

Provide weekly updates on outstanding invoices, including collected cash and problematic clients.

Ensure the Tradeshift portal is managed effectively, addressing any exceptions or unuploaded invoices promptly.

Credit Control:

Manage the Nursing Direct ledger debt book and cash collection.

Collect outstanding debt through daily client communication.

Send weekly Credit Hound reminder letters and follow up with clients as per agreed terms.

Meet weekly cash collection targets to achieve monthly goals.

Raise credits and re-invoice in Tempaid.

Manage online portal invoices and credit notes, reconciling accounts with Tempaid data.

Allocate cash daily.

Escalate unresolved issues in weekly meetings and updates.

Complete Nursing Direct RBS bank reconciliations weekly and monthly to meet deadlines.

Report unresolved issues to the Client Support Team Leader.
