Job Description Summary

The Military DoD SkillBridge program is an opportunity for Service members to gain valuable civilian work experience through specific industry training, apprenticeships, or internships during the last 180 days of service. SkillBridge connects Service members with industry partners in real-world job experiences under Dept. of Defense Instruction 1322.29. Separating Service members can be granted up to 180 days of permissive duty to focus solely on training full-time with approved industry partners after unit commander (first O-4/Field Grade commander in chain of command) provides written authorization and approval. GE Aerospace as a Skill Bridge partner offers real-world training and work experience in in-demand fields of work while having the opportunity to evaluate the Service member’s suitability for the work. Military DoD SkillBridge participants are not eligible for compensation from GE Aerospace, as they continue to receive military compensation and benefits as active-duty service members.

Job Description

This posting is for Active Military personnel who are eligible to start their SkillBridge internship in 2027.

Essential Functions:

Candidates for this internship may support any of GE Aerospace's business units.

Examples include:

  • Engineering / Technology
  • Digital Technology
  • Manufacturing & Logistics
  • Sourcing/Supply Chain

Individuals selected for this internship will have the responsibility and authority to carry out all assigned tasks

Qualifications / Requirements:

  • Active Military personnel on their last 180 days of Military service

Desired Skills / Experience:

  • Proficient in the use of a personal computer to navigate online documents, drawings, and instructions
  • Prior experience working in a team-oriented environment

This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. Therefore, employment will be contingent upon the ability to prove that you meet the status of a U.S. Person as one of the following: U.S. lawful permanent resident, U.S. Citizen, have been granted asylee or refugee status (i.e., a protected individual under the Immigration and Naturalization Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)).

Das Wichtigste zu Arbeitsmodell, Arbeitszeit und Vertrag

Arbeitsmodell: remote

Das Wichtigste zu deinem Team, deinem Fokus und deinem Einfluss

Hinter jedem erfolgreichen Bauprojekt stehen Menschen, die Prozesse verstehen und Herausforderungen annehmen – und genau hier kommt dein Karriere-Shift! Deine direkten Teamkollegen*innen, die ebenfalls aus der Baubranche kommen, analysierst komplexe Anwendungsfälle, entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen und hilfst unseren Kunden dabei, ihre Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten. Keine Hotline und doch absolute Kundennähe.

Karriereimpulse zu dieser Rolle gibt es im RIB Cast Podcast mit Volkan & Sabine:

Bereich: Customer Care Center

Du berichtest an: Teamleitung

Fokus-Markt: DACH

Dein neuer Verantwortungsbereich:

Komplexe Kundenlösungen, Eskalationsmanagement und Service Excellence

Wir wissen: Ein neues Arbeitsumfeld sollte sich nicht nur fachlich, sondern auch menschlich lohnen. Deshalb unterstützen wir dich über deine reinen Aufgaben hinaus – mit diesen konkreten Leistungen:

  • Karriereentwicklung und individuelle Weiterbildung: Wir unterstützen dich dabei, deine fachlichen und persönlichen Stärken gezielt auszubauen, durch team- und rollenbasierte Trainings, individuelle Entwicklungsangebote

  • Raum für Ideen und Mitgestaltung: Bei uns kannst du eigene Ideen, neue Ansätze und Vorschläge zur Prozessoptimierung aktiv einbringen, im direkten Austausch mit deinem Team, über das betriebliche Ideenmanagement sowie in Team- und Managementformaten wie den RIB Town Halls

  • Mitarbeitervergünstigungen (Corporate Benefits)

  • Gesundheitsmanagement (Betriebsarzt, Augenkontrollen)

  • Regelmäßige Mitarbeiterevents (Teamevents, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier)

UNTERNEHMENSKULTUR UND WERTE

Motiviert durch unsere Werte kreieren wir eine corporate culture, in der wir ein klares Bild davon haben, wie wir miteinander interact, kommunizieren, arbeiten, führen/ coachen, supporten und unseren Nachwuchs fördern. Dabei steht immer der Mensch im Vordergrund!

CHANCENGLEICHHEIT UND DIVERSITY

RIB fördert die Chancengleichheit von Frauen und Männern in allen Funktionen und Tätigkeitsfeldern.
Ganz gleich ob weibliche Führungskräfte, Mitarbeitende mit Behinderung, Berufseinsteigenden oder ältere Berufserfahrene – für uns zählt Engagement und die richtige Qualifikation. Der RIB Code of Conduct beschreibt dabei unsere wichtigsten Prinzipien in puncto Nationalität, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion,…

RIB VISION
Gebäude und Bauten sind für 36% des weltweiten Energieverbrauchs und fast 40% der energiebedingten CO2-Emissionen verantwortlich. Um die Branche effizienter, robuster und nachhaltiger zu machen, entwickeln wir Softwarelösungen, mit denen man im gesamten Lebenszyklus eines Bauwerks Ressourcen, Rohstoffe und Energie einsparen kann. Digitalisierung sehen wir als einen Treiber für eine nachhaltige Bauindustrie. "Building Better Together" steht dabei für das Zusammenspiel der beiden weltweit führenden Prozess- und Energietechnologien: RIB-Gruppe und Schneider Electric.

jobs.excerpt: About UsFlying Bisons is a leading Strategic Design & Digital Consulting company based in Warsaw, with projects across Europe and the Middle East.
jobs.description:
About Us

Flying Bisons is a leading Strategic Design & Digital Consulting company based in Warsaw, with projects across Europe and the Middle East. Our mission is to help our clients Unleash Digital Potential™.

We work at scales where real impact happens: enterprise platforms, government services, and corporate ecosystems used by millions of people. Our projects include national workforce platforms (Qiwa, Ajeer), education ecosystems (Madares), major banks (Bank Pekao, Alinma), global telecoms (Ooredoo, Salam), and international brands (KFC, Hebe, NaTemat, Enel-Med).

Our uniqueness comes from going beyond design craft. As we wrote in our manifestos - Strategic Design - Manifest and Strategic Design - The Future of Design - design craft is only 10% of success. The other 90% - the Invisible 90% - is about navigating politics, aligning stakeholders, and protecting fragile visions until they reach reality.

That’s why we’re building the discipline of Strategic Design - and we want you to be part of it.

Role context

We are looking for an ambitious Junior or early Mid-level Designer who wants to grow in an AI-native environment.

You do not need to be an AI expert.

You do not need to know how to code.

And you do not need several years of commercial experience.

What matters much more to us is whether you are curious, willing to experiment, quick to learn and already trying to use AI as part of your design process.

Maybe you have already tested Lovable, v0, Bolt, Figma Make, Cursor, Claude or another similar tool.

Maybe you have built a small app, prototype, landing page or personal project.

Or maybe you are simply the kind of person who sees a new tool and immediately wants to find out what can be done with it.

That is the mindset we are looking for.

At Flying Bisons, you will work alongside more experienced UX, UI and Strategic Designers and learn how to turn briefs, ideas and user needs into interactive solutions.

The goal is not to replace design fundamentals with AI.

The goal is to use AI to design faster, smarter and better.

Scope of services

  • work in project teams alongside more experienced UX, UI and Strategic Designers,

  • help translate briefs, concepts and user needs into user flows and interactive prototypes,

  • use AI to quickly explore different solutions instead of designing every screen from scratch,

  • experiment with tools such as Lovable, v0, Bolt, Figma Make, Cursor, Claude Code and new solutions emerging on the market,

  • create early versions of flows that can quickly be clicked through, discussed and developed further,

  • iterate on solutions based on feedback from more experienced designers and the project team,

  • think about how the whole product behaves, not just about individual screens,

  • consider different states, errors, user actions and edge cases,

  • work in Figma when it is the best tool for the job,

  • develop your ability to combine AI with solid UX and UI fundamentals,

  • gradually build your own AI-native workflow,

  • share interesting tools, experiments and learnings with the team.

    Over time, we want you to become increasingly independent in taking a well-defined product problem and turning it into a solid interactive solution.

What we are looking for

We are looking for someone who:

  • has some practical experience with UX/UI or Product Design, gained through commercial work, internships, freelance work, university projects or personal projects,

  • understands basic UX principles and can think about the entire user flow rather than individual screens,

  • has a good visual sense and understands the basics of hierarchy, spacing and interface design,

  • actively looks for ways to use AI to improve or speed up their design process

  • is interested in how AI is changing design and wants to actively develop in this area,

  • is comfortable trying new things even when they do not initially know exactly how to approach them,

  • learns new tools quickly,

  • is open to feedback and comfortable showing work that is still in progress,

  • can explain the reasoning behind their design decisions,

  • thinks not only about how a button looks, but also about what happens after the user clicks it,

  • can communicate comfortably in English in a project environment.

    You do not need to meet every requirement perfectly.

    If you are at the beginning of your career but already experimenting, building your own things and learning quickly, we would still be very happy to hear from you.

Nice to have

  • built a prototype, small app, website or personal project using AI,

  • experience with tools such as Lovable, v0, Bolt, Figma Make, Cursor, Claude Code or similar,

  • basic knowledge of how websites and digital products are built,

  • basic knowledge of HTML, CSS or general front-end concepts,

  • experience working with developers, Product Managers or researchers,

  • personal projects that demonstrate curiosity and initiative beyond work or university,

  • experience experimenting with different AI models and tools.

    None of these are mandatory.

What matters more than years of experience

We are not looking for the person with the longest CV.

We are looking for signs of potential.

What matters most to us is:

  • curiosity,

  • learning speed,

  • product thinking,

  • initiative,

  • willingness to experiment,

  • solid design fundamentals,

  • genuine interest in AI-native design.

A small project that you built yourself and can explain well may tell us more about you than a perfectly polished portfolio.

Short video application

Instead of a traditional cover letter, we would like you to send us a short video in English.

Maximum length: 8-10 minutes.

You do not need to prepare or edit it professionally. A simple screen recording or Loom is absolutely fine.

We would like you to show us two things.

1. Show us something you created, around 5 minutes

Show us one project or experiment where you used AI.

It can be:

  • a prototype,

  • a small app,

  • a website,

  • a university project,

  • a personal project,

  • an experiment,

  • or something you created mainly to learn a new tool.

Briefly tell us:

  • What were you trying to create?

  • Which AI tool did you use?

  • What did AI help you with?

  • What did you change or design yourself?

  • What did you learn while working on it?

The project does not need to be commercial or particularly complex.

We are much more interested in how you approached it.

2. Tell us what you are learning now, around 3 to 5 minutes

Tell us:

What AI tool, workflow or capability are you currently exploring? Show or tell us what caught your attention and what you would like to be able to do with it.

There is no single correct answer.

We simply want to understand what interests you and how you approach learning new things.

A few important things:

  • You do not need professional equipment.

  • You do not need to edit your recording.

  • You do not need a commercial AI project.

  • Please do not show any confidential client materials.

  • You do not need to prepare a presentation.

  • If your project is small, that is absolutely fine.

Show us something real and tell us about it in your own words.

Recruitment process

We want to keep the process simple and straightforward.

Step 1: Short video

You send us your CV, portfolio and the short video described above.

Step 2: HR screening

Around 30 minutes.

Step 3: Design interview

Around 45 minutes with one of our designers.

Optional: Short practical task

In some cases, we may ask you to complete a short practical task if we need one additional data point before making a decision.

Cooperation terms

  • B2B cooperation or umowa zlecenie for candidates with student status

  • remote cooperation.

  • work in an Apple and Google Workspace-based environment,

  • access to selected tools, systems and project environments required for project delivery,

  • opportunity to work with experienced specialists across strategy, design, research, product, analytics, technology and delivery,

  • cooperation based on delivery quality, agreed outcomes and clear communication.

jobs.title: Lead Product Engineer (Developer Platform)
jobs.excerpt: About bunny. netSome people accept the internet as it is.
jobs.description:
About bunny.net

Some people accept the internet as it is. We see what it could be.

At bunny.net, we don’t wait for change. We make it happen. You won’t find layers of red tape or play-it-safe thinking here. You’ll find people who move quickly, take ownership, and push ideas all the way to the edge. Literally.

You’ll build things that solve actual problems, not add to them.

We’re not perfect, and we don’t pretend to be. But we’re always improving. We’re looking for people who want to do the same, who take pride in their work, and aren’t afraid to challenge what’s possible.

Because everyone deserves a better internet. And we’re here to help it hop faster.

Lead Product Engineer (Developer Platform)

What if you could design the way developers ship their workloads to the edge, starting from a blank page?

As a Lead Product Engineer at bunny.net, you'll own the Developer Platform and lead a small team of engineers. We already give developers the pieces to run compute close to their users: Magic Containers, Edge Scripting, and Database. What's missing is the glue: the part that turns a set of products into one obvious way to say "deploy my workload to bunny." That glue is yours: projects, environments like dev, staging, and production, secrets shared at the right level, logs you can actually read, and a container that talks to a database without a detour through the docs.

Product Engineering sits inside Engineering. There's no Product Manager handing over requirements: you carry the product responsibilities yourself, and you shape solutions with your engineers in the codebase, not just in the conversation. How much you build yourself depends on you and on what the team needs, but shipping code is part of the role, not a bonus.

It’s a role for someone who loves both the why and the how, combining strong product judgment with technical depth, and knowing when to get hands-on and when to help others find the way forward.

You’ll have the context to see the bigger picture, the freedom to challenge assumptions, and teams that challenge your thinking right back.

If you love being close to developers, turning a blank page into something people ship on every day, and helping a team get the details right, you'll feel right at home here.

What will you do?

  • Design the primitives developers use, such as projects, environments, secrets, and logs, and how they behave across Magic Containers, Edge Scripting, and Database, so deploying, configuring, connecting, and debugging a workload on bunny.net feels like one product

  • Shape Developer Platform product direction from discovery through delivery and iteration, turning developer insights into clear priorities

  • Spot and resolve platform or product decisions that break the unified developer experience before they ship

  • Bring clarity to hard problems and give teams the context to make great decisions on their own, raising the bar for product thinking, technical judgment, and ownership beyond your own team

  • Lead a small engineering team: set direction, develop people, give clear feedback, and hold a high bar for what you ship and run

  • Build alongside your engineers across prototypes, APIs, dashboard, instrumentation, docs, and production code

  • Define and measure success, from first deploy to adoption and expansion, and use what you learn to decide what comes next

  • Work across Compute, Frontend, Design, and Product Marketing to create a cohesive experience across the dashboard, API, CLI, and docs

What will you bring?

  • Ideally, you’ve owned the full discovery → delivery → iteration loop at meaningful scale, or you’re ready to take on that level of end-to-end ownership

  • Strong product judgment and a knack for turning messy, ambiguous problems into meaningful outcomes

  • Comfort with data: knowing what to measure, what funnels and retention curves are telling you, and when to run an experiment

  • Business and market literacy: ICP, pricing, competition, revenue drivers, and how your product supports bunny.net's wider strategy

  • Strong technical depth to challenge solutions, make trade-offs, and ship production changes yourself

  • A high bar for quality, reliability, performance, security, and customer trust

  • A track record of helping others make better decisions and take more ownership

  • Clear communication, high ownership, and low ego

  • AI fluency: using AI thoughtfully across research, analysis, prototyping, coding, testing, and communication, while staying accountable for quality

What will make us extra happy?

  • Experience building developer platforms, deployment tools, or products where the developer experience is the product

  • You've deployed, configured, and debugged your own workloads on similar platforms

  • You’re as comfortable talking to customers as you are digging into the technology

  • You naturally think beyond individual features and see how products, systems, and teams fit together

  • Experience leading engineers: developing people, giving feedback, and creating the conditions for a team to make product decisions rather than execute tasks

Where should you be located?

Europe, ideally within CET ±3 hours so collaboration with the team feels natural rather than scheduled.

What's in it for you?

Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.

  • 100% flexible hours - Your work, your rhythm. Whether you thrive at 3 am or on a beach at noon, we've got you.

  • Remote-first by design - No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our headquarters.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - Coverage worldwide.

  • Paid time off - Love the slopes or the sea? Enjoy them with 25 vacation days, plus an extra loyalty day each year, capped at 5 years (30 days total), on top of your local public holidays.

  • Meeting-free Thursdays - We keep Thursdays meeting free internally so you can focus on deep work without interruptions.

  • Home office budget - We believe everyone is more efficient working in a comfortable office, and we're happy to help you set it up with an annual budget of €500.

  • Paid sick leave - Feeling ill? Take time off to fully recover without having to worry about your finances.

  • Parental leave - Paid 16 weeks for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non-birthing parents. If your country gives more, that’s your baseline. If it gives less, we top it up. Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.

  • Annual fluffle building - We're remote, but not distant! Once a year, we meet in a sunny location where virtual high-fives turn into real ones.

  • Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) - Everyone at bunny.net gets a piece of the pie, starting with 0.01% equity.

  • Mental health support - Feeling down? We've got your back. bunny.net provides mental health resources and help via .

  • Wellness budget - An annual well-being budget of €480 is here to help you stay fresh and focused.

  • Educational budget - €500 yearly for books, seminars, or online courses to keep your learning on track, work-related or not.

jobs.excerpt: As a Principal Engineer in AI Security, you will define and lead Thrivent’s strategy for defending against emerging external AI-powered threats.
jobs.description:
As a Principal Engineer in AI Security, you will define and lead Thrivent’s strategy for defending against emerging external AI-powered threats. This role focuses on protecting the enterprise from adversarial AI capabilities, including automated vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and AI-driven attack campaigns. You will operate at the intersection of cyber defense, artificial intelligence, and enterprise architecture, translating rapidly evolving external threats into practical, scalable protections across the organization. This role requires deep technical expertise, strong systems thinking, and the ability to influence security strategy at the highest levels.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Designing Solutions

  • Apply expert-level knowledge of AI-driven threats, cyber defense, and enterprise security architecture to define and drive outcomes that protect the organization from emerging AI-powered attack vectors.
  • Create the enterprise strategy for defending against AI-enabled threats, including automated vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and adversarial AI techniques.
  • Establish architecture for detection, prevention, and response capabilities specific to generative AI threat patterns.
  • Define and implement security patterns and guardrails to enable safe and secure enterprise consumption of AI technologies.
  • Drive integration of AI threat detection and controls into existing cyber defense tooling and platforms.
  • Build threat models focused on generative AI attack patterns and emerging adversarial techniques.

Implementing Solutions

  • Use independent, critical thinking to translate evolving AI threat intelligence into scalable engineering controls and defensive capabilities.
  • Lead the development of detection and response mechanisms for AI-driven attacks across enterprise environments.
  • Design and implement telemetry strategies to identify anomalous behavior indicative of AI-enabled threats.
  • Partner with Cyber Defense teams to operationalize detections, response playbooks, and automation for AI-related incidents.
  • Prototype and evaluate defensive applications of AI to enhance detection, response, and security operations.
  • Develop architecturally significant components that advance the organization’s ability to defend against AI-driven adversaries.

Learning and Applying New Techniques

  • Lead research initiatives focused on emerging AI threat capabilities, adversarial AI techniques, and evolving attack methodologies.
  • Maintain deep expertise in industry frameworks such as OWASP LLM Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS.
  • Continuously evaluate and introduce modern security technologies and approaches to address AI-era risks.
  • Drive adoption of innovative defensive techniques across the organization to stay ahead of threat evolution.

Collaborating Within the Team

  • Provide deep technical expertise in AI security to solve complex, high-impact problems and remove critical technical roadblocks.
  • Partner with product owners and engineering teams to incorporate AI security requirements into technical designs and user stories.
  • Act as a technical leader in system design across teams, ensuring AI security considerations are embedded into broader architecture decisions.
  • Mentor engineers and elevate AI security capabilities within teams.

Collaborating Across Teams

  • Partner closely with Cyber Defense, IAM, and Application Security teams to integrate AI threat protections across the security ecosystem.
  • Promote adherence to enterprise security standards while extending them to address AI-specific risks.
  • Broker design and implementation of AI security controls across product teams to support strategic priorities.
  • Drive alignment across teams on detection engineering, telemetry, and response strategies for AI threats.

Collaborating Across the Organization

  • Influence senior leadership on AI risk posture, threat landscape evolution, and required investments in defensive capabilities.
  • Provide enterprise-wide guidance on AI security architecture, ensuring consistent and scalable protection strategies.
  • Represent the organization externally on AI security topics when appropriate (industry forums, partnerships, etc.).
  • Translate complex AI security risks into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Setting Product/Platform Technology Strategy

  • Define enterprise-level capabilities required to defend against AI-powered threats.
  • Shape the strategic direction for AI security across cyber defense, detection engineering, and secure AI adoption.
  • Provide subject matter expertise to guide platform and security investments related to AI risk mitigation.

Defining Engineering Standards/Patterns

  • Establish and promote engineering standards for AI security, including secure AI usage patterns and detection frameworks.
  • Collaborate across teams to ensure consistent application of AI security controls and design patterns.
  • Drive adoption of best practices for integrating AI threat protections into engineering workflows and platforms.

DevOps

  • Provide technical leadership in identifying and responding to AI-driven security incidents and emerging threats.
  • Introduce resilient and scalable technologies to improve detection and response capabilities for evolving attack patterns.
  • Evaluate and implement enhancements to CI/CD and operational pipelines to incorporate AI security controls.
  • Influence cross-functional teams to proactively address risks associated with AI-enabled development and deployment.

Selecting and Managing Technology Vendors

  • Provide technical expertise in evaluating AI security tools, detection platforms, and emerging defensive technologies.
  • Assess how vendor solutions align with enterprise strategy for defending against AI-driven threats.
  • Contribute to selection criteria for platforms that enhance AI security posture and detection capabilities.

Coaching Engineers

  • Mentor engineers in AI security concepts, threat modeling, and detection engineering.
  • Provide guidance on best practices for securing AI-enabled systems and defending against adversarial AI techniques.
  • Deliver training, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions to build AI security expertise across the organization.

Recruiting and Building Talent

  • Engage in the broader AI and security community to strengthen organizational expertise and visibility in AI security.
  • Support recruitment efforts to hire engineers with specialized skills in AI security and advanced cyber defense.
  • Model Thrivent’s leadership competencies: Model the Way, Rally the Team, and Deliver Outcomes.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and strong security practices aligned to evolving AI risks.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related technical field, or equivalent work experience
  • 10+ years of experience in security engineering or related field
  • Proven experience defining and executing enterprise security strategy
  • Deep knowledge of modern threats, attack techniques, and detection engineering
  • Experience with threat modeling, incident response, and security operations
  • Demonstrated ability to influence both technical and executive stakeholders

Preferred:

  • Experience working with AI/ML systems and security implications
  • Knowledge of adversarial AI techniques and AI threat modeling
  • Experience with XDR, SIEM, and detection engineering practices
  • Familiarity with AI security frameworks (e.g., OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS)
  • Financial services industry experience

jobs.title: Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Senior Data & AI Platform EngineerAt OrderYOYO, data powers executive reporting, payments, finance, merchant insights, product analytics, AI, marketing automation, and M&A integration.
jobs.description:
Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer

At OrderYOYO, data powers executive reporting, payments, finance, merchant insights, product analytics, AI, marketing automation, and M&A integration. This role will shape the governed, increasingly AI-enabled data foundation that supports our next stage of scale.

Role mission

Own the continuity, evolution and AI-enablement of OrderYOYO’s modern data platform during a critical scaling phase. You will lead the migration from legacy reporting and metric tooling into a governed Microsoft Fabric platform, keep business-critical BI and semantic models reliable, improve data pipeline stability and monitoring, support CRM data integration, apply AI and automation to improve data engineering, reporting and analytics, and provide senior technical leadership for data engineering delivery.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead hands-on Microsoft Fabric architecture across lakehouse, warehouse, notebooks, semantic models, Git-backed delivery and production governance.
  • Drive migration from legacy reporting and metric tooling into a governed Fabric semantic layer, including parity testing, stakeholder sign-off and safe decommissioning.
  • Own and improve data pipelines across APIs, files, events and operational stores; establish robust orchestration, monitoring, alerting, data-quality checks and incident response.
  • Use AI and automation to accelerate ETL/ELT development, data mapping, documentation, testing, report generation, monitoring and data-quality management.
  • Design high-quality Power BI semantic models, DAX measures and reusable metric definitions for leadership, finance, commercial, product, marketing, payments and support reporting.
  • Support CRM and operational data integrations, including outbound data feeds, identity mapping, schema mapping, reverse-ETL patterns and monitoring.
  • Create reliable ingestion and modelling patterns for acquired businesses, so future integrations are repeatable, auditable and faster to execute.
  • Set data-engineering standards: definition of ready/done, code review, release discipline, documentation, runbooks and platform change governance.
  • Mentor engineers and analysts and translate business-critical data needs into pragmatic technical delivery.
  • Build automated reporting and insight-generation capabilities that reduce manual analysis and improve decision speed.

Must-have requirements

  • 6+ years in modern data warehousing, analytics engineering or data platform engineering, ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, fintech, payments, e-commerce or multi-region B2B2C environment.
  • Strong Microsoft Fabric capability, or deep Azure Synapse / Databricks experience with clear ability to specialise quickly in Fabric.
  • Expert SQL/T-SQL plus strong Python or PySpark, with a track record of building maintainable ELT/ETL pipelines and analytical data models.
  • Strong Power BI and DAX experience, including semantic modelling, incremental refresh, performance tuning, model governance and capacity/cost awareness.
  • Experience leading legacy-to-modern data platform migrations, including metric parity, stakeholder validation, change control and safe decommissioning.
  • Experience operating production data systems: monitoring, alert design, incident triage, root-cause analysis, data-quality checks, lineage and runbooks.
  • Comfortable with Git-based data engineering workflows, pull requests, release discipline and standards for notebooks, pipelines and semantic model changes.
  • Practical experience using AI or automation to improve data engineering, reporting, documentation, testing, monitoring, migration or developer productivity.

Strong-to-have experience

  • Payments, settlement, reconciliation, fees, chargebacks, merchant reporting or finance-domain data.
  • CRM-side data flows and reverse-ETL patterns, especially HubSpot, Salesforce, Zendesk or similar platforms.
  • M&A or acquired-company data integrations: schema discovery, file/API ingestion, data profiling, master-data mapping, migration QA and reporting continuity.
  • NoSQL-to-analytics modelling, including change-feed patterns from operational databases into lakehouse or warehouse structures.
  • GA4, BigQuery export, Google Ads / SEM feeds, Segment or other event and marketing analytics sources.
  • Experience with Azure OpenAI, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, prompt/version management or AI-assisted development workflows.
  • Experience building AI-generated reporting, natural-language analytics, business copilots, automated insight generation or merchant/customer intelligence tools.
  • Responsible AI and governance experience, including RBAC, PII handling, audit logs, human approval flows, explainability and GDPR-conscious design.

Candidate signals to prioritise in interview

  • Has owned a production data platform, not only built dashboards or one-off analytics projects.
  • Can explain how they governed metrics and prevented conflicting definitions across teams.
  • Has migrated or consolidated legacy reporting into a modern semantic layer without breaking business trust.
  • Balances delivery urgency with reliability, documentation, cost control and operational resilience.
  • Communicates clearly with executives, product teams, analysts and engineers; can say “no” or “not yet” with evidence.
  • Is hands-on enough to debug pipelines and models, while senior enough to set standards and mentor others.
  • Has used AI or automation in a real data-engineering context to speed up delivery, not just as a novelty, and can describe the guardrails they put around it.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are looking for a financial operator to be the source of truth for Telos Media.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a financial operator to be the source of truth for Telos Media. You will own the books across four entities and several creative brands, and you will use what you find there to tell leadership where the money is going. The mandate is simple: make the books bulletproof, then tell us what they mean.

This is a dual role. You need to be comfortable wearing both hats, and the second one is what makes this a Controller rather than an accountant:

  • The accounting hat. You own the general ledger. You ensure compliance, accuracy, and a close that lands on time every month.
  • The analyst hat. You own the insight. You explain why a brand is profitable or bleeding, using data you personally verified.

What You'll Do

1. Financial reporting and control

  • GL ownership. Prepare the final general ledger and P&L across all entities for the Head of Finance to sign off. If it is in the books, you vouch for it.
  • The close. Run a disciplined monthly close so leadership receives the financial package (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) by the 10th.
  • Review and quality control. Review the Finance Officer's reconciliations and expense coding. You are the first line of defence against errors reaching leadership.
  • Balance sheet hygiene. A clean balance sheet with no unreconciled suspense accounts and no unexplained transactions.
  • Multi-entity and intercompany. Maintain intercompany balances across US, UK and merchandise entities, and keep the intercompany position clean and reconcilable.

2. FP&A and strategic insight

  • Cost allocation. Build and maintain the logic mapping shared overhead (finance, HR, leadership) to specific brands. The measure is an accurate net profit per brand.
  • Variance analysis. Lead the monthly forecast-versus-actual review. Do not report the difference; explain the driver behind it.
  • Bleed analysis. Deep dives into struggling or new ventures to identify exactly where cash is leaking.
  • Channel P&L. Maintain individual P&Ls for creative channels so unit economics are visible.
  • Cash forecasting. Support the rolling cash forecast across entities, including inventory and production commitments.

About You

  • Experience. 5 or more years in accounting and finance, with real exposure to multi-entity or multi-currency environments. Startup, outsourced-accounting or SME background is a strong fit; large-corporate-only experience often is not.
  • Technical stack. Deep Xero proficiency is non-negotiable, including chart-of-accounts design and multi-entity handling. Expert Google Sheets or Excel — pivot tables, lookups, and building a model from scratch rather than filling one in.
  • Certification. CPA, CMA or equivalent preferred, not required where operational depth is strong.
  • Investigative instinct. This is the differentiator and we screen hard for it. You do not just categorise transactions. If a margin moves 2%, you find out why before anyone asks. If a number looks wrong, you say so, including to people senior to you.
  • Communication. You can explain a financial result to a non-finance founder in plain language, and defend it when challenged.

What Makes This Role Worth Taking

  • Full ownership of finance across four entities and several brands, with no layer between you and the Head of Finance.
  • Direct exposure to the CEO and General Manager. Your analysis reaches them in the month you produce it, not a quarter later.
  • Genuine breadth. Accounting, FP&A, multi-currency, inventory, production financing and international structuring in one role.
  • A finance function being built rather than maintained. You will shape how it works.

jobs.excerpt: Salary: £45,000 – £55,000 DOE Location: Remote We’re working with a fast-growing DTC subscription brand in the health and wellness space to appoint a CRM Manager who can take ownership of its customer lifecycle strategy and execution.
jobs.description:
Salary: £45,000 – £55,000 DOE
Location: Remote

We’re working with a fast-growing DTC subscription brand in the health and wellness space to appoint a CRM Manager who can take ownership of its customer lifecycle strategy and execution.

With approximately 90% of revenue coming through subscriptions, CRM and retention are fundamental to the continued growth of the business.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable interrogating customer data and developing a retention strategy as they are building complex journeys in Klaviyo.

You won’t be inheriting a finished test plan. You’ll be expected to find the opportunities, form a point of view, build the solution and measure the impact.

The Role

You’ll own the CRM lifecycle end to end, initially as an individual contributor, with the opportunity to grow into a CRM or Retention Lead role as the programme develops.

The role will remain hands-on. You’ll continue to build and optimise alongside taking greater strategic ownership and, over time, potentially leading a team.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the full customer lifecycle in Klaviyo, including welcome and onboarding, product education, replenishment, pre-billing, failed payment, save and skip, and winback journeys

  • Analyse flow, customer and cohort performance to identify where revenue and margin are being lost

  • Build and implement retention strategies based on why customers are cancelling or skipping, rather than relying on blanket save journeys

  • Develop strategies to convert high-intent one-time customers into subscribers

  • Own CRM activity across email, SMS and WhatsApp

  • Manage deliverability, database health and engagement

  • Develop and optimise loyalty programme mechanics, including earn, burn, tiers and redemption journeys

  • Work closely with creative teams to brief and iterate CRM assets based on performance

  • Lead A/B testing across journeys and campaigns, prioritising tests based on commercial impact

  • Develop clear reporting around CRM performance and incremental contribution

How Success Will Be Measured

You’ll have clear commercial ownership, with success focused on:

  • Increasing the contribution margin generated during a customer's first three months, relative to their initial order value.

  • Increasing the proportion of active customers ordering in any given month, capturing the impact of cancellations, skips and changes in purchase frequency.

  • Growing the incremental revenue and margin generated through CRM flows.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone with genuine Klaviyo expertise, rather than someone who has simply used the platform to send campaigns.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Proven experience owning a CRM programme end to end

  • Deep, hands-on experience with Klaviyo, including complex conditional and branched journeys

  • A strong understanding of flow performance, attribution and incremental revenue

  • Experience working within a subscription-led business

  • Experience with Skio, Recharge or a similar subscription platform

  • A strong understanding of subscriber behaviour, churn and retention

  • A highly analytical approach, with the curiosity to investigate the data before being asked

  • The ability to turn insight into action and personally build and launch your recommendations

  • Strong strategic thinking and the ability to prioritise across multiple opportunities and projects

  • Experience with a loyalty platform would be a strong advantage

  • An independent, structured and fast-moving approach

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a growing DTC business at a point where CRM has a genuine opportunity to shape commercial performance, rather than simply support it.

You’ll have significant ownership from day one, with the opportunity to build the CRM function, develop the retention strategy and grow into a broader leadership position as the business scales.

Our client is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. They believe that a diverse team makes for a stronger business and are committed to ensuring their recruitment process is fair and accessible to everyone.

Please note: Due to the volume of applications, only candidates shortlisted for the next stage will be contacted. If you have not heard from us within two weeks of applying, unfortunately your application has not been successful on this occasion. We appreciate the time taken to apply and thank everyone for their interest.

jobs.excerpt: Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry.
jobs.description:
Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

We’re looking for a Solutions Architect who can bridge the gap between what our customers need to accomplish and how Vividly should be designed to support them.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding complex business processes, challenging the status quo, and turning customer requirements into scalable future-state solutions. You’ll work across business processes, accounting workflows, data, integrations, and Vividly configuration to ensure our customers are set up correctly from the beginning.

The Solutions Architect is a critical part of our customer onboarding experience. You’ll help preserve continuity from Sales through Implementation, ensure requirements are understood before teams begin building, and keep multiple implementation work streams aligned around one cohesive solution.

What You'll Achieve

As a Solutions Architect, you’ll become an expert in Vividly, CPG trade workflows, customer business processes, ERP ecosystems, and how our different solutions come together.

You’ll engage early in the customer journey to understand what was sold, why the customer purchased Vividly, and what outcomes they expect to achieve. Following Closed Won, you’ll lead Solution Alignment to validate requirements, future-state workflows, technical dependencies, assumptions, and implementation scope before execution begins.

You’ll design solutions across areas such as Trade Promotion Management, Deduction Management, Cash Application, accruals, forecasting, revenue data, master data, file retrieval, and ERP integrations. You won't personally configure every workflow or build every integration. Instead, you'll create the solution blueprint that enables Implementation, Integrations, Managed Services, and Customer Success to execute successfully.

Throughout onboarding, you’ll remain the owner of solution integrity, helping resolve ambiguity, evaluate changes, and ensure individual work streams don't make decisions that compromise the overall customer solution.

Beyond individual implementations, you’ll identify recurring patterns, process gaps, and opportunities to standardize how Vividly designs and delivers solutions so that onboarding becomes increasingly faster, more predictable, and scalable.

In This Role, You'll Help The Team:

  • Review pre-sales discovery, commitments, requirements, and proposed solutions to ensure continuity from Sales into onboarding.
  • Lead customer Solution Alignment sessions to validate business objectives, requirements, workflows, dependencies, assumptions, and success criteria.
  • Understand customers' current-state processes and design scalable future-state workflows using Vividly.
  • Translate customer requirements into clear solution designs that Implementation, Integrations, Managed Services, and Customer Success can execute against.
  • Design solutions across trade planning, deductions, Cash Application, accruals, forecasting, reporting, pricing, customer/product hierarchies, revenue, and related workflows.
  • Understand how Vividly fits within the customer's broader ecosystem, including ERP systems, banks, retailer/distributor data, syndicated data, and other business systems.
  • Partner with Integration Solutions Engineering to define integration requirements, data flows, system dependencies, cadence, and technical constraints.
  • Partner with Managed Services to define document retrieval, deduction, and operational requirements.
  • Define clear requirements and acceptance criteria before configuration or development begins.
  • Identify potential implementation risks, dependencies, scope gaps, and product limitations early enough to prevent downstream rework.
  • Maintain clear documentation of solution decisions, workflows, requirements, assumptions, and dependencies.
  • Provide Implementation with an actionable blueprint for portal configuration and customer setup.
  • Remain engaged throughout onboarding to answer design questions and resolve ambiguity without taking over day-to-day project management.
  • Evaluate new requirements discovered during implementation and determine whether they represent configuration changes, integration requirements, product gaps, or changes in scope.
  • Support change-order and re-scoping conversations when customer requirements materially differ from the approved solution.
  • Participate in critical implementation checkpoints, design reviews, UAT, and go-live readiness when solution validation is required.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring customer requirements, product gaps, and opportunities to improve Vividly's capabilities.
  • Help establish reusable solution patterns, implementation standards, discovery frameworks, and best practices that reduce customization and accelerate onboarding.
  • Ensure critical solution context transfers cleanly to Customer Success so customers don't lose continuity after go-live.

You May Be A Good Fit For The Role If You:

  • Have 4+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Solutions Consulting, Implementation Consulting, Business Systems, ERP consulting, CPG technology, or a similar customer-facing role.
  • Have experience understanding complex business processes and translating them into scalable system or workflow designs.
  • Can move comfortably between business requirements and technical conversations without needing to personally engineer every solution.
  • Understand financial or operational workflows such as deductions, accounts receivable, accruals, revenue, forecasting, reconciliation, or accounting.
  • Have experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Sage, QuickBooks, or similar platforms.
  • Understand integration concepts including APIs, data flows, field mappings, master data, authentication, and system dependencies.
  • Can facilitate complex conversations involving Accounting, Finance, Sales, Operations, IT, and executive stakeholders.
  • Are comfortable challenging existing processes and recommending a better future-state approach rather than simply recreating what a customer does today.
  • Can distinguish between a business requirement, configuration requirement, integration requirement, product gap, and scope change.
  • Have strong documentation skills and can turn ambiguous conversations into clear requirements and decisions.
  • Are comfortable working directly with customers and establishing credibility as a trusted advisor.
  • Can manage ambiguity, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and know when additional expertise is required.
  • Learn quickly and can develop expertise across new products, workflows, ERP systems, and customer use cases.
  • Are highly organized and capable of maintaining context across multiple complex customer implementations.
  • Are comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment where processes are evolving and you'll help improve them.
  • Have strong judgment, executive presence, and communication skills.
  • Want to have a foundational impact on how a growing SaaS organization delivers complex customer solutions.

Experience with CPG, Trade Promotion Management, Deduction Management, Cash Application, Sales Finance, or CPG accounting is strongly preferred, but we would also consider candidates with strong solution architecture experience in adjacent financial or operational SaaS environments who demonstrate the ability to learn the industry quickly.

How You'll Work

You’ll work closely with Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Integrations, Managed Services, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering.

Our operating model is built around a simple principle: Solutions Engineering determines how Vividly can solve the customer's problem. Solution Architecture defines how that solution should operate. Our delivery teams make it happen.

You'll typically enter the customer journey during late-stage solutioning or immediately following Closed Won. Your first responsibility is to establish Solution Alignment, ensuring the customer's objectives, workflows, scope, requirements, and technical dependencies are understood before teams begin execution.

From there:

Implementation owns the project plan, customer coordination, configuration, milestones, and overall execution.

Integration Solutions Engineering determines how systems connect and owns the technical integration workstream.

Managed Services establishes and operates applicable retrieval and managed workflows.

Customer Success owns adoption, value realization, and the long-term customer relationship.

You own the integrity of the solution across those workstreams.

There will naturally be overlap. We expect Solutions Architects to understand enough about configuration, integrations, accounting, and customer operations to make informed recommendations and identify when something isn't working. At the same time, you won't be expected to personally manage every project task, configure every customer environment, or build every integration.

The goal is to give customers one cohesive solution rather than a collection of disconnected workstreams, while giving our delivery teams the clarity they need to execute quickly and confidently.

What Success Looks Like

You'll know you're succeeding when:

  • Customers don't have to restart discovery after Closed Won.
  • Solution Alignment identifies material requirements and risks before configuration or integration work begins.
  • Delivery teams understand exactly what they're building and why.
  • Fewer requirements are discovered late in implementation.
  • Rework and mid-implementation scope changes decrease.
  • Portal, Integration, and Managed Services workstreams remain aligned to one solution.
  • Customers are guided toward scalable Vividly best practices rather than unnecessarily recreating legacy processes.
  • Implementation timelines become shorter and more predictable.
  • Customer Success receives clear context on the solution, customer objectives, and operating model at handoff.
  • Customers reach value faster because Vividly was designed correctly from the beginning.

Why Choose Vividly?

A modern, remote-first workplace

We are committed to succeeding as a fully remote team, empowering you with the flexibility to thrive, no commute required. Every Vividly team member receives a stipend upon hire to help create a comfortable, productive home office.

Vividly days off & flexible PTO

For most USA holidays that fall on a Monday or Friday, we turn it into a 4 day weekend! Vividly also offers Flexible Time Off (and we really mean it) to help prevent burn out and fuel creativity.

Competitive Benefits

  • Healthcare, Dental and Vision - We cover 100% of your monthly premiums and 50% of all dependents
  • 401(k) - With a 3% employer contribution
  • Weekly $20 Sharebite Meal Stipend - For every meal you purchase, they donate a meal through Feeding America!
  • Monthly $50 Wellness Reimbursement
  • Monthly $200 Remote Work Stipend

Commitment to our values - The Vividly Code

  • Kind Ambition -We push boundaries with empathy and integrity
  • Keep It Real - We are transparent, honest, and authentic
  • Customer Love - We act as trusted advisors to our customers
  • Own It - We take responsibility and drive outcomes
  • Urgency Wins - We move quickly and focus on impact
  • Pull Together - We collaborate to win as a team

Please note: Vividly will never request sensitive information such as your social security number, bank account information, or other non-publicly available information during the application and interview process. If an applicant is extended an offer of employment, such sensitive information will be requested at that time during the onboarding process. Vividly will never ask you to receive and ship packages or goods as part of the interview. Other practices to be on alert for:

  • Contact initiated via unsolicited text message or cold call. Vividly does not follow up with candidates through instant messaging applications.
  • Our Talent Acquisition team only corresponds from email addresses with the domain ‘@govividly.com’. If a generic email ID ending with Gmail/Yahoo or other domain is used while receiving a job offer or interview call, there is a likelihood of a scammer.
  • While some of our jobs can be found on third party job sites, all of our current job opportunities and descriptions are posted on Vividly’s Careers page, or our official LinkedIn Company Page

The U.S. Federal Trade Commission has published helpful articles to help individuals learn more about protecting themselves from recruiting scams and financial fraud. If you believe you were a victim of such a scam, you may contact your local law enforcement agencies. Vividly is not responsible for any claims, liability, losses, damages, or expenses resulting from scammers or impersonators.

Since 2013, THE/STUDIO has been building the definitive operating system for product creation. We are combining modern SaaS technology with custom manufacturing to make producing physical goods as seamless, fast, and scalable as launching software.

We operate two core platforms: Customize Now (our best-in-class, on-demand manufacturing platform) and Source Anything(our new SaaS product that enables customers to seamlessly work with global factories beyond our own network).

We are a profitable, previously Silicon Valley-backed, fully remote company, and we are not just looking to improve manufacturing, we are looking for a visionary operator to help us truly revolutionize the global supply chain.

💻 The Opportunity

We are seeking an elite, systems-thinking Head of Operations. You will sit at the absolute intersection of bits and atoms, directly overseeing Manufacturing, our Global Factory Network, Customer Service, and Customer Success.

We don't need a traditional manager; we need an operational architect. You will treat operations like an engineering problem, using leverage, AI, and automation to scale throughput. If you are

  • Be the Cross-Functional Engine:Act as the ultimate enabler for the business. You will work in lockstep with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to build workflows that allow every department to move faster and execute flawlessly.

  • Leverage Data & AI:We need someone "super cracked" at using modern tools. You will evaluate, implement, and leverage AI, automation, and deep data analytics to drive operational efficiencies and track meaningful KPIs across all your departments.

  • Architect the Customer Experience:Map, break down, and rebuild the entire user journey from the first quote to final delivery. You will obsess over UX, ensuring that the customer is the absolute hero of their manufacturing journey.

  • Lead Global Teams:Build, mentor, and scale high-performing, distributed teams across manufacturing, customer service, and success, creating a culture of excellence and high-velocity output.

  • The Tech-Enabled Operator:You have built your career at the intersection of complex physical operations (supply chain, manufacturing, or logistics) and modern technology/SaaS.

  • A Systems Thinker:You don't just throw bodies at a problem. You solve bottlenecks with better software, better data, and better processes.

  • Highly Analytical:You are incredibly fluent with data. You know how to extract insights, define complex KPIs, and use those metrics to drive organizational change.

  • A Cross-Functional Powerhouse:You know how to speak the language of engineers, marketers, and factory managers, bringing diverse teams together to execute a unified vision.

💡 The Profile We’re Looking For (Our Core Pillars)

Our CEO defines our top performers by three distinct traits. If this describes how you operate, you will thrive here:

  1. Raw Intelligence & Problem-Solving: High processing power, business acumen, and logical reasoning. You can think on your feet, connect complex ideas, and break down ambiguous problems quickly.

About Elm AI

At Elm AI, we’re rebuilding supplier operations for an agent-first world.

We believe the next generation of enterprise software will not be passive systems of record. It will be made up of agents that stay live inside important workflows: understanding context, coordinating action, and keeping critical work moving across teams, suppliers, documents, systems, and decisions.

That is what Elm AI is building.

Our agents operate across responsible sourcing and supplier operations, helping companies manage audit review, corrective actions, supplier follow-through, remediation, scorecards, supplier portals, document review, and broader operational workflows that still run on spreadsheets, email, and manual coordination.

Elm is already live with major consumer brands, supporting supplier programs that span thousands of factories and some of the most operationally complex supply chains in the world.

Our ambition is much larger: to build the agent-first operating layer for how global supplier work gets done.

The Role

We’re hiring a Strategic Customer Success Manager to own high-value customer relationships and help customers deploy AI into real supply chain workflows.

This is not a traditional “check-in and renewal” customer success role.

You’ll work closely with sourcing, supply chain, responsible sourcing, compliance, and operations teams to understand how work actually gets done today: the SOPs, spreadsheets, handoffs, follow-ups, exceptions, dashboards, supplier communications, and recurring manual processes that keep supplier operations moving.

Then you’ll help turn those workflows into AI-powered systems that create measurable business value.

You’ll be part customer partner, part operator, part product thinker, and part solutions strategist. You should be comfortable sitting with a customer, unpacking a messy process, identifying where AI can create ROI, and working closely with our product and engineering team to bring that solution to life.

The ideal person is excited by startups, AI, enterprise software, and the practical reality of deploying technology into complex operational environments.

What You’ll Do

  • Own strategic customer relationships from onboarding through adoption, expansion, and renewal
  • Lead customers through deployment of Elm’s AI workflows across responsible sourcing and broader supplier operations
  • Map customer workflows, SOPs, pain points, data sources, and manual processes
  • Identify high-ROI opportunities where AI can reduce manual work, improve speed, increase visibility, or help teams do more with less
  • Translate customer needs into clear product, workflow, and implementation requirements
  • Partner closely with engineering and product to shape deployments and improve the platform
  • Drive adoption across customer teams, including operators, program managers, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Build repeatable playbooks for onboarding, workflow discovery, rollout, value tracking, and expansion
  • Turn customer data, usage patterns, and operational context into clear recommendations
  • Help customers understand what AI can realistically do inside their supply chain operations
  • Surface expansion opportunities by understanding the broader operational problems customers are trying to solve
  • Help shape Elm’s customer success motion as we scale

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is energized by customers, technology, and ambiguity.

You may have a background in customer success, consulting, implementation, solutions, product, operations, or a similarly customer-facing role. What matters most is that you can understand complex workflows, earn trust with customers, and help turn messy operational problems into clear, high-value solutions.

You might be a strong fit if you have:

  • 3–7 years of experience in customer success, consulting, implementation, solutions, product, operations, or a related role
  • Experience working with technical or enterprise software products
  • Strong interest in AI and how it changes business operations
  • Comfort working with customers to map workflows, diagnose problems, and define success metrics
  • Ability to speak with both operators and executives
  • Strong program management instincts and excellent follow-through
  • Data fluency: you can interpret dashboards, spot patterns, and translate findings into recommendations
  • A high degree of ownership and comfort operating without perfect structure

- Clear written and verbal communication

  • Curiosity about supply chains, sourcing, manufacturing, compliance, logistics, procurement, or supplier operations

Bonus Points

Not required, but helpful:

  • Experience in supply chain, sourcing, procurement, logistics, manufacturing, ESG, responsible sourcing, or compliance

- Experience at an early-stage startup

  • Experience in solutions engineering, implementation, or forward-deployed customer work
  • Comfort with technical concepts such as APIs, data models, workflows, integrations, or AI agents
  • Experience working with global teams across the U.S., Europe, and Asia
  • Experience selling, deploying, or supporting AI-native products

The Kind of Person Who Tends to Thrive at Elm AI

The people who thrive here are usually curious, high-agency, and a little averse to inefficient processes.

They like getting close to the customer. They ask good questions. They want to understand the actual work behind the process: who does it, why it exists, where it breaks, what it costs, and what would happen if it worked 10x better.

They are excited by AI, but they are not hand-wavy about it. They care about practical outcomes: hours saved, processes accelerated, exceptions resolved, decisions improved, and teams able to do more with less.

They don’t need a perfect playbook before moving. They help create the playbook.

They are comfortable in the messy middle between customer conversations, product strategy, implementation details, and business value. They can zoom out to an executive narrative and zoom in to a spreadsheet, SOP, or workflow diagram.

They care deeply about customers, but they also care about building a company that can scale.

Why This Role

- High ownership from day one

  • Direct exposure to founders, customers, product, and strategy
  • The chance to help define a new category of AI-native supply chain software
  • Work with major global brands on real operational problems
  • A role that can grow into customer success, solutions, implementation, or go-to-market leadership
  • Several years of runway, backed by top investors
  • A team that is ambitious, technical, thoughtful, and moving quickly

Working Style & Time Overlap

This role is remote, but requires meaningful overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

You should be comfortable working primarily in EST hours, with flexibility to accommodate customers across Europe and Asia when needed.

Perks & Support

- Competitive compensation

  • High-trust, high-ownership work environment

- Learning and development budget

- Generous AI and tooling budget

  • Personal spend card for experimentation, software, education, or anything that helps you learn and work better
  • A culture that supports sustainable work, both in how we operate and how we build the business

jobs.excerpt: QA Engineer, Web and MobileIndividual contributor.
jobs.description:
QA Engineer, Web and Mobile

Individual contributor. Reports to the Director of QA. No direct reports.

Salary: €5000 per month

Location: Poland (Fully Remote)

The role

You test the web application, frontend and backend, and the mobile applications on iOS and Android. That is the surface of the job.

Underneath it, the point of this role is to understand how the product actually works: the data flow, the API contracts, the places where two systems meet and produce behaviour nobody specified. That understanding is what lets you improve a specification before code is written, catch the gap nobody else noticed, and give Support, Sales, Product and Engineering an answer they can rely on.

We are looking for extreme ownership, the person who picks up the task nobody else wants because it needs doing and they can see why it matters.

What you will do

Test the product properly. Web end to end, frontend behaviour and backend responses, not just the UI layer. Mobile on iOS and Android against an agreed device and OS matrix, with a real understanding of platform conventions and where the two diverge.

Own our automated coverage on web. Extend and maintain the Playwright suite and write new tests for the features you take through. Investigate failures and fix flakiness rather than muting it, and be honest about what automation is and is not covering.

Verify at the API and data layer. Requests, responses, payloads, status codes, backward compatibility for older clients. Query the database directly to confirm what actually happened, rather than what the screen says happened.

Prevent bugs, not just report them. Pressure-test specifications with Product, Design and engineers before development starts: happy paths, edge cases, error states, empty states. Point out the platform that was forgotten, the API version that will break, the migration nobody planned. Asking the awkward question early is part of the job.

Debug to root cause. "It doesn't work" is not a bug report. Narrow down where it breaks and what the system is actually doing, and hand the developer something they can act on.

Support the wider business. Reproduce and triage customer issues that reach engineering, and keep test plans and known-issue lists current so release decisions rest on evidence.

Use AI every day. Reduce your own repetitive work with it, build reusable AI skills the wider team can benefit from, make small fixes in the code yourself where that is reasonable, and bring ideas about where AI can raise our quality bar.

What we are looking for

  • Three to five years of hands-on testing of web applications, with a demonstrated ability to find root causes rather than symptoms.

  • Practical test automation experience. You have written and maintained UI or API tests in Playwright, or a comparable framework, and can work in a test codebase without hand-holding.

  • You can read and reason about API contracts and payloads, query a database in SQL to verify data, and are comfortable with traffic and API inspection tooling, or quick to pick it up.

  • Mobile testing in practice. You can tell a platform convention apart from a defect, and reason about the device and OS coverage a given change actually needs.

  • Proven collaboration with Design and Product. You have been in the room during specification work and made it better without owning it, with examples you can talk us through.

  • Excellent written and spoken communication, in Polish and English, both at C2 or native level.

Nice to have

  • Testing in a regulated or healthcare-adjacent domain.

  • Device farms or cloud device labs, such as BrowserStack or Firebase Test Lab.

  • Triaging from crash and error monitoring, such as Sentry or Crashlytics.

  • Accessibility testing (WCAG).

jobs.description:
About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that helps organizations understand, engage, and retain customers at scale.

Unlike traditional platforms that stop at reporting and dashboards, Lucidya combines proprietary AI, deep language understanding, and autonomous workflows to help organizations move from insight to action. Our technology is built in-house and trained on millions of multilingual customer conversations, enabling brands across the MENA region to make better decisions, deliver better experiences, and build stronger customer relationships.

As AI reshapes how businesses operate, we're building products that make customer understanding faster, more accurate, and more actionable than ever before.

Why This Role Matters

Most organizations today are overwhelmed with customer data.

Conversations are happening across social media, surveys, reviews, support tickets, messaging channels, and countless other touchpoints. The challenge isn't collecting the data anymore. It's knowing what matters and what to do next.

The Monitoring & Research domain sits at the center of that challenge.

This is where customers come to understand public perception, identify emerging trends, monitor competitors, measure customer sentiment, and uncover the insights that drive business decisions. It is one of the most strategically important parts of Lucidya's platform and one of the biggest opportunities for innovation as AI transforms how research and customer intelligence are done.

As Senior Product Manager, you'll be responsible for shaping how thousands of users discover, trust, and act on insights generated from millions of customer conversations.

You'll be joining a team that values ownership over hierarchy, customer outcomes over feature output, and learning over certainty. We move quickly, challenge assumptions, and expect product leaders to bring strong opinions while remaining open to changing their minds when the evidence says otherwise.

If you're excited by complex customer problems, AI-powered products, and the opportunity to define the future of customer intelligence in a region where world-class solutions are still emerging, this role will give you significant room to make an impact.

What You'll Do

Own the future of Monitoring & Research at Lucidya

You'll define the vision, strategy, and roadmap across three key product areas:

  • Social Listening
  • Managed Channels Analytics
  • Voice of Customer (VoC)

Your responsibility isn't simply delivering features. It's ensuring customers can confidently answer critical business questions about their customers, markets, competitors, and brand performance.

Turn customer signals into decisions

You'll spend significant time understanding how customers currently make decisions, where they struggle to find trustworthy insights, and what prevents them from taking action.

You'll use those learnings to build products that help customers move beyond reporting and toward clear recommendations, meaningful insights, and measurable business outcomes.

Lead discovery before delivery

You'll challenge assumptions, validate problems, and ensure we're solving issues that matter before resources are committed.

You'll regularly engage customers, prospects, Customer Success teams, and internal stakeholders to uncover opportunities and validate product direction.

Success in this role means building the right thing, not simply building things quickly.

Raise the quality bar for AI-powered insights

As AI becomes increasingly central to our platform, you'll help define what "trustworthy AI" means in practice.

You'll work closely with AI, Data, Design, and Engineering teams to improve:

  • Insight accuracy
  • Sentiment quality
  • Explainability
  • Relevance
  • Customer trust

You'll constantly ask whether an insight is genuinely useful, not just technically impressive.

Make difficult prioritization decisions

Not every good idea belongs on the roadmap.

You'll evaluate opportunities using customer feedback, product data, market insights, commercial priorities, and strategic impact.

You'll make trade-offs transparently and help the organization understand why certain bets are worth making while others are not.

Drive product adoption and business impact

You'll closely monitor customer behavior, adoption patterns, retention drivers, churn signals, and feedback loops.

You'll use those insights to continuously improve the product and ensure the work being delivered creates measurable value for both customers and the business.

Be a leader beyond product

You'll collaborate across Engineering, Design, AI, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Leadership teams.

You'll help create alignment, provide clarity during ambiguity, and contribute to building a culture where teams are empowered to solve problems rather than simply execute requirements.

Requirements

Who You Are

You have strong product fundamentals

You have at least 5 years of product management experience, ideally within B2B SaaS environments.

You know how to take a problem from discovery through validation, delivery, measurement, and iteration.

You understand that product management is ultimately about creating customer and business value, not managing backlogs.

You simplify complexity

You're comfortable working with large datasets, analytics platforms, AI-powered products, or technically complex systems.

More importantly, you know how to transform complexity into experiences that feel intuitive and useful to customers.

Are you a seasoned ServiceNow expert ready to architect and deliver transformative enterprise solutions? Job Summary

As a Sr ServiceNow Technical Consultant, you will serve as a subject matter expert and technical leader responsible for designing, developing, and delivering enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions. You will collaborate closely with clients and internal teams to translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable platform configurations across multiple ServiceNow modules.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end design and development of ServiceNow solutions spanning ITSM, Customer Service Management (CSM), Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD), CRM, and Data Foundations modules.

Required Qualifications

  • Proficiency in ServiceNow scripting languages including JavaScript, GlideScript, and Jelly.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing REST and SOAP-based integrations with third-party systems.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL processes and how they map to ServiceNow platform capabilities.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to present technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • ServiceNow Platform: ITSM, CSM, HRSD, CRM, Data Foundations, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub
  • Scripting: JavaScript, GlideScript, AngularJS, HTML, CSS
  • Integration: REST APIs, SOAP, MID Server, Import Sets, Transform Maps
  • Tools: ServiceNow Studio, Update Sets, ATF (Automated Test Framework)
  • Methodologies: ITIL, Agile/Scrum, DevOps fundamentals

You will lead the migration from legacy reporting and metric tooling into a governed Microsoft Fabric platform, keep business-critical BI and semantic models reliable, improve data pipeline stability and monitoring, support CRM data integration, apply AI and automation to improve data engineering, reporting and analytics, and provide senior technical leadership for data engineering delivery.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead hands-on Microsoft Fabric architecture across lakehouse, warehouse, notebooks, semantic models, Git-backed delivery and production governance.
  • Drive migration from legacy reporting and metric tooling into a governed Fabric semantic layer, including parity testing, stakeholder sign-off and safe decommissioning.
