  • Build automated reporting and insight-generation capabilities that reduce manual analysis and improve decision speed.

Must-have requirements

  • 6+ years in modern data warehousing, analytics engineering or data platform engineering, ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, fintech, payments, e-commerce or multi-region B2B2C environment.
  • Strong Microsoft Fabric capability, or deep Azure Synapse / Databricks experience with clear ability to specialise quickly in Fabric.
  • Expert SQL/T-SQL plus strong Python or PySpark, with a track record of building maintainable ELT/ETL pipelines and analytical data models.
  • Strong Power BI and DAX experience, including semantic modelling, incremental refresh, performance tuning, model governance and capacity/cost awareness.
  • Experience leading legacy-to-modern data platform migrations, including metric parity, stakeholder validation, change control and safe decommissioning.
  • Experience operating production data systems: monitoring, alert design, incident triage, root-cause analysis, data-quality checks, lineage and runbooks.
  • Comfortable with Git-based data engineering workflows, pull requests, release discipline and standards for notebooks, pipelines and semantic model changes.
  • Practical experience using AI or automation to improve data engineering, reporting, documentation, testing, monitoring, migration or developer productivity.

Strong-to-have experience

  • Payments, settlement, reconciliation, fees, chargebacks, merchant reporting or finance-domain data.
  • CRM-side data flows and reverse-ETL patterns, especially HubSpot, Salesforce, Zendesk or similar platforms.
  • M&A or acquired-company data integrations: schema discovery, file/API ingestion, data profiling, master-data mapping, migration QA and reporting continuity.
  • NoSQL-to-analytics modelling, including change-feed patterns from operational databases into lakehouse or warehouse structures.
  • GA4, BigQuery export, Google Ads / SEM feeds, Segment or other event and marketing analytics sources.
  • Experience with Azure OpenAI, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, prompt/version management or AI-assisted development workflows.
  • Experience building AI-generated reporting, natural-language analytics, business copilots, automated insight generation or merchant/customer intelligence tools.
  • Responsible AI and governance experience, including RBAC, PII handling, audit logs, human approval flows, explainability and GDPR-conscious design.

Candidate signals to prioritise in interview

  • Has owned a production data platform, not only built dashboards or one-off analytics projects.
  • Can explain how they governed metrics and prevented conflicting definitions across teams.
  • Has migrated or consolidated legacy reporting into a modern semantic layer without breaking business trust.

  • Communicates clearly with executives, product teams, analysts and engineers; can say “no” or “not yet” with evidence.
  • Is hands-on enough to debug pipelines and models, while senior enough to set standards and mentor others.

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.
Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

This role combines client leadership, commercial ownership, and account growth, ensuring clients see measurable value while identifying opportunities to deepen our partnerships.

  • Maintain visibility of account health, pipeline, revenue, profitability, client satisfaction, and commercial risks.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Strong experience in Account Management, Client Services, Customer Success, or Strategic Account Management.
  • Proven experience managing enterprise or strategic client relationships and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience across renewals, upsells, forecasting, and account profitability.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-workstream client programmes in an agency, consultancy, MarTech, SaaS, or technology environment.

  • Comfortable translating technical and delivery topics into clear business outcomes and ROI.

Desirable

  • Experience selling Braze, Snowflake, Hightouch, Databricks, CDPs, or related Martech and data solutions
  • Experience selling into QSR, Retail, Hospitality, Financial Services, or Enterprise Digital Transformation programmes
  • Experience working within partner-led sales motions and co-selling with technology vendors
  • Existing network of enterprise buyers within the US market
  • Familiarity with modern customer engagement, loyalty, and composable data architectures

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else
• A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win
• A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond
• Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best
• Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter
• Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work
Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment
ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)

jobs.excerpt: Ready to power the future of clean energy?  Join SLR as a Senior Electrical Engineer and lead cutting-edge solar and energy storage projects that shape sustainable communities across North America and the Caribbean.
jobs.description:
Ready to power the future of clean energy? Join SLR as a Senior Electrical Engineer and lead cutting-edge solar and energy storage projects that shape sustainable communities across North America and the Caribbean. If you thrive on technical challenges, collaboration, and making a real impact, this is your opportunity to drive innovation where it matters most.

SLR is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to lead engineering activities such as design, analysis, simulation, commissioning, and technical advisory for community distributed generation (CDG), utility-scale solar, and energy storage projects. The projects may be located throughout North America and the Caribbean. The primary focus for this role will be on projects in NYISO, PJM and MISO RTO territories. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, enjoys technical challenges, and thrives in a highly collaborative and dynamic environment.

We are SLR Consulting (Americas), a 1500+ team of advisory, environmental, engineering, and regulatory professionals across Canada, the United States, and LATAM. We deliver services through the integration of over 30 disciplines to help our clients address some of their most complex challenges around sustainability. We are Making Sustainability Happen.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee and review all aspects of solar PV and battery energy storage system design, from small rooftop to large utility-scale ground mount projects, ensuring technical accuracy, regulatory compliance, and adherence to SLR and industry standards
    • Mentor Engineering team members, review team deliverables for technical quality and consistency; set and uphold drawing architecture standards and best practices across the team
    • Provide technical support to internal and external stakeholders across all phases of design, interconnection, and construction
    • Oversee day-to-day project execution; assign tasks, manage workflows, track milestones, and prepare status reports for senior management.
    • Interface with clients, vendors, utilities, and local authorities to align project requirements and ensure deliverables are met on time and within budget
    • Conduct detailed energy production simulations and modeling for solar PV and storage systems using software tools such as MS Excel, PVSyst, and Helioscope
    • Perform power system studies including underground ampacity, load flow, protective coordination, short-circuit, grounding, and arc flash analysis using ETAP
    • Prepare and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including feasibility studies, scopes of work, commissioning reports, technical specifications, and RFP responses
    • Assist Project Leads in prioritizing engineering tasks, managing team resources, and fulfilling administrative duties as needed
    • Ensure project designs comply with relevant codes and standards (e.g., NEC, CEC, IEEE, building and fire code).
    • Conduct on-site field visits to support design verification, construction, and commissioning activities
    • Recommend and implement continuous improvements in design practices, project execution processes, and product performance
    • Support business development efforts by providing technical input on proposals, estimating engineering scope, and advising on system configuration
    • Collaborate with external engineering consultants and partners to ensure quality assurance and jurisdictional compliance

Working @ SLR

With us, there is no doubt you’ll grow your subject-matter expertise and industry knowledge. We care about investing in our employees for the long-run, and if you ask our team, they’ll tell you that’s just one of the many benefits of working here. We want to be a place where you can experience career growth and satisfaction for many years.

Here’s what else you’ll enjoy as part of our team:

  • Competitive total compensation package including medical, dental, orthodontia, vision, FSA/HSA, generous PTO accrual, 10 paid holidays, 401(k) retirement account with company matching program, company paid life insurance, short and long term disability insurance, and employee assistance program
    • The salary range for this position is $200,000 - $225,000. Final agreed upon compensation will be commensurate with individual education, professional designation, experience, internal parity, and location
    • Full-time, permanent role with opportunities for professional growth and advancement

Qualifications

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in power systems engineering with solar and battery storage experience
  • Licensed Professional Engineer in New York or a state with reciprocity
    • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Systems Engineering
    • Proficient with AutoCAD, Microsoft Office, and power system analysis tools (e.g., ETAP, SKM, PSCAD)
    • Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC)
    • Familiarity with relevant standards such as IEEE 1547, CSA 22.2 No. 107.1, UL 1741, and NFPA 855 is an asset
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Legally authorized to work in U.S.

  • Willingness to travel to project sites

This job posting is for an existing vacancy. Artificial intelligence is not being used to screen, assess, or select applicants.

jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

About Altera

Altera is a global leader in FPGA and programmable logic solutions, enabling innovation in data center, communications, automotive, aerospace, and industrial markets. As we expand manufacturing capabilities for next-generation programmable devices, we are strengthening our OSAT engineering organization to deliver world-class backend manufacturing performance.

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior OSAT Engineer to drive outsourced assembly and test engineering activities across Altera’s global supplier network. You will lead NPI readiness, yield optimization, cost improvements, and qualification activity for packaging and test flows supporting Altera’s FPGA/SoC product lineup. This role requires strong semiconductor backend engineering experience, hands-on problem solving, and the ability to collaborate closely with OSAT partners and cross-functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead technical engagement with OSAT suppliers on assembly and test process development, yield ramp, quality improvement, and volume manufacturing readiness.

  • Drive new product introduction (NPI) from engineering builds through production release, ensuring OSAT capability meetselectrical/thermal/mechanicalrequirements for FPGA and SoC products.

  • Optimize packaging and test architectures for performance, cost, and reliability: advance packaging, flip-chip BGA, high-pin-count packages, substrate technologies, wafer-level solutions, burn-in/FT coverage.

  • Monitor and improve manufacturing performance using data-driven analysis; identify systemic issues and lead root cause / corrective actions.

  • Partner with Test Engineering, Package Design, Product Engineering, DFM, and Quality teams on process optimization, failure analysis, and manufacturability improvements.

  • Implement and maintain process control systems, SPC methodologies, automation improvements, and lean manufacturing principles at OSAT.

  • Support cost reduction initiatives including BOM optimization, process simplification, and cycle time improvements.

  • Track supplier performance metrics (yield, DPPM, cost, cycle time, OEE) and provide updates with risk assessments and mitigation plans.

  • Lead or support reliability testing and package qualification activities aligned to industry standards (JEDEC, IPC, AEC-Q).

  • Maintain strong technical relationship and communication cadence with OSAT partners to ensure transparency, collaboration, and escalation management.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.

  • 10+ years of semiconductor assembly, packaging, or test engineering experience.

  • Hands-on experience with OSAT manufacturing environments, including wafer finishing, substrate attach, interconnect packaging, test, and burn-in.

  • Strong technical understanding of backend manufacturing flows: flip-chip, wire bond, underfill, molding, final test, reliability stress and analysis.

  • Proven ability to analyze yield, reliability, and cost data to drive engineering decisions and improvements.

  • Demonstrated success working with international suppliers and cross-functional teams.

  • Strong statistical analysis, written and verbal communication skills, including technical reporting and supplier engagement.

​Preferred Qualifications

  • FPGA, ASIC, or SoC backend experience, particularly high-pin-count or high-power devices.

  • Experience in automotive or high-reliability product qualifications (AEC-Q / ISO standards).

  • Familiarity with advanced packaging: 2.5D/3D, fan-out WLP, heterogeneous integration.

  • Knowledge of supply chain risk mitigation, dual sourcing, and volume scaling strategies.

  • Experience with automation, traceability systems, and smartfactory/manufacturinganalytics.

jobs.description:
Kim jesteśmy?

Cześć, nazywamy się Bee Talents i od 2015 roku zajmujemy się budowaniem zespołów w branży IT na całym świecie. Dziś zapraszamy Cię do procesu rekrutacyjnego dla Naturaily.

Naturaily to butikowy software house, który buduje aplikacje webowe i rozwiązania e-commerce dla klientów z USA, Wielkiej Brytanii i Skandynawii. Na pokładzie jest około 25-30 osób, pracujących w 100% zdalnie, a równolegle prowadzonych jest zwykle 8-9 projektów klienckich - od nowych wdrożeń po długofalowe współprace. Firma jest w trakcie realnej transformacji: od klasycznego AI-supported developmentu w stronę agentic SDLC - pierwszy komercyjny projekt zrealizowany w pełni w trybie agentowym jest już za nimi, a wnioski z niego właśnie przekładają się na sposób pracy całej organizacji. To mała firma bez korporacyjnych warstw, w której szeroki zakres odpowiedzialności i realny wpływ na kierunek techniczny są standardem, a nie obietnicą.

Warunki współpracy:

    Oferowane stanowisko: Engineering Manager / Head of Engineering

    Wynagrodzenie: 25-30 000 PLN netto

    Rodzaj umowy: B2B

    Wymiar pracy: pełen etat
    Tryb pracy: 100% remote
    Lokalizacja biura: zespół integruje się najcześciej we Wrocławiu
    Język pracy: angielski (polski mile widziany, ale niewymagany)

Główne wyzwanie dla Ciebie jako Engineering Manager:

    Odpowiedzialność za engineering w całym portfelu równolegle prowadzonych projektów klienckich oraz poprowadzenie firmy przez przejście na agentic SDLC: mniejsze pody (często jeden inżynier plus agenci), spec-driven development i deterministyczna weryfikacja jako domyślny sposób pracy, a nie pojedyncze eksperymenty.

Codzienne zadania:

    Prowadzenie inżynierów w projektach

    • Wspierasz zespoły w bieżących projektach: pomagasz rozwiązać to, co je blokuje, i jesteś partnerem do rozmowy przy trudniejszych decyzjach architektonicznych.
    • Odpowiadasz za jakość techniczną w całym portfelu projektów i wychwytujesz ryzyka wcześniej, niż zauważy je klient.
    • Rozwijasz inżynierów i tech leadów: ustalasz standard dobrej pracy inżynierskiej i pomagasz ludziom do niego dochodzić.
    • Kwestionujesz rozwiązania, kiedy widzisz, że da się prościej - bez inwestowania czasu tam, gdzie się to nie zwróci.

      • Współpraca z klientami i biznesem

      • Jesteś technicznym partnerem Key Account Managerów i Project Managerów w projektach, które prowadzą.
      • Opiniujesz proponowane rozwiązania, zanim zapadną decyzje, i przedstawiasz alternatywy razem z ich konsekwencjami.
      • Wspierasz pre-sales i scoping: oceniasz wykonalność, ryzyka i pracochłonność, także w domenach, których jeszcze nie znasz.
      • Prowadzisz warsztaty z klientami, doprecyzowujesz wymagania i tłumaczysz techniczne wybory osobom nietechnicznym.

        • Transformacja w stronę agentic SDLC

        • Wprowadzasz AI-native sposoby pracy do zespołów projektowych: agentic development, AI-supported code review i automatyzację testów jako codzienny standard, a nie pojedyncze eksperymenty.
        • Ustalasz standardy i warunki, które kod oraz efekty pracy agentów muszą spełnić, zanim trafią dalej.
        • Przekształcasz model pracy w stronę mniejszych podów (często jeden inżynier plus agenci) razem z warstwą review, która zapewnia bezpieczeństwo takiego modelu.
        • Dbasz o to, żeby zmiana utrzymała tempo po pierwszym etapie i na stałe weszła do sposobu pracy zespołów.
        • Pomagasz reszcie firmy zrozumieć, co ta zmiana oznacza poza samym kodem: dla estymacji, wycen i rozmów z klientami.
        • Mierzysz wpływ adopcji AI na tempo i jakość pracy.

Co będzie Ci potrzebne?

  • Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w prowadzeniu inżynierów jako Engineering Manager, Head of Engineering, Tech Lead lub team lead: z realnym doświadczeniem po stronie zarządzania ludźmi, a nie tylko kierunku technicznego.
  • Doświadczenie w agencji, software housie lub konsultingu z odpowiedzialnością za więcej niż jeden projekt naraz.
  • Rozumienie roli lidera jako osoby, która odblokowuje zespół, razem z gotowością do dawania inżynierom szczerego feedbacku.
  • Mocny osąd architektoniczny i systemowy oraz wiarygodność techniczna pozwalająca kwestionować rozwiązania.
  • Praktyczna biegłość w narzędziach agentic i AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot lub podobne) oraz realna chęć rozwijania takiego sposobu pracy w zespołach.
  • Rozumienie, jak psuje się kod generowany przez AI (quality drift, ryzyka bezpieczeństwa, prompt injection) i pomysł na to, jak układać wokół tego review.
  • Umiejętność rozmawiania o technicznych wyborach z osobami nietechnicznymi. Pełna samodzielność w kontakcie z klientem może rozwinąć się już na miejscu.
  • Biegły angielski.

Co dostaniesz w zamian?

  • 25 - 30 000 PLN netto
  • Współpracę B2B w pełnym wymiarze
  • Realny wpływ i szeroki scope: mała firma bez korporacyjnych warstw oznacza, że Twoje decyzje techniczne widać w całej organizacji, a nie w jednym backlogu.
  • Ścieżkę rozwoju do Head of Engineering i dalej
  • Miejsce w pierwszym rzędzie transformacji agentic: nie prezentacja o AI, tylko zakończony komercyjny projekt w trybie agentowym i decyzja, jak wygląda kolejny.
  • Pracę z klientami z USA, UK i Skandynawii, w tym z n8n.io, jedną z bardziej rozpoznawalnych firm w świecie AI i automatyzacji.
  • 100% pracy zdalnej z całej Polski.

Brzmi interesująco? Porozmawiajmy! :)

Rozmowy z zespołem: 30-45 min z inżynierem, ok. 45 min z CEO oraz behavioural interview z CTO

Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych jest Bee Talents PSA, ul. Królowej Jadwigi 43, 61-871, Poznań, NIP: 7792463296. Cele przetwarzania Twoich danych osobowych to: przeprowadzenie wstępnego etapu rekrutacji, na podstawie wyrażonych przez Ciebie zgód, udziału w przyszłych procesach rekrutacyjnych, na podstawie zgody, obrona przed potencjalnymi roszczeniami naszych Klientów, dla których prowadzimy rekrutację, w szczególności dotyczących niezgodności profilu Kandydata z wymaganiami określonymi przez Klienta – co jest prawnie uzasadnionym interesem Administratora Danych na podstawie art. 6 ust. 1 lit. f) RODO. GET TO KNOW US

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Frontend Software Engineering Manager (Hands-On technical) to our Partners Acquisition team in Portugal!

The Partners Area is accountable for the supplier side of our marketplace, ensuring gym and wellness partners can seamlessly onboard and thrive. The Partners Acquisition team specifically owns the critical entry point of this ecosystem: the entire acquisition journey (self-sign-up funnels, referral systems, automated content setup, and system activation). Our ultimate goal is to drastically reduce time-to-market for new partners globally. To achieve this, we are a heavily data-informed squad that runs multiple parallel A/B tests to optimize every step of our conversion funnel.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Accelerate Global Onboarding: Lead the delivery of a highly optimized, high-conversion self-service product that eliminates onboarding friction for new B2B partners.
  • Scale our Experimentation Engine: Architect and oversee a robust experimentation setup using Growthbook, enabling the team to safely run complex, parallel A/B tests across our frontend and backend ecosystems without compromising system performance or code quality.
  • Lead a Blended Architecture: Successfully manage and architect a diverse ecosystem that seamlessly connects high-traffic frontend apps (Tanstack/React/TS) and backend services (Kotlin/AWS) with our core CRM/ERP data workflows (Salesforce).
  • Champion Engineering Excellence & AI: Establish modern SDLC standards, mandating and driving the adoption of AI-assisted development tools for faster coding, automated reviews, and testing.
  • Empower a Cross-Functional Team: Foster a high-performance culture across a hybrid squad of 6 engineers (4 Frontend, 2 Backend).

WHO YOU ARE

  • Proven Technical Leadership: Experience managing or leading cross-functional engineering teams in high-growth environments.
  • Experimentation & Growth Mindset: Deep practical experience with A/B testing methodologies and experimentation feature-flagging tools (ideally Growthbook, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, or similar). You understand how to build systems for rapid telemetry and tracking.
  • Hands-on & Architecturally Sound: You still love to code, review pull requests, and can confidently architect scalable systems. Proficient in React, and TypeScript.
  • Distributed Systems Expert: You have extensive experience navigating Microservices and Micro-frontend architectures at scale.
  • AI-First Mindset: Actively uses and promotes AI best practices (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT) to boost team velocity.
  • Strategic Communicator: You are proficient in English and excel at asynchronous communication, capable of articulating complex technical trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

Mandatory Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Professional working proficiency in English, as you will collaborate with distributed global teams.
  • Proven Engineering Leadership: Demonstrable experience directly managing and leading cross-functional software engineering teams in high-growth, product-driven environments.
  • Full-Stack Technical Depth: Extensive hands-on experience and deep architectural understanding of modern full-stack ecosystems—specifically Kotlin (or Java), AWS, React, and TypeScript—with the ability to code, review PRs, and guide system design.
  • AI-First Engineering Mindset: Active and mandatory integration of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) into your personal coding, review, and documentation workflows, with the ability to champion these practices across the team.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in people managementand deep architectural understanding of modern full-stack ecosystems are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

HEALTHCARE: Health insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhuband LinkedIn!

You will receive an email with a direct URL link to the Job Posting of interest. Applying through this URL link will create your referral relationship for our Talent Acquisition Team.

JOB OBJECTIVE:
The Safety and Loss Control Consultant conducts loss analysis and research prior to conducting on-site occupational safety and loss prevention surveys to assess the policy holder's safety efforts and to detect occupational safety hazards to employees. The Safety and Loss Control Consultant prepares and submits reports of findings to management and makes recommendations to management to correct hazards and safety and loss control program needs. This position also participates in management training programs; researches literature, laws, standards and technical developments in the field of safety and loss control and provides the Underwriting Department with risk assessments in support of underwriting determinations.


The Consultant works with standard to large accounts and accounts that present more complex hazard and safety issues. The Consultant may mentor and provide guidance to Safety and Loss Control Trainees as needed. The Consultant participates in training sessions for policyholders in conjunction with Senior Safety and Loss Control Consultants. This requires a vast working knowledge and experience with all aspects of loss control regarding all property and casualty coverages written by Encova:

• General and Products Liability

• Workers’ Compensation

• Property
• Auto/Fleet

• Risk Improvement

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
1. Consults with policy holders to improve the occupational safety programs and performance leading to a safer and healthier workplace.
2. Provides underwriters with information concerning the level of safety of policy holders
3. Evaluates policy holder safety programs and work sites for hazardous conditions
4. Conducts simple Industrial Hygiene testing.
5. Research literature, standards, laws, and rules to provide policy holders with effective solutions.
6. Develops cost effective methods to correct hazardous conditions.
7. Analyzes loss information to determine accident trends and provide policy holders with effective solutions.
8. Provides underwriting with accurate and timely reports on the hazards and the effectiveness of controls and the willingness of the policy holder to comply with recommendations to control hazards.
9. Keeps underwriting apprised of any changes in hazards or exposures through copies of reports to policy holders and special reports to underwriting.
10. Responds to requests from policy holders, underwriters, and other agencies in a timely fashion regarding safety issues.
11. Communicates ideas and issues with management to reach successful agreement through innovation, creativity, and compromise.
12. Provides leadership and motivation of the support staff to achieve loss control goals and objectives.

OTHER FUNCTIONS:
1. Nonessential function: other duties as assigned.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university required. Preferably in safety, industrial hygiene, engineering or related field.
• Preference may be given to applicants with master's degree in Safety or Industrial Hygiene from an accredited college or university.
• Preference may be given to applicants with two years of full-time or equivalent part-time paid occupational safety management or occupational safety management consulting experience in industry or insurance.
• Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), Certification as an Associate in Risk Management (ARM), Associated Safety Professional (ASP) are preferred.
• Knowledge of the various core elements within the occupational safety and industrial hygiene process.
• Knowledge of effective safety program management.
• Knowledge of risk management as it relates to safety and industrial hygiene as an overall function of business in planning, leading, and directing its operations.
• Knowledge of workers' compensation laws, policies and rules, as well as understanding of the principles of insurance and risk management.
• Basic understanding of guaranteed cost, deductibles, retrospective rating plans and the impact of accident prevention on each plan.
• Knowledge of the rating systems, methods of calculating experience modification factors and the elements of each formula.
• Understanding of the U. S. Department of Labor Bureau of Labor Statistics loss information, formulas and principles of calculating incidence rates for policy holders.
• Knowledge of basic business financial principles to analyze cost effectiveness and return on investment of recommended solutions to hazards and exposures.
• Ability to make sound judgments and work independently, and to establish and maintain effective working relationships with other policy holders, policyholders, regulatory agencies, and labor communities.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Ability to compile, analyze, and report on findings.
• Knowledge of Federal OSHA MSHA, DOT and NFPA standards.
• Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
• Ability to safely operate a motor vehicle.

• Must hold a valid driver’s license.

Job Description:

Title: Senior Software Developer for Analytics

Location: Remote – UK

Reports to: Senior Manager, Software Development for Analytics

Vacancy: Existing vacancy

The Role:

We're looking for a Senior Software Developer to join our Analytics engineering team. You'll design the technical solutions that turn rich automotive and consumer datasets into products and insights our global customers can rely on.

The Impact You Will Have in This Role:

At J.D. Power, we're global leaders in consumer insights, advisory services, and data analytics. In this role you'll design the solutions that connect our data pipelines, models, and user experiences into one coherent product, working on a modern cloud data platform such as Snowflake, Databricks, or Palantir Foundry. You'll drive the engineering plan for complex feature areas, lead code and design reviews, and work closely with data scientists and AI engineers to get prototypes into production. Mentoring the engineers around you is a big part of the job too.

What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:

  • Design the technical solutions that tie together data pipelines, models, and user-facing experiences into one coherent product.

  • Break complex analytics or AI feature areas down into clear engineering plans, and flag technical risks before they become problems.

  • Lead code and design reviews, helping the team sharpen its approach to architecture, structure, and testing.

  • Work closely with data scientists, AI engineers, and product managers to shape experiments and turn promising prototypes into production-ready systems.

  • Mentor junior engineers, sharing what you know about system design, debugging, and talking to stakeholders.

  • Take ownership of end-to-end analytical solution design - data contracts, feature stores, model endpoints, client integration - on a modern cloud data platform such as Snowflake, Databricks, or Palantir Foundry.

  • Bring solid business judgement to architecture and tooling decisions, weighing cost, risk, and value rather than just technical elegance.

  • Keep an eye on where analytics and AI platforms are heading and recommend when it's worth adopting something new.

  • Choose the right integration pattern for the problem at hand and run small proofs of concept to test whether an idea will scale.

  • Decide when to build versus reuse, and how far to trade experimentation speed against reliability - calls that ripple out to the products other teams and customers depend on.

  • Communicate effectively with senior engineers, data scientists, and product partners so that everyone is aligned with business, product, and technical direction.

Qualifications of this Role:

Required Experience

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or related field) plus around 8 years of relevant software development experience - or 6 years with a Master's, or 3 with a PhD. Equivalent experience is also welcome.

  • A track record of owning delivery on complex, multi-team software or data engineering work.

Desirable Experience

  • Background in automotive, consumer insights, or analytics-driven SaaS.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and running technical design reviews.

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong Python, SQL, and Git skills, with real experience running production data pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data platform - Snowflake, Databricks, Palantir Foundry, or something similar.

  • Comfortable with JavaScript/TypeScript and React for building the applications and interfaces that customers will use.

  • Experience designing data architectures that scale, and a good handle on integration patterns like ETL/ELT and batch or streaming.

Desirable Technical Skills

  • PySpark or a similar distributed data processing framework.

  • CI/CD pipelines, observability tooling (logging, alerting, monitoring), and infrastructure-as-code.

  • Experience working with cloud infrastructure, in either Azure, AWS, or GCP.

  • Some exposure to putting AI/ML models into production analytics use cases.

  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS and data visualization libraries.

Desirable Competencies

  • Equally comfortable thinking strategically and getting hands-on - you don't need much oversight to drive a complex feature area forward.

  • A natural mentor who enjoys raising the bar for the people around you.

The role ensures leadership has the intelligence necessary to make informed investment, pursuit, and staffing decisions while delivering a consistent, high-value customer experience. As a trusted advisor to both customers and internal stakeholders, this individual drives alignment, facilitates cross-functional collaboration, anticipates risks and constraints, and identifies opportunities for expansion and long-term partnership growth. Through a combination of strategic insight, operational discipline, and executive communication, the role helps position Lemartec as a preferred partner for mission critical customers and supports the company's continued expansion in a rapidly growing market. Company Overview Founded in 1979, Lemartec is a national general contractor and construction management firm and is part of the General Building group within MasTec’s Clean Energy and Infrastructure segment. As MasTec’s vertical construction arm, Lemartec delivers complex projects across industrial, aviation, power, and large commercial markets. Led at the segment level by Manny García-Tuñón, the General Building Operating Group represents MasTec’s vertical construction capabilities and serves as the platform for future growth in this space. As a MasTec company, Lemartec maintains international capabilities and strategic partnerships throughout the Americas and the Caribbean, enabling the execution of some of the most complex projects in the industries we serve. jobs.description:
Closer — HighKey Enterprises

HighKey is a premium agency specializing in social media management, press, and paid patient acquisition for cash-pay medical aesthetics and wellness clinics doing $250K+ per month.

We work with plastic surgeons, med spas, longevity clinics, and high-end practitioners who want to dominate their market.

The leads are inbound and paid for. We need someone who can close them.

What You're Selling

Two streams. You work both.

Stream A is HighKey's agency retainer (SMM, press, ads).

Average client is $6,500/month on a 52-week contract. Commission is retention-based. You earn 10% of each client's monthly payment for months 1 to 3, 7.5% for months 4 to 6, and 5% for months 7 to 12.

Every client you close pays you every month they stay active, for up to 12 months. Each new close stacks on top of your existing retained clients.

Your Stream A income grows every month without needing to increase volume. That is the compounding mechanic that separates this role from a standard closer position.

Stream B is patient acquisition for partner clinics. HighKey runs the ads, and you close patients on procedure packages averaging $20,000.

You collect a deposit and book the consult. No medical advice. Flat commission of approximately $1,000 per close.

If you source a deal yourself through cold outreach or your personal network, you earn a 5% bonus on the month 1 payment on top of standard rates. Proof of origin required.

What the Numbers Look Like

Month 1 is a paid ramp. You spend it learning the product, the script, and the pipeline as an SDR at $25/hr before taking closer calls. This is intentional. Closers who skip the ramp underperform.

Month 2 to 3: $4,000/month base plus commission. OTE $9,650 to $15,600. Month 4+: Commission only. At minimum close rates, the floor is $13,550/month. No base needed to hit that number. Month 8+ steady state: $19,238/month at minimum close rates. Income continues to grow as Stream A clients stack through their retention windows.

At full schedule you run 6 demos per day:

  • 2 Stream A, 4 Stream B.
  • Minimum close rates are 10% on shown Stream A calls and 15% on shown Stream B calls. These are the floor, not the target.

The Problems You'll Be Solving

Clinic owners come to us because they're losing ground in saturated markets.

  • Weak social proof.
  • Poor online authority.
  • Inconsistent branding.
  • Low consultation flow.
  • Low-quality leads.
  • Difficulty converting ad traffic.

Your job is to diagnose these problems on the call and position HighKey's solutions accordingly.

What We Expect

6 booked demos every business day, minimum. If you're under 6, you flag it that morning.

Post-call reporting in GHL and the BC Analytics Sheet within 15 minutes of every call ending. 2 call recordings submitted per week for review.

GHL pipeline updated every 2 weeks. Follow up every 48 to 72 hours on every committed lead, good lead that didn't close, and anything awaiting payment.

Contracts sent within 24 hours of every close.

This is a remote role but runs like an in-office job. All calls are on Google Meet with camera on and Fathom recording enabled. You need a professional setup, reliable internet, and a quiet environment.

Who This Is For

Minimum: 3+ years sales experience, 2+ years sales training, proven high-ticket closing experience. Background in medical, aesthetics, wellness, or health services is a strong plus. Preferred: agency sales, luxury client experience, medical or aesthetic industry background.

You sell outcomes. You stay composed under pressure. You take direct feedback and apply it. You manage your own follow-up without being asked.

Our Culture

Competitive. Fast-paced. High-accountability. Direct. Performance-driven.

We move fast, we expect professionalism, and we don't carry underperformers. If that's the environment you want, you'll fit here.

How to Apply

Apply through our portal. The first step is a short video submission. You'll be asked to answer this question on camera.

Salary: $3,000+ / month

jobs.description:
About Centific

Centific is a frontier AI data foundry that curates diverse, high-quality data, using our purpose-built technology platforms to empower the Magnificent Seven and our enterprise clients with safe, scalable AI deployment. Our team includes more than 150 PhDs and data scientists, along with more than 4,000 AI practitioners and engineers. We harness the power of an integrated solution ecosystem—comprising industry-leading partnerships and 1.8 million vertical domain experts in more than 230 markets—to create contextual, multilingual, pre-trained datasets; fine-tuned, industry-specific LLMs; and RAG pipelines supported by vector databases. Our zero-distance innovation™ solutions for GenAI can reduce GenAI costs by up to 80% and bring solutions to market 50% faster.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI creators and industry leaders by bringing best practices in GenAI to unicorn innovators and enterprise customers. We aim to help these organizations unlock significant business value by deploying GenAI at scale, helping to ensure they stay at the forefront of technological advancement and maintain a competitive edge in their respective markets.

About Job

AI Research Engineer: Vision AI / VLM / Physical AI

Company: Centific

Location: Seattle, WA (or Remote)

Type: Full‑time

Build the Future of Perception & Embodied Intelligence

Are you pushing the frontier of computer vision, multimodal large models, and embodied/physical AI—and have the publications to show it? Join us to translate cutting-edge‑ research into production systems that perceive, reason, and act in the real world.

The Mission

We are building state of‑ t‑heart Vision AI across 2D/3D perception, egocentric/360° understanding, and multimodal reasoning. As an AI Research Engineer, you will own high‑ ‑leverage experiments from paper → prototype → deployable module in our platform.

We are seeking passionate Engineersto join our cutting-edge labs, you could be part of :

Computer Vision team as a Research Engineer and dive into the world of 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, and visual AI. You’ll explore innovative techniques like those used to transform real-world spaces into immersive 3D models—such as the 3D Reconstruction projects —and work with cutting-edge architectures like VGG-T (Visual Geometry Grounded Transformers), known for advancing deep learning in vision tasks. This role is perfect for those excited to develop AI systems that interpret, reconstruct, and interact with the visual world, using state-of-the-art tools and methodologies. Physical AI Robotics team, where you’ll work at the intersection of simulation, robotics, and AI. You’ll leverage NVIDIA’s Omniverse for advanced 3D simulation and collaboration, Isaac Sim for robotics training and testing, and GR00T for foundation models in robotics. Experience with Holoscan SDK for real-time medical and industrial robotics pipelines, Newton Physics for dynamic simulation, and NVIDIA’s NERD for neural robot dynamics will be a plus. This role is ideal for those eager to push the boundaries of AI-driven robotics using state-of-the-art tools and frameworks.

What You’ll Do

  • Advance Visual Perception: Build and fine‑tune models for detection, tracking, segmentation (2D/3D), pose & activity recognition, and scene understanding (incl. 360° and multi‑view).
  • Multimodal Reasoning with VLMs: Train/evaluate vision–language models (VLMs) for grounding, dense captioning, temporal QA, and tooluse; design retrieval‑ augmented and agentic loops for perception‑ action‑ tasks.
  • Physical AI & Embodiment: Prototype perception‑in‑the‑loop policies that close the gap from pixels to actions (simulation + real data). Integrate with planners and task graphs for manipulation, navigation, or safety workflows.
  • Data & Evaluation at Scale: Curate datasets, author high‑signal evaluation protocols/KPIs, and run ablations that make results irreproducible impossible.
  • Systems & Deployment: Package research into reliable services on a modern stack (Kubernetes, Docker, Ray, FastAPI), with profiling, telemetry, and CI for reproducible science.
  • Agentic Workflows: Orchestrate multi-agent pipelines (e.g., ‑LangGraphstyle graphs) that combine perception, reasoning, simulation, and ‑codeg eneration to ‑selfc heck and ‑selfcorrect‑.

Example Problems You Might Tackle

  • Long horizon‑ video understanding (events, activities, causality) from egocentric or 360° video.
  • 3D scene grounding: linking language queries to objects, affordances, and trajectories.
  • Fast, privacy preserving perception for ‑ondevice‑ or edge inference.
  • Robust multi‑modal evaluation: temporal consistency, open‑set detection, uncertainty.
  • Vision conditioned‑ policy evaluation in sim (Isaac/MuJoCo) with sim2real stress tests.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Masters/Ph.D in CS/EE/Robotics (or related), actively publishing in CV/ML/Robotics (e.g., CVPR/ICCV/ECCV, NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR, CoRL/RSS).
  • Strong PyTorch (or JAX) and Python; comfort with CUDA profiling and mixed precision‑ training.
  • Demonstrated research in computer vision and at least one of: VLMs (e.g., LLaVA style, video‑ language‑ models), embodied/physical AI, 3D perception.
  • Proven ability to move from paper → code → ablation → result with rigorous experiment tracking.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with video models (e.g., TimeSFormer/MViT/VideoMAE), diffusion or 3D GS/NeRF pipelines, or SLAM/scene reconstruction.
  • Prior work on multimodal grounding (referring expressions, spatial language, affordances) or temporal reasoning.
  • Familiarity with ROS2, DeepStream/TAO, or edge inference optimizations (TensorRT, ONNX).
  • Scalable training: Ray, distributed data loaders, sharded checkpoints.
  • Strong software craft: testing, linting, profiling, containers, and reproducibility.
  • Public code artifacts (GitHub) and first‑author publications or strong open source‑ impact.

Our Stack (you’ll touch a subset)

  • Modeling: PyTorch, torchvision/lightning, Hugging Face, OpenMMLab, xFormers
  • Perception: YOLO/Detectron/MMDet, SAM/Mask2Former, CLIP‑style backbones, optical flow
  • VLM / LLM: Vision encoders + LLMs, RAG for video, toolformer‑/agent loops
  • 3D / Sim: Open3D, PyTorch3D, Isaac/MuJoCo, COLMAP/SLAM, NeRF/3DGS
  • Systems: Python, FastAPI, Ray, Kubernetes, Docker, Triton/TensorRT, Weights & Biases
  • Pipelines: LangGraph‑like orchestration, data versioning, artifact stores

What Success Looks Like

  • A publishable or open‑sourced outcome (with company approval) or a production‑ready module that measurably moves a product KPI (latency, accuracy, robustness).
  • Clean, reproducible code with documented ablations and an evaluation report that a teammate can rerun end‑to‑end.
  • A demo that clearly communicates capabilities, limits, and next steps.

Why Centific

  • Real impact: Your research ships—powering core features in our MVPs and products.
  • Mentorship: Work closely with our Principal Architect and senior engineers/researchers.
  • Velocity + Rigor: We balance top‑tier research practices with pragmatic product focus.

Salary: $180,000-$240,000 + OTB

Centific is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, familial status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.title: Head of People Operations
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a hands-on Head of People Operations who loves making things work well, every single day.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a hands-on Head of People Operations who loves making things work well, every single day. The foundations are already here: our HR systems, policies, and core processes are in place. What they need now is someone who'll sharpen them, make them consistent across every country we operate in, and keep them running smoothly as we grow.

This isn't a pure strategy role. You'll spend most of your time close to the work: advising managers on tricky employee relations cases, checking that a contract in Kenya meets local law, fixing the onboarding step that keeps tripping people up, and finding ways AI can take the admin off everyone's plate. You'll also own our yearly company offsite, from the agenda to the moment you open it on day one.

Equally vital, you will champion and embody our company culture. You will safeguard our core values, model them in daily interactions, and comfortably lead challenging discussions when expectations aren't met. Acting as a trusted advocate for employees with leadership, you will champion their interests while thoughtfully balancing staff needs, corporate values, and business priorities.

Job Details

  • Job Title: Head of People Operations
  • Reporting To: Chief Operating Officer
  • Grade: M7 (Head of)
  • Location: Remote in United Kingdom (but open to GMT +/- 3 hours time zone if you have UK HR Experience)
  • Compensation: 60,000-70,000 GBP but this will be adjusted to a local benchmark if you are based outside of the UK
  • Contract Structure: Permanent

Key Responsibilities

  • Culture carrier. You'll protect and live our culture and values every day, and hold others to them too. You'll run engagement surveys, turn the results into specific actions, and follow through, keeping our culture strong across a remote-first, multi-country team.
  • Employee relations. You'll be the go-to person for managers and staff regarding grievances, disciplinary matters, performance concerns, absences, and exits. You handle cases fairly, document them properly, and close them out, and you know when to bring in local counsel.
  • Multi-country compliance. You'll make sure our contracts, handbooks, and policies comply with employment law in each country where we hire, whether through our own entities or an Employer of Record. That means tracking legal changes, keeping country-specific terms up to date, and flagging risk early. As a project-based business, you'll also make sure people are classified correctly (permanent, fixed-term, project-funded, consultant or contractor) as projects start and end, with the right contracts, notice terms and exit processes for each.
  • Refining systems and processes. Most of what we need already exists. Your job is to audit it, spot the gaps, and tighten it up: onboarding, offboarding, probation, performance reviews, leave, contract changes, etc.
  • Using AI to work smarter. You'll look for practical ways AI can save time and improve quality across the people function, such as drafting initial versions of letters and policies, answering routine employee questions, cleaning up HR data, or summarising survey results. You'll roll these out safely, with clear guidance on data privacy.
  • People operations and HR data. You'll own the accuracy of our HRIS and people data, support payroll and benefits administration across countries, and produce clean, reliable reporting for the leadership team. Every process should be documented, owned, and easy to follow.
  • Annual company offsite. You'll lead the yearly offsite end-to-end: shaping the agenda with the leadership team, managing the venue, travel, visas, budget, and logistics, and hosting the sessions on the day. People should leave feeling more connected and clearer on where we're going.
  • Supporting managers. You'll coach managers through the people side of their jobs and give them simple tools, templates, and training so they can handle more on their own.
  • Clear, warm communication. You write clearly, explain policy in plain language, and can handle difficult conversations with empathy and directness.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 3 months: you've reviewed every core people process and policy, met each manager, most of the company, and shared a prioritised list of fixes with the leadership team.
  • By 6 months: the top-priority processes are refined, documented, and owned. Open employee relations cases are handled consistently, and managers and employees feel supported
  • By 9 months: at least two AI-supported workflows are live and saving the team measurable time, with guidance in place on how to use them safely.
  • By 12 months: you've delivered a well-run annual offsite that people rate highly, and managers say HR is fast, clear, and easy to work with.

Requirements

  • Solid HR generalist experience. You've got 7+ years in HR, with at least 2 years leading the people function or a significant part of it, including managing a small team. You'll lead 3 direct reports here.
  • Employee relations know-how. You've handled a wide range of ER cases yourself, from the first conversation to the final outcome, and you're confident, calm, and fair under pressure.
  • Labour law across multiple countries. You've worked with employment law in the UK but also in more than one jurisdiction and understand how contracts, notice periods, leave and termination rules differ between them. You know your way around Employer of Record models and when to call local counsel.
  • Project-based business experience. You understand how people work in organisations funded by projects or grants. You know the difference between permanent, fixed-term, project-funded and contractor roles, how to classify people correctly in each country, and how to manage contract renewals and endings when funding changes.
  • A process builder with an eye for detail. You can take a messy or inconsistent process and turn it into something simple and reliable. You notice the typo in the offer letter and the missing step in the leaver checklist, and you fix them.
  • Comfort with HR systems and AI tools. You're confident using an HRIS and comfortable experimenting with AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot to make work faster and better. You can show us examples of where you've done it.
  • Event planning experience. You've planned and run in-person events, ideally a company offsite or retreat for 50+ people, including agenda design, logistics, budget and facilitation.
  • Clear, warm communication. You write clearly, explain policy in plain language and can handle difficult conversations with empathy and directness.
  • Happy to travel. You're comfortable travelling occasionally to our sites in Africa

Nice to have

  • Experience working in Africa. You've supported teams or employed people in African countries such as Kenya, Uganda, Ghana, Nigeria and Ethiopia, and you understand local labour law, payroll and cultural context there.
  • Global health or NGO background. You've worked in a mission-driven organisation
  • CIPD Level 5 or above, or an equivalent HR qualification. Not required, but a plus.
  • UK-based. The role is fully remote, but a UK base would be ideal.

Benefits

5 Reasons to Join Simprints

Life is short. We believe work should be inspirational, meaningful and fun. At Simprints, we’re taking on global development’s biggest challenges, powered by an amazing culture and incredible people. Work with us, and you will grow faster, learn more, and take on great responsibilities with the potential to make lasting change.

1. Genuine Impact. Work directly with our partners and users to deliver technology that has the potential to impact millions of lives across the globe. At Simprints, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about driving real change.

2. An incredible, diverse team. Our work is at the intersection of technology and global development, and we’ve managed to build an amazing team drawn from all over the world. But don’t take our word for it—we’re an externally recognised as a Great Place to Work, and a 2025 Best Workplace for Women amonst many other accolades.

3. Mutual Flex. We champion a work culture where autonomy and trust are paramount, steering clear of mere face-time metrics. Whether it's managing life's essentials like healthcare appointments or adapting work hours to match your peak productivity times, we've got you covered. In return, we count on your reciprocal flexibility when mission-critical moments arise, like stepping up for a crucial client discussion on a Friday or tackling unexpected technical glitches beyond regular hours.

4. Ultimate work-life balance. As long as you're driving results and fostering teamwork, we encourage you to strike that perfect balance between your professional and personal life. Our commitment to this model's success is solidified through semi-annual productivity assessments with our board, ensuring that our high standards of performance are consistently met.

5. Professional development. We promote continual learning and put our money where our mouth is with development plans and access to global experts through the GLG network. We also have a generous professional development budget for each colleague – “Eduprints”. Is there some training you’d like, or maybe you could benefit from professional coaching? Simply provide a business case that shares your aspirations and the resources you need, and we'll do our best to support you. We care about both your development in Simprints and your holistic long-term career goals. Simprints Alumni have gone on to work for Google, World Bank, Gavi, Save the Children, and other top players.

jobs.description:
Full-time

Remote, US

$225,000 - $250,000 base salary

$325,000 - $350,000 OTE

About Us

The Ammortal Chamber brings together multiple scientifically backed technologies into one experience. It is a healing technology that can be utilized by wellness clinics and inside the home. Our clients include specialty spas and clinics, sports teams, and individuals.

We are a small team with a startup culture. After our first full year shipping a finished product on the market, we have shown strong growth. Our team is made up of engineers, health professionals, and startup entrepreneurs.

As we continue expanding, this role offers the chance to make a tangible impact by developing and delivering cutting-edge wellness technology. You'll collaborate across disciplines to innovate and shape technologies that enhance well-being for our clients.

What is this role and why does it exist?

The response to the Chamber has driven the opportunity to bring an experienced sales leader in to bring the sales team to the next level. We have a small, capable sales team carrying a large and growing book of commercial accounts across Performance, Hospitality, Wellness, Private Clubs, and Residential.

The VP of Sales exists to manage the sales organization end to end. This person will own day-to-day sales leadership and build a repeatable system: a defined sales process, accurate pipeline data, clear rep accountability, and a hiring plan that scales the team as production scales. This person will be a player-coach at first. The team is small enough that this person will carry strategic deals personally while building upon the sales organization.

This is a role with a designed growth path. We are looking for someone who wants to learn the sales organization first, then grow into broader commercial leadership as the business grows.

Responsibilities

  • Own the Sales Goals: Carry the company revenue target. Set and manage quotas, territory and vertical coverage, and the operating cadence that gets the team to plan every month and every quarter.
  • Lead, Coach, and Develop the Sales Team: Take over day-to-day management of the existing sales team. Run weekly 1:1s, deal coaching, and call reviews. Raise the baseline for the sales team.
  • Build the Repeatable Sales Motion: Turn how we sell today into a documented, teachable playbook — discovery, qualification, demo and Chamber experience, pricing conversation, objection handling, and close. Operationalize our account tiering model so effort matches account value.
  • Own Forecasting and Pipeline Integrity: work with our VP of Commercial Ops to deliver a forecast leadership can plan production and cash against.
  • Set Vertical Strategy and Prioritization: Decide where the team spends its time across Performance, Hospitality, Wellness, Private Clubs, and Residential. Concentrate effort on the verticals that compound.
  • Scale the Team: Build the sales hiring plan alongside Finance and People. Interview, onboard, and ramp new reps against a defined ramp curve, and add vertical or segment leadership when volume justifies it.
  • Partner Across the Company: Work with Marketing on demand and messaging, with Partner Success on a clean post-sale handoff, and with Operations and Supply Chain so that what we sell matches what we can build and install.

Skills to Excel

  • Systems builder
    • Can see the system underneath the activity and builds it: process, stages, cadence, tooling, accountability.
  • Complex, high-consideration selling
    • The Chamber is a significant physical product with a long consideration cycle, multiple stakeholders, install logistics, and different types of buyers.
  • Fluent in the Numbers
    • Numbers driven and drives decisions based on the numbers. Able to read a P&L, build forecasts, and be able to tie strategy to the numbers
  • Talent Magnet
    • Point of view on what great looks like in this market
  • Cross-Functional Emotional Intelligence
    • Know how to build trust cross functionally: with Product, Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Partner Success

Requirements

What Technical Knowledge Do You Need to Perform in This Role?

Required

  • HubSpot or similar CRM at an administrative level (pipeline architecture, reporting, forecasting, and automation).
  • Sales forecasting methodology and pipeline math.
  • Quota, territory, and compensation plan design.
  • Revenue intelligence and call-recording tools (Gong, Clari, Fireflies, or similar).
  • Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and Asana for day-to-day collaboration.

Preferred

  • Sales enablement and onboarding platforms.
  • Comfort using AI tools for research, account mapping, outreach personalization, and call analysis.

Qualifications (Must haves)

  • 8+ years in sales with at least 3 years leading a sales team and carrying a team number.
  • Experience selling into any of our core verticals: professional or collegiate sports, hospitality, med spas and wellness clinics, private clubs, or high-net-worth residential.
  • Track record building a sales function from an informal motion into a repeatable, documented system.
  • Experience selling high-ticket, high-consideration products with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience interviewing, onboarding, and ramping sales reps
  • Ownership of a forecast that leadership relied on for planning.

Qualifications (Nice to haves):

  • Background in health, wellness, longevity, performance, or medical device sales.
  • Experience selling a physical product where manufacturing capacity, lead times, and install logistics are a factor
  • Exposure to international expansion or channel and partner-led sales.

Benefits

Pay, Location, Benefits

  • Pay Range: $225,000 - $250,000 base salary, $325,000 - $350,000 OTE
  • Benefits: 80% of health, dental, and vision insurance covered
  • Equity: 40,000 options vesting over 4 years with a 1 year cliff

jobs.description:
Position Title: Program Associate, Higher Education

Status: Full Time

FLSA: Exempt

Location:Flexible/Remote

JOB SUMMARY & KEY PRIORITIES

The Youth Leadership Team equips and mobilizes youth and young adults to strengthen their leadership, advocate for mental health, and create change in their schools and communities through accessible, high-quality, equity-centered leadership programs and opportunities. The team works directly with students and campus stakeholders to support student-led initiatives that advance mental health change.

The Program Associate, Higher Education supports the Youth Leadership Team by carrying out assigned programs and projects for college students. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Higher Education, this role serves as a core student-facing team member who supports the day-to-day implementation of Active Minds' higher education programming, with a primary focus on the Mental Health Advocacy Institute (MHAI).

The Program Associate helps deliver well-run programs and positive participant experiences. The role combines project coordination, student coaching and facilitation, program operations, content creation, and collaboration across teams. The Associate flags barriers to participation and implementation and works with the Senior Manager to address them.

The position works closely with the Youth Leadership Team and colleagues across Measurement, Chapters, Marketing & Communications, Operations and other relevant departments. The role also works directly with youth and young adults, campus staff and faculty, facilitators, interns, and external partners.

ABOUT ACTIVE MINDS

Active Minds is the largest nonprofit in the United States mobilizing youth and young adults to transform mental health norms across society. For more than 20 years, we have equipped the next generation of peer mental health advocates through a variety of programs, including the Active Minds Chapter Network, A.S.K., and Send Silence Packing. Our advocacy, initiatives, and campaigns foster lasting change in how youth view and discuss mental health, encouraging them to use their voices to influence broader conversations and inform mental health supports within their communities. Together, we are building a diverse movement of champions committed to improving mental health for all.

KEY RESULTS

Initiative Implementation

  • Coordinate day-to-day implementation of the Mental Health Advocacy Institute, including program calendars, participant onboarding, learning management system support, session preparation, and milestone tracking.
  • Support MHAI recruitment and applications, including outreach to colleges, universities, higher education associations, and campus networks, with a focus on reaching BIPOC and LGBTQ+ students and students at varied institution types, including community colleges and HBCUs.
  • Coordinate MHAI alumni engagement, including student panels, project spotlights, and connections to additional Active Minds leadership opportunities (e.g. Chapters, the Youth Mental Health Innovation Fund, policy advocacy).
  • Connect MHAI participants and collegiate advocates to the Youth Mental Health Innovation Fund through outreach, informational sessions, and application support, in coordination with the Senior Manager, Youth Grants and Educator Engagement
  • Support the delivery of higher education resources, webinars, training, and campus partnership initiatives as assigned.
  • Make routine logistical and participant-support decisions within established program guidelines, referring complex participation concerns, policy decisions, and strategic questions to the Senior Manager.

Execution of Functional/Tactical Tasks

  • Serve as a primary contact for routine participant questions about program requirements, deadlines, materials, and support.
  • Monitor participant progress and follow-up promptly when students miss sessions or milestones.
  • Coach college students and give timely feedback on their milestones, using established program criteria and guidance from the Senior Manager, as they develop campus mental health advocacy action plans, identify administrative allies, and implement campus and systemic changes.
  • Facilitate and co-facilitate virtual sessions, office hours, make-up sessions, and small groups across assigned Youth Leadership programs, using interactive activities, discussions, and reflections that strengthen students’ leadership and advocacy skills.
  • Carry out assigned projects from planning through completion, maintaining timelines, coordinating deliverables, and keeping the Senior Manager informed of progress, barriers, and support needs.
  • Use ClickUp and Google Workspace to track project milestones, tasks, session communications, and facilitator and speaker logistics.

Logistical and Tactical Support

  • Maintain the MHAI's online learning platform, including posting materials and assignments, organizing resources, and supporting participant access.
  • Coordinate logistics for MHAI facilitators, guest speakers, and virtual sessions, including scheduling, onboarding materials, attendance, breakout rooms, interactive tools, and participant access needs.
  • Handle administrative tasks across assigned Youth Leadership programs, including mass communications, participant records , required forms, and submitted work.
  • Under the Senior Manager's guidance, process participant stipends, speaker honoraria, facilitator payments, including collecting forms and receipts, submitting payment requests, tracking payment status, and flagging discrepancies.

Content, Document, and Resource Creation

  • Create and update supplemental materials for higher education and other Youth Leadership programs, including videos, worksheets, interactive activities, reflection prompts, action plan templates, and facilitator guides, using established templates and in collaboration with the Senior Manager and relevant colleagues.
  • Prepare facilitator training materials, communications, and implementation guidance.

Individual & Team Collaboration

  • Collaborate across the Youth Leadership Team and other departments to coordinate programming, share resources, and connect participants with additional engagement opportunities.
  • Assist with training and technical assistance for campus partners to support student leadership and mental health advocacy.
  • When assigned an intern, establish expectations, provide guidance and feedback, and monitor progress toward deliverables.

Data Management & Reporting

  • With the Senior Manager and Measurement Team, collect and maintain standardized MHAI data on participation, completion, participant experience (including Net Promoter Score), and intended leadership outcomes.
  • Maintain accurate records of recruitment, participant engagement, campus stakeholder communications, and student project implementation
  • Gather participant feedback, especially from BIPOC and LGBTQ+ students. Share themes with the Senior Manager, suggest improvements, and help carry out approved changes.
  • Support preparation of program summaries, presentations, and reports for internal teams and funders, as assigned.

Organization-Wide Competencies

  • Apply an equity-centered, community- and strengths-based approach to student programming and engagement.
  • Contribute to team and organizational strategic goals by completing assigned deliverables on time.
  • Represent Active Minds at conferences, meetings, trainings, and other events as assigned.
  • Share student engagement learnings, resources, and practices with colleagues.
  • Participate in organization-wide initiatives and other responsibilities as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least one year of relevant experience supporting higher education programs, student leadership, mental health promotion, advocacy, student affairs or related nonprofit initiatives. Relevant experience may include employment, internships, graduate assistantships, service roles, or substantial student leadership responsibilities.
  • Experience engaging college students and collaborating with campus staff, faculty, or community partners.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience facilitating presentations, trainings, or student-facing programming.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team, knowing when to check in with a supervisor for guidance.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Experience creating documents, presentations, or educational materials.
  • Experience entering, organizing, and maintaining data accurately (e.g., spreadsheets, forms, surveys).
  • Ability to provide supportive, constructive guidance while maintaining clear program expectations and exercising sound judgment.
  • Proficiency with Google products and project management platforms (e.g., ClickUp).
  • Commitment to equity and inclusion and applying an equity-centered lens to student programming and engagement.
  • Belief in college students' ability to lead meaningful change in mental health and their campus communities.
  • Willingness and ability to travel within the United States to conferences, on-site Active Minds events, and staff gatherings, and support evening programming during the academic year.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using Google Classroom or another learning management system.
  • Experience with Salesforce or another customer relationship management system.
  • Familiarity with campus mental health advocacy, peer education, student leadership development, or collaborative campus change efforts.
  • Experience engaging students across varied institution types, including community colleges, historically Black colleges and universities, and other institutions serving historically underserved students.

OUR CULTURE

Active Minds is a place where every employee matters. We value diverse perspectives, radical authenticity, and a community-driven approach. We dream big, offering flexibility to staff while we work to achieve our mission. As such, we are proud to offer competitive salaries and benefits and an environment that is friendly to remote working and life/work balance.

Active Minds is an equal-opportunity employer that works to advance racial equity and social justice in an increasingly multicultural and globally connected world. We value diverse experiences, including educational background, intersectional identities, and lived experiences. We make a particular effort to recruit people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities, and people with other marginalized identities. Active Minds encourages all to apply for our open positions as we depend on a diverse staff to carry out our mission.

COMPENSATION

This position offers an initial salary range of $52,500-$57,750 along with robust benefits. The starting pay for this position is equal to others at the same level throughout the organization. The role sits within Active Minds Level 1 salary band, and as such, has the potential to grow to $68,250 over time. FLSA Status: Exempt.

Active Minds has an industry-leading and competitive benefits package that includes Health, Vision and Dental Insurance, Paid Vacation and Sick Leave, Paid Holidays, Company Wide Mental Health Days, 401(k) Matching, HSA and FSA Options, Life Insurance, Short Term, and Long Term Disability, Fully Paid Parental Leave, Wellness Reimbursement Program, and Professional Development Stipends.

Active Minds recruits, hires, trains, compensates, and promotes our staff regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.

ACTIVE MINDS RECRUITING PROTOCOLS

  • Active Minds will never ask an applicant to send – and Active Minds will never send an applicant - a check or any payment or item of value (such as a gift card) in connection with the interview process or job onboarding process.
  • Active Minds will never ask for personal information about an applicant (such as their Social Security number or banking information) until the job onboarding process;
  • Active Minds will never extend a job offer without first conducting multiple rounds of video interviews. The Active Minds interview/hiring process will always include at least 3 virtual interviews.
  • All legitimate Active Minds job offers are extended verbally by the HR/People & Culture Team. • If you are expecting an email from Active Minds, please always verify that the sending domain in the email is activeminds.org and NOT any variation of it.

For further information on how to protect yourself from employment scams, please review these “Consumer Advice” guidelines.
