You will join our Customer Support team, part of our wider Customer Success team, and report to our VP of Customer Success and our Customer Support Team Lead. You will work alongside Onboarding, Customer Integrations, Sales, and Engineering.

At its heart, this role is about problem solving: answering customer questions, addressing their concerns, and troubleshooting issues until they're resolved.

Why This Work Matters

For most gym owners, Support is the part of Gymdesk they talk to most. Every conversation shapes how they feel about the product and about us.

  • For our customers, a quick, accurate answer means billing runs on time, classes stay booked, and they can get back to their members.

  • For their members, many of the issues you solve are ones members feel directly: a payment that didn't go through, a class they couldn't book, an app that won't log in.

  • For Gymdesk, customers who feel well supported trust the product more, use more of it, and stay with us longer. What you hear also helps Product and Engineering decide what to fix next.

This role is where a customer's question turns into confidence in Gymdesk.

What You'll Own

Customer conversations

  • Answer customer questions by phone, chat, and email, handling a high volume of conversations each day (often 50 or more).

  • Give clear, accurate answers about how Gymdesk works, in plain language that a busy gym owner can act on right away.

  • Follow up on open issues so every customer knows what is happening and what comes next.

Troubleshooting and escalation

  • Investigate and resolve technical and account-related issues, including billing, scheduling, member records, and settings.

  • Recognize when an issue needs more help, and escalate it to Engineering with clear steps to reproduce, screenshots, and customer impact.

  • Coordinate with Onboarding, Customer Integrations, and Sales when a question belongs with another team, so customers get a smooth handoff instead of a runaround.

Records and knowledge

  • Keep accurate, complete ticket records in HubSpot, including the issue, steps taken, and outcome.

  • Tag recurring questions and bugs so the team can spot patterns.

  • Become an expert in Gymdesk, and keep up with new features and changes as they ship.

Improving the experience

  • Suggest and help write help-center articles, saved replies, and templates that answer common questions faster.

  • Share customer feedback with the Support Team Lead, Product, and Engineering about what confuses or frustrates customers.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means customers feel heard, get accurate answers quickly, and come away more confident in Gymdesk. Here is what we hope your first few months look like:

  • First 30 days: Comfortable with Gymdesk's core features. Handling chat and email conversations with support from the team. Escalations written clearly and completely.

  • 60 days: Handling phone, chat, and email independently at a steady daily volume. HubSpot ticket records current and complete. Comfortable knowing what to solve and what to escalate.

  • 90 days: A go-to resource on the team for common issues. Contributing saved replies or help-center updates. Sharing patterns from customer conversations with Product and Engineering.

Who You Are

  • 1–3 years of experience in customer support, customer success, or a similar customer-facing role.

  • Service-minded at heart. You get energy from helping people, and you take pride in following through.

  • Patient and clear when explaining something technical. You can walk a gym owner through a billing setting or a scheduling issue in plain, reassuring language.

  • Calm and organized at a fast pace, able to juggle many conversations and prioritize what matters most.

  • A curious troubleshooter who digs into the "why" behind an issue instead of stopping at the first answer.

  • A clear, professional communicator in writing, on the phone, and over chat, with fluent English.

  • Comfortable working through a CRM or ticketing system (such as HubSpot), Slack, and other remote-work tools.

  • A quick learner who enjoys becoming an expert in complex software.

  • Familiar with AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for drafting replies, summarizing conversations, or finding answers, and interested in using them thoughtfully.

  • Comfortable in a growing company where processes are still being built.

  • Nice to have: experience in SaaS support; familiarity with HubSpot help desk or service pipelines; experience with billing or payments questions; or experience serving fitness, martial arts, or wellness businesses.

Tools You'll Use

HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace, phone and chat support tools, and AI tools for drafting replies, summarizing conversations, and research. We will train you on Gymdesk and our support processes.

Why This Role

You will join a close-knit Support team within our growing Customer Success team, so your work and your ideas will be seen. Every conversation you handle is a gym owner who gets back to running their business, and every pattern you spot helps make Gymdesk better for thousands of customers.

If you think you'd be a good fit, we'd love to hear from you.

About the company

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.

Project Highlights

  • Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All contributors are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
  • Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

jobs.description:
Position Title: Chief Growth Officer

Reports to: Executive Director

Team: 2 FTEs on partnerships + 1 marketing contractor

Role Type: Full-Time Employee

About Us:

The Student Basic Needs Coalition (SBNC) is building the national model for connecting students with public benefits and basic needs resources.

Millions of students are eligible for programs like SNAP and Medicaid, yet the majority never enroll due to complex rules, stigma, and administrative barriers. SBNC addresses this gap by partnering with organizations across the country to implement peer-led outreach programs and deploy Navvy, SBNC’s AI-enabled technology platform that screens students for benefits eligibility and supports the enrollment process.

Since launching in 2020, SBNC has grown rapidly. The organization now partners with 100+ campuses nationwide, has screened more than 50,000 students, and has referred students to over $116 million in potential public benefits. In 2024, SBNC hired its first full-time Executive Director and has since grown to a $2 million organization with a team of seven, expanding to ten staff members this year as it scales its national model.

Position Overview:

SBNC is hiring its first Chief Growth Officer (CGO) to turn strong demand and a growing national network into a repeatable growth and earned-revenue model. We already work with 100+ campuses and regularly hear interest from colleges, systems, states, funders, and other partners, but we have not yet built a sales engine or established pricing for our offerings. The CGO will help determine which institutional segments to prioritize, how to position and package our work, what institutions are willing to pay for, and how to move from interest and pilots to recurring paid partnerships. They will work closely with the Executive Director on SBNC’s highest-priority sales and relationships while building the systems, pipeline, and team needed to make growth increasingly repeatable. This role does not own fundraising; the CGO coordinates with the Executive Director so growth, partner, and funder messaging stay aligned.

The CGO will also lead SBNC's marketing, building our brand and positioning with institutional buyers while owning our direct-to-student and alternative distribution strategy. That includes deciding where investments in digital channels, creator partnerships, and non-campus partners such as national nonprofits, food banks, and workforce programs can most effectively connect students to Navvy. Direct-to-student channels are measured on reach and impact; earned revenue comes from institutional partnerships.

Growth doesn't end at a signed agreement. The CGO will own renewal and expansion, build a partner-success model that sets new partners up to launch well, and close the loop between the field and product so partner and student insights shape how Navvy evolves.

This is a player-coach role for someone who can move between strategy and execution: shaping go-to-market and pricing, personally advancing important partnerships, using data to decide where to invest, developing staff, and working closely with product and the executive team as SBNC scales. The ideal candidate's deepest strength will be institutional sales and partnerships, paired with the judgment to lead marketing and use data to test which channels best reach students.

Responsibilities

Growth Strategy & Leadership (15%)

  • Set SBNC's growth and marketing strategy across institutional and direct-to-student channels, identifying priority markets, segments, and distribution opportunities based on data, partner feedback, and org positioning
  • Achieve targets for Navvy screener adoption, partnerships, and revenue, reporting performance to the executive team, funders, and board on a regular cadence
  • Own and evolve SBNC’s go-to-market strategy for paid offerings, including market research, customer segmentation, positioning, packaging, pricing, pilot design, sales motion, and testing what institutions will pay for
  • Manage, lead and build the growth function over time, including defining roles, systems, processes, developing staff, and planning future hiring needs as the team expands

Business Development & Earned Revenue (40%)

  • Build and manage a strong, nationwide pipeline of campus, state, system, and other institutional partners
  • Lead partnership development and sales strategy from initial outreach through negotiation, close, and implementation, with direct personal ownership of the organization's highest-stakes system and state-level relationships and managerial oversight of all partnerships
  • Use Hubspot CRM data and forecasting to drive pipeline visibility and data-informed decisions across the growth team
  • Diversify and scale SBNC's earned-revenue base so it grows alongside philanthropic revenue, ensuring pricing and packaging decisions preserve equitable student access as well as organizational sustainability
  • Hold accountability for the earned-revenue P&L, setting annual and multi-year targets in partnership with the COO

Partner Success & Field Learning (25%)

  • Build a scalable partner-success model, ensuring new partners launch successfully with the support, tools, and expectations needed to drive student and staff engagement
  • Own renewal and expansion strategy and targets, identifying opportunities to deepen relationships, improve retention, and grow revenue over time
  • Partner closely with the Chief Product Officer to ensure Navvy is delivered effectively to campuses/partners, owning the feedback loop so partner and student experience insights inform product development
  • Sponsor and sustain the growth team's community of practice among institutional partners, translating field learnings into documented, replicable practices that inform SBNC's tiered engagement model and go-to-market approach
  • Track partner satisfaction and account status as core success measures

Marketing & Direct-to-Student Reach (20%)

  • Lead demand generation, brand awareness, and growth marketing efforts, managing contractors and external partners as budget allows
  • Build SBNC's brand and positioning with institutional buyers through case studies, conference presence, thought leadership, and sales enablement materials that support pipeline growth
  • Own SBNC's direct-to-student reach strategy, testing channels such as creator partnerships, social, search, and referral to connect students not served through campus partners
  • Build non-campus distribution partnerships (e.g., national nonprofits, food banks, workforce programs) that embed Navvy where students already seek help
  • Run a structured channel-testing portfolio with clear hypotheses, success thresholds, and stop criteria, scaling what works and sunsetting what doesn't
  • Track reach and efficiency metrics (completed screenings, cost per completed screening, downstream benefit applications)

Skills and Competencies

We recognize that some individuals from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don't meet 100% of the listed qualifications. Please don't let that discourage you from applying! We value the unique skills, experiences, and perspectives that each applicant brings, and we encourage you to apply if you believe your background demonstrates the required skills and competencies.

Required for all Roles at SBNC:

  • Commitment to SBNC's mission to help postsecondary students connect to the resources they need to stay enrolled, complete their education, and build a foundation for economic mobility.
  • Treating students as co-designers, not only people we serve, and prioritizing those facing the greatest barriers first, true to our value of Lead With Students.
  • Resourcefulness and a sense of urgency in removing friction between students and the benefits they qualify for, while maintaining a high bar for quality and follow-through, our value of Unlock Every Dollar.
  • A commitment to Design for Scale by thinking a step ahead of where the organization is today, prioritizing what matters most, and building for the next campus, policy shift, or student barrier before it arrives.
  • Comfort wearing multiple hats, Owning the Outcome, asking for help when stuck, and showing up for teammates when it counts. A startup mentality.
  • Treating growth and innovation as an ongoing habit and leaning on the team to Learn Together by seeking feedback, sharing it openly, and adapting when needed.

Required for this Role:

  • Functional or executive-level leadership experience with 7+ years of management experience, including significant experience leading growth, partnerships, business development, sales, or a related function, while remaining willing and able to perform individual-contributor-level work
  • Personally owned and drove at least $500K in annual recurring revenue from higher education institutions, government agencies, systems, or similarly complex institutional buyers

The Opportunity:

The Contract Analyst – Government Contracts is responsible for administering, coordinating, and supporting VWR’s government contract programs, with a focus on contract administrative efforts for major federal and state contract vehicles, including NASPO and DLA eCAT. This role ensures contractual requirements are monitored, reported, and executed in alignment with customer obligations, internal policies, and compliance expectations. The Contract Analyst partners closely with Sales, Bids/Quotes, Pricing, Legal, Government Contracts leadership, and external customers to support contract performance, issue resolution, reporting accuracy, and continuous process improvement.


The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing time-sensitive contract administration activities in a fast-paced environment. This individual must be able to operate independently within defined business objectives while maintaining strong communication with internal stakeholders and government customers.

How you will thrive and create an impact


  • Manage contract administrative efforts for assigned government contracts, including NASPO and DLA eCAT, ensuring contract requirements are executed accurately, timely, and in compliance with customer obligations.
  • Take ownership of contract compliance issues by performing and communicating root-cause analysis to management and successfully implementing corrective action plans in collaboration with internal and external partners and customers.
  • Perform analysis and complete reporting functions for assigned government customers, including customer-specific reporting, fee requirements, and contract performance tracking.
  • Perform contract modifications and administrative actions on assigned government contracts, including completion and maintenance of customer pricing files.
  • Proactively recommend tools, policies, and processes that enhance government customer performance, contract compliance, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency; assist in developing, auditing, and implementing such functionality.
  • Provide supporting analytics to Sales leadership and the Government Contracts Manager to improve government customer growth, profitability, and performance across major federal and state contracts.
  • Partner with Sales and Bids/Quotes teams to implement new agreements and ensure all aspects of contractual requirements are delivered to the customer.
  • Train and assist internal partners to ensure customer reporting, administrative fee requirements, and other contract obligations are maintained and executed in compliance with VWR’s contracts.
  • Proactively manage and measure assigned accounts against departmental metrics to drive business support, process improvement, and accountability.
  • Maintain effective communication with internal stakeholders and external government customers regarding contract requirements, reporting obligations, pricing files, timelines, and administrative actions.

  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of Government Contracts administration and operational excellence.

  • Ability to analyze data, prepare reports, maintain pricing files, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to navigate and effectively communicate with internal partners and external customers, including government customer contacts.
  • Ability to prioritize work and manage extremely time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Ability to understand and comply with internal policies, contract terms, customer requirements, and reporting obligations.

  • Customer-focused approach with the ability to balance service, compliance, risk management, and business needs.

Remote

Adventist HealthCare seeks to hire a Clinical Documentation Specialist who will embrace our mission to extend God’s care through the ministry of physical, mental and spiritual healing.

As a Clinical Documentation Specialist you will:
• Examine medical records to ensure documentation is accurate, complete, and reflective of the patient’s clinical status.

• Verify that clinical documentation supports correct ICD-10-CM/PCS and CPT coding for proper reimbursement and collaborates with the coding/revenue cycle team.
• Ensure that documentation and provider queries align with regulatory standards, including CMS guidelines and organizational policies.
• Communicates and establishes relationships with physicians and clinical staff to share insights, trends and education to improve documentation practices.
• Contributes to organizational quality improvement initiates by ensuring robust and accurate documentation related to MHACs, PPCs, PSIs, SOI/ROM and mortality.
• Track and report on metrics related to documentation quality, such as query response rates or documentation accuracy.
• Provide guidance and education on documentation best practices and standards to physician and clinical staff to support ongoing improvement.
• Assist in internal and external audits by ensuring proper documentation and addressing identified issues.
• Maintains and enhances current medical, coding and CDI knowledge via participating in continuing education offerings.

Education and Experience:

•Doctor of Medicine (MD), Doctor of Osteopathy (DO), Foreign Medical Graduate (FMG), Registered Nurse (RN), Pharmacist, Doctor of Physical Therapy
•RHIA, RHIT, or related clinical/allied health degree
•Minimum of 5 years inpatient clinical experience

•Experience with ICD-10-CM/PCS, DRGs, SOI/ROM or HCC is a plus
•Lean Six Sigma Green belt preferred
•Solventum360 preferred
•CCDS (Certified Clinical Documentation Specialist), CDIP (Clinical Documentation Improvement Practitioner) or equivalent required or within 90 days

•Certified Documentation Expert Inpatient (CDEI)

Adventist HealthCare strongly recommends all applicants to be fully vaccinated for COVID-19 before commencing employment. Applicants may be required to furnish proof of vaccination.

Tobacco and Drug Statement

Tobacco use is a well-recognized preventable cause of death in the United States and an important public health issue. In order to promote and maintain a healthy work environment, Adventist HealthCare will not hire applicants for employment who either state that they are nicotine users or who test positive for nicotine and drug use.

While some jurisdictions, including Maryland, permit the use of marijuana for medical purposes, marijuana continues to be classified as an illegal drug under the federal Controlled Substances Act. As a result, medical marijuana use will not be accepted as a valid explanation for a positive drug test result.

Adventist HealthCare will withdraw offers of employment to applicants who test positive for Cotinine (nicotine) and marijuana. Those testing positive are given the opportunity to re-apply in 90 days, if they can truthfully attest that they have not used any nicotine products in the past ninety (90) days and successfully pass follow-up testing. ("Nicotine products" include, but are not limited to: cigarettes, cigars, pipes, chewing tobacco, e-cigarettes, vaping products, hookah, and nicotine replacement products (e.g., nicotine gum, nicotine patches, nicotine lozenges, etc.).

You’ll make sure the service is available, secure and performant as you strive to continuously improve it.

  • Familiarity with Claude Cowork, or strong willingness and aptitude to learn it quickly, as AI fluency is expected

  • Experience supporting social event planning or community hosting
  • Familiarity with managing shared documentation systems or knowledge bases

Work Schedule

  • This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work
  • Availability during US Pacific Time business hours

Compensation & Time Off

  • Compensation paid in USD
  • Paid bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th
  • Paid Time Off according to company policy
  • Holidays observed according to company guidelines

Application Requirements

Please submit:

  • An updated resume

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

jobs.excerpt: About UsSeismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue.
jobs.description:
About Us

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview

Seismic is going through one of the most significant product transformations in its history. We're bringing together two leading enablement platforms. We're building a next-generation, AI-driven platform on a headless architecture. And we're expanding into compliance-focused capabilities for the most regulated industries in the world.

The Product Transformation & Strategy team makes sure those changes land well for customers and for the business. As a Senior Product Transformation Lead, an individual contributor role, you'll connect what customers need with what Product & Engineering builds. You'll turn what our go-to-market teams see in the field into structured insight, design programs that help customers move to new platform capabilities with confidence, and give executives the data they need to make better decisions.

This role isn't customer-facing, but it's built for someone who has been. You know how customers use enablement platforms day to day, what makes them adopt something new and what blocks them. You'll bring that perspective into how we plan, prioritize and roll out product change.

You'll start by helping us move from feature-by-feature gap analysis to a strategic, theme-based approach to platform transition. Over time, your scope will grow into the broader transformation of Seismic's product and operating model.

Who you are:

Required

  • 7+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as Technical Account Manager, Implementation Manager, Solution Consultant, Solutions Engineer or Solutions Architect, ideally at a B2B SaaS company. Some of that experience should include program, strategy or operations work.
  • Deep expertise in enablement platforms, and an understanding of how enterprise customers configure, adopt and get value from them.
  • A track record of designing and launching new programs or processes from scratch, including the change management needed for adoption.
  • Proven ability to influence without authority, and to manage stakeholders with competing priorities and strong opinions.
  • Confidence communicating with and presenting to VP and executive audiences.
  • Strong analytical skills, and comfort pulling, combining and interpreting data from multiple systems (for example Salesforce, Snowflake or Jira).
  • A working understanding of how software is built and shipped, including release cycles, sprints and launch gates.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in your daily work, and an interest in building automations that remove manual effort.
  • Strategic thinking: you can step back from individual requests to see patterns and themes, and then turn them into an actionable plan.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with the Seismic and/or Highspot platforms.
  • Experience building scoring models, health scores or segmentation frameworks for customer or product decisions.
  • A background in human-centered design, service design or process design.
  • Experience supporting a major platform migration, product consolidation or replatforming initiative.
  • Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services or life sciences, and their compliance needs.
  • Experience building Slack workflows, bots or other lightweight internal tooling.

Who thrives here

  • You're energized by ambiguity and enjoy building structure where none exists.
  • You can earn credibility quickly with both a customer-facing VP and an engineering lead.
  • You're pragmatic. You'd rather ship a useful version one and iterate than wait for something perfect.
  • You care about the humans on both sides of the process: the customer adopting change and the internal teams making it happen.

What you'll be doing:

Build and own the customer fit and readiness model

  • Design a customer fit score from scratch. It will assess each customer's readiness for new platform capabilities, using product usage, CRM, support and feature request data.
  • Operationalize it so that Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Implementation, executives and our Transition Center of Excellence use it every week to decide where to focus.
  • Keep improving the model as the product and customer base change, and tie it to measurable business outcomes.

Shift from tactical gap analysis to strategic themes

  • Find recurring customer themes and transition blockers, and organize the work by product area (for example content, then engagement) instead of feature by feature.
  • Turn customer signals into clear, prioritized input for product roadmaps, so that a meaningful share of the roadmap reflects the voice of the customer.

Design programs from the ground up

  • Create new programs end to end: the systems, mechanics, incentives, buy-in strategy and change management.
  • Fit processes into how field and product teams already work, with empathy for both sides.

Lead cross-functional alignment

  • Bring together Product Management, Engineering, Product Operations, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Technical Account Management and Account Executives around shared priorities.
  • Mediate when go-to-market and product teams disagree, find workable compromises and drive decisions forward.
  • Present recommendations and progress to VP and executive leaders across Product, Engineering and go-to-market.

Use data and AI as force multipliers

  • Pull and analyze data from disparate systems (Salesforce, Snowflake, Jira and others) and connect the work back to business impact.
  • Use AI tools as a day-to-day coworker. For example, use them to pull insights from customer call recordings, cluster feature requests into themes, and build skills and automations (such as Slackbots) that scale the team's reach.
  • Keep up with AI and industry trends, and bring new approaches to the team.

Job Posting Footer

jobs.description:
ORDERYOYO – Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer

Remote · Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices

Join OrderYOYO’s Data team to build the data pipelines and lakehouse that power executive reporting and merchant insights across our platform, and automate how we deliver finance data and AI-driven data products to the rest of the business.

You’ll own complex changes from technical design through release and production operation, working closely with the leadership team, Finance, Product and fellow engineers. Your work will improve the accuracy and reliability of our reporting, merchant insights and finance data, while reducing routine manual Finance work.

Our data platform runs in a Microsoft Azure cloud environment, and we’re moving it to Microsoft Fabric. We value transferable experience: strong Azure Databricks or Synapse engineers who can quickly develop deep Fabric expertise are encouraged to apply. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure architecture, BI or people-management position, and you’ll regularly design, code, troubleshoot and operate production data solutions.

Role Mission

Build and evolve OrderYOYO’s data platform into a single source of truth for executive reporting, merchant insights, finance automation and AI, leading the move to a modern Microsoft Fabric lakehouse. You’ll help strengthen the reliability and quality of our data in production while building AI into how we deliver data products and supporting our growing international restaurant platform.

Core responsibilities

•Design, build and operate production-grade data solutions in Microsoft Fabric across Lakehouse, Warehouse, notebooks, pipelines and related platform capabilities.

•Build and run production pipelines in Fabric, Python and PySpark that are tested and maintainable, not just notebooks.

•Design ingestion and transformation patterns that scale across multiple source systems, databases and business domains while controlling source impact, concurrency and platform cost.

•Manage Fabric capacity and cost, and retire redundant legacy layers.

•Lead migrations from legacy to modern platforms with metric parity, stakeholder sign-off, change control and safe decommissioning.

•Run the platform in production: monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root-cause analysis, data-quality checks, lineage and runbooks.

•Diagnose and resolve production issues across SQL, Spark, pipelines and semantic models, including performance degradation, data failures and capacity/resource constraints.

•Support and evolve governed semantic models and reusable metric definitions, working closely with analytics and business stakeholders to ensure performance, consistency and reliability.

•Build AI into the platform and our delivery: RAG, Azure OpenAI and agents, with prompt and version management.

•Deliver applied data science such as churn, recommendations, personalisation, fraud or risk models, and show the results.

•Work with executives, Finance, Product and engineering, and judge when to move fast, standardise, automate or hold.

Must-have requirements

•6+ years of relevant data experience, including substantial recent hands-on data engineering or data-platform engineering responsibility in production environments.

•Demonstrated ability to independently take a data-engineering problem from requirements and technical design through implementation, production deployment, monitoring and ongoing operation.

•Deep hands-on Microsoft Fabric, or strong Synapse, Databricks or Delta experience with a clear path to Fabric.

•Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture and Delta-based data engineering, including partitioning, schema evolution, file optimisation and performance considerations.

•Expert SQL and T-SQL, including complex modelling and tuning.

•Production-grade Python or PySpark.

•Strong experience designing and implementing incremental data ingestion patterns, including approaches such as CDC, change tracking or watermarks, with reliable merge/upsert, replay and idempotent processing.

•Experience with analytical and semantic data modelling, ideally with Power BI/Fabric semantic models, including performance optimisation, governance and reusable business metrics.

•Working knowledge of Azure platform fundamentals including Azure SQL, ADLS/OneLake, Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC and Key Vault.

•A track record of leading a legacy-to-modern migration.

•Real, hands-on AI engineering beyond out-of-the-box Copilot.

•Concrete data science or ML models you delivered, with results.

Strong-to-have experience

•Strong Power BI/Fabric experience, including Direct Lake, DAX, semantic model performance tuning, incremental refresh and capacity considerations.

•Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform, Bicep or equivalent tooling.

•Data platform experience in SaaS, marketplace, fintech, payments, e-commerce or multi-region businesses.

Who We Are

At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. We look for engineers who take ownership, raise risks early, explain decisions clearly, collaborate respectfully and follow through on commitments.

Our values describe what that looks like day to day:

  • Passion: Adaptable and positive in a fast-moving environment, proactive about improving how things work.

  • Action: Leads by example and takes the initiative rather than waiting to be asked.

  • Compassion: Supports colleagues and considers the impact of decisions on merchants and teammates.

  • One Team: Communicates clearly in writing and in person, stays calm under pressure and shares information openly.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

What we offer

•A salary of up to £80,000 per year (or local equivalent).

•A remote role, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.

•Ownership of a business-critical data and AI platform.

•A collaborative, international engineering team.

jobs.title: Recruiter for European Roles – Afternoon Hours, No Night Shift (Commission) – An
jobs.excerpt: European roles, your afternoon hours.  No night shift.
jobs.description:
European roles, your afternoon hours. No night shift. If you recruit for foreign clients from the Philippines, this is the same game, paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Angeles City and across the Philippines.

Please read the whole post before applying. It's long on purpose. If it isn't for you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. For proven partners, things grow with your results, agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • You can reach us directly with any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

Role: Outbound Sales Specialist

Reports to: India BU Lead

Location: Remote/Hybrid working (India-based).

We are currently a remote-first organisation, but hybrid working may be an option in the future.

Salary: Up to INR 18,00,000 depending on experience, plus equity

Hours: Full-Time 9.30am-6.30pm IST

A note about recruitment at Vestd

We recognise how challenging the job market can be for candidates, and at Vestd we strive to provide a positive candidate experience. If you are interested in this opportunity, we kindly request that your application and all communication go through official application channels. Apply via our website careers page, other job site or LinkedIn, as opposed to sending the team individual emails or LinkedIn direct messages. We want each candidate to be considered fairly, and for everyone who applies to receives a consistent experience.

Contacting Vestd employees via email, personal social media, or other informal routes is not appropriate. We also have a zero-tolerance approach to any form of harassment or abuse directed at our team. Candidates who do not respect these boundaries may be disqualified from the recruitment process and, in serious cases, barred from applying in future.

About Vestd

Vestd is a leading sharetech platform for equity management - shares schemes, fund raising, company secretarial and much more.

Our regulated platform makes light work of all of the most popular and tax-efficient share scheme types, empowering businesses to attract and retain their talent. Our powerful software also helps investors, and founders seeking investment.

Vestd was founded by Ifty Nasir, who lives and breathes our mission. Vestd’s big moonshot aim is to see one billion people worldwide invested in the companies they work hard to grow by 2030. We are all about inclusion and fairness for our customers and our team.

Vestd is also a B Corp-certified company, which means we’re committed to balancing profit with purpose. We care about our people, our customers, and the wider world – and we hold ourselves to the highest social and environmental standards.

If you’d like to learn more about Vestd, check out this short video from our founder, Ifty.

Requirements

The role

We are looking for individuals who are not only passionate about our mission but also comfortable and confident using cutting-edge technologies and AI tools, to streamline processes, drive innovation, and contribute to the growth of Vestd.

Responsible for driving outbound lead generation through proactive prospecting and cold calling potential customers. The role involves identifying and reaching out to prospective businesses, initiating conversations, qualifying leads, generating interest in Vestd's solutions, and converting these interactions into qualified meetings and product demos for the sales team. The individual will own the top of the sales funnel, with clear targets around outbound activity, qualified meetings booked, and leads generated.

What success looks like in year one

Success in this role will be measured by consistent outbound activity, the ability to generate a healthy pipeline of qualified leads, and converting cold outreach into meaningful business conversations. The individual should consistently meet monthly targets for calls, prospect engagement, qualified meetings and demos booked, ultimately contributing to new customer acquisition and revenue growth for the business.

What you’ll own

  • Outbound Prospecting: Proactively identify and reach out to potential customers through cold calling, email and other outbound channels to generate interest.
  • Lead Generation & Qualification: Build a strong pipeline of qualified leads by understanding prospect requirements, assessing fit and creating opportunities for the sales team.
  • Meeting & Demo Conversion: Own the responsibility of converting outbound conversations into qualified meetings and product demos, consistently achieving weekly and monthly targets.

What we’re looking for

Essential elements of this role

We cannot provide an exhaustive list of duties; additional duties may arise, but these will be core elements of this role.

  • 8+ yrs of SDR or Sales experience (of which 5+ yrs in B2B business).
  • Experience using Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot or similar prospecting tools.
  • Impeccable attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • You must be comfortable with working in a remote-first environment

Nice to have

These will help you stand out from the pack:

  • Experience selling B2B SaaS, HRTech, FinTech or compliance-related products.
  • Understanding of startup ecosystems, ESOPs, equity management or fundraising.
  • Experience working with a defined ICP and running structured outbound campaigns.

Culture fit

What makes Vestd folk collaborative, adaptable, and eager to grow?

  • Thrives in a startup environment, ready to tackle diverse challenges with enthusiasm
  • Adaptable - open to taking on responsibilities beyond the defined role as needed
  • Passionate about contributing to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Embraces technology to improve processes and drive efficiency

While the above describes the core responsibilities, this role may from time to time involve tasks beyond this list — as needed to respond to evolving business needs.

Benefits

What you can expect

Our culture is our backbone (BreatheHR named us one of the ‘Top 3 Companies in the UK for Company Culture’), and we take team happiness seriously.

Vestd strives to be as principled as possible. We’re all about Goal 8 of the United Nations ‘Sustainable Development Goals. This goal is about ‘Decent work and economic growth,’ and we consider it both with our external activities and internal workings.

We’ll do everything we can to help you grow in your role. In return, you’ll want to learn all about our industry and do all you can to help us continue leading it.

Vestd is remote-first, so in return for your commitment, diligence, and productivity, you’ll have a lot of autonomy during your working day. Some roles demand office hours (to fit our customers’ schedules), but we are committed to offering flexibility where possible.

Happy employees make for happy customers, as demonstrated in our five-star reviews. Vestd’s excellence has also been recognised by The Europas, The Fintech Awards London, The Hustle Awards, TechRound, and BusinessCloud’s Fintech50. See more about our awards here.

This could be the perfect opportunity if you’re an autonomous, self-driven individual passionate about contributing to a meaningful mission and value being part of a supportive, close-knit team.

Why work at Vestd?

Vestd is a great place to work. There are a range of benefits that you can look forward to as one of our folk (benefits vary depending on location):

  • This job is remote-first, although attendance is required twice yearly at our in-person get-togethers
  • A flexible environment to help you achieve the best work/life balance
  • An Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), of course! (After the qualifying period)
  • Monthly recognition scheme, where we celebrate our folk
  • Support with home working equipment*
  • A personal training and development budget to keep your career and professional growth on track
  • Private medical insurance (after the qualifying period)
  • Team retreats are held twice a year. They can include an overnight stay and focus on fun and team cohesion
  • Great team ethos, connect through regular team and company socials
  • 25 days annual leave plus one extra day per year of service (up to five days)

We’re looking for somebody with initiative who can focus on the business and their personal growth path. This is a great time to join our team, and it would be a superb role for the right person.

*At Vestd we provide our folk with the hardware and software required to support them in their role. As a remote-first business, we expect anyone applying for a job to have a suitable, quiet working space. You must have an appropriate desk/table and chair, with a reliable internet connection.

Equality, diversity and inclusion (EDI) at Vestd

At Vestd, we’re committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and diverse team. Trust is one of our core values; with that comes a commitment to fairness and transparency. We want to be open about our EDI efforts.

We wish to recruit people who are passionate about working in a diverse environment and who will support us to ensure that all colleagues are supported and included while working with us.

Research shows that while men are likely to apply when they meet 60% of a job’s requirements, women and individuals from underrepresented groups often apply only when they meet every criterion.

We understand the value of transferable skills and the unique perspectives that diversity brings. That’s why we encourage applications from candidates with unique strengths and experiences.


Our application process

We are accepting rolling applications for this role with no fixed end date - if you are interested in joining the Vestd folk, please apply when you can. We will respond to every applicant, but we may only screen some candidates depending on the number of applications received.

Our recruitment pipeline has a few stages, giving you plenty of opportunities to learn about Vestd as we take the time to find someone who is the best fit for the role. We aim to complete the selection process as efficiently as possible, and we are committed to making our candidate experience as inclusive as we can, so please get in touch with us if you require any information or support during the application process or need to ask for any adjustments.

A typical selection process might be:

  • Apply online
  • 20-minute screening call
  • 45-minute interview with the hiring manager and team member
  • Task-based assignment
  • 45-minute team cultural interview
  • 30-minute interview with the CEO

How we review applications

Some roles include questions about essential requirements, and applications that don’t meet them may be closed automatically. All other applications are reviewed by a member of our People Team, who may use AI to help review CVs against the role requirements. AI never makes a recruitment decision. If you’d like a person to review a closed application, or need a reasonable adjustment, contact us at . You can read more in our Recruitment Principles and Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Please note that we record our interviews. These recordings are only viewed by the hiring team and no later than once a role is filled, all recordings are deleted. We do not share any candidate information with anyone outside of Vestd at any time.

If you need any adjustments or support with your application, please let us know.

We are excited to receive your application.

When a role is filled, we will contact all other applicants to let them know.

This job is remote-first within India. You must be primarily India-based and eligible to work in the country.

You will create shared definitions, clarify ownership, and build adoption across functions. In partnership with Product, Technology, Marketing, Retail, Operations, Finance, Information Security, and business leaders, you will move quickly from strategy to execution and business value.

You will create an operating model that pairs enterprise standards with clear business ownership and fast, cross-functional delivery. Business teams will continue to own how data is defined and used, while delivery partners remain accountable for execution. jobs.excerpt: Recruit for Europe from home, paid in euros per placement.
jobs.description:
Recruit for Europe from home, paid in euros per placement. Your own hours, your own methods. Open to recruiters based in Buenos Aires and across Argentina.

Read all of this before you apply. It's long on purpose. If this isn't you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. Everything grows with your results, for proven partners and agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • Direct contact with us whenever you have a question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryThe Technical Support Engineer L1 - Strategic Accounts serves as a dedicated technical support resource for DeepHealth's strategic and high-value customer accounts, providing advanced troubleshooting, incident resolution, and proactive technical assistance to ensure a seamless healthcare IT experience.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Technical Support Engineer L1 - Strategic Accounts serves as a dedicated technical support resource for DeepHealth's strategic and high-value customer accounts, providing advanced troubleshooting, incident resolution, and proactive technical assistance to ensure a seamless healthcare IT experience. This role works closely with the Strategic Accounts Team (SAT) Lead, internal technical teams, and customer stakeholders to resolve complex technical issues, maintain high service quality, and support the operational stability of customer environments. The Technical Support Engineer L1 - Strategic Accounts is responsible for delivering white-glove technical support, maintaining strong customer relationships, managing assigned support cases, and ensuring timely communication and resolution of technical issues affecting strategic accounts. This position plays a critical role in supporting customer satisfaction, improving operational efficiency, and ensuring the reliable performance of DeepHealth's healthcare IT solutions.

Candidate must sit in Mountain or Pacific Time

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Strategic Account Support and Customer Service

  • Serve as a dedicated technical support resource for assigned strategic and high-value customer accounts.

  • Provide white-glove technical support, ensuring responsive, professional, and personalized service to strategic customers.

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with customer IT personnel, clinical users, system administrators, and other key stakeholders.

  • Respond to customer inquiries through phone, email, and ticketing systems in a timely and professional manner.

  • Take ownership of assigned customer issues from initial investigation through resolution, maintaining consistent communication throughout the support lifecycle.

  • Provide proactive customer updates regarding incident status, troubleshooting progress, expected next steps, and resolution.

  • Identify potential technical risks or recurring issues and communicate findings to the SAT Lead for further review and mitigation.

  • Participate in scheduled customer meetings, technical discussions, and incident reviews as needed.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of assigned customer environments, workflows, configurations, and operational requirements.

  • Ensure customer issues are addressed in accordance with established service-level agreements (SLAs), support procedures, and escalation guidelines.

  • Support customer satisfaction and retention through dependable technical service and effective issue resolution.

Technical Support and Troubleshooting

  • Provide advanced technical support for PACS, RIS, and related healthcare IT applications.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues involving application functionality, system performance, networking, databases, integrations, and infrastructure.

  • Investigate escalated technical incidents involving PACS/RIS systems, DICOM communications, HL7 interfaces, EMR integrations, and other healthcare technologies.

  • Analyze application logs, system events, database information, and monitoring tools to identify potential causes of technical issues.

  • Perform troubleshooting across Windows and Linux operating environments.

  • Assist with diagnosing and resolving issues involving SQL databases, application servers, network connectivity, and system integrations.

  • Support applications and integrations hosted in public cloud environments.

  • Perform approved system maintenance, application updates, upgrades, patches, and configuration changes.

  • Assist with troubleshooting system performance degradation, application errors, service interruptions, and connectivity issues.

  • Validate system functionality following maintenance activities, configuration changes, and incident resolution.

  • Escalate unresolved or complex technical issues to the appropriate internal teams while providing complete troubleshooting documentation and supporting evidence.

Incident Management and Escalation Coordination

  • Monitor assigned support tickets and customer incidents to ensure timely investigation and resolution.

  • Prioritize assigned incidents based on severity, customer impact, operational urgency, and established SLA requirements.

  • Follow established incident management and escalation procedures.

  • Coordinate with PACS, RIS, Interoperability, Engineering, Infrastructure, and other technical teams to resolve customer issues.

  • Ensure escalations include documented troubleshooting steps, relevant logs, error messages, system information, and examples necessary for further investigation.

  • Maintain ownership of customer communication and follow-up throughout the escalation process.

  • Provide regular updates to the SAT Lead regarding critical incidents, recurring problems, customer concerns, and potential service risks.

  • Assist with incident investigations, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews.

  • Participate in critical incident response and service restoration activities as required.

  • Track assigned escalations through resolution and confirm that appropriate customer follow-up has been completed.

  • Identify recurring incidents and recommend preventive measures or technical improvements.

Technical Documentation and Process Improvement

  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of customer incidents, troubleshooting activities, resolutions, and system changes within the designated ticketing system.

  • Develop and update technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, knowledge base articles, and customer-specific support procedures.

  • Document recurring technical issues and known workarounds to improve troubleshooting efficiency.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives involving technical support processes, incident management, and customer service delivery.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline support workflows and improve issue resolution times.

  • Share technical knowledge, troubleshooting findings, and lessons learned with other support engineers.

  • Follow established documentation standards and internal operational procedures.

  • Assist with maintaining accurate customer environment information, including application versions, configurations, integrations, and infrastructure details.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Technical Projects

  • Collaborate with IT, Product, Engineering, Project Management, and Customer Success teams to support customer technical requirements.

  • Participate in customer healthcare IT projects, including system implementations, upgrades, migrations, integrations, and technical enhancements.

  • Assist with technical evaluations, testing, validation, and implementation of customer solutions.

  • Support technical troubleshooting and coordination during customer go-live activities.

  • Work with internal teams to investigate product defects, validate fixes, and communicate technical findings.

  • Assist with implementing and supporting solutions within public cloud environments and DeepHealth platforms.

  • Provide technical input and level-of-effort information for customer requests and proposed solutions as needed.

  • Participate in technical discussions involving customer infrastructure, workflows, system requirements, and integration dependencies.

  • Coordinate assigned technical tasks and provide progress updates to the SAT Lead and appropriate stakeholders.

Monitoring, Proactive Support, and Operational Readiness

  • Monitor assigned customer environments using available monitoring and diagnostic tools.

  • Review system alerts, application performance indicators, service availability, and operational health metrics.

  • Investigate abnormal system behavior, performance trends, and potential service disruptions.

  • Identify and communicate emerging technical risks before they result in significant customer impact.

  • Assist with validating monitoring alerts, escalation procedures, and incident response workflows.

  • Participate in scheduled maintenance activities and operational readiness checks.

  • Support proactive technical reviews of customer environments when requested.

  • Follow established procedures for documenting and communicating critical system events.

  • Participate in on-call rotations, after-hours support, and critical incident response as required.

Customer Training and Technical Guidance

  • Provide technical guidance to customer administrators, IT personnel, and service-level users.

  • Deliver product and service training to customers as needed.

  • Educate customers on system functionality, configuration options, troubleshooting procedures, and recommended best practices.

  • Assist customers in understanding technical workflows and system capabilities.

  • Provide clear explanations of technical issues and resolutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Support customer adoption of solutions through effective technical communication and assistance.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience (required).

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT support, technical troubleshooting, or related technical roles (required).

  • Experience supporting healthcare IT systems, preferably within radiology or medical imaging environments (required).

  • Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems (Windows 7 and above, Windows Server) (required).

  • Strong Linux system administration and command-line experience (required).

  • Experience with MSSQL database management and relational database technologies (required).

  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, troubleshooting, and infrastructure support (required).

  • Experience supporting PACS, RIS, DICOM, HL7, EMR, and other healthcare IT systems (required).

  • Proven experience troubleshooting complex software applications and healthcare technology solutions (required).

  • Experience with public cloud environments and cloud-based integrations (required).

  • Familiarity with scripting, data serialization, and reporting tools such as SSRS (required).

  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and critical problem-solving skills (required).

  • Experience using ticketing systems and ITIL-based support processes (required).

  • Strong customer service, relationship management, and technical support experience (required).

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences (required).

  • Ability to independently investigate and manage assigned technical issues while recognizing when escalation is necessary (required).

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under pressure (required).

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional technical and business teams (required).

  • Ability to provide professional and timely customer communication throughout the incident lifecycle (required).

  • Flexibility to work varied schedules and participate in on-call rotations as required (required).

  • Strong understanding of PC/server hardware platforms and general IT infrastructure (required).

  • Professional communication and interpersonal skills required for internal and external customer interactions (required).

  • Preferred: CCNA or CCNP certification.

  • Preferred: CompTIA Linux+, RHCA, or RHCT certification.

  • Preferred: Radiology workflow experience.

  • Preferred: Experience in healthcare or clinical IT environments.

  • Preferred: Advanced knowledge of healthcare imaging and workflow technologies.

  • Preferred: Experience supporting enterprise PACS/RIS environments.

  • Preferred: Experience supporting high-priority or strategic customer accounts.

  • Preferred: Familiarity with cloud-hosted healthcare applications and infrastructure.

  • Preferred: Experience with technical monitoring and alerting platforms.

  • Preferred: Experience participating in incident investigations and root cause analysis.

  • Preferred: Familiarity with customer-facing escalation management and SLA-driven support environments.

Quality Standards

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

  • Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.

  • Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

  • Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

  • Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

  • Practices universal safety precautions.

  • Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.

  • Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

  • Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

  • Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

  • Demonstrates accountability for assigned customer issues and technical responsibilities.

  • Maintains professional, timely, and accurate communication with customers and internal teams.

  • Follows established escalation procedures and communicates critical incidents to the SAT Lead.

  • Demonstrates a customer-focused approach to technical support and problem resolution.

Travel

This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%.

Working Environment

Remote

Salary:

$70,000-$80,000 USD

Run delivery operations and capacity
