jobs.excerpt: Multilingual recruiting for Europe, from home, paid in euros per placement.
jobs.description:
Multilingual recruiting for Europe, from home, paid in euros per placement. Open to recruiters based in Rabat and across Morocco.

Please read the whole post before applying. It's long on purpose. If it isn't for you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing is given up front. For proven partners, things grow with your results, agreed case by case:

  • Once you deliver, we cover tool costs such as monthly subscriptions.
  • Proven recruiters can get earlier payouts, arranged with you.
  • Consistent performers can earn a monthly base on top of commission.

The rules bend toward the people who prove themselves. This job gets better the more you deliver.

What you get from day one

  • Proper onboarding: we explain everything, the employers, the roles and how we work, and answer all your questions before you start, so you begin with confidence.
  • Full role details and answers to the questions candidates usually ask.
  • You can reach us directly with any question about a role or a candidate.
  • Total freedom over how, when and where you work.

What's realistic

  • The first weeks are about building your pipeline.
  • Once you're up and running, a below-average recruiter makes about 1 placement a month, a good recruiter 2–5, and our best recruiters 5–10. It gets easier over time: you build a pool of candidates to come back to, and people start recommending you.
  • We expect at least one placement a month once you're up and running.

How we choose

  1. You answer the questions below. We read every answer.
  2. If your answers are strong, we have a video call.
  3. If we're a fit, we onboard you.

Everyone starts with a 30-day trial. Show real progress in that month, with candidates submitted and in interviews, and you stay and grow. If not, we part ways with no hard feelings.

To apply, answer these questions

  1. Your numbers. How many placements have you made per month on average, and for which roles and countries? What was your best month?
  2. The task. We have a Dutch-speaking customer service role in Athens, and candidates must already be allowed to work in the EU. Where exactly would you find 5 of them within two weeks, and how? Name the real channels, groups or searches you'd use.
  3. Commission. Why do you prefer being paid per placement over a salary, or over how you've been paid before?
  4. Your setup. Which tools and channels do you use today? How many hours a week can you put in, and what else are you working on right now?

Apply here with your CV. Then email your answers to , with your name and country in the subject. Applications without answers aren't reviewed.

Optional: attach a voice note or video answering "Why should we pick you?" It's the quickest way for us to get to know you.

Be specific: numbers, names, real examples. Answers that sound AI-written, or that just say what you think we want to hear, are rejected.

  • Design event-driven, event-sourced microservices for a multi-tenant SaaS platform — from domain modeling through API contracts (GraphQL, including federated schemas, and REST) and data schemas.

  • Own services in production: instrument with metrics, logs, and traces (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana); lead root-cause analysis.
  • Deploy to Kubernetes via Helm and code-first CI/CD pipelines; keep services healthy through capacity planning and performance tuning.

jobs.title: Senior Integration Engineer
jobs.excerpt: This is a Remote Position.  US based role only.  No HB-1 Visa Support OUR VISIONEqus is a company building privacy-first AI, identity, and trust infrastructure for the agentic era.
jobs.description:
This is a Remote Position. US based role only. No HB-1 Visa Support

OUR VISION

Equs is a company building privacy-first AI, identity, and trust infrastructure for the agentic era. The digital world was built around platforms, not people. AI is rewriting what software can do, and we have a narrow window to make sure that future puts the individual at the center rather than further behind. We start from one conviction: your digital identity should belong to you, travel with you, and give you real agency in how you show up online. You set the rules, you hold the keys, and you benefit from your own data.

We are building toward that future across every layer it requires: the infrastructure that makes it possible, the standards that make it interoperable, and the experiences that bring it to life for the people who use it. We are early, and we are clear about what is built today and what is still ahead. The people who use what we build keep control of their own data, and we hold ourselves to that standard in everything we make.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

We’re taking the EQUS Developer Toolkit to organizations of all kinds, from banks and other regulated institutions to employers, education providers, public bodies and digital platforms, and every one of them needs someone technical on our side to get them live. This is our first dedicated integration hire and a hands-on, customer-facing role. You’ll be the technical lead for each customer from the first architecture call to the first credential in production: designing the solution, connecting their identity and back-end systems, and guiding them through security review. You’ll bring what you learn back into the product and the docs, and help shape how integration works as the team grows. You may be required to work on other EQUS products over time. Your day-to-day includes, but is not limited to:
  • Designing each customer’s solution, turning use cases such as KYC status, employee or student IDs, qualifications, age checks, membership and AI-agent payment mandates into a Developer Toolkit design (issuance and presentation flows, wallet model and build method) that the customer’s architects can sign off
  • Running technical onboarding, provisioning sandbox and production tenants, issuing client credentials, setting up Issuers, Verifiers and credential schemas with the customer, and enabling and tracking on-request features such as the Web Wallet, AP2 agent flows and quota increases
  • Connecting customer identity systems, guiding IAM teams through Bring Your Own IdP (OpenID Connect), Authorization Server registration and OAuth client-credentials setup in both directions
  • Getting back-end integrations live, specifying and reviewing each customer’s Attribute Provider endpoint and helping their engineers debug using request IDs, error codes and rate-limit headers
  • Supporting front-end teams as they embed our UI within strict security policies and allowed-origin rules, apply their branding, and enable the browser Digital Credentials API where devices support it
  • Leading EU Digital Identity Wallet readiness, from moving Verifiers to X.509 and securing registration certificates from national Registrars to configuring trusted roots
  • Owning the technical side of security and procurement, answering due-diligence questionnaires and joining security reviews using our data-handling, encryption, DPA and TOMs documentation
  • Supporting business development in technical sales conversations, helping prospective customers understand what an integration involves and helping us close our first deals
  • Acting as the customer’s voice to product, logging and prioritizing the gaps that block deals and working with our engineering team and partners on fixes
  • Making every integration faster than the last, writing quickstarts, help-center articles, sample code and a reusable customer integration pack with sector variants, including a flow decision tree, security answers and a go-live checklist

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED

You combine deep technical skill with real empathy for customers, and you’re as comfortable with a bank’s IAM team as with a startup’s two developers. You’re fluent in OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect and can work out why a token is rejected, you can read an OpenAPI spec and write enough back-end code to build sample integrations, and you understand PKI well enough to untangle a certificate chain. You write clearly, whether it’s an integration design, a security answer or public documentation. You are comfortable with ambiguity, because parts of our product are still being built and you’ll design around the roadmap. You are self-directed in a remote setting, managing your own time and keeping several customer integrations moving at once.

YOUR EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

This role calls for 4 or more years in a customer-facing technical role such as solutions engineer, integration engineer or technical consultant for an API or identity product. You’ve personally taken enterprise customers from pilot to production, ideally in regulated or security-conscious sectors such as banking, insurance, government, healthcare or education, including security reviews and vendor due diligence. You bring hands-on experience with REST APIs and at least one back-end language (TypeScript/Node, Java/Kotlin or Python), and a working understanding of X.509 certificates, trust anchors and key management. Experience with verifiable credentials and digital identity standards (OID4VCI, OID4VP, SD-JWT VC, ISO 18013-5 mdoc), eIDAS 2.0 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet ecosystem, enterprise identity providers such as Microsoft Entra, Okta or Ping, and payments, open banking or agentic-payment protocols like AP2 are all a plus.

  • Build the funding pipeline: Track opportunities, applications and decisions, prioritising activity according to potential value and likelihood of success.
  • Develop relationships: Build and maintain relationships with funders and explore opportunities for repeat funding, multi-year awards and longer-term partnerships.
  • Communicate our impact: Work with colleagues to gather evidence and develop persuasive funding propositions that demonstrate the value of our work.
  • Manage funding and reporting: Monitor income against targets, maintain accurate records and ensure funder reporting requirements and deadlines are met.
  • Explore new income streams: Identify potential opportunities for corporate partnerships, major donors and other forms of philanthropic support.
  • Work collaboratively: Coordinate with colleagues across the organisation to identify funding opportunities and ensure fundraising activity supports our wider priorities.

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with fundraising experience, excellent writing skills and the initiative to identify opportunities and turn them into income.

You will bring:

  • Fundraising experience: A track record of researching, developing and submitting successful funding applications, ideally to trusts, foundations or statutory funding bodies.
  • Excellent writing skills: The ability to produce clear, persuasive applications and make a compelling case for support.
  • Initiative: The ability to research prospective funders, spot opportunities and build a pipeline proactively.
  • Relationship-building skills: The confidence to engage with funders, understand their priorities and develop productive relationships.
  • Commercial awareness: The ability to assess funding opportunities, prioritise your time and focus on those with the strongest potential.
  • Strong organisation: The ability to manage multiple applications, deadlines and reporting requirements accurately.
  • Analytical skills: Experience of tracking funding opportunities and income, with an understanding of budgets and restricted and unrestricted funding.
  • A collaborative approach: The ability to work with colleagues to develop funding propositions and communicate the impact of our work.
  • An interest in our purpose: A motivation to help secure the resources that enable Common Purpose to deliver its work.

All applicants must also

  • Have excellent written English and verbal communication skills.
  • Be comfortable working independently and as part of a collaborative team.
  • Be confident using Microsoft Office and digital tools.
  • Understand the importance of fundraising compliance, including relevant requirements under the Code of Fundraising Practice and GDPR.
  • Be able to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Be willing to travel within the UK occasionally, as required.
  • Be committed to Common Purpose's independent and non-aligned approach to its work.

What we offer

  • Purpose: The opportunity to help fund programmes that create meaningful change for individuals, organisations and communities.
  • Ownership: The opportunity to shape and develop our fundraising activity.
  • Variety: Exposure to a diverse range of funders, organisations, sectors and partners.
  • Flexibility: A remote-first and flexible working environment.
  • Growth: The opportunity to develop new funding opportunities and build lasting partnerships.
  • A global network: The opportunity to work with colleagues, participants and partners across different countries and contexts.

About Common Purpose

Common Purpose is a global non-profit organisation working to build a more inclusive, connected and effective society.

We believe that many of the biggest challenges facing the world cannot be addressed by any one organisation, sector or community working alone. Progress depends on people with different experiences, perspectives and forms of influence understanding one another and finding new ways to work together.

For more than 37 years, we have brought people together across sectors, backgrounds and generations to challenge assumptions, build understanding and develop the ability to address complex social and organisational challenges.

Through our programmes and partnerships, we create opportunities for people to encounter different perspectives, understand the realities facing others and see beyond the boundaries of their own experience. We help people recognize the influence they hold and use it to make a positive difference.

Our work has reached more than 90,000 professionals and nearly 75,000 students worldwide.

As a non-profit, we are committed to extending the reach and impact of this work, ensuring that more people and communities can benefit from it.

Next steps

If you are a fundraiser who enjoys spotting opportunities, writing compelling applications and helping organisations secure the funding they need, we'd love to hear from you.

Please send us your CV and a cover letter explaining why you're interested in the role and what you would bring to Common Purpose. We'd particularly welcome examples of successful funding applications or funding you have secured.

We welcome applications from people interested in full-time or fractional working arrangements. If you would prefer a fractional arrangement, please tell us a little about the working pattern you have in mind.

Common Purpose is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from people from all backgrounds and will consider candidates based on the relevance of their skills, experience and potential.

If you have any access requirements during the recruitment process, please contact us at .

Salary: £40,000–£45,000 per annum, depending on experience

jobs.description:
We're looking for an Lead Generation Specialist to devise and write cold email campaigns for a fast-growing B2B sales intelligence platform serving GTM teams that sell into local and vertical SMB markets. You will own the strategy and execution of outbound email campaigns, researching ICPs and pain points, building copy angles, writing sequences that get opened and replied to, and optimizing based on results.

This is a writing-first role. You need substantial B2B outbound email experience, ideally across a wide variety of SMB verticals. You should know how to research an ICP, identify pain points that actually land, build a compelling copy angle, structure a proper sequence, and A/B test your way to better performance over time. Past campaign results are required to apply. You will be working inside the company's own in-house platform, which combines a database of businesses and contact information with an enrichment tool that functions similarly to Clay, allowing you to create customized research variables per prospect. You will also use general AI tools and web research to inform personalization and messaging. If you have the experience, can show the results, and want to own outbound campaign copy for a fast-growing B2B platform, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Work inside a fast-growing B2B sales intelligence platform with real traction and a growing SMB-focused client base
  • Access to a proprietary in-house enrichment platform with deep prospect data and customizable research variables
  • High-ownership copywriting role with direct impact on pipeline generation and campaign performance

What You'll Work On

ICP Research and Copy Strategy

  • Research ICPs, pain points, and buying triggers across a wide range of SMB verticals including HVAC, dental, restaurants, and others
  • Build copy angles that speak directly to real prospect problems rather than generic value propositions
  • Use the company's in-house enrichment platform to build customized research variables per prospect and leverage them for meaningful personalization
  • Use general AI tools and web research to deepen prospect understanding and sharpen messaging

Sequence Writing and Campaign Execution

  • Write proper cold email sequences from subject line through follow-ups that generate opens, replies, and meetings
  • Structure sequences with the right cadence, tone, and escalation logic for each vertical and ICP
  • Develop and test multiple messaging angles per campaign to identify what resonates best
  • Manage multiple active campaigns simultaneously without losing quality or attention to detail

A/B Testing and Optimization

  • A/B test subject lines, opening lines, CTAs, and sequence structures systematically
  • Analyze campaign performance data including open rates, reply rates, and positive response rates and use it to improve copy
  • Identify what is working across campaigns and apply learnings quickly to new sequences
  • Flag underperforming campaigns early and propose specific copy changes to improve results

Collaboration and Documentation

  • Work closely with the GTM and sales team to align email messaging with broader campaign goals and ICP priorities
  • Maintain organized campaign documentation including copy versions, test results, and performance notes

What You Bring

  • Substantial B2B outbound email experience with a track record of campaigns that generated real replies and meetings across a variety of SMB verticals — this is the primary requirement
  • Ability to research an ICP, identify genuine pain points, and build copy angles that land rather than generic pitches
  • Knows how to structure a proper cold email sequence and understands cadence, tone, and escalation logic
  • Strong A/B testing discipline with the ability to optimize campaigns based on real performance data rather than gut feel
  • Past campaign results to show — open rates, reply rates, meetings booked, or similar metrics are required to apply
  • Comfortable working inside a proprietary enrichment or research platform and using custom prospect data to inform personalization
  • Comfortable using AI tools and web research as part of the research and writing process
  • Excellent written English with a direct, concise, and human communication style

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Clay or a similar prospect enrichment and research platform
  • Background in outbound sales or SDR work that gives you firsthand understanding of what buyers respond to
  • Experience writing cold email for a B2B SaaS, sales intelligence, or data platform
  • Familiarity with cold email tools such as Instantly, Smartlead, or Apollo

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. Past campaign results showing performance metrics such as open rates, reply rates, or meetings booked — this is required to apply and candidates without results to share will not be considered
  3. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your B2B outbound email experience, and walking through one campaign you built from ICP research through to results

Only candidates who submit both campaign results and a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you have substantial B2B outbound email experience, can research an ICP and turn it into a campaign that actually converts, and want to own cold email copy for a fast-growing B2B platform with real traction in the SMB market, this role gives you the ownership and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

Executive Assistant – Irth Solutions

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Columbus, Ohio (Preferred); Open to Eastern and Central Time Zones

Department: G&A

Company Overview

Irth Solutions is a software product company developing innovative technology platforms designed to set industry benchmarks. With a strong product culture, collaborative work environment, and significant growth potential, Irth offers an exciting opportunity to work with modern, enterprise-scale data platforms.

Position Summary

Irth Solutions is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative support to the Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) and supplemental support to the CEO and other senior leaders.

Working closely with the existing Executive Assistant and broader administrative team, this individual will manage complex executive calendars, coordinate travel and events, track meeting agendas and action items, oversee day-to-day office operations, and develop scalable administrative processes.

The ideal candidate is detail-obsessed, able to multitask, self-directed, flexible across leadership priorities, comfortable in a fast-changing, growing organization, and trusted with confidential information. This role is well suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, growing organization and enjoys building efficient processes that support executive effectiveness.

This is a full-time position. While there is a preference for candidates within commuting distance of our headquarters in Columbus, Ohio, we are considering all Eastern and Central time zone candidates.

Key Responsibilities

1. Executive Support & Calendar Management

  • Manage complex, high-volume calendars for the CCO and supplemental support for the rest of the C-Suite leaders, including but not limited to: scheduling and coordinating meetings, conferences, and calls with internal and external parties across time zones and functions.
  • Anticipate and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts and adjustments to ensure optimal time management.
  • Prepare meeting agendas and relevant documents for all appointments and events.
  • Maintain and track executive agendas, ensuring all key meetings, deadlines, and deliverables are met.
  • Provide reminders and follow up on action items from meetings and projects.
  • Maintain files, records, and other documents for the executives, ensuring confidentiality and organization.
  • Assist with presentations, reports, and other important documents as needed.
  • Prioritize competing executive requests, exercising judgment on what should be moved, protected, delegated, or escalated.
  • Flex across additional executives and shifting leadership priorities as the organization evolves.

2. Travel & Event Coordination

  • Manage travel arrangements, accommodations, and itineraries, covering flights, lodging, ground transportation, and expense documentation.
  • Coordinate logistics for internal and external events, including company meetings, conferences, webinars, and team-building activities.
  • Ensure events run smoothly and efficiently, managing the setup, equipment, and supplies.

3. Process Improvement & Administrative Infrastructure

  • Develop and maintain administrative processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Identify opportunities for greater efficiency and automation, including through AI tools.
  • Create repeatable executive-support practices that can be shared across the team.
  • Help establish scalable administrative infrastructure as Irth grows.

4. Office Operations & Employee Experience

  • Oversee daily office operations, including office supplies, equipment maintenance, and vendor management.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and productive office environment.
  • Manage incoming and outgoing mail and packages, ensuring timely and accurate delivery.
  • Coordinate logistics for office supplies, equipment, and materials.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:

  • Ensure the CCO's calendar and schedule are organized, accurate, and aligned with business priorities.
  • Provide reliable, proactive administrative support with minimal oversight.
  • Help the CCO stay focused by anticipating needs and managing follow-through.
  • Establish strong working relationships with the existing Executive Assistant and administrative team.
  • Improve administrative workflows through documentation, consistency, and thoughtful use of technology.
  • Ensure travel, meetings, events, and office operations are handled efficiently.
  • Contribute to a scalable administrative support structure as Irth continues to grow.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C-Suite executives.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organizational and time-management skills.
  • 3-5 years experience using Microsoft products (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint) required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.
  • Ability to use AI tools such as Copilot or Claude.
  • Ability to work on-site in Columbus, OH on a hybrid schedule; or if hired as remote employee, travel as needed to support executive team (less than 15% of the year)
  • Proven ability to manage complex, high-volume calendars and prioritize competing executive requests.
  • Flexibility to support additional executives and shifting leadership priorities.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-changing, growing organization.

AI Use in Hiring

As part of our hiring process, Irth may use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated tools to assist with reviewing and screening applications. These tools are intended to support the hiring process but do not replace human judgment or decision-making. All hiring decisions involve human review.

Role Type

This is a New Position.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is USD $65,000-75,000. This range reflects the base salary only and does not include any other compensation components like OTE. Any offers made are dependent on factors including and not limited to experience, skills, and location.

Benefits

Why Join Irth?

At Irth, we believe great work happens when people have the support, flexibility, and resources they need to do their best work. As part of the Irth team, you'll enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience.
  • The opportunity to join a dynamic, growing company that is well respected within its industry.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance options.
  • A 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Flexible PTO policy and company-paid holidays.
  • Additional benefits, including life insurance, pet insurance, employee discounts, and perks programs.
  • A generous one-time work-from-home stipend to help you create a productive and comfortable remote workspace.
  • Opportunities to connect with colleagues through monthly company lunches, volunteer outings, and quarterly team gatherings.
  • Complimentary snacks, beverages, and coffee for employees visiting our Columbus, Ohio office.

At Irth, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution, collaborate with a talented team, and grow alongside an evolving technology company.

jobs.description:
If you have worked in the visa section of a U.S. Embassy or Consulate and want to bring that expertise to the private sector, this role is for you. Visa Franchise is looking for a Visa & Consular Processing Analyst to own consular expertise end to end for our clients, with a primary focus on E-2 treaty investor cases. You will be the in-house reference for how U.S. consulates work: protocols, documentation standards, appointment logistics and wait times. You will guide clients through the DS-160 and MRV steps, prepare them for their consular interview, make sure every package meets each consulate's requirements, and turn this knowledge into SOPs so it lives in the company and not in one person. This is not a legal role: Visa Franchise is not a law firm, and legal matters are handled by the independent attorney each client engages.

We are a remote-first experience done right. Join our rapidly growing team of over 20+ fully remote staff who are mostly located in Buenos Aires, Argentina. At the same time receive exceptional opportunities for career growth working on products and features with a direct impact on the success of our companies.

Required Qualifications:

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in the consular section of a U.S. Embassy or Consulate (locally engaged staff, consular assistant, or similar)
  • Demonstrated experience with E-2 treaty investor visas from the consular side, in processing or adjudication support
  • Working knowledge of the nonimmigrant visa process from the applicant side: DS-160, MRV fee payment, appointment scheduling platforms (U.S. Travel Docs / AIS), document requirements and interview logistics
  • Fully bilingual in English and Spanish, able to run client meetings and write client-facing instructions in both
  • Strong attention to detail on documentation: forms, names, dates and consistency across a case file
  • Client-facing communication skills: able to explain a high-stakes process clearly and keep clients calm and prepared
  • Highly organized, able to track dozens of cases in parallel with hard deadlines and no dropped steps
  • Comfortable with CRM and project management tools (HubSpot, Jira) and the Office 365 suite
  • Proficient in using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to support daily work and optimize workflows
  • Ability to follow and improve upon set processes in a fast-paced, flexible environment
  • Ability to work Monday to Friday within U.S. Eastern Time (ET) hours, ~9:00 to 17:30

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong ability to work and communicate with clients, prospects, attorneys and their staff
  • Experience at a U.S. consulate in Latin America, with familiarity across multiple posts
  • Additional E-2 exposure from an immigration law firm or consultancy handling E-2 caseloads
  • Exposure to other investor or business visa categories (E-1, L-1, O-1)
  • Portuguese language skills
  • Track record of writing SOPs, checklists or training material (Trainual or similar)
  • Comfort working with data: wait times, appointment availability and case throughput in spreadsheets or dashboards

Responsibilities:

  • Own the company's knowledge of U.S. consulate protocols and documentation standards, post by post, with depth on the posts that handle our E-2 volume
  • Act as the internal reference on consular operations, and communicate changes in consular requirements to the team
  • Set the standard for DS-160 and consulate-facing form accuracy, and own the final review before submission
  • Guide clients through DS-160 completion, MRV fee payment and the appointment booking platform
  • Prepare clients for the consular interview end to end, and debrief them afterwards to feed outcomes back into the knowledge base
  • Work with the package creation team and the filing attorney so each package and filing meets the specific consulate's requirements, flagging gaps before filing
  • Maintain a tracker of consular wait times and appointment availability, and optimize interview dates to shorten time to interview
  • Document consular processes into clear SOPs and checklists (Trainual), and keep case status updated in HubSpot and Jira
  • Propose and support improvements to the consular workflow

Location: Remote, Latin America. Full-time, Monday to Friday, within U.S. Eastern Time hours.

Compensation, Perks and Benefits:

  • Very competitive salary package in US dollars
  • Quarterly bonus (based on targets’ achievements) and annual profit-sharing
  • 15 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year
  • Holidays between Christmas and New Year
  • Health Benefits: health insurance and gym pass
  • English lessons
  • Work From Home (WFH) allowance setup ($500) to start then up to $500 a year to be used towards WFH equipment and services
  • Additional offerings: a dynamic work environment, a high level of autonomy, the ability to continue developing your career and skills, and clear expectations for success

Organization Description:

Our organization is comprised of two companies under one umbrella. Our team is 100% remote based, with our headquarters in the U.S. and the majority of our team located in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

Our vision is to foster the largest community of data-focused entrepreneurs and investors in the world.

  • Vetted Biz converts analytical data and complex business material into clear, easy-to-understand information to power the business buying process for new and experienced entrepreneurs alike.
  • Visa Franchise is a business consulting firm that, since 2015, has helped over 1,200 families from more than 80 countries establish their businesses and build their lives in the United States. We act as the project manager for our clients' move to the U.S., coordinating everything it involves, from business setup and immigration to real estate, banking, tax, and schools, and connecting them with a curated network of independent specialists and service providers. Visa Franchise is not a law firm; legal work is handled by independent attorneys our clients engage directly.

We have been a founder-led and self-funded organization since our initial founding in 2015, with a long-term vision to be the largest community of data-focused entrepreneurs and investors in the world.

Job Title: Clinical Lead

Job Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Overview

Clinical Leads are an integral part of clinical trial delivery, working alongside clinical teams to improve patients’ lives by bringing new drugs to the market faster. The Clinical Lead is a member of the core project team responsible for the clinical delivery of clinical studies to meet contractual requirements in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies and practices. Clinical Leads ensure clinical delivery to customers, lead clinical teams and partner with Project Leaders and other functional teams ensuring projects meet delivery requirements at all times.

Essential Functions

  • Ensure clinical delivery of assigned projects in compliance with regulatory requirements (International Conference on Harmonization (ICH)-Good Clinical Practice (GCP), protocol), customer requirements (contract), and internal requirements (policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), project plans).
  • Accountable for meeting projects’ recruitment targets and ensuring appropriate recruitment strategies are in place.
  • Contribute to the development of the project risk mitigation plan and manage clinical risks through the project’s lifecycle.
  • Ensure clinical quality delivery by identifying quality standards/requirements, planning how compliance will be measured, monitoring and overseeing management of clinical quality issues.
  • Manage clinical aspects of Project Finances including Estimate at Completion (EAC). Understand the scope of clinical delivery and create plans to deliver. Monitor and manage changes against baseline Estimate at Completion (EAC) and identify additional service opportunities or out of scope work.
  • Identify clinical stakeholder landscape for the project and manage both internal and external stakeholders through effective communication and resolution management.
  • Collaborate with the clinical team to support milestone achievements. Report to internal and external stakeholders as per project scope requirements.
  • Resourcing and Talent Planning of the clinical team. Manage the clinical team at project level to successfully deliver the project through the establishment of high-quality operational plans and guidance and project related trainings.
  • Conduct regular team meetings and communicate appropriately to achieve objectives.
  • Support professional development by providing feedback to clinical team line managers on performance relative to project tasks.
  • May contribute to the development of the clinical delivery strategy for proposals. Participate in bid defense preparations and meetings. Develop and present Clinical Operation plan in partnership with Business Development and Project Leadership.
  • May mentor and coach new peers as they assimilate into this role.
  • May work as a primary Clinical Lead alongside other Clinical Leads to deliver large, global trials.
  • May attend site visits as applicable in support of project delivery.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree Bachelor's Degree in health care or other scientific discipline required Req
  • Requires 5 years clinical research/monitoring experience or equivalent combination of education, training and experience. Req
  • Requires basic knowledge of Project management practices and terminology. Req
  • Requires good knowledge of applicable clinical research regulatory requirements i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines.; Req
  • Requires broad protocol knowledge and therapeutic knowledge.; Req
  • Requires good understanding of Clinical Research industry (drug/device/technology/etc.) and the relevant environments in which it operates. Req
  • Requires understanding of project finances. Req
  • Knowledge of clinical trials - Knowledge of clinical trial conduct in addition to skill in applying applicable clinical research regulatory requirements i.e. International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and relevant local laws, regulations and guidelines, towards clinical trial conduct.
  • Communication - Strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language.
  • Problem solving - Problem solving skills.
  • Organization - Planning, time management and prioritization skills.
  • Prioritization - Ability to handle conflicting priorities.
  • Quality - Attention to detail and accuracy in work. Results-oriented approach to work delivery and output.
  • Leadership - Good influencing and negotiation skills. Good judgment and decision-making skills. Effective mentoring and training skills, fostering learning and knowledge sharing with colleagues.
  • IT skills - Good software and computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications including but not limited to Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Collaboration - Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and clients.
  • Cross-collaboration - Ability to work across geographies displaying high awareness and understanding of cultural differences.
  • Effective communication - Ability to influence without authority.
  • IQVIA Core Competencies - Ability to demonstrate all IQVIA competencies (Client Focus, Collaboration, Communication, innovation, Ownership).

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Under the direction of the Director – Platform Technology and the Principal Platform Integration Engineer, this team member will support the direct execution and delivery of technical aspects of Mayo Clinic Platform’s technology roadmap.

  • Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of reusable platform foundations using established well-architected and secure-by-default principles.

  • Use established DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment tooling to automate delivery and ensure high availability and performance of healthcare applications.

  • Stay informed about technologies and practices relevant to platform engineering, healthcare interoperability, frontend development, and cloud operations, and contribute to the team’s evaluation of their practical value.
  • Work with product, solutions, and implementation teams to identify recurring application and integration needs and translate them into reusable platform tools, patterns, and documentation.
  • Partners with the solutions and implementation/support team to design, develop and deploy management and support tooling for all aspects of the platform’s operations. This may include things like quality monitoring tools, system action audit logs, and application telemetry.

  • Collaborate with product partners to follow established Software Development Life Cycle and Product Development Life Cycle processes, helping keep technical delivery aligned with product goals and organizational requirements.

- Experience with Interoperability standards such as HL7, FHIR and OMOP.

VivoSense is a science and technology company specializing in digital health technologies (DHTs), including wearable sensors, mobile applications, and connected monitoring tools. We partner with pharmaceutical sponsors, healthcare providers, and academic groups to develop and deliver real-world digital clinical measures backed by rigorous scientific and analytic expertise.

We are looking for an ambitious and highly motivated engineer with a passion for learning, solving complex technical challenges, and working at the intersection of science and software engineering. This role requires someone who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, evaluating technical tradeoffs, and developing practical solutions that meet business and user needs. You will help operationalize and commercialize scientific workflows by integrating algorithms, digital measures, and analytical processes into the VivoSense Platform while contributing to architecture, design, implementation, validation, and continuous improvement efforts across the product ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead technical evaluation and onboarding of new sensors and physiological data sources, including SDK/API assessment, data formats, sampling characteristics, device behavior, and integration requirements.
  • Perform physiological and sensor data-quality analysis, including completeness, sampling-rate verification, gaps, anomalies, timing issues, signal quality, and cross-sensor consistency.
  • Investigate sensor and data-pipeline issues, working with vendors, Science, and Engineering to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.
  • Prototype and validate algorithms and data-processing methods using Python and Jupyter notebooks before production implementation.
  • Translate scientific algorithms, research methods, and analytical requirements into clear technical specifications that Engineering can implement on the platform.
  • Partner with Engineering to productionize scientific algorithms and sensor-processing workflows, providing domain guidance, reference implementations, expected outputs, and validation criteria.
  • Define sensor data models, interfaces, mappings, acceptance criteria, and validation requirements for new integrations and analytical capabilities.
  • Support verification and validation of sensor integrations and analytical workflows, including comparison of expected versus platform-generated results.
  • Maintain technical documentation covering sensor characteristics, integration requirements, algorithms, data mappings, known limitations, and troubleshooting guidance.
  • Monitor changes from sensor vendors, including firmware, SDK, API, algorithm, and data-format changes, and assess their impact on the VivoSense platform.

Qualifications

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience working with physiological, wearable, biomedical, clinical, or scientific data.
  • Strong Python skills, including experience with Jupyter, pandas, NumPy, SciPy, or similar tools for data analysis and algorithm development.
  • Experience with physiological signals such as accelerometry, PPG, ECG, heart rate, HRV, temperature, sleep, or respiration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including investigating ambiguous data-quality or sensor issues and identifying root causes.
  • Ability to translate scientific methods and algorithms into technical requirements, reference implementations, and validation criteria.
  • Working knowledge of software development practices, data formats, APIs, testing, debugging, and technical documentation.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to move scientific workflows or algorithms into production systems.
  • Familiarity with AWS/cloud platforms and distributed data-processing systems is preferred.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across Science, Data Science, Product, Quality, Engineering, and external partners.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working in regulated healthcare, clinical research, or medical-device environments such as FDA, GxP, ISO 13485, or 21 CFR Part 11.
  • Familiarity with C#/.NET, R, cloud platforms, or modern software delivery practices is a plus.

$130,000 - $160,000 annual USD (DOE and Location)

  • Direct access to senior leadership

jobs.title: Technical Solution Architect
jobs.excerpt: Ciklum is looking for a Technical Solution Architect to join our team full-time in Ukraine.
jobs.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Technical Solution Architect to join our team full-time in Ukraine.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Technical Solution Architect, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Our client is a leading global payments platform that connects businesses and consumers across 260 payment types in over 40 countries. With over 20 years of experience and an annual transaction volume exceeding $150 billion, it is a powerhouse in digital wallets, eCash solutions, and merchant acquiring.

In 2026, our client is undergoing a massive AI transformation. You will be joining the Intelligent Automation & AI Engineering initiative with the goal of replacing manual decision-making workflows with reliable, auditable AI-assisted systems.

You will work in an automation COE, collaborating with a centralised AI Platform team, IT, Dev Ops etc.

Responsibilities:

  • Design end-to-end AI-powered solutions, defining architecture, technology choices, integrations, and deployment approaches
  • Build prototypes, AI agents, automations, and production-ready solutions using modern AI technologies
  • Design and improve AI-assisted development workflows, develop reusable agent skills, engineering standards, and automation frameworks
  • Design, deploy, and optimize Azure infrastructure for AI applications, ensuring scalability, security, and cost efficiency
  • Transform business ideas into working prototypes, validate assumptions, and iterate quickly based on feedback
  • Connect AI solutions with enterprise platforms, internal APIs, databases, and business systems
  • Own technical decisions and proactively identify challenges, driving solutions from concept through delivery
  • Work directly with business stakeholders, understand business challenges, and translate requirements into practical technical solutions
  • Establish reusable architecture patterns, security guardrails, and engineering best practices
  • Research emerging AI technologies, evaluate new tools, and identify opportunities to accelerate engineering and business processes
  • Mentor engineers, document reusable solutions, and help teams adopt AI-assisted development practices
  • Take responsibility for technical outcomes, troubleshoot blockers, and proactively coordinate across teams to ensure delivery

Requirements:

  • Strong experience designing end-to-end enterprise solutions, including integrations, APIs, authentication, data flows, and cloud infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Functions, App Services, Storage, Key Vault, Entra ID, networking, and identity management
  • Practical experience building LLM-powered applications, AI agents, tool calling, RAG, and multi-step workflows
  • Strong experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Claude Code, including agent instructions, skills, and automated development workflows
  • Strong development background in at least one programming language: Python, C#, or TypeScript, and experience building production-ready applications
  • Experience connecting enterprise systems using REST APIs, MCP, webhooks, and workflow automation
  • Ability to turn ambiguous business requirements into working prototypes quickly, validate assumptions, and iterate based on feedback
  • Understanding of enterprise security, RBAC, managed identities, secrets management, and secure AI solution design
  • Ability to independently drive technical initiatives from discovery through implementation and deployment
  • Strong English communication skills, comfortable working directly with business stakeholders and explaining technical decisions
  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and Microsoft Graph API
  • Familiarity with Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar agent orchestration frameworks
  • Experience designing reusable AI agent skills, custom instructions, MCP servers, and agentic SDLC workflows
  • Experience with Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, and automated cloud provisioning
  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Docker, and automated deployment pipelines
  • Experience integrating SharePoint, Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Teams, and other enterprise platforms
  • Knowledge of LLM evaluation, prompt optimization, tracing, monitoring, and cost management
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as financial services, with security, compliance, and governance constraints
  • Experience mentoring engineers, creating reusable engineering standards, and enabling teams to adopt new technologies
  • Experience exploring emerging AI technologies, running technical experiments, and turning successful prototypes into reusable solutions
  • Highly proactive and initiative-driven, takes initiative, challenges existing approaches, and proactively identifies opportunities for improvement
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, thrives in a fast-paced R&D environment with evolving requirements and uncertainty
  • Strong builder mentality, prefers experimenting, prototyping, and validating ideas rather than spending excessive time on theoretical discussions
  • Passionate about AI, actively explores emerging AI tools and technologies and applies them in real-world scenarios
  • Independent and accountable, makes technical decisions and takes ownership without requiring constant guidance
  • Scalability-oriented, thinks beyond individual tasks and focuses on creating scalable, reusable solutions that benefit multiple teams
  • Pragmatic engineering mindset, balances speed of delivery with engineering quality, security, and maintainability
  • Collaborative, enjoys working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Flexibility: Enjoy radical flexibility – work remotely or from an office, your choice
  • Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

As one of Ukraine’s largest IT companies and a top employer recognized by Forbes, we’ve spent over 20 years delivering meaningful tech solutions. We proudly support diverse talent and military veterans, recognizing their unique skills and perspectives they bring to shaping the future.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

jobs.description:
About Jorie:

Jorie AI, occupies a uniquely interconnected position at the center of the healthcare industry. An inseparable part of today's healthcare billing ecosystem, with leading edge technology that is driving transformation with AI infused Robotic Process Automation for end-to-end Revenue Cycle Management, providing practice and financial management services to the healthcare industry. Applied Intelligence, Better Insight, Accelerated Efficiencies with Jorie AI.

Our work environment:

Growth advancement opportunities

Flexible work environment (Work-life Balance)

Collaborative and friendly company culture

Great Benefits:

401(k) matching up to 4%

Medical

Dental

Vision

Long/Short Term Disability insurance

Life insurance $25,000 Paid by employer

PTO 2 weeks

10 and half Holidays

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design and deliver software for healthcare and other regulated industries, covering automation, web applications, and platform services. You will take loosely defined client needs and turn them into working, production-ready solutions. That could be an automation workflow, a backend service, a web application, or a customer deployment. You will set technical direction, make architecture decisions, and mentor engineers across the team. You will work directly with clients, operations teams, and SMEs, and own your work from the first conversation through production support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Requirements to Solution: Turn loose or incomplete client requirements into clear scope, a working design, and delivered software. Ask the right questions early, surface gaps and edge cases, and propose options with their tradeoffs.
  • Technical Leadership: Set technical direction and engineering standards across automation, backend, and web work.
  • Architecture: Design services, automation, and data flows that bridge legacy systems and modern platforms, and document the tradeoffs behind each decision.
  • Backend and APIs: Design and build Python services and APIs (e.g., FastAPI) that are typed, tested, and easy to extend.
  • Web Applications: Build or guide web applications and internal tools, and partner with front-end engineers on API contracts and user workflows.
  • Automation: Lead the design of browser, desktop, and computer-vision automation (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, OpenCV, OCR) that holds up through application changes.
  • Integrations: Own integrations with third-party systems, APIs, and client interfaces, including data mapping and error handling.
  • Data and SQL: Design schemas, migrations, and queries that stay fast and correct as volume grows.
  • Reliability: Design for failure with retries, recovery of partial work, and safe concurrent processing.
  • Deployment and Operations: Own how your systems are built, deployed, and run, including CI/CD, containers, and cloud or customer-hosted environments. Lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
  • Client Communication: Act as a technical contact for client IT and business teams, and explain tradeoffs and constraints in plain terms.
  • Scoping and Estimation: Assess new work for feasibility, break it into deliverable phases, and give effort estimates.
  • AI/ML: Evaluate where AI/ML and LLM tools add real value, and lead their introduction into production.
  • Compliance and Security: Own secure credential handling, access control, logging, and audit practices in line with HIPAA and HITRUST.
  • Documentation: Write design, deployment, and operations documentation that others can follow without you.
  • Mentorship: Grow Software Engineer I and II teammates through code review, design review, pairing, and technical guidance.
  • Hiring and Culture: Take part in hiring and technical interviews, and help shape engineering practices across the team.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years of professional software development experience.
  • Expert proficiency in Python, including production-grade design, testing, and performance tuning.
  • A proven record of taking loosely defined requirements to working production solutions.
  • Experience designing and building backend services and APIs.
  • Strong SQL skills, including schema design, migrations, query performance, and concurrency.
  • Experience owning systems in production: deployment, monitoring, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
  • Experience with CI/CD and containerized deployment (e.g., Docker).
  • Experience integrating with third-party systems and APIs.
  • Direct client- or stakeholder-facing experience, including explaining technical decisions to non-technical audiences.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical work across a team.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA or similar data privacy requirements, and secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Proficiency with Git, including branching strategies and code review practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience with React and TypeScript.
  • Production experience with Selenium, Playwright, or other browser automation.
  • Experience with OpenCV, OCR, or image processing.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Helm, or OpenShift.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure or another cloud platform.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL or SQL Server.
  • Experience with authentication and identity (e.g., OIDC, SAML, Keycloak).
  • Experience with task queues, distributed processing, or managing a fleet of workers.
  • Experience with healthcare RCM workflows, healthcare data standards (X12 EDI, HL7), or EHR integrations.
  • Experience in regulated or federal environments (e.g., HITRUST, FedRAMP, Section 508 / WCAG).
  • Experience bringing AI/ML or LLM tools into production.
  • Experience with logging, alerting, and observability tools.
  • PowerShell scripting and Windows environment experience.

Must be legally authorized to work in the USA. No Contractors, No C2C, No Visa Sponsorship

No recruiting agencies.

Remote in USA Only. We cannot consider candidates from New York, California, or Washington state

Mon-Fri 8:00 AM to 5:00 PMCST

Flexible working hours may be required based on business

jobs.description:
Overview

This is a remote role that may be hired in several markets across the United States. Priority given to those candidates located in Raleigh, North Carolina, Phoenix, Arizona and Dallas, Texas.

We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Engineer to join our Data Platform Engineering Organization and lead the design, development, and modernization of enterprise data platforms that power analytics, reporting, business intelligence, and operational decision-making across the organization.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on data engineering leader with expertise in cloud-based data platforms, data warehousing, ETL/ELT development, and modern data engineering practices. This individual will be responsible for delivering scalable data solutions utilizing AWS Services, Snowflake, dbt, Python, SQL, and related technologies while mentoring team members and driving engineering excellence.

As part of our growing Cloud Data and AI Platform organization, you will lead and collaborate with a talented team of engineers, product partners, and business stakeholders to deliver enterprise data products and cloud-based data solutions. This role offers the opportunity to mentor engineering talent, drive engineering best practices, and support the adoption of modern data engineering capabilities across the organization.


Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties and Responsibilities:

The successful candidate will have experience working in large enterprise environments and partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver trusted data products that support strategic business objectives.

  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise data solutions utilizing AWS Services, Snowflake, dbt, Python, SQL, and related cloud technologies.
  • Develop and support data warehouses, Operational Data Stores (ODS), and ETL/ELT pipelines that enable analytics, reporting, and operational data capabilities.
  • Design and implement batch and real-time data processing solutions using modern streaming and event-driven architectures.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, analysts, and technology teams to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
  • Define and promote data quality strategies, testing standards, governance practices, and compliance controls across the data platform lifecycle.
  • Establish enterprise testing practices, including data validation frameworks, dbt testing standards, and quality controls to support trusted data products.
  • Define monitoring, observability, and operational reliability standards, including dashboards, alerts, service-level objectives (SLOs), and service-level agreements (SLAs) for enterprise data platforms.
  • Establish deployment strategies, environment promotion standards, and release governance practices that support secure and reliable delivery across enterprise data platforms.
  • Contribute to technical discussions, peer reviews, and knowledge-sharing initiatives across the data engineering team.
  • Leverage AI-powered development and productivity tools to accelerate solution delivery, improve code quality, and enhance engineering productivity

Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree and 6 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, Cloud Data Platforms, or related technology disciplines.

OR

High School Diploma or GED and 10 years of experience in the same areas.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Advanced experience with modern data warehousing and large-scale data processing technologies such as Snowflake, Spark, or equivalent platforms.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Advanced experience designing, developing, orchestrating, and supporting ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration solutions using tools such as dbt, Apache Airflow, Astronomer, or equivalent cloud-native data engineering technologies.
  • Advanced experience with data modeling, data warehousing, and data engineering best practices.
  • Experience designing, developing, and supporting scalable, reliable, and high-performing data engineering solutions in enterprise environments.
  • Experience collaborating with business and technology stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Following qualifications are a plus

  • Advanced experience with enterprise ETL/ELT tools such as DataStage, SAP BODS, SSIS, Informatica, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience developing and supporting Operational Data Stores (ODS), analytics platforms, and data products.
  • Experience with Snowflake Cortex, Change Data Capture (CDC), streaming, and real-time data ingestion technologies including Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Qlik Replicate, Snow pipe Streaming, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience integrating data across AWS, on-premises, and Snowflake environments, with exposure to enterprise security, governance, and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience with Data Vault modeling and modern data warehousing methodologies.
  • Experience leading technical initiatives, mentoring team members, and promoting engineering best practices.
  • Experience within Financial Services, Banking, or other highly regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with Tableau, Power BI, or other analytics and visualization platforms.
  • Experience using AI-powered development and productivity tools to improve engineering efficiency and delivery outcomes.

jobs.excerpt: Ciklum is looking for a proactive Senior/Lead Full Stack AI Engineer to join our team in Brazil.
jobs.description:
Ciklum is looking for a proactive Senior/Lead Full Stack AI Engineer to join our team in Brazil.

About the role:

As a Senior/Lead Full Stack AI Engineer, you'll become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experience of tomorrow.

In this role, you will bring a broad technical perspective and adapt across modern stacks, building scalable React/TypeScript interfaces, resilient Python backend services, and integrating production-grade LLM capabilities on AWS. You will be an AI champion within the engineering organization, elevating developer productivity and delivery excellence.

Responsibilities:

  • Full-Stack Development: Design, implement, and maintain high-performance, robust frontend applications with modern React, TypeScript, and Node.js monorepo tooling
  • Backend & Automation: Develop scalable backend services, automation scripts, and evaluation pipelines primarily using Python
  • LLM Production Features: Build, test, and ship production-ready LLM features (prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, long-context handling)
  • Evaluations & Quality Gates: Define and implement robust evaluation (eval) frameworks to gate releases, analyze non-deterministic failure modes, and iterate based on benchmark metrics
  • Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure: Design, configure, and maintain infrastructure on AWS (leveraging both serverless tools and compute/container components like ECS/EKS, VPC networking, and IAM) safely managed via Terraform (IaC)
  • Data Management: Work hands-on with both SQL and NoSQL databases, executing schema evolutions and zero-downtime production migrations
  • Observability & Reliability: Set up granular metrics, structured logs, and alerts for distributed/non-deterministic architectures; lead production incident troubleshooting and root-cause analysis
  • CI/CD & Delivery: Maintain and enhance automated CI/CD pipelines (preferably GitLab CI/CD) ensuring rapid, reliable deployments
  • AI Advocacy & Culture: Champion AI-assisted engineering tools (Copilot, Cursor, LLM APIs) and best practices across the team to drive engineering efficiency and knowledge sharing
  • Technical Alignment: Collaborate closely with team members and stakeholders, articulating architectural trade-offs and driving clarity in technical decisions

Requirements:

  • Full-stack & Versatility: Broad technical perspective with an emphasis on adaptability across modern software stacks and architectures, favoring breadth and quick ramp-up over narrow specialization
  • Frontend & TypeScript: Strong production experience with modern React and TypeScript (including Node.js, asynchronous patterns, comprehensive testing, and monorepo tooling)
  • Backend & Scripting: Working proficiency with Python for backend services, evaluations, data analysis, and automation tooling
  • AWS Beyond Serverless: Practical hands-on experience across the AWS ecosystem—extending beyond serverless (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, Bedrock) to broader architectural components such as containers (ECS/EKS), networking, compute, and IAM
  • LLM Features in Production: Proven track record of shipping features leveraging LLM APIs (prompts, tool calling, structured outputs, long context), with the ability to describe the evals that gated releases, failure modes encountered, and iterations deployed
  • AI Champion Mindset: Enthusiastic, proactive embrace of AI-assisted engineering tools in daily workflows (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, LLM APIs), combined with the drive to champion AI-first practices across the team
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Ability to read, understand, and safely modify Terraform configurations across environments
  • Data & Persistence: Hands-on experience with both NoSQL and SQL data stores, including schema changes and live-system migrations
  • Observability: Ability to design metrics, logs, and alarms tailored for non-deterministic systems, effectively debugging production issues from telemetry data
  • CI/CD: Proficiency with modern CI/CD pipelines, ideally GitLab CI/CD
  • Communication: Upper-intermediate or fluent written and spoken English, with strong skills in articulating trade-offs and aligning cross-functional teams around technical decisions

Desirable:

  • Hands-on experience with multi-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or specialized LLM evaluation frameworks
  • Practical understanding of LLM cost control strategies (model routing, prompt caching, token budgets, rate-limiting)
  • Knowledge of prompt-injection defenses and agentic security patterns
  • Experience building or consuming internal APIs using GraphQL
  • Experience in code intelligence or semantic retrieval workflows (indexing, symbol/AST search, knowledge bundles)
  • Practical exposure to Kubernetes, AWS AppSync, and AWS EventBridge
  • Automated testing with Playwright or Cucumber
  • Certifications such as Claude Certified Developer or Claude Certified Architect (Anthropic)

What’s in it for you?

  • Care: your mental and physical health is our priority. We ensure comprehensive company-paid medical insurance and mental health programs, 5 undocumented sick-leave days per year
  • Tailored education path: boost your skills and knowledge with our regular internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy license, language courses and company-paid certifications
  • Growth environment: share your experience and level up your expertise with a community of skilled professionals, locally and globally
  • Long-term employment with 20 working-days paid vacation and local bank holidays
  • Flexibility: 100% remote work mode
  • Opportunities: we value our specialists and always find the best options for them. Our Internal Mobility Program helps change a project if needed to help you grow, excel professionally and fulfill your potential
  • Global impact: work on large-scale projects that redefine industries with international and fast-growing clients
  • Welcoming environment: feel empowered with a friendly team, open-door policy, informal atmosphere within the company and regular team-building events

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

As we expand into Latin America, every Ciklumer is helping to shape our story. Collaborate with seasoned experts and make a global impact backed by two decades of industry leadership.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

  • doświadczeniem w integracji CMS z zewnętrznymi systemami i usługami,

  • doświadczeniem w technicznym prowadzeniu zespołu, nadzorowaniu jakości dostarczanego rozwiązania oraz prowadzeniu code review,

  • praktycznym doświadczeniem w pracy z AI-assisted development / agentic coding, np. Claude Code lub podobnymi narzędziami, oraz weryfikowaniu jakości kodu wytwarzanego przy ich wsparciu,

  • umiejętnością podejmowania i uzasadniania kluczowych decyzji architektonicznych oraz świadomego analizowania trade-offów,

  • doświadczeniem w prowadzeniu warsztatów technicznych i współpracy z architektami oraz interesariuszami po stronie klienta,

  • podejmowanie kluczowych decyzji dotyczących struktury i schematów komponentów oraz sposobu organizacji treści,

  • definiowanie standardów technicznych oraz nadzorowanie jakości dostarczanego kodu poprzez regularne code review,

  • organizowanie i prowadzenie agent-assisted delivery oraz weryfikowanie rezultatów pracy wykonywanej przy wsparciu agentów AI,
